AI.method: 规划器基于四项原则：使用粗略物体模板、采用人类抓取类型、进行物体中心交互、以柔顺滑动接触代替预设接触点；通过虚拟模型控制实现，并在Shadow灵巧手上评估。
AI.result: 无反馈条件下，规划闭合运动可容忍约1厘米尺寸误差以及数厘米和数十度的位姿误差，在27个测试条件中的25个优于最先进的数据驱动规划器；对80个日常物体抓取成功率为82.5%，并在自主流程中取得成功。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性可以设计到闭合运动本身中，而不仅依赖反馈；该规划器为不确定环境下的可靠操作开辟了路径，后续将结合物理手上的自适应反馈控制。

title: Mammography Foundation Models for Opportunistic Prediction of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events
summary: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains the leading cause of death among women, yet cardiovascular risk assessment often relies on clinical variables that may be missing, outdated, or unavailable in routine care. Screening mammography offers an opportunity for opportunistic cardiovascular risk stratification because it is routinely acquired and contains vascular features, including breast arterial calcifications (BAC), that are associated with cardiovascular risk and events. We evaluate whether mammography specific foundation models, originally pretrained for breast cancer-related tasks, can transfer to cardiovascular risk prediction without cardiovascular specific supervision or explicit BAC annotation. We constructed a 5-year major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE) cohort of 22,497 women linked to electronic health record outcomes, including 500 events (2.22% prevalence). The foundation models achieved AUROCs of 0.823 and 0.822 substantially exceeding an age-only model (AUROC 0.765), despite using only the screening mammogram as input, with no clinical variables. Both foundation models evaluated assigned substantially higher predicted risk to patients with radiologist-documented BAC, despite BAC never being used as a training label, and showed activation patterns consistent with vascular findings. Together, these findings suggest that mammography foundation models can recover clinically relevant cardiovascular risk information directly from mammographic pixels and suggest that screening mammography may provide an opportunistic source of cardiovascular risk information to complement conventional clinical assessment without additional imaging. Code is available in https://github.com/PauFeld/MammoCVD

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了原本用于乳腺癌任务的乳腺X线摄影基础模型，能否在不使用心血管监督信号或钙化标注的情况下，直接从筛查性乳腺X线图像中预测女性5年主要不良心血管事件风险。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病是女性首要死因，但常规心血管风险评估依赖可能缺失、过时或不可用的临床变量。筛查性乳腺X线摄影常规开展，且包含与心血管风险相关的血管特征（如乳腺动脉钙化），因此有望用于机会性心血管风险分层。
AI.method: 构建了22,497名女性、随访5年的MACE队列，并与电子健康记录结局链接，其中500例事件，患病率2.22%。使用乳腺X线摄影基础模型，仅以筛查性乳腺X线图像为输入，不提供临床变量，也不进行心血管特异性监督或显式BAC标注，评估其对MACE的预测能力，并与仅使用年龄的模型比较。
AI.result: 基础模型达到AUROC 0.823和0.822，显著超过仅使用年龄的模型（AUROC 0.765）。尽管BAC从未作为训练标签，两个模型均对放射科医生记录的BAC患者赋予显著更高的预测风险，且激活模式与血管表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 乳腺X线摄影基础模型能够直接从图像像素中恢复具有临床相关性的心血管风险信息，提示筛查性乳腺X线摄影可作为机会性心血管风险信息来源，在无需额外影像的情况下补充传统临床评估。代码已公开于https://github.com/PauFeld/MammoCVD。

title: Efficient Unified Multimodal Understanding (EUMU): Winning Solution for the MUMU Track at the 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: The Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) Challenge requires a single efficient model to jointly perform multi-concept image tagging, open-vocabulary object detection, and image captioning. We present Efficient Unified Multimodal Understanding (EUMU), the winning solution for the MUMU Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge. EUMU builds on a shared pretrained multimodal model, using its prompt-based capabilities for detection and captioning and training lightweight heads on shared visual features to predict quality, scene, and event tags. Rather than treating the three tasks independently, EUMU applies task-aware inference refinement by reusing task outputs as cross-task cues. For detection, caption cues help recover objects missed by the initial detection. For captioning, detection cues help refine the caption to better reflect the detected objects. For tagging, image statistics refine quality predictions, while caption and detection cues refine scene and event predictions. This design unifies all three tasks within a single model while satisfying the challenge's resource constraints. EUMU contains 239.169M parameters, requires 23.947 GFLOPs, uses 4.5 GB of peak inference memory, and achieves a final challenge score of 17.3409. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Dayoung-Kil/EUMU.

AI.tldr: EUMU是第8届LSVOS挑战赛MUMU赛道的冠军方案，使用单一高效多模态模型统一完成多概念图像标注、开放词汇目标检测和图像描述。
AI.motivation: MUMU挑战要求用单个高效模型同时执行多概念图像标注、开放词汇目标检测和图像描述，并满足严格的计算与内存资源限制。
AI.method: 基于共享预训练多模态模型，利用其提示能力进行检测和描述，并在共享视觉特征上训练轻量头预测质量、场景和事件标签；采用任务感知推理优化，跨任务复用输出作为线索，例如用描述线索找回漏检目标、用检测线索细化描述、用图像统计和描述/检测线索优化标注预测。
AI.result: 模型包含239.169M参数，需要23.947 GFLOPs，峰值推理内存4.5 GB，最终挑战赛得分为17.3409，并获得MUMU赛道冠军。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨任务线索复用和统一模型设计，EUMU在单一模型内统一了三种多模态理解任务，同时满足挑战赛的资源约束。

title: Neo-Classic: A Benchmark for Evaluating Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning in Classical Chinese Poetry
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), 2026
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high accuracy on established Classical Chinese Poetry benchmarks, it remains challenging to distinguish transferable Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning from reliance on familiar pre-training patterns. To address this issue, we introduce Neo-Classic, an evaluation benchmark that combines a constructionist Out-of-Sample (OOS) dataset with a suite of reverse understanding probes. Unlike traditional benchmarks that rely on verification or generation over historical corpora, Neo-Classic comprises strictly metrical poetry authored by contemporary experts, reducing the possibility of direct retrieval. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, including Qwen3-Max, Gemini-3-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.2, across five behavioral probes designed to test hierarchical constraint satisfaction. Our results reveal two primary limitations. First, a performance gap of 20 to 50 percent emerges when models transition from historical to contemporary texts. Second, models exhibit substantial difficulties in discourse-level ordering tasks, with standard accuracy remaining low (0 to 13 percent). Although expert-level guidance improves the performance of reasoning-enhanced models to 36 percent, a notable gap with human experts persists. These findings suggest that while current LLMs capture local formal patterns, they struggle with global hierarchical planning required for robust Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Neo-Classic 基准，用当代专家创作的严格格律诗和反向理解探针，评估大语言模型在古典诗词中的语言审美推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有古典诗词基准上 LLM 准确率虽高，但难以区分其真正具备可迁移的语言审美推理，还是依赖预训练中熟悉的模式。
AI.method: 构建 Neo-Classic：结合建构主义式样本外数据集与反向理解探针；采用当代专家创作的严格格律诗，降低直接检索可能；在五类行为探针上评估 Qwen3-Max、Gemini-3-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2 等先进模型，测试层级约束满足能力。
AI.result: 模型从历史文本迁移到当代文本时性能下降 20% 至 50%；篇章级排序任务表现很差，标准准确率仅 0% 至 13%；专家级提示可将推理增强模型提升至 36%，但仍与人类专家存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 能捕捉局部形式模式，但在稳健语言审美推理所需的全局层级规划方面仍有困难。

title: Stop Removing Stopwords: How an Inherited Preprocessing Default Distorts Legal Text-as-Data
summary: Empirical legal scholarship increasingly treats judicial text as data, and much of it still runs on sparse, interpretable pipelines -- TF-IDF features and linear classifiers -- because the textual feature is often the object of study, not merely a means to a prediction. Yet these pipelines inherit a chain of preprocessing defaults from mid-century information retrieval that were never validated against classification accuracy, the most entrenched being stopword removal. This study introduces an exhaustive single-word ablation that measures a preprocessing step's effect directly against the downstream objective, and applies it to stopword removal as the hardest case to dislodge. Matching Supreme Court Database labels to Caselaw Access Project opinion texts, it examines two binary tasks that bracket F1 headroom, ideological direction (no-removal baseline F1 ~ 0.68) and constitutional versus non-constitutional law type (~ 0.92), across 7,668 and 7,001 opinions. For each task the analysis approximates the best stoplist any expert could build, removing each of roughly 18,500 candidate words and measuring the effect directly. Three findings follow: generic stoplists in common use fall below the no-removal baseline in every test; even optimized stoplists are statistically indistinguishable from removing nothing; and meta-models trained on word-level features cannot predict which removals help, so list curation has nothing to target. The method generalizes to any inherited preprocessing default, and the result is a caution specific to interpretable legal text-as-data: a step that silently reshapes which features a model sees can distort the very doctrinal and ideological signal such research exists to recover. Leaving stopwords in place is a question of measurement validity.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过穷举单字消融实验，检验停用词移除对法律文本分类任务的影响，发现常用停用词表反而降低性能，最优停用词表与不移除无显著差异，且无法预测哪些词移除有益。
AI.motivation: 法律文本作为数据的研究常沿用信息检索的预处理默认设置（如停用词移除），但这些默认从未针对分类准确率验证；文本特征本身是研究对象，预处理可能扭曲信号。
AI.method: 使用美国最高法院数据库标签与Caselaw Access Project意见文本，构建两个二分类任务（意识形态方向，F1约0.68；宪法与非宪法法律类型，F1约0.92），对每个任务进行单字消融：移除约18,500个候选词，直接测量对下游目标的影响，并近似专家可构建的最佳停用词表。
AI.result: 常用停用词表在所有测试中均低于不移除基线；优化停用词表与不移除统计上无差异；基于词级特征的元模型无法预测哪些移除有益。
AI.conclusion: 停用词移除等预处理默认会悄然改变模型所见特征，可能扭曲法律文本研究旨在恢复的教义和意识形态信号；保留停用词是测量效度问题。方法可推广至其他继承的预处理默认。

title: Compression Hurts, Pooling Helps: Information Loss in Rayleigh-Scale Estimation from B-Mode Ultrasound
summary: Clinical B-mode images are widely available as potential data sources for quantitative ultrasound (QUS) analysis for tissue characterization. However, standard clinical ultrasound devices apply unknown log-compression to RF envelope data before display and storage. Previous work has demonstrated estimation of the underlying RF envelope statistics in the presence of an unknown compression law. Using Fisher information analysis, we show that finite-offset log compression causes severe information loss when estimating the Rayleigh scale $σ$, which controls diffuse speckle. For a single image window, unknown compression raises the minimum achievable variance for unbiased estimation of $σ$ by a compression-independent factor of approximately $\FisherMinInflation$. When $M$ equal-sized windows share the same unknown compression settings, the excess variance decays as $1/M$; even in the most favorable regime, reducing the variance inflation factor below $1.1$ requires $\FisherBestCaseWindows$ windows. Our analysis treats the contrast parameter $a$ as unknown and the boundary offset $b$ as known; estimating $b$ experimentally shows even larger variance. We validate this theory using synthetic estimation experiments and demonstrate RF-scale recovery on real RF-envelope windows from the OASBUD dataset. Together, these results clarify the limitations of using routine B-mode images for QUS.

AI.tldr: 本文分析常规B模式超声图像用于定量超声（QUS）时的信息损失问题，重点研究未知对数压缩对RF包络统计参数估计的影响。
AI.motivation: 临床B模式图像广泛可得，是QUS组织表征的潜在数据源；但标准设备在显示和存储前会对RF包络数据施加未知的对数压缩，导致参数估计困难。
AI.method: 使用Fisher信息分析，在未知压缩律下估计RF包络统计；将对比度参数a视为未知、边界偏移b视为已知，并通过合成实验及OASBUD真实RF包络数据验证。
AI.result: 有限偏移对数压缩会严重损失估计Rayleigh尺度σ的信息；单个图像窗口下，未知压缩使无偏估计σ的最小方差按压缩无关因子约FisherMinInflation增大；M个等大窗口共享同一未知压缩时，额外方差按1/M衰减，但即使最有利情形，将方差膨胀因子降至1.1以下也需约FisherBestCaseWindows个窗口；若实验估计b，方差更大。
AI.conclusion: 常规B模式图像用于QUS存在固有局限，未知对数压缩会显著降低RF包络统计参数估计精度。

title: Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, under review for ICRA 2027
summary: Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length. Project page with videos https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoM-Nav，一种用于人形机器人多楼层、多层级无地图导航的分层强化学习策略，并在 Unitree G1 上实现了超过 10 米垂直位移和 100 米路径长度的导航。
AI.motivation: 标准单阶段强化学习导航流程难以扩展到多层级和多楼层地形，主要瓶颈在于人形机器人与复杂地形（如楼梯）的交互非常困难。
AI.method: 将导航问题分解为两步：先训练一个基于降阶动力学但使用完整 3D LiDAR 观测的策略，用于复杂多楼层地形导航；再利用该导航知识启动一个基于全阶人形动力学的策略，并在回路中冻结运动控制策略。此外，对导航策略输出应用泊松安全滤波器，以在分布外障碍物下恢复安全性。
AI.result: 所得 RoM-Nav 策略在 Unitree G1 上实现了无地图多楼层导航，测试中垂直位移超过 10 米、路径长度超过 100 米。泊松安全滤波器在不降低导航成功率的情况下，提升了分布外障碍物下的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将导航分解为降阶与全阶两阶段学习，并引入安全滤波，可以使人形机器人完成复杂多楼层无地图导航，克服单阶段强化学习难以扩展的问题。

title: Demystifying Linear Operator Learning for Control Systems
comment: accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control; authors' version
summary: This paper proposes a structured approach to learning linear operators for control systems from data. We address both structural and learning-theoretic aspects of the problem. To derive structural assumptions, we propose using the well-established framework of (semi)groups for evolution equations, as operators in control systems are of the same type. Further, we propose analyzing learning algorithms through the lens of the inverse problems framework. This reveals how a learned model depends on the data via error decompositions, convergence guarantees, and optimal regularization -- enabling us to compare existing methods and derive provably advantageous algorithms. In order to obtain these results, we restrict our scope to bounded operators on Hilbert spaces. Although this may appear restrictive, existing approaches often make this assumption implicitly to obtain matrix-like representations. We demonstrate the power of using these frameworks by deriving a convergent estimator for time-varying systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从数据学习控制系统线性算子的结构化方法，结合（半）群框架与逆问题学习理论，并在希尔伯特空间有界算子假设下为时变系统导出收敛估计器。
AI.motivation: 控制系统中的算子与演化方程算子类型相同，但现有数据驱动线性算子学习方法缺乏结构假设与学习理论保证，且常隐含矩阵化假设；需要统一框架来比较方法并设计更优算法。
AI.method: 利用（半）群框架刻画演化方程的结构假设；将学习算法置于逆问题框架中分析，进行误差分解、收敛性分析和最优正则化；研究范围限定为希尔伯特空间上的有界算子。
AI.result: 揭示了学习模型如何依赖数据，给出误差分解、收敛保证与最优正则化；可比较现有方法并推导出具有可证明优势的算法；为时变系统导出一个收敛估计器。
AI.conclusion: 所提结构化和理论框架有效，虽有界算子假设看似限制，但与现有矩阵化做法一致；该框架能指导控制系统线性算子的数据驱动学习并得到收敛估计。

title: Bifurcation Beyond Surface-Tangential Asymptotic Convergence in Continuous Sliding Mode Control
summary: For second-order systems under continuous sliding mode control (SMC), the literature has long relied, largely through phase-portrait illustrations, on the implicit convention that the phase-plane trajectory approaches the equilibrium along a direction tangential to the designed sliding surface. This paper investigates this tangential convergence assumption through a rigorous phase-plane analysis of the double-integrator system subject to standard linear SMC. We reveal that the asymptotic state ratio is not unique but instead exhibits a bifurcation that depends on the control gains, the sliding surface parameter, and the initial conditions. The key finding is that the system may converge along an implicit secondary manifold rather than aligning with the designed sliding surface, implying that smooth entry is not globally guaranteed. We derive closed-form expressions for the convergence ratios and establish a classification framework that precisely characterizes when the smooth-entry assumption holds and when it fails. The analysis is further extended to classical PD control, and we show that the bifurcation threshold coincides with the critical damping boundary that separates the two convergence regimes. These findings bridge terminal geometry and convergence smoothness, providing a predictive framework for high-performance motion control design. Simulation results validate the proposed classification of convergence regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过严格相平面分析，研究二阶系统在连续滑模控制下沿滑模面切向收敛这一隐含假设，发现渐近状态比存在分岔，系统可能收敛到隐式次级流形而非设计滑模面。
AI.motivation: 文献长期依赖相轨迹图隐含认为二阶连续滑模控制下轨迹会沿设计滑模面切向趋于平衡点，但该切向收敛/平滑进入假设缺乏严格验证。
AI.method: 针对双积分器系统在标准线性滑模控制下进行相平面分析，推导收敛比的闭式表达，并建立分类框架；进一步扩展至经典PD控制。
AI.result: 渐近状态比不唯一，取决于控制增益、滑模面参数和初始条件；系统可能沿隐式次级流形收敛，平滑进入并非全局保证。PD控制下分岔阈值与临界阻尼边界一致。仿真验证了收敛区域分类。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了终端几何与收敛平滑性之间的联系，为高性能运动控制设计提供了可预测的收敛分类框架。

title: ParticleSplat: Self-supervised Object-centric Latent Particle Splatting
summary: We present ParticleSplat, a self-supervised object-centric learning method that decomposes scenes into a set of latent ''particles'' representing semantic entities through feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, which represents images as a set of particles with attributes such as position, scale, and visual appearance, we address a key limitation of DLP: its inherently 2D nature, which prevents explicit 3D spatial and geometric reasoning that are critical for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation. Leveraging the structural similarity between latent particles and 3D Gaussian primitives, we introduce a 3D latent particle space trained with a novel view synthesis objective. Our model jointly encodes multiple views with camera poses into a shared 3D object-centric latent space, then transforms particles into particle-aligned 3D Gaussians whose composition reconstructs the full scene. On simulated and real-world datasets, we show that this formulation inherently learns object masks without supervision and supports controllable 3D scene editing, such as moving objects by modifying particles in the latent space. We further establish that the learned 3D representation improves downstream performance on robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ParticleSplat，一种自监督、以物体为中心的学习方法，将场景分解为潜在“粒子”，并通过前馈3D高斯泼溅表示语义实体，实现3D空间与几何推理。
AI.motivation: 现有Deep Latent Particles（DLP）本质上是2D表示，缺乏显式3D空间与几何推理能力，难以支持机器人操作等下游任务。受潜在粒子与3D高斯基元结构相似性的启发，希望将粒子表示扩展到3D。
AI.method: 在DLP基础上引入3D潜在粒子空间，使用新颖视图合成目标进行训练。模型联合编码多视角图像与相机位姿到共享的3D物体中心潜在空间，并将粒子转换为粒子对齐的3D高斯，通过组合重建完整场景。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实数据集上，方法无需监督即可学习物体掩码，并支持可控3D场景编辑（如在潜在空间修改粒子来移动物体）；学习到的3D表示还提升了机器人操作下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ParticleSplat将物体中心粒子表示从2D扩展到3D，利用3D高斯泼溅实现自监督场景分解、编辑和下游机器人任务改进，验证了3D潜在粒子表示的潜力。

title: Towards Proactive Detection of User-Side Implicit Conflicts in Human-LLM Dialogue
summary: In Human-LLM dialogue, follow-up user utterances may implicitly conflict with earlier intents, leading the LLM to misinterpret user needs and generate inappropriate responses. A reliable dialogue system should proactively detect user-side conflicts before generating a response and seek clarification when necessary. However, prior work has largely focused on LLM-side conflicts, leaving user-side conflicts underexplored. To fill this gap, we construct UC-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating user-side conflict detection. Preliminary experiments show that existing LLMs struggle with this task, especially when conflicts arise from implicit incompatibilities grounded in dialogue history. To improve lightweight LLMs with limited training data, we investigate data synthesis for user-side conflict detection. Existing synthesis methods do not explicitly model the implicit incompatibilities between historical and current user utterances, making it difficult to capture the evolution of conflicts and to generate reliably labeled implicit conflict samples. We propose SynUC, a constraint-guided synthesis method that represents user-side conflicts in a constraint space and uses the SPEAKING framework to guide traceable constraint transformations. Applying SynUC to WildChat, we construct UC-Data, a user-side conflict training set containing 2,487 samples. On UC-Bench, Qwen3.5-4B trained on UC-Data outperforms larger general-purpose LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.8, as well as the same backbone trained on data synthesized by existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文关注人机对话中被忽视的“用户侧冲突”问题，构建了人工标注基准 UC-Bench，并提出约束引导的数据合成方法 SynUC 及训练集 UC-Data，使轻量模型在用户侧冲突检测上超越大型通用模型。
AI.motivation: 在多轮 Human-LLM 对话中，用户后续话语可能与先前意图存在隐性冲突，若系统不能主动识别，就会误解需求并生成不当回复。已有研究主要关注 LLM 侧冲突，用户侧冲突尚缺乏探索，且现有合成方法无法显式建模历史与当前话语间的隐性不兼容，难以生成可靠标注的隐式冲突样本。
AI.method: 1）构建人工标注基准 UC-Bench 用于评估用户侧冲突检测；2）提出 SynUC，将用户侧冲突表示在约束空间中，并借助 SPEAKING 框架引导可追溯的约束变换，实现数据合成；3）基于 WildChat 合成用户侧冲突训练集 UC-Data（共 2,487 条样本），用于微调轻量模型。
AI.result: 初步实验表明现有 LLM 在用户侧冲突检测上表现不佳，尤其在需要依据对话历史推断隐性不兼容时更为困难。在 UC-Bench 上，基于 UC-Data 训练的 Qwen3.5-4B 优于 Claude Opus 4.8 等更大规模的通用 LLM，也优于使用现有合成方法数据的同骨架模型。
AI.conclusion: 用户侧冲突检测是一个重要但被低估的任务，显式建模约束空间并结合 SPEAKING 框架的合成方法能有效提升轻量模型性能，使其在少量训练数据下超越大型通用模型。

title: Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?
summary: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. An agent that improves an accelerator may be reasoning about the machine, or may be searching competently over knobs whose meaning it never recovers -- and only the first transfers to the next architecture. Existing evaluations cannot tell the two apart, because they vary the agent while holding the framing of the problem fixed. We do the opposite. AutoTuring hands the same agent the same 15-dimensional accelerator space twice: once as named architectural knobs with simulator counters, once as anonymous variables on [0,1], with the evaluator, the legal space and the reachable optima held identical, so that the only thing that varies is whether the problem means anything. The gap between the two is the measurement. On a nine-kernel FP16 GEMM basket, meaning pays: the architect beats a modeled H200 by 5.4% and its blind counterpart by 12.3% on average, with 70.1% fewer simulator calls. It does not pay uniquely: a critic loop recovers most of that gap for the blind agent and buys the architect nothing, so architectural knowledge and structured critique behave as substitutes rather than as complements. We report these as preliminary findings -- five to six runs per condition on a single modeled accelerator -- and take the comparison itself, not the accelerator, to be the contribution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AutoTuring 对比方法：让同一智能体在相同的 15 维加速器设计空间中，分别面对有语义的架构旋钮与无意义的 [0,1] 匿名变量，以测量“问题是否有意义”对硬件设计的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有报告只能说明智能体改进了设计，却无法判断它是在推理机器架构，还是在对无意义旋钮进行有效搜索；前者才能迁移到新架构，但已有评测固定问题框架、只变化智能体，无法区分两者。
AI.method: AutoTuring 将同一智能体、同一 15 维加速器空间分别以两种方式呈现：一是有名称的架构旋钮与模拟器计数器，二是 [0,1] 上的匿名变量；评测器、合法空间和可达最优值保持一致，仅改变问题是否有意义。实验在九核 FP16 GEMM 任务集上进行，并引入 critic loop，每组条件运行 5 至 6 次。
AI.result: 有语义的“架构师”智能体平均比建模的 H200 快 5.4%，比其盲搜对应版本快 12.3%，且模拟器调用次数减少 70.1%。但语义优势并非唯一来源：critic loop 能弥补盲搜智能体的大部分差距，却对架构师智能体没有增益，说明架构知识与结构化批评是替代关系而非互补关系。
AI.conclusion: 作者将此作为初步发现，仅基于单个建模加速器和每组 5 至 6 次运行；其核心贡献不是加速器本身，而是该对比评测方法，用以区分智能体是在理解架构还是在盲目搜索。

title: MAGS: Multi-agent Auto-formalization Guarantees Safety for Agentic Outputs
summary: LLM coding agents now generate complex programs at a scale that makes thorough human review increasingly difficult, raising the risk of safety and security failures. Common approaches, including fuzz testing, static analysis, and LLM-as-a-Verifier, can detect many failures but struggle to cover all possible edge cases. Formal verification addresses this by providing machine-checkable guarantees over specified properties, but traditionally demands substantial manual specification and proof engineering. We introduce a unified multi-agent framework, MAGS, that generates executable programs with formal safety guarantees, using Dafny as a verification-aware intermediate representation where safety properties can be mechanically checked. MAGS formalizes and freezes human-audited APIs and safety requirements, translates generated code into Dafny, repairs violations using verifier feedback, and compiles verified programs back into executable code. We evaluate MAGS on 100 CUDA kernels, 100 terminal scripts, and 20 robotic-arm tasks. Across all 220 examples, it achieves a 100% success rate in producing programs with non-trivial safety guarantees against frozen specifications. Independent safety and functional evaluations further show strong performance across all three domains, while revealing failures when the auto-formalized semantics do not fully capture the target behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGS多智能体框架，以Dafny为验证中间表示，为LLM生成的代码提供形式化安全保证，在220个任务上实现100%成功生成满足冻结规范的程序。
AI.motivation: LLM编码代理生成的复杂程序规模庞大，人工审查困难，存在安全风险；模糊测试、静态分析和LLM验证器难以覆盖所有边界情况；形式化验证可提供机器可检查的保证，但传统上需要大量手动规范和证明工程。
AI.method: 统一多智能体框架MAGS：形式化并冻结经人工审计的API和安全需求；将生成代码翻译为Dafny；利用验证器反馈修复违规；将验证通过的代码编译回可执行代码。
AI.result: 在100个CUDA内核、100个终端脚本和20个机械臂任务共220个例子上，100%成功生成具有非平凡安全保证且符合冻结规范的程序；独立安全与功能评估显示三个领域表现强劲，但当自动形式化语义未能完全捕获目标行为时会出现失败。
AI.conclusion: MAGS能有效为LLM生成代码提供形式化安全保证，但其效果依赖于自动形式化语义的准确性；当语义不完整时仍存在失败风险。

title: The segmentation ceiling: why explicit left-ventricular masks do not improve learned ejection-fraction regression
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to Computers in Biology and Medicine
summary: Accurate estimation of left ventricular ejection fraction (EF) from echocardiography is central to cardiovascular care, and deep learning enables automated EF prediction from echocardiographic video. Because EF is clinically derived from left-ventricular (LV) volumes, a widely held intuition is that explicit LV segmentation should improve prediction. We introduce a quantitative criterion, the segmentation ceiling, that makes this testable: from EF as a normalized difference of end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes, we derive in closed form how per-frame segmentation area error propagates into EF error, and thus the accuracy a mask must reach before it can improve on direct regression. Using EchoNet-Dynamic, a UniFormer-S backbone, and the empirically measured within-patient error correlation, the criterion places the break-even near 10% per-frame area error, whereas a representative segmenter operates at roughly 14%, above the ceiling. Consistent with this, four strategies for injecting segmentation or area information (a predicted-mask channel, end-diastolic/end-systolic clip sampling, and per-bin and amplitude area-consistency objectives) fail to beat a raw-video baseline; ground-truth masks help only through label leakage. Input representation thus not being the limit, we identify generalization as the practical lever: weight averaging with strong augmentation attains a test R^2 of 0.806 (MAE 4.08) under a matched dense-clip protocol, comparable to an R(2+1)D baseline (0.811) while tightening the validation-to-test gap. Finally, a heteroscedastic beta-NLL formulation yields informative, well-calibrated per-prediction uncertainty, larger for clinically harder low-EF cases, where Monte-Carlo dropout does not. The segmentation ceiling gives a concrete design criterion for when mask-guided EF estimation is worthwhile, plus a simple, uncertainty-aware recipe for EF regression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“分割上限”准则，量化左心室分割误差传播到射血分数（EF）预测误差的阈值，并据此检验分割信息是否真能提升超声心动图EF预测；结果发现现有分割精度未达阈值，分割策略难以超越原始视频基线，而强增强权重平均与异方差beta-NLL不确定性建模更实用。
AI.motivation: 临床EF由左心室舒张末期和收缩末期容积导出，因此直觉认为显式左心室分割应能改善深度学习EF预测。作者希望定量检验这一直觉，并明确分割需达到多高精度才可能带来增益。
AI.method: 基于EF是容积归一化差值的定义，闭式推导每帧分割面积误差如何传播为EF误差，提出“分割上限”；使用EchoNet-Dynamic、UniFormer-S骨干和实测患者内误差相关性计算盈亏平衡点。实验比较原始视频回归与四种注入分割/面积信息的策略，并测试真实掩码、权重平均+强增强，以及异方差beta-NLL不确定性估计。
AI.result: 分割上限约为每帧面积误差10%，而代表性分割器约14%，高于阈值。四种分割/面积注入策略均未超过原始视频基线；真实掩码仅通过标签泄漏带来虚假提升。权重平均+强增强在匹配密集片段协议下达到测试R^2=0.806、MAE=4.08，与R(2+1)D基线0.811相当且缩小验证-测试差距。beta-NLL给出良好校准的逐预测不确定性，在更难的低EF病例中更大，而蒙特卡洛dropout未能做到。
AI.conclusion: “分割上限”为何时值得采用掩码引导EF估计提供了具体设计准则：若分割误差高于阈值，直接视频回归更优。当前瓶颈不是输入表示，而是泛化能力；强增强权重平均和不确定性感知的beta-NLL配方是简单有效的EF回归方案。

title: OHRID-Retail: An Open Multimodal Dataset of Human Activity in Retail Environments
summary: Open datasets describing human behavior in environments shared with mobile robots remain limited, particularly for retail activities that combine locomotion, reaching, object handling, and robot guided movement. This paper introduces OHRID Retail, an open, human centered multimodal dataset collected from 16 healthy adults performing a simulated shelf picking task under three within participant conditions: no robot, low speed robot guidance, and high speed robot guidance. Each participant completed two trials per condition. Whole body kinematics were recorded using 17 Xsens Awinda inertial sensors and muscle activity was measured at 10 locations using Delsys Trigno surface electromyography sensors. Descriptive analyses demonstrate variation in whole body movement intensity and muscle activation across robot interaction conditions and body locations. OHRID Retail provides openly available raw recordings, processed measures, documentation, and reproducible analysis resources. The dataset can support research in human activity recognition, multimodal sensor fusion, occupational biomechanics, ergonomics, human aware robot navigation, and human robot interaction in retail and related shared environments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了OHRID Retail，一个开放的人类中心多模态数据集，用于研究人类在移动机器人共享环境中的行为，特别是零售场景下的货架拣选任务。
AI.motivation: 目前描述人类在移动机器人共享环境中行为的开放数据集仍然有限，尤其是涉及运动、伸手、物体处理和机器人引导移动的零售活动。
AI.method: 数据集收集自16名健康成年人，在三种条件下（无机器人、低速机器人引导、高速机器人引导）执行模拟货架拣选任务，每种条件每人完成两次试验。使用17个Xsens Awinda惯性传感器记录全身运动学，使用10个Delsys Trigno表面肌电传感器测量肌肉活动。
AI.result: 描述性分析表明，在不同机器人交互条件和身体部位之间，全身运动强度和肌肉激活存在差异。
AI.conclusion: OHRID Retail提供了公开可用的原始记录、处理后的测量数据、文档和可重复分析资源。该数据集可支持人类活动识别、多模态传感器融合、职业生物力学、人因工程、人类感知机器人导航以及零售和相关共享环境中的人机交互研究。

title: Design of Economic Dispatch Schemes of An Isolated BESS Network Based on Distributed Discrete-time PI+Rest Consensus
summary: Battery energy storage systems (BESSs) are widely integrated into smart grids. For an isolated BESS network, however, capacity degradation and power loss of battery units increase operating costs. To alleviate this problem, two distributed economic dispatch (ED) schemes with discrete-time dynamics are developed in this paper, thus obtaining the optimal output power vector and ensuring supply-demand balance while considering dynamic line loss and capacity constraints. It is worth mentioning that proportional-integral protocols with reset mechanisms (PI+R protocols) are introduced into these schemes which can greatly improve the consensus rate and control accuracy. Specifically, a marginal cost (MC) consensus controller and an average power mismatch estimator are the core components of each scheme, where these two are coupled to each other. In this regard, the difference between the two schemes is that for the MC consensus controllers, one involves incorporating the estimated average power mismatch feedback term into the closed-loop system error to design the PI+R protocol, while the other does not. In addition, regarding to each PI+R protocol, the integral term is reset to 0 when the proportional term experiences zero crossing, in order to accelerate the convergence rate and reduce overshoot. The effectiveness, conditions under which the reset mechanism works, and stability of these schemes are all well analyzed. Finally, some simulation cases are designed and compared with an existing solution. From the simulation results, it can be seen that the designed second scheme greatly improves the performance of the previous scheme in consensus rate, convergence rate, BESS/agent plug and play, load switching, and wide area system application.

AI.tldr: 本文针对孤立电池储能系统网络中容量退化和功率损耗导致运行成本增加的问题，提出了两种基于离散时间动力学的分布式经济调度方案，并引入带重置机制的PI+R协议，以实现最优输出功率分配和供需平衡。
AI.motivation: 孤立BESS网络中电池单元容量退化与功率损耗会推高运行成本，因此需要优化经济调度，在考虑动态线路损耗和容量约束的同时保证供需平衡。
AI.method: 设计了两种分布式经济调度方案，核心包括边际成本一致性控制器和平均功率不匹配估计器，二者相互耦合。采用PI+R协议：当比例项过零时积分项重置为0，以加快收敛并减少超调。两种方案的区别在于MC一致性控制器是否将估计的平均功率不匹配反馈项纳入闭环误差。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提方案有效，且第二种方案在一致性速度、收敛速度、BESS/代理即插即用、负载切换和广域系统应用等方面显著优于原有方案。
AI.conclusion: 两种方案的有效性、重置机制工作条件和稳定性均得到分析；带反馈的第二种PI+R方案能大幅提升性能，适合孤立BESS网络的分布式经济调度。

title: HyperAMS-Net: Adaptive Multi-Scale Spatial Hypergraph Network for Brain Disorder Classification
comment: Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate classification of brain disorders from neuroimaging data remains challenging because of substantial inter-subject heterogeneity and the complex multi-scale patterns present in functional connectivity and morphological representations. To address these challenges, we propose HyperAMS-Net, a deep learning framework for brain disorder classification using neuroimaging representations derived from resting-state functional MRI or structural MRI. HyperAMS-Net integrates adaptive multi-scale convolution, hypergraph attention, spatial-channel attention, and adaptive feature fusion. Specifically, adaptive multi-scale convolution learns data-driven weights over multiple receptive fields to capture complementary patterns at different scales. Hypergraph attention models higher-order dependencies among learned feature representations through node--hyperedge--node message passing, while spatial-channel attention enhances discriminative feature learning. Adaptive feature fusion further aggregates complementary information across parallel network branches. HyperAMS-Net is evaluated on three benchmark datasets spanning distinct brain disorders: ABIDE for autism spectrum disorder, REST-meta-MDD for major depressive disorder, and ADNI for Alzheimer's disease, using 5-fold stratified cross-validation. HyperAMS-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated datasets, attaining the highest accuracy and AUC among the compared methods. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contribution of each proposed component, with the largest performance degradation observed when hypergraph attention is removed.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperAMS-Net深度学习框架，用于基于rs-fMRI或sMRI的脑疾病分类，融合自适应多尺度卷积、超图注意力、空间-通道注意力和自适应特征融合，在ABIDE、REST-meta-MDD和ADNI三个数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 神经影像数据存在显著的个体间异质性以及功能连接和形态表征中的复杂多尺度模式，导致脑疾病分类仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出HyperAMS-Net框架，集成自适应多尺度卷积（学习多感受野的数据驱动权重）、超图注意力（通过节点-超边-节点消息传递建模高阶依赖）、空间-通道注意力（增强判别特征学习）和自适应特征融合（聚合并行分支互补信息）；在ABIDE、REST-meta-MDD和ADNI数据集上采用5折分层交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 在所有评估数据集上均达到最先进性能，准确率和AUC最高；消融实验验证各组件贡献，移除超图注意力时性能下降最大。
AI.conclusion: HyperAMS-Net能有效应对脑疾病分类中的异质性和多尺度模式挑战，各组件协同提升分类性能。

title: Reflective Recovery: A Self-Supervised Method for Reasoning by Learning from Mistakes
summary: Data-driven fine-tuning is widely adopted to enhance reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its simplicity and efficiency. However, mainstream imitation learning methods that rely exclusively on perfect reasoning trajectories suffer from a Scaling Collapse: when the problem set is limited, increasing positive examples fails to yield continuous improvement. However, during inference, an LLM can not guarantee that every intermediate step is correct and is therefore prone to errors. Once such errors arise, the LLM often struggles to recover and may be further misled by the accumulation of previous mistakes. To address this, we propose Reflective Recovery, a simple yet effective self-supervised approach that transforms failed reasoning attempts into recovery training data. Specifically, we extract initial segments of failed trajectories, concatenate them with prompts, and use them to guide the LLM toward valid solutions. Because these segments from failed trajectories are likely to contain errors, this process teaches models to recognize and correct mistakes during reasoning, enabling recovery from erroneous states without relying on external critics or reward models. Evaluated on extensive benchmarks, Reflective Recovery significantly improves performance. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it boosts accuracy from 30.0% to 37.5% on AIME 2025 and from 37.6% to 47.8% on Minerva. More importantly, analyses demonstrate that it breaks the scaling collapse barrier and enables models to develop emergent self-correction behaviors, representing a paradigm shift from outcome-oriented memorization to process-oriented reflective reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Reflective Recovery，一种自监督方法，将失败推理轨迹转化为恢复训练数据，以提升大语言模型的推理鲁棒性和自我纠错能力。
AI.motivation: 主流模仿学习仅依赖完美推理轨迹，受限于问题集规模时会出现 Scaling Collapse，即增加正例无法持续提升性能；同时推理中一旦出错，模型难以恢复且易被累积错误误导。
AI.method: 提取失败轨迹的初始片段，与提示拼接后用于引导模型生成有效解；由于失败片段可能含错，该过程训练模型识别并纠正推理中的错误，无需外部批评器或奖励模型。
AI.result: 在多个基准上显著提升性能：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 在 AIME 2025 上准确率从 30.0% 升至 37.5%，在 Minerva 上从 37.6% 升至 47.8%；并突破 Scaling Collapse，涌现自我纠错行为。
AI.conclusion: Reflective Recovery 将训练范式从结果导向的记忆转变为过程导向的反思推理，为 LLM 推理能力提升提供了简单有效的自监督路径。

title: Closed-World Resolution Against Tool Hallucination in LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents fail in a way no tool-selection or tool-security method addresses: they call tools that do not exist and pass arguments no schema declares. Existing defenses either pick the right tool (selection) or constrain what an agent may do with real tools (gating), both of which presuppose the emitted call refers to a real tool at all. We show this is a structural blind spot: a hallucinated call is by construction not a decision any gate made, so no gate can reject it. This paper is primarily a measurement and benchmark study. We give a five-class taxonomy of tool hallucination (H1-H5) and, as a reference point, the Resolution Rung: a training-free, closed-world resolver (registry membership plus a signature check) whose interest is where it must sit, not what it computes. We prove hallucination defense must precede any causal gate, and characterize the one irreducible residue (borrowed arguments schema-indistinguishable from a valid call). Across ten hosted models under two invocation surfaces we measure 322 genuine hallucinations; fabricated-tool calls concentrate on the unconstrained raw-JSON surface (34 vs. 3), and model scale does not help (a 675B model matches a 7-8B one). We then extend to the Model Context Protocol, where merging several servers into one namespace creates hallucination surfaces a single registry cannot express (a second taxonomy, M1-M5); on the live MCP surface we measure 154 hallucinations, including from frontier models that were clean on the single-registry surface, because collisions and shadowing are structural to the merge. We release the versioned Hallucinated-Tools Benchmark (HTB) so any resolver is comparable across submissions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇测量与基准研究，揭示并量化了工具增强LLM智能体的“工具幻觉”问题：智能体会调用不存在的工具并传入无schema声明的参数。作者提出五类幻觉分类（H1-H5）与一个免训练的封闭世界解析器Resolution Rung，证明幻觉防御必须前置于任何因果门控，并在单一注册表与MCP两种调用面上进行了大规模测量，发布了HTB基准。
AI.motivation: 现有防御要么关注工具选择（tool-selection），要么关注工具安全门控（gating），二者都预设了智能体发出的调用确实指向一个真实工具。然而，工具幻觉调用在构造上就不是任何门控做出的决策，因此任何门控都无法拒绝它，这是现有方法的结构性盲区。
AI.method: 作为测量与基准研究，作者：（1）给出工具幻觉的五类分类法（H1-H5）；（2）提出Resolution Rung——一个免训练、封闭世界的解析器（基于注册表成员资格加签名校验），并论证幻觉防御必须前置于任何因果门控；（3）刻画了唯一不可约的残余情况（借用参数、在schema上与合法调用无法区分）；（4）在两种调用面、十个托管模型上测量真实幻觉；（5）将研究扩展到Model Context Protocol（MCP），提出第二套分类法（M1-M5）；（6）发布版本化的Hallucinated-Tools Benchmark（HTB）。
AI.result: 在十个托管模型、两种调用面下共测得322次真实幻觉；虚构工具调用集中在无约束的raw-JSON调用面（34次 vs. 3次），且模型规模无帮助（675B模型与7-8B模型表现相当）。在实时MCP调用面上测得154次幻觉，包括在单注册表调用面上表现干净的前沿模型，原因是多服务器合并到同一命名空间带来的碰撞与遮蔽是结构性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 工具幻觉是现有工具选择与门控方法无法覆盖的结构性盲区，幻觉防御必须前置于任何因果门控，且存在一类不可约的残余。MCP的多服务器命名空间合并进一步制造了单一注册表无法表达的幻觉面。作者发布HTB基准，使不同解析器可在统一标准下跨提交比较。

title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 GAVEL 框架，利用显式图世界模型对 LLM 生成的长程机器人规划进行验证与修复，从而提升任务成功率与规划效率。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽可用于长程机器人规划，但其生成的计划常不满足具身约束、难以从规划错误中恢复，并且在部分可观测环境下推理效果不佳。
AI.method: 构建显式图世界模型，表示物体关系、动作前置条件与效果，以及未观测物体位置的概率信念；在执行前预测 LLM 动作后果、检测违规并修复可由世界模型直接推导的错误，仅将 LLM 重规划保留给需要语义推理的错误。对于多任务指令，基于物体位置分布重排剩余子任务，以最小化期望搜索成本。
AI.result: 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 的 100 个单任务和 500 个多任务指令上评估，使用 Qwen3-8B 时，单任务成功率从 41.2% 提升至 91.8%，多任务成功率从 19.9% 提升至 92.6%；分布信念推理相比静态版本减少约 5.4% 的移动距离。
AI.conclusion: 显式图世界模型作为外层框架，可显著提升长程具身规划在紧凑型与前沿 LLM 能力下的可靠性和效率。

title: SCOUT: Sim-to-Real Text-Based Person Retrieval by Embedding-Space Prediction over Frozen Video Features
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI City Challenge (Track 4). Code and annotations: https://github.com/abtraore/SCOUT-ECCV
summary: Text-based person retrieval under a sim-to-real gap (synthetic training data, a real-image gallery) is usually tackled with costly fine-tuned cross-encoders. We ask whether a frozen-encoder system can compete. We present SCOUT, which casts cross-modal retrieval as prediction in embedding space. A trainable predictor maps the patch tokens of a frozen video encoder into the embedding space of a frozen text encoder under a bidirectional InfoNCE objective, and no encoder is fine-tuned in the base model. The video encoder is V-JEPA, the text encoder is EmbeddingGemma, and the predictor is initialized from a Qwen3.5-0.8B decoder. We make three findings. First, the best frozen text encoder is simply the one whose geometry best matches the video features. A training-free alignment score ranks three candidate text encoders in the same order as their retrieval accuracy on our held-out split (Spearman $ρ= 1.0$); a fourth, LLM-based encoder shows the rule is metric-dependent, holding for a neighborhood-overlap score ($ρ= 0.8$) but not for a linear probe ($ρ= -0.2$). Second, two precision-targeted levers, parameter-efficient ExPLoRA adaptation of the video encoder and a training-free attribute-decomposed reranker built on a vision-language model, improve the top-rank precision that otherwise limits the frozen system, adding 2.2 points of leaderboard R@1. Third, a local-versus-public calibration study explains which interventions transfer to the real domain. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 the full retrieve-fuse-rerank system reaches 84.25 mAP@10 on the final leaderboard, while a single frozen model submitted alone reaches 60.63. Our trained components cost about 95 GPU-hours. CMP, the dataset authors' fine-tuned cross-encoder that trains for sixteen GPU-days, is one fusion member of the full system, not an alternative. Code and annotations: https://github.com/abtraore/SCOUT-ECCV

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SCOUT，将文本到人物检索中的跨模态检索建模为嵌入空间预测：用可训练预测器把冻结视频编码器 V-JEPA 的 patch token 映射到冻结文本编码器 EmbeddingGemma 的嵌入空间，并用双向 InfoNCE 训练，基础模型不微调任何编码器。研究发现：文本编码器几何匹配度可预测检索效果；ExPLoRA 与属性分解重排序可提升 top-rank 精度；局部-公开校准可解释干预迁移。在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 上，完整 retrieve-fuse-rerank 系统达 84.25 mAP@10，单一冻结模型为 60.63。
AI.motivation: 在合成数据训练、真实图像库检索的 sim-to-real 场景中，现有方法通常依赖昂贵的微调 cross-encoder。作者希望验证：仅使用冻结编码器的系统是否也能具备竞争力，并降低训练成本。
AI.method: 将跨模态检索视为嵌入空间预测：训练一个预测器，把冻结 V-JEPA 视频编码器的 patch token 映射到冻结 EmbeddingGemma 文本编码器的嵌入空间，采用双向 InfoNCE 目标；基础模型不微调编码器。预测器由 Qwen3.5-0.8B 解码器初始化。引入参数高效 ExPLoRA 适配视频编码器，以及基于视觉语言模型的免训练属性分解重排序器，并进行局部与公开集校准研究，最终形成 retrieve-fuse-rerank 系统。
AI.result: 第一，免训练对齐分数可将三个候选文本编码器按检索准确率排序，Spearman ρ=1.0；第四个 LLM 编码器显示规则依赖度量，邻域重叠分数 ρ=0.8，线性探针 ρ=-0.2。第二，ExPLoRA 与属性分解重排序两个精度导向杠杆提升 top-rank 精度，排行榜 R@1 增加 2.2 点。第三，完整系统在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 达 84.25 mAP@10，单一冻结模型为 60.63；训练组件约耗 95 GPU-hours。作者微调的 cross-encoder CMP 训练需 16 GPU-days，且只是完整系统中的一个融合成员，而非替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 冻结编码器系统在 sim-to-real 文本人物检索中可以具备竞争力，尤其与精度提升和重排序结合后表现显著。文本编码器与视频特征的几何匹配是选择冻结文本编码器的关键因素；ExPLoRA 与属性分解重排序可提升精度，局部-公开校准有助于判断哪些干预可迁移到真实域。

title: On unified asymmetric barrier Lyapunov functions
summary: Barrier Lyapunov functions (BLFs) have been a popular choice when dealing with constrained control problems. In the current article, we present a unified asymmetric barrier Lyapunov function that generalizes the existing logarithmic symmetric Lyapunov function. We show that the proposed function is smooth and does not require the discontinuous switching function that is ubiquitous in the asymmetric barrier Lyapunov functions existing in the literature. Based on the proposed barrier Lyapunov function, a control law, guaranteeing exponentially fast output tracking, is designed for a class of single-input single-output nonlinear systems with output constraints. We show that the proposed control law unifies the control design and structure for a system with either symmetric or asymmetric output constraints. Furthermore, we constructively show that the proposed function can be bounded from above and below by symmetric class $\mathcal{K}$ functions which help in establishing local exponential convergence together with the proposed control law. Lastly, we provide numerical examples to illustrate the performance of the proposed control and compare the results with the existing logarithmic BLFs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一的非对称障碍Lyapunov函数（BLF），推广了现有的对数对称BLF，并基于该函数为带输出约束的SISO非线性系统设计了可实现指数快速输出跟踪的控制律。
AI.motivation: 现有障碍Lyapunov函数在处理约束控制时，尤其是非对称障碍Lyapunov函数中，通常需要不连续切换函数，且对称与非对称约束下的控制设计不统一，因此需要一种更平滑、统一的BLF。
AI.method: 提出一种统一的非对称障碍Lyapunov函数，证明其光滑且无需不连续切换函数；基于该BLF设计控制律，用于带输出约束的一类单输入单输出非线性系统；并构造性地证明该函数可由对称class K函数上下界约束，从而分析局部指数收敛性；最后通过数值仿真与现有对数BLF比较。
AI.result: 所提出的BLF推广了对称对数BLF，避免了非对称BLF中常见的不连续切换；基于该函数的控制律能够保证指数快速输出跟踪，并统一了对称与非对称输出约束下的控制设计和结构；同时借助class K函数上下界证明了局部指数收敛。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的统一非对称障碍Lyapunov函数为约束控制提供了一种光滑且统一的设计框架，适用于对称和非对称输出约束，并实现了指数收敛性能，数值例子验证了其相对于现有对数BLF的优势。

title: A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a morphing rotor-distributed aerial robot with flexible continuum links that achieves both high shape adaptability and an expanded wrench space. The flexible continuum links function as soft manipulators, passively conforming to the shape of the environment, while the thrusters distributed along the continuum links expand the feasible thrust wrench space and enable the end-effector to exert large interaction forces. To realize the proposed robot, it is essential to suppress vibrations of the lightweight continuum links. Thus, we develop a composite leaf-spring structure that provides both high torsional and vertical stiffness, and vibration-suppressing control methods. Using these implementations, we demonstrate stable flight and a variety of aerial manipulation tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to realize aerial manipulations using flexible links with an integrated thruster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种带柔性连续体连杆和分布式旋翼的可变形空中机器人，兼具软体机械臂的环境适应性和扩展的可行力旋量空间，并实现稳定飞行与多种空中操作任务。
AI.motivation: 空中操作对扩展空中机器人应用至关重要，但现有研究难以同时实现两个目标：利用软体机械臂获得高环境适应性，以及沿机械臂分布推进器来扩展可行力旋量空间。
AI.method: 设计可变形、旋翼分布的空中机器人，采用柔性连续体连杆作为软体机械臂，使其被动顺应环境形状；沿连续体分布推进器以扩展推力力旋量空间，并让末端执行器施加较大交互力。为抑制轻质连续体连杆振动，开发兼具高扭转和垂向刚度的复合板簧结构及抑振控制方法。
AI.result: 实验展示了稳定飞行以及多种空中操作任务，验证了所提机器人实现柔性连杆与集成推进器结合进行空中操作的能力。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个使用带集成推进器的柔性连杆实现空中操作的工作，表明该方案可同时提升环境适应性和操作力输出能力。

title: Video Based Assessment of Surgical Skills Using Frozen Pretrained Video Foundation Models
comment: Accepted for publication in npj Digital Medicine
summary: Automated video-based surgical skill assessment has advanced rapidly, yet rigorous evaluation of continuous standardized score prediction under participant-level generalization to unseen trainees remains limited. We introduce VBA-Net+, a video-only framework for Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery (FLS) score regression and pass-fail classification using pretrained video foundation models as frozen feature extractors. We evaluate two FLS datasets, suturing and pattern cutting, using VideoPrism, V-JEPA2, and VideoMAE v2, with a frame-level SimCLR baseline. A lightweight fully convolutional head is trained on embeddings offline and evaluated using participant-level leave-one-user-out (LOUO) cross-validation within the standardized assessment protocol. For continuous score prediction, the best representation achieves $R^2$=0.6367 for suturing and 0.9261 for pattern cutting. For pass-fail classification at official FLS thresholds, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) reaches 0.9073 and 0.9906, respectively. Frozen video-encoder pipelines generally outperformed the frame-level SimCLR pipeline, particularly for suturing, providing a benchmark for video-only FLS assessment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VBA-Net+，一种仅基于视频、使用冻结预训练视频基础模型提取特征的 FLS 评分回归与通过/不通过分类框架，并在缝合和剪裁任务上采用受试者级 LOUO 交叉验证评估。
AI.motivation: 自动化视频手术技能评估发展迅速，但在标准化评分预测中，针对未见受训者的参与者级泛化仍缺乏严格评估。
AI.method: 使用 VideoPrism、V-JEPA2、VideoMAE v2 等预训练视频基础模型作为冻结特征提取器，并以帧级 SimCLR 为基线；在离线嵌入上训练轻量级全卷积头，采用参与者级留一用户交叉验证（LOUO）评估缝合和剪裁两个 FLS 数据集。
AI.result: 连续评分预测最佳 R² 为缝合 0.6367、剪裁 0.9261；按官方 FLS 阈值的通过/不通过分类 AUC 分别为 0.9073 和 0.9906。冻结视频编码器流程总体优于帧级 SimCLR，尤其在缝合任务上更明显。
AI.conclusion: VBA-Net+ 为仅视频的 FLS 评估提供了基准，表明冻结视频基础模型结合轻量回归头在标准化技能评分和通过/不通过分类上具有较好泛化能力。

title: AMB3R-SLAM: Kilometer-scale SLAM with Hierarchical Backend
summary: We present AMB3R-SLAM, a real-time monocular SLAM system capable of reconstructing kilometer-scale trajectories over 10k frames on a single consumer-grade GPU. Our model couples a lightweight front-end for low-latency online tracking with a hierarchical backend that progressively enforces local, mid-level, and global consistency. By avoiding bundle adjustment that relies on the static world assumption, our system naturally handles complex dynamic scenes out of the box. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method can be extended to leverage stereo, RGB-D, and LiDAR as additional inputs. AMB3R-SLAM achieves strong camera tracking performance across 9 datasets, reducing the absolute trajectory error (ATE) of previous state-of-the-art methods on VBR and Oxford Spires by over 70%. With additional LiDAR input, our model further reduces ATE to sub-meter level on KITTI and VBR datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 AMB3R-SLAM，一种可在单块消费级 GPU 上实时运行的公里级单目 SLAM 系统，支持万帧轨迹重建；通过轻量前端与分层后端实现局部、中层和全局一致性，并可扩展至立体、RGB-D 和 LiDAR 输入。
AI.motivation: 现有 SLAM 方法常依赖静态世界假设的 bundle adjustment，难以处理动态场景；同时需要兼顾实时性、大规模轨迹重建和单消费级 GPU 部署，并具备多模态扩展能力。
AI.method: 采用轻量前端进行低延迟在线跟踪，后端分层逐步施加局部、中层和全局一致性约束；避免依赖静态世界假设的 bundle adjustment，从而自然处理动态场景；方法可扩展融合 stereo、RGB-D 和 LiDAR 额外输入。
AI.result: 在单块消费级 GPU 上实现实时运行，可处理 10k 帧、公里级轨迹；在 9 个数据集上取得强相机跟踪性能，在 VBR 和 Oxford Spires 上将先前 SOTA 的 ATE 降低 70% 以上；加入 LiDAR 后，在 KITTI 和 VBR 上将 ATE 进一步降至亚米级。
AI.conclusion: AMB3R-SLAM 能高效处理大规模、动态场景下的实时 SLAM，并可通过多模态输入进一步提升精度，性能显著优于现有先进方法，具有实际应用潜力。

title: VisKG-LM: Compiling Knowledge Graphs into Visual Memory for Multiple-Choice Question Answering
summary: Knowledge graphs are usually integrated into question answering by encoding a retrieved subgraph with a graph neural network and fusing it with the language model in the online inference path. The same subgraph is therefore re-encoded from scratch every time a pair is scored, across training epochs, seeds, and evaluation runs, even though the knowledge graph never changes. We ask whether the retrieved knowledge graphs can instead be compiled once, offline, and then accessed as read-only memory. VisKG-LM shows that it can, by decoupling graph encoding from language reasoning. It serializes each retrieved candidate-specific subgraph as Relation-Labeled Paths and renders the result as an image whose two-dimensional layout preserves the branching structure of the paths. Each image is encoded once, offline, and cached for reuse. At inference, the language model contextualizes the question and candidate from text alone, and only its final layer consults the cached visual memory, reading both its global layout and its local relational detail. The graph information thus enters only after the text has been understood. On the test sets of CommonsenseQA, OpenBookQA, and MedQA-USMLE, VisKG-LMimproves over GreaseLM by $1.2$, $0.8$, and $4.3$ points, respectively, while matching or surpassing GraphVis, a $7$B vision-language model, with only about $400$M online parameters. Against a matched text-only control that receives the identical Relation-Labeled Paths, it gains $4.2$, $6.5$, and $5.1$ points across the three benchmarks. These gains show that the complete visual-memory interface adds value beyond path textualization alone and support compiled visual memory as an alternative to online graph propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出 VisKG-LM，将知识图谱问答中检索到的子图离线编译为可复用的视觉记忆，而非在线反复用图神经网络编码。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常在线编码检索子图并与语言模型融合，导致同一静态子图在训练、推理和评测中被反复重新编码，计算冗余且效率低。
AI.method: 将候选子图序列化为 Relation-Labeled Paths，并渲染为保留路径分支结构的二维图像；每张图像离线编码一次并缓存。推理时语言模型仅从文本理解问题与候选，最后一层再查询缓存视觉记忆，读取全局布局和局部关系细节。
AI.result: 在 CommonsenseQA、OpenBookQA、MedQA-USMLE 上分别比 GreaseLM 提升 1.2、0.8、4.3 分；以约 4 亿在线参数匹配或超过 70 亿参数 GraphVis。与接收相同 Relation-Labeled Paths 的纯文本对照相比，分别提升 4.2、6.5、5.1 分。
AI.conclusion: 完整视觉记忆接口带来的收益超过单纯路径文本化，说明离线编译视觉记忆可作为在线图传播的替代方案。

title: The syntax and semantics of goals
comment: To appear in Topics in Cognitive Science, special issue on Goal-Centric Perspectives in Cognitive Science
summary: In both cognitive science and computer science, goals are conceptualized as cognitive states that flexibly combine with world knowledge to organize and specify purposeful behavior. In this way, goals are compositional representations whose content relates to rational behavior. We here draw attention to goals as representations and their content because it highlights a parallel with other areas in cognitive science - in particular, the syntax-semantics interface in linguistics and logic - while also foregrounding foundational questions about the expressivity, design, and efficiency of different goal representations. For example, goals are typically taken as fixed and imposing constraints on desirable behaviors, but we can also identify constraints on goal representations themselves, such as whether a particular goal language is sufficiently expressive to capture behaviors of interest, or whether different goal representations capture the same behavior. Here, we synthesize work that aims to characterize the properties of different goal representations and suggest these are points of a broader design space. We close by discussing how distinguishing the form and meaning of goals can elucidate the implicit assumptions we make about goals, inform the study of interactions between higher-level cognition and motivation, and isolate axes of variation for different conceptions of goals.

AI.tldr: 本文从认知科学与计算机科学出发，将目标视为可与世界知识灵活组合的组成性表征，强调其内容与理性行为的关系，并综合不同目标表征的性质，提出目标表征构成一个更广泛的设计空间。
AI.motivation: 目标通常被视为固定并施加行为约束，但其表征本身的性质——如表达力、设计取舍和效率——尚未被充分探讨；同时，目标与语言学、逻辑学中的句法-语义界面存在类比，促使研究者重新审视目标的形式与意义。
AI.method: 采用理论综合与概念分析，借鉴认知科学、计算机科学、语言学和逻辑学，特别是句法-语义界面思想，比较不同目标表征的属性，并构建目标表征的设计空间框架。
AI.result: 指出目标表征可具有不同表达力、设计和效率，能捕捉相同或不同行为，并可将这些性质视为设计空间中的点；区分目标的形式与意义有助于揭示隐含假设。
AI.conclusion: 刻画目标表征的性质能阐明我们对目标的默认假设，推动高阶认知与动机交互研究，并为不同目标概念划分变异轴。

title: PerSeM: Persistent Semantic Memory for Long-Horizon Open-Vocabulary UAV Mapping
summary: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables rich semantic perception for UAVs, but frame-wise predictions can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations and changing viewpoints. We present PerSeM, a training-free persistent semantic memory framework for long-horizon open-vocabulary UAV mapping. PerSeM associates frame-wise semantic observations with persistent world-space voxels and constructs a majority-based semantic memory, which is conservatively refined through history-preserving spatial refinement, trust-aware replay, and context-guided verification. Experiments on the Forest and UAVScenes benchmarks show that persistent 3D memory provides substantial gains in semantic correctness and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions. Beyond this strong persistent-memory baseline, PerSeM provides consistent additional improvements, improving both semantic accuracy and temporal stability across all five evaluated UAVScenes sequences. Analysis using regions identified independently of the final PerSeM predictions further shows that these gains are concentrated in semantically difficult and temporally unstable regions, where majority-based memory is most likely to remain uncertain. These results demonstrate that persistent 3D aggregation provides a strong foundation for long-horizon semantic mapping, while conservative refinement of uncertain memory states can provide additional improvements without retraining or additional neural-network inference.

AI.tldr: 提出PerSeM，一种无需训练的长时程开放词汇无人机建图持久语义记忆框架，通过将逐帧语义观测关联到世界空间体素并构建基于多数投票的语义记忆，并进行保守细化。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇分割能为无人机提供丰富语义感知，但逐帧预测在重复观测和视角变化下存在时序不一致问题，因此需要持久且一致的语义建图方法。
AI.method: 无需训练；将逐帧语义观测关联到持久世界空间体素，构建基于多数投票的语义记忆；通过保留历史的空间细化、信任感知重放和上下文引导验证对记忆进行保守细化。
AI.result: 在Forest和UAVScenes基准上，持久3D记忆显著提升语义正确性和时序稳定性；在所有五个UAVScenes序列上进一步取得一致提升；增益集中在语义困难与时序不稳定区域。
AI.conclusion: 持久3D聚合为长时程语义建图提供了强基础，而对不确定记忆状态进行保守细化可在无需重训练或额外神经网络推理的情况下带来额外改进。

title: A Multi-Modal Generative Model for Tomato Disease Leaves Understanding
comment: In submission to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture Journal
summary: Artificial intelligence for plant disease analysis has advanced from task-specific classifiers to multi-modal models capable of jointly interpreting visual and textual information. However, practical deployment in precision agriculture remains limited because most existing approaches treat disease understanding as isolated prediction tasks, failing to capture the complementary relationships among symptom recognition, severity assessment, and question-driven diagnostic reasoning. In tomato pathology, accurate interpretation of diseased leaves requires more than label prediction; it demands integrating visual symptoms with semantic context to support a comprehensive and explainable understanding. Here, we present SOLAR, a multimodal generative model that understands tomato disease spanning six question-answering tasks. SOLAR learns to align visual features with task-aware language representations by Fusion Expert module based on mixture-of-expert, enabling it to generate contextually relevant answers across diverse diagnostic tasks. By formulating tomato disease analysis as a generative Visual Question Answering (VQA) task, SOLAR provides a flexible framework that supports multi-task inference within a single model while improving performance and cross-task knowledge sharing. We evaluate SOLAR on $41,677$ images, including $216,209$ Question-Answering (QA) pairs to understand tomato leaf disease under both closed and open-ended QA settings. Experimental results show that SOLAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art vision-only, vision-language, and task-specific models across all tasks, demonstrating superior accuracy, robustness, and multimodal reasoning. These findings highlight the potential of generative multimodal modeling as an effective direction for understanding of plant disease. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/EnalisUs/SOLAR.

AI.tldr: 提出SOLAR多模态生成模型，用于番茄叶部病害理解，覆盖六类问答任务，并在大规模图像与QA数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有植物病害AI多局限于孤立预测任务，难以捕捉症状识别、严重度评估与问答诊断推理之间的互补关系，限制精准农业实际部署。
AI.method: 将番茄病害分析建模为生成式视觉问答（VQA）任务，采用基于混合专家的Fusion Expert模块对齐视觉特征与任务感知语言表示，实现单模型多任务推理与跨任务知识共享。
AI.result: 在41,677张图像和216,209个问答对上评估，SOLAR在闭集与开放问答设置下均持续优于视觉单模态、视觉语言及任务专用SOTA模型，准确率、鲁棒性和多模态推理更优。
AI.conclusion: 生成式多模态建模是植物病害理解的有效方向，代码已开源。

title: Foldable Antenna Array in Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks: Architectures and Applications
summary: Space-air-ground integrated networks (SAGINs) integrate heterogeneous platforms with different coverage, mobility, and payload constraints, which creates strong demands for flexible antenna architectures. Foldable antenna arrays (FAAs) provide a promising solution by reconfiguring array geometry, antenna positions, and orientations through controllable joints or hinges. However, existing studies on FAAs have mainly considered simple folding configurations and limited deployment benefits, while FAAs' architectures and broader potential for SAGIN remain largely unexplored. In this article, we present the fundamentals and architectures of FAA, including folding mechanisms, foldability levels, and functional capabilities. We then examine FAA applications for ground base stations, low-altitude platforms, high-altitude platforms, and satellites, together with their potential challenges and solutions. Finally, we highlight open issues and future research directions, and provide a case study to demonstrate the FAA-enabled communication performance improvement in SAGIN.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了可折叠天线阵列（FAA）在空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）中的基础、架构、应用、挑战和未来方向，并通过案例研究展示了其通信性能提升。
AI.motivation: SAGIN集成异构平台，对灵活天线架构有强烈需求。FAA通过可控关节重构阵列几何、位置和方向，是有前景的解决方案，但现有研究仅考虑简单折叠配置和有限部署优势，其架构和更广泛潜力尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 本文提出了FAA的基础和架构，包括折叠机制、可折叠级别和功能能力；分析了FAA在地面基站、低空平台、高空平台和卫星中的应用及挑战与解决方案；最后指出开放问题和未来方向，并进行案例研究。
AI.result: 通过案例研究展示了FAA在SAGIN中通信性能的提升，并总结了FAA在不同平台应用的潜在挑战与解决方案。
AI.conclusion: FAA是SAGIN中灵活天线架构的有前景解决方案，其架构和应用潜力值得进一步研究，未来需解决开放问题并探索更多方向。

title: Advantage Scale Calibration Imbalance in Group-Relative Optimization under Low-Variance Rewards: Diagnosis and Bounded Recovery
summary: In verifier-style RLVR, group-relative optimization often treats advantage scale as an implementation detail. This paper separates two low-variance cases: sub-resolution jitter that should not become a preference signal, and credible but small cardinal gaps that should be learned without distorting KL calibration. We propose an advantage-scale three-way calibration interface: the same within-group scale denominator simultaneously determines the reward-branch strength, prompt-level batch weight, and the effective KL calibration induced when the reward branch is re-expressed on the original cardinal scale. This interface explains why RLOO / Dr.GRPO can let credible small gaps become KL dominated, whereas GRPO's standard-deviation denominator can amplify tiny gaps without bound. Based on this interface, we further introduce the Reward-Resolution Protocol and MaxNorm-AC, respectively filtering sub-resolution gaps and providing bounded cardinal recovery on credible nonzero gaps. Across dense / MoE architectures and math / code reasoning, MaxNorm-AC improves over the strongest robust-scale baseline while truncating the low-variance inverse-scale tail.

AI.tldr: 本文将 verifier-style RLVR 中组相对优化的 advantage scale 从实现细节提升为关键校准问题，区分亚分辨率抖动与可信小幅真实差距，并提出三路校准接口、Reward-Resolution Protocol 与 MaxNorm-AC。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常把 advantage scale 当作实现细节，但同一组内尺度会同时影响 reward 分支强度、prompt 级批权重和有效 KL 校准，导致小差距要么被 KL 主导，要么被无界放大。
AI.method: 提出 advantage-scale 三路校准接口，用同一组内尺度分母统一解释 reward 分支、批权重与 KL 校准；据此分析 RLOO、Dr.GRPO、GRPO；引入 Reward-Resolution Protocol 过滤亚分辨率差距，并提出 MaxNorm-AC 对可信非零差距做有界基数恢复。
AI.result: 该接口解释了 RLOO/Dr.GRPO 为何让可信小差距被 KL 主导，以及 GRPO 标准差分母为何无界放大微小差距；在 dense/MoE 架构和 math/code 推理任务上，MaxNorm-AC 优于最强 robust-scale 基线，并截断低方差逆尺度尾部。
AI.conclusion: advantage scale 需要显式校准；通过区分噪声与可信小差距，并采用有界恢复与过滤机制，可提升 RLVR 优化稳定性与性能。

title: SemSafe-3DGS: Semantic Risk-Aware Active Navigation in Uncertain 3D Gaussian Splatting Maps
comment: Accepted to be presented at the SeMaNa 2026 Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Autonomous robots operating in partially observed environments must navigate safely while acquiring observations that improve future planning. Existing safety formulations generally reason primarily about geometry. Consequently, geometrically similar scene elements may induce comparable control responses despite having different semantic consequences. We present a semantic risk aware safe-active perception framework for navigation in attributed 3D Gaussian maps. Semantic attributes modulate an Average Value-at-Risk collision clearance model through class dependent risk weights, allowing safety-critical Gaussian primitives to receive greater influence in the composite barrier. The resulting weighted clearances are aggregated into a control barrier function, while a trajectory-relevant active perception barrier promotes observations that reduce geometric map uncertainty along the robot's anticipated motion. Both objectives are integrated in a unified CBF-QP that enforces semantic risk-aware collision avoidance as a hard constraint while relaxing information acquisition when it conflicts with safety or task progress. Experiments demonstrate efficient safety constraint, improved navigation through active perception, semantic dependent trajectory adaptation, and real-robot execution under Ackermann dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在带属性3D高斯地图中用于自主机器人导航的语义风险感知安全主动感知框架，通过类别风险权重调节AVaR碰撞间隙，并在统一CBF-QP中融合安全约束与主动感知。
AI.motivation: 现有安全规划主要基于几何进行推理，忽略场景元素的语义后果，导致几何相似但语义不同的元素可能引发相近的控制响应。
AI.method: 在带属性的3D高斯地图中，用语义属性通过类别相关风险权重调制Average Value-at-Risk碰撞间隙模型，使安全关键高斯基元在复合屏障中影响更大；将加权间隙聚合为控制屏障函数，并设计轨迹相关主动感知屏障，促进沿机器人预期运动降低几何地图不确定性；二者集成到统一CBF-QP中，安全作为硬约束，信息获取在与安全或任务进度冲突时松弛。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能高效施加安全约束、通过主动感知改善导航、实现语义相关的轨迹适应，并在Ackermann动力学真机上执行。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了语义风险感知的安全主动感知导航，兼顾碰撞安全与信息获取，并支持真实机器人部署。

title: Unifying Image Quality Assessment Datasets: MOSAIQ-500K and MOSAIQ-Bench
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Image quality assessment (IQA) datasets use different subjective protocols and rating scales, so their scores are not directly comparable. The lack of a common perceptual scale hinders multi-dataset training and precludes direct inter-dataset evaluation. We address this by conducting a new subjective experiment and using its ratings as perceptual anchors to fit monotonic mappings that place the existing scores of 23 IQA datasets on a common quality scale while preserving within-dataset rankings. The resulting dataset, MOSAIQ-500K, contains over 500,000 images and is, to our knowledge, the largest IQA dataset with perceptually aligned subjective scores. We also propose MOSAIQ-Bench, an inter-dataset benchmark, and use it to evaluate 31 IQA methods, revealing substantial gaps between intra- and inter-dataset performance, particularly on authentic distortions. The aligned scores offer a key advantage: replacing specialized multi-dataset training mechanisms with standard regression losses yields comparable intra-dataset accuracy and better inter-dataset performance. MOSAIQ thus provides a practical foundation for combining heterogeneous IQA datasets to train more generalizable IQA models. Code and dataset will be made public at ivc.uwaterloo.ca/projects/unifying_iqa_datasets/ upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过主观实验建立统一感知尺度，将23个IQA数据集的分数映射到可比较的质量标度，构建了超过50万张图像的MOSAIQ-500K数据集，并提出MOSAIQ-Bench跨数据集基准，用于评估和训练更通用的IQA模型。
AI.motivation: 现有IQA数据集采用不同主观协议和评分尺度，分数不可直接比较，导致难以进行多数据集联合训练和跨数据集评估，缺乏共同感知尺度。
AI.method: 开展新的主观实验，将其评分作为感知锚点，对23个IQA数据集的已有分数拟合单调映射，在保留数据集内部排序的同时统一到共同质量尺度；构建MOSAIQ-500K数据集和MOSAIQ-Bench跨数据集基准，并评估31种IQA方法。
AI.result: MOSAIQ-500K包含超过50万张图像，是最大的具有感知对齐主观分数的IQA数据集；评估显示IQA方法在数据集内与跨数据集性能存在显著差距，尤其在真实失真上；使用对齐分数后，标准回归损失可替代专门的多数据集训练机制，获得相当的类内精度和更好的跨数据集性能。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIQ为整合异构IQA数据集提供了实用基础，有助于训练泛化能力更强的IQA模型，并推动跨数据集评估与统一感知尺度的应用。

title: Effects of Sequence Timing on the Spatio-Temporal Properties of 3D BOLD fMRI: A Formal Framework and Analysis
summary: 3D sequences provide an alternative to 2D or multiband sequences for BOLD fMRI. The impact of acquisition time differences between slices is well understood for 2D or multiband sequences. For 3D sequences, k-space is partitioned into multiple segments and the final image depends on samples taken over an extended period of time. Any precise timing information is lost during reconstruction. A theoretical description of how sequence timing impacts 3D BOLD fMRI data properties is lacking in the literature. We present a formal framework that models sequence timing effects and draw connections to existing literature. The framework rests on the statistical description of a spin system that allows incorporation of BOLD signal changes and is completed by a general description of spatial encoding and image reconstruction. Using this formulation, we define three key images: the actual image reconstructed from a segmented 3D acquisition, an optimal reference image unaffected by sequence timing, and an error image representing their difference. Two sets of operators are defined that describe the generation of these images and allow us to analyse the effects of sequence timing independent of the object. All operators take the form of spatio-temporal filters. They mix signal content spatially and based on its temporal waveform. High-frequency BOLD signal content is affected more strongly compared to low-frequency content. Simulations demonstrate that while the total variance of 3D image time series can be reduced, spatio-temporal fidelity is increasingly lost. Furthermore, we hypothesize that the heightened sensitivity of 3D sequences to physiological noise (compared to 2D) is caused by sequence timing damping thermal noise more strongly than physiological fluctuations. The impact of motion and system instabilities on image time series needs to be studied further.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个形式化框架，用于建模3D BOLD fMRI中序列时序对数据性质的影响，并通过模拟说明3D采集会降低时空保真度。
AI.motivation: 2D或多频带序列的层间采集时间差异影响已被较好理解，但3D序列将k空间分段采集，重建时精确时间信息丢失，文献中缺乏序列时序如何影响3D BOLD fMRI数据特性的理论描述。
AI.method: 基于自旋系统的统计描述纳入BOLD信号变化，并结合空间编码与图像重建的一般描述，建立形式化框架；定义实际重建图像、不受序列时序影响的最优参考图像和误差图像；定义两组算子描述图像生成，并作为时空滤波器分析序列时序效应；通过模拟验证。
AI.result: 所有算子均为时空滤波器，会混合信号的空间内容及其时间波形；高频BOLD信号成分比低频成分受到更强影响；模拟显示3D图像时间序列的总方差可被降低，但时空保真度逐渐丢失；还推测3D序列对生理噪声更敏感，是因为序列时序对热噪声的抑制强于对生理波动的抑制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可形式化描述3D BOLD fMRI中的序列时序效应，并与现有文献建立联系；运动和系统不稳定性对图像时间序列的影响仍需进一步研究。

title: To Memories and Beyond: From Remembering to Knowing You across Long-Term Multimodal Personal Archives
summary: As AI systems evolve into personalized digital companions, a central capability is reasoning over a user's long-term personal history: not merely storing past events, but tracking longitudinal experiences and evolving preferences. Progress here is bottlenecked by evaluation, existing long-term memory benchmarks are largely synthetic and text-only, they overlook the visual records that anchor everyday human memory, lack the authentic and causally connected longitudinal data that real personalization demands, and consequently remain confined to shallow factual recall. We introduce ReaLMem (Real-world Long-term Multimodal Memory), the first benchmark built from authentic multi-year personal visual archives, paired with first-person subjective annotations. ReaLMem evaluates models across three cognitive tiers of increasing difficulty: factual recall, persona inference, and predictive personalization. We further propose ChronoProfiler, a temporal-weighting profiling module that computes temporal stability scores for user attributes and applies them as a salience prior, resolving conflicts among temporally inconsistent preferences and helping models compound multiple co-active preferences in complex personalized decisions. Extensive evaluation of frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and memory systems on ReaLMem reveals predictive personalization as a consistent ceiling, exposes clear performance gaps and bottlenecks between MLLMs and memory systems, and shows that high-quality, temporally informed representations substantially improve personalization. Together, ReaLMem and ChronoProfiler provide an authentic testbed and a simple, effective mechanism for long-term personalization, laying a foundation for future research on lifelong AI companions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个基于真实多年个人视觉档案与第一人称标注的长期多模态记忆基准 ReaLMem，并设计时间加权画像模块 ChronoProfiler，用于评估和提升 MLLM 的长期个性化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆基准多为合成、纯文本数据，忽视视觉记录，缺乏真实且因果关联的纵向数据，只能评估浅层事实回忆，无法支撑真正的个性化 AI 伴侣。
AI.method: 构建 ReaLMem 基准，包含真实多年个人视觉档案和主观标注，并按事实回忆、人格推断、预测性个性化三个认知层级评估；提出 ChronoProfiler，通过计算用户属性的时间稳定性分数作为显著性先验，解决时间不一致偏好冲突并复合多个共时偏好。
AI.result: 对前沿 MLLM 和记忆系统的广泛评估显示，预测性个性化是持续瓶颈，MLLM 与记忆系统间存在明显性能差距，高质量且时间感知的表征能显著提升个性化效果。
AI.conclusion: ReaLMem 与 ChronoProfiler 为长期个性化提供了真实测试平台和简单有效机制，为终身 AI 伴侣研究奠定基础。

title: The Small-Talk Effect in Practical Synchronization of Heterogeneous Oscillating Dynamics
summary: This paper investigates multi-time scale commu- nication schemes in synchronization of heterogeneous Lienard oscillator systems. Existing results rely on global exchange of information for all networked systems at discrete time instants, providing limited flexibility in adjusting the trade-off between communication rate and synchronization performance. A scheme to investigate how global updates are complemented by more frequent local interactions within a sub-network is thus proposed in this paper. For a prescribed bound on the synchronization error, conditions are derived under which the global and local update rates can be selected as design parameters. A numerical example illustrates the beneficial effect of the local interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异构Liénard振子同步中的多时间尺度通信方案，提出用子网络内更频繁的局部交互补充全局更新，并给出全局/局部更新速率的设计条件。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖所有网络系统在离散时刻进行全局信息交换，难以灵活权衡通信速率与同步性能。
AI.method: 提出多时间尺度通信方案：全局更新与子网络内更频繁的局部交互相结合；针对给定同步误差上界，推导全局和局部更新速率可作为设计参数选取的条件，并用数值仿真验证。
AI.result: 得到了在预设同步误差界下，全局更新速率与局部更新速率可设计选取的条件；数值例子表明局部交互具有有益效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入局部交互补充全局更新，可在通信速率和同步性能之间提供更大灵活性，并实现异构Liénard振子系统同步。

title: Compositional Reasoning in Language Models under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training
summary: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we instantiate this framework with data-structure tasks, which provide deterministic reward computation and clear compositional structure. We find a consistent decomposed-to-composed asymmetry: decomposed-skill training does not reliably transfer to composed tasks, whereas composed-task training transfers more readily back to decomposed tasks. We provide theoretical explanation for this asymmetry, and further evaluate compositional generalization under length extrapolation, structural distribution shift, and transfer to tasks requiring unseen skills. Finally, we present a pilot study on real-world tool-calling benchmarks, showing preliminary evidence that the decomposed-to-composed asymmetry can extend to practical settings.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型后训练（如强化学习）对组合推理的影响，提出依赖图框架来形式化组合推理，并通过数据结构任务和真实工具调用基准进行实证分析。
AI.motivation: 组合推理对现实问题求解至关重要，因为训练数据有限，模型必须通过组合已学技能来泛化；但后训练方法对组合推理的具体影响仍不清楚。
AI.method: 提出依赖图框架，定义三个复杂度递增的组合层级；用具有确定性奖励和清晰组合结构的数据结构任务实例化；进行理论解释，并评估长度外推、结构分布偏移、未见技能迁移及真实工具调用基准。
AI.result: 发现一致的“分解到组合”不对称：分解技能训练不能可靠迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更容易迁移回分解任务；理论解释了该不对称，并在工具调用基准中观察到初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 后训练在组合推理上存在系统性不对称，组合任务训练可能比分解技能训练更有效；该现象可能扩展到实际应用，提示需重视组合任务训练与评估。

title: Dynamic-LIVO: A Dynamic-Aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry System Using Spatio-Temporal Normals
summary: This paper proposes Dynamic-LIVO, a dynamic-aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) system for robust state estimation and static colored mapping in dynamic environments. Dynamic-LIVO employs Spatio-Temporal (S-T) normal analysis to identify dynamic LiDAR points and propagates the resulting classification to both LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial updates, preventing dynamic LiDAR measurements and their associated visual observations from affecting state estimation and mapping. However, S-T normal estimation can be unreliable in newly observed and spatially sparse regions due to insufficient spatio-temporal observations. To address this issue, we introduce a time-delayed S-T normal estimation strategy that defers the classification of insufficiently constrained points and re-evaluates them as additional observations become available. This strategy improves dynamic classification reliability while preserving valid static points for map construction. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets with diverse sensor configurations demonstrate that Dynamic-LIVO improves localization accuracy and produces cleaner static colored maps in challenging dynamic environments. The source code and self-collected dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dynamic-LIVO，一种动态感知的 LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry 系统，用于动态环境中的鲁棒状态估计和静态彩色建图。
AI.motivation: 动态物体会污染 LiDAR 和视觉观测，影响状态估计与建图；而现有时空法向分析在新观测或空间稀疏区域不可靠。
AI.method: 利用时空（S-T）法向分析识别动态 LiDAR 点，并将分类传播到 LiDAR-惯性与视觉-惯性更新中，避免动态测量影响状态估计和建图；同时提出时间延迟 S-T 法向估计策略，延迟分类约束不足的点，待更多观测后再评估。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和自采数据集、多种传感器配置下实验表明，Dynamic-LIVO 提高了定位精度，并在挑战性动态环境中生成更干净的静态彩色地图。
AI.conclusion: Dynamic-LIVO 能提升动态环境下的状态估计鲁棒性和静态建图质量，源代码和自采数据集将在接收后公开。

title: Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models
summary: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用LLM内部激活训练轻量级MLP探针来检测有害提示，在多个基准上取得与超大外部防护模型相当的效果，同时显著降低延迟和计算开销。
AI.motivation: 自主系统依赖LLM，但现有安全基础设施带来延迟和计算开销，难以用于资源受限、时间敏感场景；外部防护模型无法理解模型内部状态，存在根本性保障缺口。
AI.method: 从LLaMA-3.1-8B提取激活，训练轻量级MLP分类器探针（12.6M参数）检测有害提示。
AI.result: 在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上，F1分别达到99%、83%和84%，与参数量大1000倍的防护模型相当，同时降低延迟和计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部激活已包含判断内容是否有害的信号，基于内部探针的轻量级防护方案可行且高效。

title: OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion
comment: The project page is at https://OmniMimic.github.io
summary: Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands.
