VA-Bench contains 14 base task families (11 single-arm and three dual-arm), seven held-out geometry/layout variants, and a long-horizon five-object composition track. We evaluate 12 primary model conditions in three independent runs over the same 20 physically verified seeds per base task, reporting terminal success, nine trajectory-level behavioral diagnostics, and subtask progress. First, the best-performing model scores 100.0% on target localization and 78.9% on spatial relations in the annotated run. Its three-run macro-average task success is only 53.93+/-3.17%. Second, active camera control significantly improves task success over passive multi-view observation. In one matched comparison, success rises from 27.86% to 57.50%. Third, held-out geometric transfer can reduce task success by over 30 percentage points. No model completes a strict long-horizon episode, despite substantial partial progress. VA-Bench thus tests whether general-purpose MLLMs can turn visual demonstrations and actively acquired evidence into successful embodied action.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VA-Bench，用于评估通用多模态大模型在空间智能中的完整“观察—推理—行动—修正”闭环，包括主动获取缺失证据、统一空间表征和基于反馈执行动作。
AI.motivation: 现有空间智能评估多停留在描述物体位置，无法检验模型在观测不完整时是否能够主动寻找缺失证据、在共同空间框架中解释信息并据此行动。
AI.method: 构建 VA-Bench，包含 14 个基础任务族（11 个单臂、3 个双臂）、7 个留出几何/布局变体和长时程五物体组合任务。模型仅从 RGB 演示学习程序上下文，主动选择相机视角、发出度量笛卡尔命令，并依据执行反馈修正；不提供物体位姿、oracle 轨迹或学习到的动作头，由固定模型无关控制器执行模型指定目标。评估 12 个主要模型条件，每个基础任务在相同 20 个物理验证种子上独立运行 3 次，报告最终成功率、9 项轨迹级行为诊断和子任务进度。
AI.result: 最佳模型在标注运行中目标定位达 100.0%，空间关系达 78.9%，但三次运行宏平均任务成功率仅 53.93±3.17%。主动相机控制显著优于被动多视角观察，匹配比较中成功率从 27.86% 提升至 57.50%。留出几何迁移可使任务成功率下降超过 30 个百分点。没有模型完成严格长时程任务，尽管有显著部分进展。
AI.conclusion: VA-Bench 检验通用多模态大模型能否将视觉演示和主动获取的证据转化为成功的具身行动；当前模型在空间闭环任务中仍存在明显局限。

title: LearnActCoder: Role-Aware Error Memory for Adaptive Clinical Coding Agents
summary: Clinical coding agents repeatedly encounter the same failure modes, including unsupported codes, missed documented conditions, specificity errors, and procedure-coding convention mismatches. We introduce Learn-Then-Act, an inference-time adaptation framework that converts errors from a small labeled LEARN batch into a structured Mistake Knowledge Database (MistakeKDB). False-negative lessons are routed to a recall-oriented Coder, while false-positive lessons are routed to a precision-oriented Judge. We instantiate the framework in LearnActCoder, a Coder-Judge clinical coding pipeline with lookup-table grounding where available. On 150 matched MIMIC-III notes, structured MistakeKDB improves CPT F1 by 5.9 percentage points, while raw-example and reflection-style memories remain near the no-memory baseline; the ICD-9 improvement is not significant. On a matched MIMIC-IV cohort, memory shifts ICD-10 coding toward higher precision at a recall cost, leaving F1 statistically unchanged. Applying the same memory to 1,000 held-out MIMIC-III notes maintains a stable ICD operating point, providing scale/stability evidence. Overall, the results are consistent with structured, feedback-derived error memory being useful for adapting clinical coding behavior across cases without weight updates or changes to the underlying workflow. Absolute CPT/HCPCS performance remains low, and the system is evaluated retrospectively rather than in clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Learn-Then-Act推理时自适应框架，将小规模标注LEARN批次中的错误转化为结构化MistakeKDB，并实例化为LearnActCoder临床编码流水线，以在不更新模型权重的情况下改善编码行为。
AI.motivation: 临床编码智能体反复出现相同失败模式，如不支持编码、遗漏已记录病症、特异性错误以及手术编码惯例不匹配，因此需要一种能利用错误经验进行推理时适应的方法。
AI.method: 提出Learn-Then-Act框架，把错误转为结构化Mistake Knowledge Database；将假阴性教训路由给偏向召回率的Coder，将假阳性教训路由给偏向精确率的Judge；实例化为LearnActCoder，采用Coder-Judge临床编码流水线，并在可用时使用查找表进行 grounding。
AI.result: 在150条匹配的MIMIC-III病历上，结构化MistakeKDB使CPT F1提高5.9个百分点，而原始示例和反思式记忆接近无记忆基线，ICD-9提升不显著；在匹配的MIMIC-IV队列上，记忆使ICD-10编码偏向更高精确率但牺牲召回率，F1统计上不变；在1000条留出MIMIC-III病历上，ICD工作点保持稳定，提供规模与稳定性证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结构化的、由反馈衍生的错误记忆有助于跨病例适应临床编码行为，且无需权重更新或改变底层工作流；但CPT/HCPCS绝对性能仍较低，且系统为回顾性评估，未在临床部署中验证。

title: F$^{2}$DR: A Fine-Grained Full-Pipeline Reward Framework for DeepSearch Workflows
summary: With the widespread industrial deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), DeepSearch has emerged as the dominant paradigm for resolving complex user queries. It typically operates through an iterative closed-loop workflow consisting of planning and reflection, information retrieval, and answer generation. However, existing reward models (RMs) and evaluation benchmarks are primarily designed for static single-turn tasks, failing to capture the full-pipeline complexity of DeepSearch workflows. To address this limitation, we propose F2DR, a fine-grained full-pipeline DeepSearch reward framework. F2DR evaluates DeepSearch workflows across three dimensions: Content, Trajectory, and Answer, enabling comprehensive process-level assessment. We further construct DeepSearch RM-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating RMs in DeepSearch scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F2DR achieves significantly higher evaluation consistency than self-evaluation-based baselines, while DeepSearch RM-Bench exhibits strong discriminative capability across existing open-source RMs. We will publicly release the complete DeepSearch RM-Bench dataset soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向DeepSearch全流程的细粒度奖励框架F2DR，并构建DeepSearch RM-Bench基准，用于评估DeepSearch场景下的奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型和评测基准主要针对静态单轮任务，无法覆盖DeepSearch中规划、反思、检索和答案生成等迭代闭环流程的复杂性。
AI.method: 提出F2DR框架，从内容（Content）、轨迹（Trajectory）和答案（Answer）三个维度对DeepSearch工作流进行全过程评估；同时构建专用基准DeepSearch RM-Bench。
AI.result: 实验表明，F2DR在评估一致性上显著优于基于自评估的基线；DeepSearch RM-Bench对现有开源奖励模型展现出较强的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: F2DR和DeepSearch RM-Bench能够更全面地评估DeepSearch全流程中的奖励模型，弥补现有静态单轮评估的不足，数据集将公开。

title: AutoData: Agentic Search for Pre-training Data Selection
summary: LLM agents have recently shown promise in automating machine learning engineering by editing model and training code under execution feedback. Data, however, remains largely outside this agentic optimisation loop. We frame pre-training data selection as heuristic engineering over per-document features, i.e., lexical statistics, categorical labels, and perplexity. We introduce AutoData, an agent that searches directly over executable selection algorithms. Unlike prior data mixture methods that optimise weights over a fixed set of domains, AutoData searches a richer program space of scoring, stratification, and stochastic selection rules, discovering feature interactions automatically by iteratively refining algorithms with validation feedback from a proxy model. Within an overnight search, AutoData discovers a selection algorithm that outperforms existing human-designed curation pipelines. Despite being searched only on this small proxy, the discovered recipe transfers to larger scales and improves the downstream metric CORE. These results suggest that data engineering can be treated as an agentic machine learning problem, extending autonomous research from model and training-code optimization to the data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AutoData，将预训练数据选择视为可执行算法的搜索问题，让 LLM 智能体在验证反馈下自动发现优于人工设计的数据筛选流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体已能自动优化模型和训练代码，但数据选择仍主要依赖人工启发式流程，未充分纳入智能体的自动化优化闭环。
AI.method: 将预训练数据选择形式化为对文档级特征（词法统计、类别标签、困惑度等）的启发式工程；AutoData 直接搜索可执行的筛选算法，包括评分、分层和随机选择规则，并利用代理模型验证反馈迭代优化算法。
AI.result: 在一次通宵搜索中，AutoData 发现的筛选算法优于现有的人工设计数据整理流程；尽管仅在小代理模型上搜索，该配方仍可迁移到更大规模，并提升下游指标 CORE。
AI.conclusion: 数据工程可以被视为一种智能体机器学习问题，从而将自主研究从模型和训练代码优化扩展到数据优化。

title: Tele-Traversability: Rethinking Traversability for Teleoperated Ground Robots in Terrain Navigation
summary: Teleoperation, a human-in-the-loop control scheme, allows a human operator to remotely command and guide a mobile robot to navigate in off-road environments, yet fluent and user-friendly tele-navigation requires an alignment of traversability evaluation between human and robot. In the teleoperation system, the human operator typically utilizes off-site incomplete and delayed feedback via a human-machine interface to make a judgment of traversability, while the robot makes such an evaluation based on in situ onboard sensory information, which could cause divergent traversability estimation and thus generate mismatched decisions and actions. Existing approaches for traversability modeling, estimation, and prediction are mainly derived from the view of robots, i.e., robot-centric, and are practically suitable for fully autonomous mobile robots, but neglect the influence of human operators. To address this problem, this paper extends the concept of traversability from robot-centric to human-centric by accounting for the operator's cognitive states, such as attention, workload, and risk tolerance or awareness, termed tele-traversability. We first revisit the definitions and roles of traversability in robotics and then extend them to teleoperation settings. Finally, we highlight future trends and open challenges of tele-traversability toward human-centric teleoperation systems.

AI.tldr: 该文指出现有可通行性研究多以机器人为中心，未充分考虑遥操作中人类操作员的认知影响；为此提出以人为中心的“遥可通行性”概念。
AI.motivation: 遥操作中，人类操作员依赖不完整、延迟的离站反馈判断可通行性，而机器人依赖现场机载感知，二者评估可能不一致，导致决策与动作不匹配。现有可通行性建模、估计与预测方法主要面向全自主机器人，忽略了人类操作员的影响。
AI.method: 概念性扩展与综述：重新审视机器人学中可通行性的定义与作用，并将其扩展到遥操作场景，纳入操作员的注意力、工作负荷、风险容忍度或风险意识等认知状态。
AI.result: 提出“遥可通行性”概念，将可通行性从以机器人为中心扩展到以人为中心，强调人机可通行性评估对齐对流畅、易用遥导航的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 未来需面向以人为中心的遥操作系统，进一步研究遥可通行性，并关注相关趋势与开放挑战。

title: Absence is Presence: Understanding Visual Scene Negative Events Under Safety Cognitive Constraint
summary: Traditional scene understanding focuses on affirmative information objectively present in images. However, in safety-critical domains, comprehending key information that should exist but is actually absent is vital for risk mitigation. To bridge this gap, we focus on visual scene negative captioning with safety as the cognitive constraint. The core challenge is to convert physical absence into semantic negative events. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with this process because affirmation bias suppresses negative reasoning, while limited mental filling capability and representation bias further hinder the inference of absent information. To address these challenges, we propose a negative captioning framework based on counterfactual reconstruction and contrastive decoding (CRCD). Inspired by human cognition, CRCD reformulates the task as counterfactual latent change captioning to bypass affirmation bias. It contrasts a synthesized safe expectation with reality to identify semantic omissions. To address limited mental filling, we design a dual-branch counterfactual reconstruction architecture. The amodal completion branch restores defective objects, while the functional association branch infers completely absent safety objects. Concurrently, a multi-condition representation learning mechanism is integrated to mitigate representation bias by projecting universal features onto predefined safety criteria subspaces, thereby capturing information across more dimensions. By decoding feature-level semantic residuals between the reconstructed scene prototype and raw input, CRCD bounds the non-existence search space and activates the decoder's negative logic. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of CRCD, establishing a high-performance baseline for this pioneering task.

AI.tldr: 论文关注以安全为认知约束的视觉场景负面描述任务，提出基于反事实重建与对比解码（CRCD）的框架，将图像中物理缺失的关键信息转化为语义负面事件。
AI.motivation: 传统场景理解聚焦图像中客观存在的肯定信息，但在安全关键领域，理解应该存在却实际缺失的信息对风险规避至关重要。现有视觉语言模型因肯定偏差、心理填补能力有限和表征偏差，难以处理缺失信息。
AI.method: 提出CRCD框架：将任务重构为反事实潜在变化描述以绕过肯定偏差；通过对比合成的安全期望与现实来识别语义遗漏；设计双分支反事实重建架构，其中amodal补全分支恢复缺陷物体，功能关联分支推断完全缺失的安全物体；集成多条件表征学习机制，将通用特征投影到预定义安全标准子空间；解码重建场景原型与原始输入间的特征级语义残差，约束不存在搜索空间并激活解码器负面逻辑。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了CRCD的有效性，为该开创性任务建立了高性能基线。
AI.conclusion: CRCD能够有效实现视觉场景负面描述，将物理缺失转化为语义负面事件，为安全关键领域的风险缓解提供支持。

title: SnapPhysics: A Physics-Aware Scene Graph from a Single View for Interactive Mixed Reality Scenes
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE ISMAR, 2026
summary: We propose SnapPhysics, a training-free framework that reconstructs 3D objects and estimates their physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of gravity from a single image. For physically coherent interactions in mixed reality (MR), such properties are as important as geometry. Prior approaches infer them by analyzing object dynamics in video, which is computationally costly, or by querying vision-language models (VLMs) on single images, which lacks geometric grounding and inter-object relationships. We address these limitations by combining instance-level 3D reconstruction and spatial alignment with a physics-aware scene graph that encodes these relationships and per-object metric geometry as structured context for VLM-based property reasoning. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that SnapPhysics improves scene-level F-Score by 18.6% over the best learning-based method, and on real captured scenes with ground-truth mass, it reduces the mean absolute log difference error (mALDE) by up to 20.5% and improves log-scale correlation ($r^2_{\mathrm{ls}}$) by up to 19.6% over VLM-only estimation. SnapPhysics enables physically interactive MR experiences without manual parameter tuning. Project page: https://snapphysics-ismar2026.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出SnapPhysics，一种无需训练即可从单张图像重建3D物体并估计质量、摩擦和重心等物理属性的框架，用于混合现实中的物理一致交互。
AI.motivation: MR中物理一致交互不仅需要几何，还需要物体物理属性；现有方法依赖视频动态分析，计算成本高，或仅用VLM处理单图，缺乏几何基础和物体间关系。
AI.method: 结合实例级3D重建与空间对齐，构建物理感知场景图，将物体间关系和每个物体的度量几何编码为结构化上下文，供VLM进行物理属性推理。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT上，场景级F-Score比最佳学习方法提升18.6%；在带真实质量标注的实拍场景中，mALDE最多降低20.5%，log尺度相关系数r²_ls最多提升19.6%。
AI.conclusion: SnapPhysics无需人工调参即可实现物理可交互的MR体验。

title: Rethinking Multi-Agent Collaboration: When More Is Less
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models and single-agent harnesses has reshaped the landscape of autonomous systems, raising a critical question of when multi-agent collaboration offers genuine value. As individual agent capabilities continue to scale, multi-agent collaboration faces diminishing returns while incurring growing context overhead. Through systematic analysis, we delineate the capability boundaries of multi-agent collaboration relative to single-agent alternatives, showing that it confers systematic benefits specifically in long-horizon tasks with sparse dependencies, while single-agent harnesses remain superior in tightly coupled, sequential workflows. Building on these insights, we propose SAIGE, a lightweight multi-agent collaboration mechanism based on Semantic-Aware Incremental Graph Evolution. SAIGE models collaboration as a dynamically evolving graph, where nodes are agent instances spawned on demand and edges encode semantic dependencies established through content-based information retrieval. Experiments on long-horizon, complex task benchmarks show that SAIGE achieves a favorable trade-off between context efficiency and task performance, and that scaling the agent pool or deepening the recursion level does not consistently improve outcomes. Our findings suggest that multi-agent superiority is bounded by task structure rather than universal, and that more agents do not necessarily make a system more intelligent.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析多智能体协作相对单智能体的能力边界，提出SAIGE轻量级协作机制，在长时程稀疏依赖任务中有效，但更多智能体不一定更智能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型与单智能体系统快速发展，随着单智能体能力提升，多智能体协作收益递减且上下文开销增大，需明确何时多智能体协作真正有价值。
AI.method: 系统分析多智能体与单智能体的能力边界；提出SAIGE（语义感知增量图演化）机制，将协作建模为动态演化图：节点为按需生成的智能体实例，边表示基于内容检索建立的语义依赖。
AI.result: 在长时程复杂任务基准上，SAIGE在上下文效率与任务性能间取得良好权衡；扩大智能体池或加深递归层级并不持续提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体的优势受任务结构限制而非普适，更多智能体不一定使系统更智能。

title: Zarya: A Hybrid Autoregressive--Masked Diffusion Language Model with Flexible Training and Dual-Mode Inference
comment: Preprint. Work in progress. Please cite peer-reviewed version when published
summary: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) are constrained by sequential, left-to-right generation, while masked diffusion models (MDMs) enable parallel decoding but suffer from high computational overhead due to the inability to reuse Key-Value (KV) cache and from incoherent generation arising from learning dependencies over an intractable space of token combinations. We introduce Zarya, a family of hybrid language models that jointly optimizes an autoregressive (AR) objective and a masked-diffusion objective within a single architecture. Zarya structures training data into variable-size slots and employs a curriculum that gradually increases slot granularity, enabling a smooth transition from fine-grained AR learning to coarse-grained diffusion learning. At inference, Zarya provides two distinct decoding paradigms through a unified interface: (i) MDM sampling with first-hitting denoising, and (ii) slotted speculative decoding that interleaves inter-slot diffusion-based selection with intra-slot autoregressive infilling, achieving full KV cache reuse. The training and inference regimes are fully decoupled, allowing a model trained with any configuration to be deployed in either mode. Extensive configurability --- including grouped noise patterns (Prefix Completion, Fill-In-the-Prefix, Fill-In-the-Middle), ordered sampling schedules, and noise-level permutation strategies --- enables flexible research exploration. We release Zarya models publicly in sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, demonstrating performance on standard benchmarks while offering a principled integration of autoregressive and diffusion paradigms.

AI.tldr: Zarya 是一类混合语言模型，在单一架构中联合优化自回归目标与掩码扩散目标，通过槽位与课程学习连接细粒度 AR 和粗粒度扩散，并支持两种统一解码范式，公开 0.6B、1.7B、4B 模型。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型受限于从左到右的顺序生成；掩码扩散模型虽可并行解码，但无法复用 KV 缓存导致计算开销高，且因在不可处理的词元组合空间上学习依赖而生成不连贯。
AI.method: 提出 Zarya，将训练数据组织为可变大小槽位，并用逐步提高槽位粒度的课程学习，从细粒度 AR 平滑过渡到粗粒度扩散；推理时统一接口支持 MDM 首次命中去噪采样，以及槽位推测解码，交错进行槽间扩散选择与槽内 AR 填充，实现完整 KV 缓存复用。训练与推理解耦，支持分组噪声模式、有序采样计划、噪声级排列等配置。
AI.result: 公开 0.6B、1.7B、4B 规模的 Zarya 模型，在标准基准上展示性能，并证明自回归与扩散范式的原则性集成。
AI.conclusion: Zarya 为 AR 与扩散范式提供了统一且可配置的集成方案，训练配置与推理模式可解耦部署，便于灵活研究和实际应用。

title: TorchCraft: Unified binder design by inverting an all-atom structure predictor
summary: All-atom structure predictors model diverse molecular interactions, but using their learned structural priors for binder design remains challenging. Here we present TorchCraft, a unified binder-design framework that optimizes sequence logits through a frozen all-atom predictor. Implemented in TorchFold, TorchCraft combines confidence, contact, geometric, and sequence-prior objectives within a shared optimization procedure for minibinders, framework-conditioned VHHs, cyclic peptides, and ligand-binding proteins. Using pretrained AlphaFold 3 weights, TorchCraft generated representative minibinders and VHHs with experimentally measured binding across four targets in each format, without post hoc sequence redesign. Computational benchmarks further demonstrated the framework's applicability to cyclic peptides and ligand-conditioned pocket design. TorchCraft extends predictor inversion to multiple binder formats and molecular contexts, providing a common framework for reusing all-atom structural priors in design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TorchCraft，一个统一的结合体设计框架，通过冻结的全原子结构预测器优化序列 logits，并在 TorchFold 中实现。
AI.motivation: 全原子结构预测器已能建模多样分子相互作用，但利用其学习到的结构先验进行结合体设计仍具挑战。
AI.method: TorchCraft 在共享优化流程中结合置信度、接触、几何和序列先验目标，支持 minibinders、框架条件 VHH、环肽和配体结合蛋白设计；使用预训练 AlphaFold 3 权重。
AI.result: TorchCraft 生成了代表性 minibinders 和 VHHs，并在各四种靶点上实验测得结合，无需事后序列重设计；计算基准还展示了其对环肽和配体条件口袋设计的适用性。
AI.conclusion: TorchCraft 将预测器反演扩展到多种结合体格式和分子场景，为在设计中共用全原子结构先验提供了通用框架。

title: Recovering Aggressively Pruned Vision-Language-Action Models with Offline Hidden-State Distillation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models let robots follow language instructions, but their language backbones of several billion parameters are the main obstacle to running them on robot hardware. Structured pruning reduces that backbone, and removing 63% of it from OpenVLA-OFT drops LIBERO-Long success from 93.2% to 0.8%. A recent approach restores such a model with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, which needs online rollouts and hundreds of GPU-hours. We recover most of the lost success entirely offline. Width pruning narrows the blocks but keeps the residual stream at its original size, so teacher and student hidden states have the same shape and are matched directly, without a projector. Training against a cache built in one teacher pass lifts the 63%-reduced student to within 3.5 points of the teacher in about 8 GPU-hours. A sweep over nine ratios locates where the recovery objective starts to matter. Up to 45% reduction the two do not differ significantly on OpenVLA-OFT. Hidden-state distillation then adds +2.1 to +4.5 points there between 63% and 87%, and +9.4 to +22.1 points on CogACT from 63% onward. At 81% on CogACT, a tripled recovery budget narrows the distilled student's gap to the teacher to 3.9 points on average, while supervised recovery stays more than 20 points below. At matched compression, width pruning yields higher success and depth pruning lower latency. On a 6-DoF manipulator, the distilled student at 72% reduction reaches 77.5% success against 59.5% for supervised recovery, runs 2.23x faster on-board than the teacher, and uses 62% less memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种纯离线恢复方法，用于修复结构化剪枝后的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过宽度剪枝保持残差流形状不变，使教师与学生隐藏状态可直接匹配，无需投影器，并利用一次教师前向构建的缓存进行隐藏状态蒸馏，从而在极少 GPU 时间内恢复大部分成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型虽能跟随语言指令，但数十亿参数的语言主干难以部署到机器人硬件上。结构化剪枝可压缩主干，但会严重降低成功率，例如 OpenVLA-OFT 剪掉 63% 后 LIBERO-Long 成功率从 93.2% 降至 0.8%。现有恢复方法需监督微调加强化学习，依赖在线 rollout 和数百 GPU 小时，因此需要更高效的离线恢复方案。
AI.method: 采用宽度剪枝，只缩小模块而保留残差流原始尺寸，使教师和学生隐藏状态形状一致，可直接匹配而无需投影器。训练时使用一次教师前向传播构建的缓存进行隐藏状态蒸馏。在 OpenVLA-OFT 和 CogACT 上扫描九种压缩比例，并与监督恢复方法对比；在 6-DoF 机械臂上评估部署性能。
AI.result: 63% 压缩的学生模型约 8 GPU 小时即可恢复到教师 3.5 个百分点以内。压缩至 45% 时，蒸馏与监督恢复在 OpenVLA-OFT 上无显著差异；63% 至 87% 时隐藏状态蒸馏带来 +2.1 至 +4.5 个百分点提升；CogACT 上从 63% 起提升 +9.4 至 +22.1 个百分点。CogACT 81% 压缩下，三倍恢复预算使蒸馏学生与教师平均差距缩小至 3.9 个百分点，而监督恢复仍低 20 个百分点以上。相同压缩率下，宽度剪枝成功率更高，深度剪枝延迟更低。6-DoF 机械臂上，72% 压缩的蒸馏学生达到 77.5% 成功率，监督恢复为 59.5%，且比教师板载运行快 2.23 倍，内存少用 62%。
AI.conclusion: 纯离线隐藏状态蒸馏能有效恢复宽度剪枝后 VLA 模型的大部分性能，无需在线 rollout 或大量 GPU 小时。宽度剪枝在成功率上优于深度剪枝，而深度剪枝在延迟上更优。该方法在 OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT 及真实机械臂上均验证了压缩、恢复与部署效率的平衡。

title: JustMem: Just-Enough Memory Access for Long-Term Conversations
summary: Efficient long-term conversational memory requires retrieving sufficient evidence without indiscriminately expanding the context presented to the language model. This is challenging because relevant evidence may be distributed across multiple sessions, while compression may discard details needed for answering. Different queries therefore require different forms of memory access. To capture these demands, we formulate memory access along two dimensions: discovery breadth, which controls how broadly evidence is searched, and reading fidelity, which controls whether evidence is read in compact form or recovered from the original conversation. Based on this formulation, we introduce JustMem, which stores conversation history as compact atomic memories and adapts memory access along these two dimensions to each query. Specifically, LOOKUP handles local evidence, COMPOSE broadens discovery for distributed evidence, and REPLAY increases reading fidelity for fidelity-sensitive evidence. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, JustMem achieves the highest mean accuracy and retrieval recall among the compared memory systems while using substantially fewer generative-model tokens for memory construction and inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 JustMem，将对话历史存储为紧凑的原子记忆，并沿“发现广度”和“读取保真度”两个维度自适应调整记忆访问，以在高效检索证据的同时避免上下文膨胀。
AI.motivation: 长期对话记忆需要检索足够证据，但不能盲目扩展语言模型上下文。相关证据可能分散在多个会话中，压缩又会丢失细节，且不同查询需要不同形式的记忆访问。
AI.method: 将记忆访问形式化为两个维度：发现广度控制证据搜索范围，读取保真度控制以紧凑形式读取还是从原始对话恢复。JustMem 据此存储紧凑原子记忆，并按查询自适应选择 LOOKUP（局部证据）、COMPOSE（扩大发现以处理分布式证据）、REPLAY（提高保真度以处理对细节敏感的证据）。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上，JustMem 在对比的记忆系统中取得最高平均准确率和检索召回率，同时在记忆构建和推理中使用显著更少的生成模型 token。
AI.conclusion: JustMem 通过自适应记忆访问，在检索充分证据与控制上下文成本之间取得平衡，为长期对话记忆提供了一种高效且有效的方案。

title: KoUniTalk: A Lightweight Articulation-Centered Korean-English 3D Talking Face Benchmark
summary: High-quality 3D talking face datasets remain largely English- centric, and Korean 3D facial motion data are difficult to combine with standard English benchmarks because of differences in mesh topology, spatial scale, coordinate system, and temporal sampling. We present KoUniTalk, a lightweight articulation-centered Korean-English 3D talk- ing face benchmark that retargets VOCASET and the released Korean speech-based 3D talking face data to a shared mesh topology using de- formation transfer. Rather than proposing a new deformation-transfer algorithm or a full-head identity-preserving avatar dataset, KoUniTalk provides an identity-neutral canonical output space for controlled speech- driven facial articulation training and evaluation across English and Ko- rean. The unified template contains 1,176 vertices and focuses on the mouth and adjacent lower- and mid-face regions, reducing the output dimensionality from 15,069 and 72,147 dimensions to 3,528 dimensions, corresponding to 4.27-fold and 20.45-fold reductions compared with VO- CASET/FLAME and the original Korean mesh, respectively. To exam- ine whether retargeting preserves speech-relevant motion, we evaluate semantic mouth-landmark trajectories, including mouth opening, mouth width, aperture ratio, and mouth-opening dynamics. Since the official test set of the Korean dataset is not publicly released, we additionally define a subject-disjoint Korean benchmark split. The processed matched benchmark contains 22 speakers, 4,978 sequences, and 642,781 frames, enabling Korean-English cross-dataset evaluation of speech-driven 3D fa- cial animation models in a single compact articulation-template space. Source-reported inventory counts are listed separately from these pro- cessed counts

AI.tldr: 提出KoUniTalk，一个以发音为中心的轻量级韩英3D说话人脸基准，通过变形迁移将VOCASET与韩语3D说话人脸数据统一到共享网格，便于跨语言训练与评测。
AI.motivation: 高质量3D说话人脸数据集大多以英语为中心，韩语3D面部运动数据因网格拓扑、空间尺度、坐标系和时间采样不同，难以直接与标准英语基准结合。
AI.method: 使用变形迁移将VOCASET和公开韩语语音3D说话人脸数据重定向到共享网格拓扑；构建身份中立的规范输出空间，聚焦嘴部及相邻中下面部区域；定义受试者不重叠的韩语基准划分；通过张嘴、嘴宽、开口率和张嘴动态等语义嘴部关键点轨迹评估重定向是否保留语音相关运动。
AI.result: 统一模板包含1,176个顶点，输出维度从15,069和72,147降至3,528，分别较VOCASET/FLAME和原始韩语网格减少4.27倍和20.45倍。处理后的匹配基准包含22位说话人、4,978个序列和642,781帧，可支持韩英跨数据集语音驱动3D面部动画评估。
AI.conclusion: KoUniTalk不提出新的变形迁移算法或完整身份保持头像数据集，而是提供一个紧凑、身份中立的统一发音模板空间，用于韩英语音驱动3D面部动画的受控训练与评测。

title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
comment: Paper is accepted in IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings. Spoken question answering (SQA) benchmark for Telugu remains unexplored, and the reliability of automatic evaluation in this setting remains unquantified. We introduce VākQA, a Telugu SQA benchmark of 2,001 factoid question-answer pairs across six domains, with 2.53 hours of speech audio, bilingual transcriptions, and human-verified reference answers. We first validate evaluation methods against human judgements: Gemini-as-a-judge best approximates human ratings but is non-uniformly strict, while open-weight judges systematically penalize correct Telugu answers that differ in surface form from the reference. Using this validated setup, we benchmark proprietary and open-weight models across input modality, language, and domain. We observe that Telugu phrasing retains cultural specificity that is lost in translation, speech input introduces phonetic confusions that alter question meaning, and cascaded ASR-MT errors compound progressively. VākQA is publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 VākQA，一个泰卢固语口语问答基准，包含 2,001 个事实型问答对、2.53 小时语音、双语转写和人工验证参考答案，并系统评估了自动评判方法与多种模型在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前问答系统在大语言模型推动下发展迅速，但主要集中在高资源语言的文本和口语场景。泰卢固语口语问答基准尚未被探索，且该场景下自动评估的可靠性也缺乏量化研究。
AI.method: 构建 VākQA 泰卢固语口语问答基准，覆盖六个领域，包含 2,001 个事实型问答对、2.53 小时音频、双语转写与人工验证参考答案；先用人工判断验证自动评估方法，再在输入模态、语言和领域维度上评测闭源与开源模型。
AI.result: 验证发现 Gemini-as-a-judge 最接近人工评分，但严格程度不一致；开源权重评判模型会系统性惩罚与参考答案表面形式不同但正确的泰卢固语答案。模型评测显示：泰卢固语表述保留翻译中丢失的文化特异性，语音输入引入改变问题含义的语音混淆，级联 ASR-MT 错误会逐步累积。
AI.conclusion: VākQA 已公开发布，为泰卢固语口语问答提供了基准，并揭示了多语言、多模态问答中评估可靠性与错误传播等关键挑战。

title: Quantifying Mechanical Intelligence in Legged Robots with Information Theory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 for publication
summary: Mechanical intelligence, loosely defined as the reduction in control burden afforded by a robot's physical form, has become a prominent concept in robotics, with instantiations in bioinspired robotics, soft robotics, robotic swarms, and many other areas. However, rigorous theoretical understanding and quantitative measures of mechanical intelligence have lagged behind the engineering systems that the community has developed. In this work, using modern legged robots as a benchmark and exemplar, we propose several information-theoretic metrics for quantifying mechanical intelligence. By viewing body dynamics as both a computational process and a communication channel, we show that several prior insights in legged-robot engineering can be described using information theory, and we quantify how bits are processed by mechanical modes and across robot coordinates. Specifically, we examine the trade-off between explicitly incorporating compliance through series-elastic actuation and using so-called proprioceptive, low-gear-ratio transmissions, and we explore how these mechanisms interact with control policies during locomotion. We develop these results on systems of increasing complexity: a simplified linear model of a robot-leg transmission, a nonlinear single-leg simulation, and simulated quadruped robots controlled by a learned policy while navigating challenging terrain. These results lay the groundwork for broader study of robot mechanisms and their role in embodied computation.

AI.tldr: 该文以现代腿式机器人为例，提出用信息论指标量化机械智能，即机器人身体形态如何降低控制负担，并为理解机构与具身计算的关系奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 机械智能在机器人学中日益重要，但缺乏严谨的理论理解和定量度量，落后于已有的工程系统发展。
AI.method: 将身体动力学视为计算过程和通信信道，提出若干信息论指标；以腿式机器人为基准，分析串联弹性驱动与低齿轮比本体感受传动之间的权衡，并在线性机器人腿传动模型、非线性单腿仿真和由学习策略控制的模拟四足机器人越障任务中验证。
AI.result: 表明腿式机器人工程中的若干已有洞见可用信息论描述，并能量化机械模态及机器人坐标间处理的信息比特数；同时揭示合规性与传动方式如何与运动控制策略交互。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为更广泛地研究机器人机构及其在具身计算中的作用奠定了基础。

title: OmniCalib: Target-Free, Task-Structured Self-Calibration for Humanoid Robots
summary: Assembly, wear, and component replacement perturb the sensor extrinsics and joint zeros encoded by a humanoid CAD model. Existing procedures calibrate one sensor pair or require external fiducials. Using only robot-native motion and onboard sensing, we present OmniCalib, a target-free workflow that calibrates the full upper limbs---all 14 arm joint zeros and the extrinsics of both wrist and chest cameras---as well as lower limbs and the multi-camera head rig. Each module matches a robot-native task to a parameter block, checks observability, and writes only supported corrections to the CAD model. Our depth ICP method recovers all 14 arm joint zeros and calibrates all RGB-D camera extrinsics without any calibration target. Relative to CAD, the estimated extrinsic corrections are 10.56 mm and 1.74 degrees for the left wrist, 6.33 mm and 1.25 degrees for the right wrist, and 9.81 mm and 0.929 degrees for the chest RGB-D camera. ICP point-to-plane residual is 2.09 mm. On the same injected offsets, ICP and ArUco recover all 14 joint zeros below the 0.1-degree encoder-resolution reference. On an AGIBOT A3 Ultra humanoid, four static double-support stances recover all 12 lower-limb joint-zero offsets injected with an RMS error of 0.063 degrees. The head module combines multi-camera visual odometry with legged odometry and dynamic compensation through the live ROS transform tree. Using only planar walking, it attains a mean SO(3) error of 1.061 degrees across three sequences. The best sequence reaches 0.775 degrees, competitive with iKalibr at 0.902 degrees from rich 6-DOF excitation. Rig-relative angles repeat within 0.140 degrees. Injection recovery and held-out tests validate each observable block.

AI.tldr: OmniCalib 是一种无需标定物、仅利用机器人自身运动和板载传感的类人机器人标定流程，可校准上肢14个关节零位、腕部/胸部RGB-D相机外参、下肢关节零位以及多相机头部装置。
AI.motivation: 装配、磨损和部件更换会扰动CAD模型中的传感器外参和关节零位；现有方法通常只校准单个传感器对，或依赖外部标定物。
AI.method: 将机器人原生动作与参数块匹配，检查可观测性，并只把有支持的修正写入CAD模型。上肢用深度ICP无靶标恢复14个手臂关节零位并校准RGB-D外参；下肢用静态双支撑站姿估计12个关节零位；头部结合多相机视觉里程计、腿式里程计与动态补偿，并通过ROS变换树在线融合。
AI.result: 相对CAD，左腕外参修正10.56 mm、1.74°，右腕6.33 mm、1.25°，胸部RGB-D相机9.81 mm、0.929°；ICP点到面残差2.09 mm。注入偏移下，ICP与ArUco均将14个关节零位恢复到低于0.1°编码器分辨率参考。AGIBOT A3 Ultra上，12个下肢关节零位注入偏移的RMS误差为0.063°。头部仅用平面行走，三条序列平均SO(3)误差1.061°，最佳0.775°，与iKalibr在丰富6自由度激励下的0.902°相当；装置相对角度重复性0.140°。
AI.conclusion: 注入恢复和留出测试验证了各可观测模块；表明仅用机器人原生运动和板载感知，无需标定靶标，也能有效校准类人机器人多模块参数，并将可靠修正写回CAD模型。

title: Integrating knowledge from case reports: a medical ontology based multimodal information system with structured summary
summary: Published medical case reports serve as a crucial medical information carrier, documenting discoveries in rare diseases, diagnostic methods, and innovative treatments. Despite the wealth of clinical knowledge in millions of case reports in the public medicine literature database (PubMed), accessing relevant information efficiently is hindered by the limitations of traditional keyword-based retrieval tools on unstructured and diverse case reports. To address the above issues, we introduce a comprehensive multimodal information system for case reports integrating structured clinical summaries of patients including medical images and biomedical named entities from 52949 open-access case reports published from 2000 to 2021. The multimodal essential information is organized in a well-structured medical ontology. Also, a powerful interface for searching and browsing case reports is designed to assist junior clinicians in retrieving cases effectively and improving the identification and diagnosis of rare diseases.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个面向医学病例报告的综合多模态信息系统，整合了2000至2021年间52949篇开放获取病例报告中的结构化临床摘要、医学图像和生物医学命名实体，并提供高效的搜索与浏览界面。
AI.motivation: 医学病例报告是重要的医学信息载体，记录了罕见病、诊断方法和创新治疗等发现，但PubMed中数百万病例报告因非结构化和多样性，传统关键词检索工具难以高效获取相关信息。
AI.method: 引入综合多模态病例报告信息系统，整合结构化患者临床摘要、医学图像和生物医学命名实体，数据来自52949篇2000至2021年开放获取病例报告；将多模态核心信息组织在结构化医学本体中，并设计强大的搜索和浏览界面。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖52949篇开放获取病例报告的多模态信息系统，实现了结构化临床摘要、医学图像和生物医学命名实体的整合与本体化组织，并提供了有效的检索与浏览接口。
AI.conclusion: 该系统可帮助初级临床医生有效检索病例，提高罕见病的识别和诊断能力。

title: WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning
summary: Adapting robots to new objects and tasks requires interaction experience that can be costly to obtain. We present WorldContact, a contact-centric world model for deformable-object manipulation, constructed from a limited set of high-quality trajectories to generate additional training data efficiently. It predicts object dynamics using larger time steps than the source numerical simulator, which requires small integration steps to resolve rapid motion and prevent interpenetration. We evaluate WorldContact across 16 shopping-bag manipulation tasks. State-rollout measurements on a single H100 GPU show a $10\times$ speedup over the source simulator, excluding rendering and disk I/O. We use the generated data to fine-tune an existing vision-language-action policy and deploy it directly on a real robot. In bag lifting, the same policy achieves 65% single-attempt success when fine-tuned on source simulation data alone, compared with 95% when fine-tuned on the dataset expanded with WorldContact. These results support efficient data generation with WorldContact for robot policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出以接触为中心的可变形物体操作世界模型 WorldContact，用少量高质量轨迹高效生成额外训练数据，用于机器人策略适配。
AI.motivation: 机器人适应新物体和新任务需要交互经验，但真实交互数据获取成本高、代价大。
AI.method: 构建 WorldContact 接触中心世界模型，基于有限高质量轨迹预测可变形物体动力学；采用比源数值模拟器更大的时间步训练/预测，以处理快速运动并避免穿透；在16个购物袋操作任务上评估，并用生成数据微调现有视觉-语言-动作策略后部署到真实机器人。
AI.result: 在单张H100 GPU上进行状态推演，WorldContact 比源模拟器快10倍（不含渲染和磁盘I/O）；在袋子提升任务中，仅用源仿真数据微调时单次尝试成功率为65%，加入 WorldContact 扩展数据后提升至95%。
AI.conclusion: WorldContact 能高效生成训练数据，显著提升机器人策略在新物体和任务上的适配效果。

title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
summary: The KV cache has become a major bottleneck in deploying LLMs, as its memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and batch size, imposing substantial pressure on both memory capacity and bandwidth. Among various KV cache compression techniques, quantization is particularly attractive due to its effectiveness and ease of deployment. However, most existing methods rely on fixed-width quantization, where a $b$ bit representation is inherently limited to $2^b$ quantization levels. As the bit width decreases, the number of available levels shrinks exponentially, leading to severe information loss and rapid performance degradation. We further observe that fixed-width quantization fails to exploit the highly non-uniform distribution of KV cache. After rotation and normalization, KV values approximately follow a normal distribution, with most values concentrated near the center and only a small fraction appearing in the tails. Nevertheless, fixed-width coding allocates the same number of bits to frequent and rare symbols. Entropy coding naturally exploits such non-uniformity by assigning shorter codewords to frequent symbols and longer ones to rare symbols, substantially reducing the average number of bits required for representation. However, its variable-length output is not suited to highly parallel attention kernels, where efficient dequantization and computation rely on regular memory layouts and fixed-stride accesses. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{D-Quant}, a flexible KV cache quantization framework that introduces a \textbf{drift} mechanism to convert entropy-coded representations of each token into fixed-size bitstreams, enabling regular memory access and parallel dequantization within attention kernels.

AI.tldr: 针对 KV cache 内存瓶颈，提出 D-Quant 量化框架，利用熵编码压缩非均匀分布的 KV 值，并通过 drift 机制将变长编码转为固定大小比特流，以支持并行注意力内核。
AI.motivation: KV cache 内存随序列长度和批量线性增长，成为 LLM 部署瓶颈。现有固定位宽量化受限于 2^b 个量化级，低位宽下信息损失严重；且 KV 值近似正态分布，固定位宽未利用其非均匀性。熵编码虽能压缩，但变长输出不适合高度并行的注意力内核。
AI.method: 提出 D-Quant 框架，引入 drift 机制，将每个 token 的熵编码表示转换为固定大小比特流，从而实现规则内存访问和注意力内核内的并行反量化。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，主要结果是提出 D-Quant 框架，通过 drift 机制解决熵编码变长输出与并行注意力内核不兼容的问题。
AI.conclusion: D-Quant 为 KV cache 量化提供了一种灵活方案，在利用熵编码压缩非均匀分布的同时，保持固定步长内存布局和并行反量化能力。

title: Contagion on the Trading Floor: How Adversarial Signals Spread in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
comment: Published in ECML PKDD 2026. 25 pages, including 7 pages of supplementary material
summary: Multi-agent trading systems built on large language models (LLMs) are beginning to appear in quantitative finance, yet their robustness to adversarial inputs is largely unknown. We study the vulnerability of LLM trading stacks to black-box, input-only attacks that enter solely via admissible social-media feeds. We introduce the Generic Multi-Agent Trading System (GMATS), a framework that captures modern multiagent trading architectures and instantiate a class of black-box poisoning attackers that treat an LLM as a post generator and inject budget-constrained, plausibly benign social-media content into the analyst's evidence stream. We define contagion metrics that trace how adversarial content propagates through the stack, including belief-shift scores at analyst and coordinator layers and attack-clean deltas on standard backtest metrics. Experiments on a safe offline benchmark with historical market and social data show that even simple input-only attackers can materially degrade risk-return profiles, sharply reducing Sharpe ratios. At the same time, we find that suitably designed multi-agent topologies and coordinator prompts can dampen adversarial shocks and improve average robustness under identical poisoning budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体交易系统对抗性输入攻击的鲁棒性，提出GMATS框架及黑盒投毒攻击方法，发现仅通过社交媒体信息即可显著降低风险收益表现，但合理的多智能体拓扑与协调者提示可缓解冲击。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体交易系统在量化金融中逐渐出现，但其面对对抗性输入的鲁棒性尚不清楚，尤其是仅通过可接受的社交媒体信息流进入系统的黑盒攻击。
AI.method: 提出通用多智能体交易系统框架GMATS，构建黑盒投毒攻击者：将LLM作为帖子生成器，在预算约束下向分析师证据流注入看似良性的社交媒体内容；定义传播指标，包括分析师与协调者层的信念偏移分数，以及标准回测指标上的攻击-干净增量；在安全离线基准上使用历史市场与社交数据进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使简单的仅输入攻击者也能实质性恶化风险收益特征，显著降低夏普比率；同时发现设计良好的多智能体拓扑和协调者提示可以在相同投毒预算下抑制对抗冲击并提升平均鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体交易系统对社交媒体输入投毒具有脆弱性，但通过优化多智能体架构与协调提示可增强鲁棒性，为安全部署提供方向。

title: PACE: Precise AI Cinematic Expression: A Typed Specification for Script-Grounded Previsualization and Geometric Conformance
summary:
Between a screenplay and a film sits a planning problem that is spatial first: who stands where, and what a camera sees from where it stands. An image diffusion model asked for a shot in free text settles that plan by its own defaults. We present PACE (Precise AI Cinematic Expression), a typed representation for the plan: the screenplay evidence, the characters, props and locations it needs, where each subject stands, and what the camera does. A value is written once at the level it belongs to (script, scene, shot or panel) and inherited below it. A compiler turns the result into both the prompt sent to the diffusion model and a 3D scene built in metres, and a camera solver places the camera so that the declared framing is the framing built. Where a declared value becomes geometry, PACE measures, field by field, how far the compiled camera and the staged render sit from the declaration, rather than asking a model to judge.
  On the 11-scene Automatic Drive screenplay, every staged single-subject panel places its subject within 1.2% of frame width of its declared position; with two or three subjects one camera pose cannot satisfy every position, and the residual is reported rather than absorbed. On 204 external director-storyboard shots, delivered head height is 1.906 times the staged target from the director's words, 1.733 from the compiled prompt, and 0.955 with the greybox control; the condition that holds framing best draws the described action least. Declaring the pose on 30 shots raises the action drawn from 58.9% to 74.4% without moving the framing. Transitions, fitted motion and human review of the generated panels remain open. Code: https://github.com/StudioPiLabs/pace-core

AI.tldr: PACE是一种类型化表示，用于将剧本转化为精确的镜头规划，通过编译器生成扩散模型提示和3D场景，并用相机求解器保证构图精确。在自动驱动剧本和外部故事板镜头上验证了其精度和局限。
AI.motivation: 从剧本到电影之间存在空间规划问题：谁站在哪里、相机从何处看到什么。自由文本驱动的图像扩散模型依赖自身默认来规划镜头，缺乏对构图和调度的精确控制。
AI.method: 提出PACE类型化表示，包含剧本证据、角色、道具、地点、主体位置和相机运动。值在脚本、场景、镜头或面板层级写入并向下继承。编译器将其转为扩散模型提示和以米为单位的3D场景，相机求解器放置相机使声明的构图与构建的构图一致。通过逐字段测量编译相机和 staged render 与声明的偏差来评估。
AI.result: 在自动驱动剧本的11个场景中，单主体面板的主体位置误差在画幅宽度的1.2%以内；多主体（2-3个）时单一相机位姿无法满足所有位置，残差被报告。在204个外部导演故事板镜头上，导演文字、编译提示和灰盒控制得到的头部高度分别是 staged 目标的1.906、1.733和0.955倍；构图保持最好的条件绘制动作最少。在30个镜头上声明姿态，可使绘制动作从58.9%提升至74.4%，且不改变构图。
AI.conclusion: PACE能够精确控制镜头构图和主体位置，但转场、拟合运动和生成面板的人工审核仍是待解决问题。代码已开源。

title: Socialized UAV Cross-Task Learning: Towards Cross-Granularity Collaboration through Hierarchical Interaction
summary: Joint learning across heterogeneous tasks is often treated as task coupling through feature sharing, distillation, or auxiliary supervision. However, in cross-task learning, mismatched representational and supervisory granularities make such coupling prone to interference, teacher bias, or unidirectional collapse. We argue that cross-granularity learning is fundamentally a problem of hierarchical interaction regulation rather than simple task coupling. This issue is particularly evident in UAV perception, where visual shifts and detection--segmentation objectives naturally form coarse- and fine-grained knowledge sources. To systematically study this problem, we introduce CrossUAV, a UAV benchmark for joint object detection and instance segmentation that provides a unified evaluation platform for cross-granularity task collaboration. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration (CGSC), a progressive and adaptive framework that regulates when, where, and how tasks exchange information across network hierarchies. CGSC progressively activates cross-task interactions and adaptively adjusts the strength according to task contribution, suppressing harmful interference while exploiting complementary coarse- and fine-grained structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements on both tasks, validating hierarchical dynamic interaction as an effective mechanism for cross-granularity collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨粒度学习本质上是层次交互调节问题，而非简单任务耦合。针对无人机感知中的跨粒度任务协作，提出了CrossUAV基准和CGSC框架，通过渐进自适应调节跨任务交互，在目标检测和实例分割上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 联合学习异构任务常被视为特征共享、蒸馏或辅助监督的任务耦合，但表征和监督粒度不匹配易导致干扰、教师偏差或单向崩溃。跨粒度学习应视为层次交互调节。无人机感知中视觉变化和检测-分割目标自然形成粗粒度和细粒度知识源，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 引入CrossUAV，一个用于联合目标检测和实例分割的无人机基准，提供跨粒度任务协作的统一评估平台。提出跨粒度社会化协作（CGSC）框架，渐进且自适应地调节任务在网络层次中何时、何地、如何交换信息，根据任务贡献调整交互强度，抑制有害干扰并利用互补的粗/细粒度结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，两个任务均获得一致提升，验证了层次动态交互作为跨粒度协作机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跨粒度协作可通过层次动态交互调节有效实现，CGSC在CrossUAV基准上验证了该机制。

title: PetriBench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning over Dynamic State Spaces
summary: Characterizing LLM reasoning remains an open challenge, as many existing benchmarks isolate specific reasoning skills, rely on external knowledge, or are costly to extend. We introduce PetriBench, a compact, fully self-contained, and scalable benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over dynamic state spaces using Petri nets, a mature formalism for modeling real-world concurrent and distributed systems. PetriBench organizes reasoning into four task families varying by scope and temporal horizon, with Easy, Medium, and Hard levels generated by increasing structural complexity and evaluated against exact ground truth. Across a diverse set of proprietary and open-weight models, accuracy decreases consistently with difficulty, while harder instances expose increasingly distinct task-specific capability profiles. Additional analyses show that test-time compute improves performance but interacts differently with different reasoning tasks, and that procedural generation yields smooth scaling with structural complexity. Together, these results show that PetriBench provides a unified and extensible setting for probing the strengths, limits, and scaling behavior of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PetriBench，一个基于 Petri 网的紧凑、自包含且可扩展的 LLM 推理基准，用于评估动态状态空间中的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 推理基准往往孤立特定技能、依赖外部知识或扩展成本高，难以统一评估推理能力。
AI.method: 利用 Petri 网建模并发与分布式系统，设计四个任务族，并按结构复杂度生成 Easy、Medium、Hard 三级实例，使用精确真值评估多种专有和开源模型，并分析测试时计算的影响。
AI.result: 模型准确率随难度上升而持续下降；更难实例暴露更明显的任务特定能力差异；测试时计算能提升性能，但与不同推理任务交互不同；程序化生成使性能随结构复杂度平滑变化。
AI.conclusion: PetriBench 为探测 LLM 推理的优势、局限和扩展行为提供了统一且可扩展的评估环境。

title: PART: Learning 3D Part Assembly and Retrieval with Transformers
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 11 pages, 12 figures. Project page: https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/
summary: 3D assembly is fundamental to modern manufacturing and digital content creation. In this paper, we present PART, a unified transformer-based framework for 3D part retrieval and assembly: given a target shape and a part library, PART automatically selects the appropriate parts and predicts their 6-DoF poses to reconstruct the target. While prior work has achieved impressive progress on assembling a pre-defined set of parts, this more practical retrieval-based setting remains largely unexplored. The task faces three key challenges: (i) a combinatorially explosive search space that grows exponentially with library size; (ii) variable-length outputs, as different targets require different numbers of parts; and (iii) continuous 6-DoF pose estimation for part assembly. To address these, we formulate retrieval and assembly as a set prediction problem and design a novel transformer-based framework that retrieves parts and regresses their poses with variable-length output. Additionally, we exploit the duality between part pose estimation and target segmentation through joint training and a novel segmentation-enhanced optimization module. Finally, We curate a large-scale dataset of 80K+ shapes, and the results show that PART generalizes to scene layouts, image targets, and real-world scans. Project Page: https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PART，一个统一的基于Transformer的3D部件检索与装配框架。给定目标形状和部件库，PART自动选择合适部件并预测其6-DoF位姿以重建目标。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多集中于装配预定义部件集，而更实用的基于检索的设定尚未被充分探索。该任务面临三大挑战：随部件库规模指数增长的组合搜索空间、不同目标所需部件数量不同导致的变长输出，以及部件装配所需的连续6-DoF位姿估计。
AI.method: 将检索与装配建模为集合预测问题，设计基于Transformer的框架，以变长输出检索部件并回归其位姿。同时利用部件位姿估计与目标分割之间的对偶性，通过联合训练和一种分割增强优化模块提升性能。构建了包含8万多个形状的大规模数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，PART能够泛化到场景布局、图像目标和真实世界扫描等不同输入形式。
AI.conclusion: PART为基于检索的3D部件装配提供了一种统一且有效的解决方案，并展示了向多种实际应用场景推广的潜力。

title: BINDER: A Latent Variable Model for Probabilistic Medical Image Registration
summary: We propose a new probabilistic model for general-purpose medical image registration that builds upon the mutual information registration criterion. It centers around a spatial interpolation technique that assumes latent voxel-wise correspondences between the images being registered. By exploiting these latent variables, we derive dedicated optimization and MCMC sampling techniques that only involve closed-form iterative updates. When applied to nonlinear registration, an efficient demons-like optimization algorithm is obtained that shows robust out-of-the-box performance across a variety of monomodal and multimodal registration tasks. We also demonstrate a corresponding sampler that can quantify, for the first time, uncertainty in multimodal registration scenarios with very high-dimensional 3D deformations. Our code, which we call BINDER (Bayesian INference for DEformable Registration), is freely available at https://github.com/ste93ste/BINDER.

AI.tldr: 提出 BINDER 概率医学图像配准模型，基于互信息并引入潜在体素对应关系，推导闭式迭代优化与 MCMC 采样，实现非线性配准及高维多模态不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 医学图像配准，尤其多模态和高维 3D 形变场景，需要通用、鲁棒且能量化不确定性的方法；现有互信息配准缺乏高效概率推断与不确定性估计。
AI.method: 构建基于互信息的概率模型，假设图像间存在潜在体素级对应关系；采用空间插值技术，推导仅含闭式迭代更新的优化和 MCMC 采样；非线性配准时得到类似 demons 的高效算法；实现开源工具 BINDER。
AI.result: 在多种单模态和多模态配准任务中表现出稳健的开箱即用性能；首次在多模态配准中量化高维 3D 形变的不确定性；代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: BINDER 为通用医学图像配准提供了有效概率框架，兼具高效优化与不确定性量化能力，且代码开源可用。

title: TacSushi: Tactile-Grounded World-Action Modeling for Dexterous Sushi Manipulation
summary: Dexterous food manipulation requires control under deformation, occlusion, and uncertain contact. We present TacSushi, a tactile-grounded, Cosmos3-based world-action policy that learns from recorded future consequences while acting on current observations. The backbone encodes current RGB, language, and hand state, and feature-wise gated fusion incorporates fingertip tactile features into the action representation. During training, a decoder conditioned on demonstrated action chunks predicts logged future visual observations, task progress, relative contact risk, and tactile summaries; this decoder is removed at deployment. Failed trials provide consequence supervision, but their actions are excluded from imitation. We train TacSushi on 340 successful and 50 failed real-robot trials and compare six methods in 600 separate rollouts across three in-distribution tasks and two out-of-distribution ingredient variants. To assess food quality beyond a single geometric threshold, we score terminal outcomes using an anchored visual-quality protocol that equally weights five human ratings and three vision-language-model ratings per rollout. Full TacSushi achieves 68.3% average in-distribution success and 37.5% out-of-distribution success, compared with 36.7%/10.0% without future-consequence supervision and 25.0%/17.5% with direct tactile concatenation in place of gated fusion. These comparisons support complementary benefits of feature-wise gated tactile fusion and training-only predictive supervision.

AI.tldr: TacSushi 是一个基于 Cosmos3 的触觉接地世界-动作策略，用于灵巧食物操作。它在训练时利用未来后果监督，并通过特征级门控融合指尖触觉信息，部署时移除预测解码器。
AI.motivation: 灵巧食物操作面临形变、遮挡和不确定接触等挑战，需要更好的触觉与预测性监督来提升操作成功率和泛化能力。
AI.method: 骨干网络编码当前 RGB、语言和手部状态；采用特征级门控融合将指尖触觉特征融入动作表示。训练时，以示范动作块为条件的解码器预测未来视觉观测、任务进度、相对接触风险和触觉摘要，部署时移除该解码器。失败试验仅提供后果监督，其动作不用于模仿。在 340 次成功和 50 次失败的真实机器人试验上训练，并在 3 个分布内任务和 2 个分布外食材变体中进行 600 次独立 rollout，比较 6 种方法。终端结果使用锚定视觉质量协议评分，该协议等权结合 5 个人工评分和 3 个视觉语言模型评分。
AI.result: 完整 TacSushi 在分布内平均成功率为 68.3%，分布外为 37.5%；无未来后果监督时分别为 36.7% 和 10.0%；用直接触觉拼接替代门控融合时分别为 25.0% 和 17.5%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持特征级门控触觉融合与仅训练时预测性监督具有互补收益，能显著提升灵巧食物操作性能与泛化性。

title: Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Companion to arXiv:2606.28308 and arXiv:2607.17543. Fully reproducible: a single self-contained notebook regenerates every number, table, and figure
summary: Regularized self-play -- the family behind DeepNash's Stratego play -- drives a two-player zero-sum policy to a Nash equilibrium by best-responding to a slowly moving, entropy-regularized reference policy $ρ$. When the game has a polytope of value-equivalent equilibria, the regularizer silently breaks the tie: with a uniform reference it selects the maximum-entropy member, the I-projection of $ρ$ onto the Nash set. Can the reference be used to choose the equilibrium on purpose? On five exactly solvable games plus a 2-D polytope, with exact best responses and equivalence tests over independent seeds, anchoring the reference at a target member and refining steers self-play to that member with mean coordinate error 0.007 at median exploitability $5\times10^{-5}$, TOST-equivalent to the request within $\pm0.05$; the anchoring persists through refinement and follows the reference, not the initialization. Selection follows the reach-weighted I-projection (slope 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]). We report with equal emphasis where the story breaks: fixed off-manifold references cost 0.08-0.25 exploitability; stiff or flat families require a smaller mirror step, set by a pre-registered rule; boundary targets undershoot; curvature predicts where boundary saturation bites (rank correlation 0.90, p=0.037) while interior precision is curvature-independent. Table and MLP steering maps are equivalent within $\pm0.03$ at every target (30 seeds); matched control arms show attention's robust signature is excess seed variance, any systematic shift bounded at 0.018 and not significant. Against a best response the selection-robustness trade-off is degenerate: steering matters only against fixed, non-equilibrium opponents. The recipe -- anchor the reference at the desired member and refine -- reinterprets the KL anchor of RLHF-style RL as a selection knob, not only a stability leash.

AI.tldr: 本文研究正则化自博弈能否有意选择价值等价均衡中的目标均衡。方法是将参考策略锚定到目标均衡成员并继续精炼，在多个可解博弈和二维多面体上验证；结果表明自博弈可被引导至目标成员，但也存在边界、离流形参考和刚性/平坦族等失效条件。
AI.motivation: DeepNash 等正则化自博弈中，熵正则项会在价值等价均衡构成多面体时隐式打破平局，例如均匀参考会选择最大熵均衡。作者追问：参考策略能否被主动用作均衡选择旋钮，而不仅是稳定项。
AI.method: 在五个精确可解博弈加一个二维多面体上，使用精确最佳响应和跨独立种子的等价性检验；将参考策略锚定到目标均衡成员并精炼，测试选择是否跟随参考而非初始化。还比较表格与 MLP 引导图，并设置匹配控制组，分析注意力机制的种子方差与系统偏移。
AI.result: 锚定参考并精炼可将自博弈引导到目标成员：平均坐标误差 0.007，中位可利用度 5×10^-5，TOST 等价于请求值 ±0.05；选择遵循可达加权 I-投影（斜率 0.969 [0.950, 0.987]）。失效条件包括：固定离流形参考带来 0.08–0.25 可利用度代价；刚性和平坦族需更小镜像步；边界目标会欠调；曲率可预测边界饱和（秩相关 0.90，p=0.037），内部精度与曲率无关。表格和 MLP 引导图在各目标上等价（±0.03，30 种子）；注意力稳健特征主要是种子方差过大，系统偏移上限 0.018 且不显著。对抗最佳响应时选择-稳健性权衡退化，引导仅在面对固定非均衡对手时重要。
AI.conclusion: 锚定参考到期望均衡成员并精炼，可将 RLHF 式 RL 中的 KL 锚重新解释为均衡选择旋钮，而不仅是稳定性约束；同时该选择方法有明确适用边界，需关注参考离流形、目标在边界、族刚性以及对手类型等条件。

title: Dual-Axis Policy Optimization for LLM Agents: Bayesian Feedback Attribution and Trajectory Mass Normalization
summary: Reinforcement learning for LLM agents involves two distinct optimization di- mensions: how environment feedback is exploited within a trajectory, and how complete trajectories are aggregated across a batch. We formulate these dimen- sions as Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution and Inter-Trajectory Objec- tive Aggregation, and introduce BATON (Bayesian Attribution and Trajectory Objective Normalization), a dual-axis policy optimization framework. BATON instantiates the first axis with Bayesian Feedback Attribution, which constructs a feedback-conditioned posterior over sampled actions, and the second with Trajec- tory Mass Normalization (TMN), which assigns equal optimization mass to com- plete trajectories. Experiments with GRPO and GiGPO on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA show that both axes provide independent gains and that their combi- nation consistently achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BATON，一种面向 LLM 智能体强化学习的双轴策略优化框架，分别处理轨迹内反馈归因和轨迹间目标聚合，并在多个任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体强化学习存在两个关键但常被忽视的优化维度：轨迹内如何利用环境反馈，以及批次中如何聚合完整轨迹；现有方法对二者处理不足。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为 Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution 和 Inter-Trajectory Objective Aggregation，并提出 BATON 框架。其第一轴为 Bayesian Feedback Attribution，构建基于反馈条件的动作后验；第二轴为 Trajectory Mass Normalization（TMN），为完整轨迹分配同等优化质量。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SearchQA 上结合 GRPO 与 GiGPO 实验表明，两个轴均带来独立增益，且二者结合在不同模型规模下持续取得最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 同时优化轨迹内反馈归因与轨迹间目标聚合能够提升 LLM 智能体强化学习效果，BATON 为这类双维度优化提供了有效框架。

title: Evaluating Communicative Success in Machine-Translated Conversation
summary: Interpreter agents built on machine translation (MT) increasingly mediate live conversation between people who do not share a language, yet we still evaluate them with metrics built for isolated sentences, which measure fidelity rather than whether communication succeeds. We introduce a reusable three-layer checklist-and-judge framework that evaluates interpreter-mediated conversation across semantic, pragmatic, and cultural-social dimensions, covering the naturalness, intent, and social appropriateness that fidelity metrics leave unmeasured. It runs in both single-turn and interactive multi-turn settings, where simulated users reply to translated messages as the conversation unfolds and each turn is scored alongside the conversation as a whole. We extensively validate it through controlled perturbations, cross-judge comparisons, and human annotations. Our main single-turn benchmark evaluates 10 interpreter setups across Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian, and Korean from 5,624 OpenSubtitles-derived scenarios spanning 12 translation directions, and our multi-turn study covers all 6 language pairs in scripted and live modes. Results show a consistent decline from semantic to pragmatic and cultural-social success, while conventional MT metrics overlook failures among stronger interpreters, and prompt ablations show that scenario context, structured instructions, and cultural context improve communicative success, although gains vary across setups. Our work thus provides an evaluation framework and benchmark for interpreter agents in conversation, and highlights the importance of communicative success alongside existing translation metrics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个可复用的三层“清单与评判”框架，用于评估口译智能体在真实对话中的交际表现，并构建单轮与多轮基准，强调语义、语用和文化社会层面的成功而不仅是翻译忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有机器翻译评估多针对孤立句子，主要衡量忠实度，无法判断口译智能体是否真正促成跨语言沟通；因此需要面向会话、覆盖自然度、意图和社会适宜性的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出三层 checklist-and-judge 评估框架，覆盖语义、语用、文化社会维度，支持单轮和交互式多轮设置；多轮中模拟用户对翻译消息作出回复，并对每轮及整段对话评分。通过受控扰动、跨评委比较和人工标注进行验证。单轮基准评估10种口译设置，涵盖阿拉伯语、孟加拉语、印尼语、韩语，基于5,624个OpenSubtitles场景、12个翻译方向；多轮研究覆盖6个语言对，含脚本和实时模式。
AI.result: 结果显示从语义到语用再到文化社会层面，表现持续下降；传统机器翻译指标会忽视较强口译系统中的失败。提示消融表明，场景上下文、结构化指令和文化上下文能提升交际成功，但增益因设置而异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为会话中的口译智能体提供了评估框架和基准，并指出在现有翻译指标之外，应同样重视交际成功。

title: EmbodiedMind: Adaptive Data Curation and Prefix-Tree Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Embodied Intelligence
summary: Training embodied foundation models typically requires massive-scale datasets and extensive computational resources, yet often suffers from three critical limitations: (1) inefficient sample utilization due to low-informative samples; (2) imbalanced gradient contributions across heterogeneous tasks; and (3) severe credit assignment problem in long-horizon planning, where trajectory-level rewards indiscriminately penalize all tokens. To address these issues, we propose an efficient training paradigm that achieves state-of-the-art average performance through strategic data selection and hierarchical policy optimization. Our approach consists of three synergistic stages. First, Rejection Sampling-based Fine-Tuning (RSFT) filters out low-informative samples to establish robust behavioral priors while preventing distributional collapse. Second, Iterative Rejection GRPO (IR-GRPO) employs task-specific queues stratified by difficulty to keep datasets balanced across reinforcement learning iterations, coupled with a hybrid reward mechanism for precise cross-task feedback. Third, to enhance long-horizon task planning, we introduce Trie-GRPO, a novel reinforcement learning algorithm based on action prefix trees, which enables step-level advantage estimation. This resolves the credit assignment problem by isolating intermediate correct decisions from downstream errors, while effectively balancing exploration efficiency and depth compared to conventional search trees. As a result, EmbodiedMind achieves a state-of-the-art average performance of 70.02% across 18 benchmarks, and significantly outperforms other embodied foundation models in long-horizon task planning accuracy. Our project will be released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三阶段高效训练范式，通过数据筛选与分层策略优化提升具身基础模型性能，最终模型EmbodiedMind在18个基准上取得70.02%的平均表现。
AI.motivation: 现有具身基础模型训练通常依赖大规模数据和算力，但存在样本利用率低、异构任务梯度贡献不均衡、长时规划中轨迹级奖励导致信用分配困难等问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个协同阶段：RSFT通过拒绝采样微调过滤低信息样本，建立稳健行为先验；IR-GRPO使用按难度分层的任务队列平衡强化学习迭代数据，并结合混合奖励提供跨任务反馈；Trie-GRPO基于动作前缀树进行强化学习，实现步级优势估计，以隔离中间正确决策与下游错误。
AI.result: EmbodiedMind在18个基准上达到70.02%的最优平均性能，并在长时任务规划准确率上显著优于其他具身基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，结合战略性数据选择与分层策略优化，可有效缓解具身基础模型训练中的样本、梯度和信用分配问题，并计划开源项目以支持复现。

title: MetaRTL: Meta-path Attention Enhanced Relational Table Learning
summary: Relational table learning has gained increasing attention with the widespread use of relational databases. Existing methods typically rely on deep GNN or HGNN stacks, leading to high computational costs and limited performance on large real-world databases. We propose MetaRTL, a two-stage framework for scalable and expressive relational table learning. In the first stage, MetaRTL obtains initial table embeddings via lightweight pre-training. In the second stage, it performs non-parametric message passing to derive meta-path features, which are then aggregated by an attention module, MetaAttn. By shifting computation from deep message passing to efficient meta-path aggregation, MetaRTL captures rich relational semantics while maintaining high efficiency. Experiments on 10 real-world datasets across 24 tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaRTL，一个两阶段关系表学习框架，通过轻量预训练和非参数消息传递+MetaAttn聚合元路径特征，实现高效可扩展的关系表学习。
AI.motivation: 现有关系表学习方法依赖深层GNN/HGNN堆叠，计算成本高，在大规模真实数据库上性能受限。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段轻量预训练获得初始表嵌入；第二阶段进行非参数消息传递提取元路径特征，并用注意力模块MetaAttn聚合；将计算从深层消息传递转移到高效元路径聚合。
AI.result: 在10个真实数据集、24个任务上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MetaRTL能在保持高效率的同时捕获丰富关系语义，适用于大规模关系表学习。

title: Generalization through Lexical Abstraction in Transformer Models: The Case of Functional Words
summary:
Pronouns, adverbs and other functional words (such as they, her, somewhere, there) are often used in language to replace concrete nouns or phrases, when their properties - such as gender, grammatical number - provide sufficient information for the given context. Do pretrained transformer models encode such functional words in a manner that allows them to be used like humans do? Can language models recognize the syntactic and semantic parallelism of sentences such as "The researchers wrote the paper" and "They wrote it", which relies on such lexical abstraction?
  We map these linguistic questions into the embedding space of a pretrained transformer model, and compare representations of nouns, with the representations of the pronouns and adverbs that can replace these nouns, in isolation and in parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We then probe for shared syntactic and semantic structure in the embeddings of parallel lexicalized and functional sentences.
  We find that functional words are located centrally compared to nouns, but are also distinct, which is congruent with their behaviour as place-holders in a wide variety of contexts.
  The analysis of the embeddings of parallel (lexicalized and functional) sentences show them inhabiting different subspaces of the embedding space. Experiments that distil the structural information of the sentence show that training on either type of data does not reveal the shared structure - because of the over-consistency of the vocabulary (in case of the functional data), and the too much variety (in case of the lexicalized versions). However, training with a mix of functional and lexicalized sentences, the shared structure emerges.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预训练Transformer模型是否像人类一样编码代词、副词等功能词，并探讨模型能否识别词汇化句子与功能化句子之间的句法和语义平行性。
AI.motivation: 功能词常替代具体名词或短语，但其编码方式是否支持类似人类的抽象与替换能力尚不清楚；作者希望了解语言模型能否捕捉如“The researchers wrote the paper”与“They wrote it”之间的平行结构。
AI.method: 将语言学问题映射到预训练Transformer的嵌入空间，比较名词与可替代它们的功能词在孤立形式及平行词汇化/功能化句子中的表示，并探测平行句子嵌入中的共享句法和语义结构，还进行了结构信息蒸馏实验。
AI.result: 功能词在嵌入空间中比名词更中心化，但也保持独特性，符合其作为多语境占位符的行为；平行词汇化与功能化句子占据不同子空间；仅用功能化或词汇化数据训练不能揭示共享结构，前者因词汇过度一致，后者因变化过多；混合训练后共享结构才出现。
AI.conclusion: 预训练Transformer对功能词和名词的编码存在系统差异，且不能仅从单一句子类型中直接提取词汇化与功能化句子间的共享结构；混合功能词与词汇化句子有助于显现这种共享的句法和语义结构。

title: KoNeoBench: A Curated Evaluation Dataset for LLM Understanding of Korean Neologisms
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code and data are available at the project repository
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on static benchmarks, even though natural language constantly evolves through newly emerging words and meanings. Existing Korean benchmarks are centered on established vocabulary and therefore provide limited coverage of such recent lexical change, and their English-oriented design makes it difficult to assess the typological properties of Korean, in which content words combine productively with functional morphemes. In this paper, we introduce KoNeoBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' understanding of Korean neologisms. KoNeoBench is built on 1,785 Korean neologisms attested in online news since 2020 and curated through expert lexicographic review. Each entry provides usage examples, word-formation analyses, and dictionary-style definitions. Based on this resource, we define four tasks and report results on recent models, together with a human baseline. Our experiments show that current LLMs exhibit clear limitations in recovering source components, distinguishing semantic categories, and generating accurate definitions. These results reveal specific aspects of recent Korean lexical change that remain challenging for current LLMs. KoNeoBench is available at https://github.com/bcmilab/ko-neobench/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 KoNeoBench，一个用于评估大语言模型理解韩语新造词的基准。该基准包含 1,785 个 2020 年以来网络新闻中出现的新造词，并由专家进行词典学审查，定义了四项任务，并测试了近期模型与人类基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型通常在静态基准上评估，但自然语言会不断产生新词和新义。现有韩语基准主要覆盖既有词汇，对近期词汇变化覆盖不足；且其英语导向设计难以评估韩语中内容词与功能语素能产性结合的类型学特征。
AI.method: 构建 KoNeoBench：收集 2020 年以来网络新闻中出现的 1,785 个韩语新造词，经专家词典学审查；每条词条提供用法示例、构词分析和词典式定义。基于该资源定义四项任务，并在近期模型上报告结果，同时设置人类基线。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前大语言模型在还原来源成分、区分语义类别和生成准确释义方面存在明显局限，揭示了近期韩语词汇变化中对现有模型仍具挑战性的具体方面。
AI.conclusion: KoNeoBench 为评估大语言模型对韩语新造词的理解提供了新基准，并暴露出当前模型在处理韩语近期词汇变化时的不足。该基准已在 https://github.com/bcmilab/ko-neobench/ 公开。

title: SlugTrails: An Egocentric Benchmark for Floor Plan Localization in Large Buildings
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Preprint. Code and data: https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails
summary: Floor-plan-based indoor visual localization enables infrastructure-free positioning, but most methods are developed and evaluated in small residential environments unlike the large public buildings of real deployment. We introduce SlugTrails, a floor plan localization benchmark for large indoor spaces under realistic egocentric sensing: $30$ Hz Aria glasses recordings across three campus buildings and six floors ($22089$ m$^2$ of floor plan outline), CAD-derived floor plans with semantic classes and circulation space masks, and trajectories aligned into the floor plan frame using laser-surveyed anchors. One protocol covers three practical ways of gathering geometry under a limited field of view -- a single walking frame, a stationary multi-view sweep, and a walking stream with odometry -- so methods designed for different regimes are compared on the same buildings and ground truth. Evaluating five representative geometric and learned systems under their native sensing configurations, we find that stock checkpoints (official released weights) are near zero on SlugTrails (at most $0.004$ R@1m30$^{\circ}$ on walking single frames), while fine-tuning on SlugTrails improves every trainable family on all three tasks (e.g., F$^3$Loc $0.0 \rightarrow 0.141$ single-frame and $0.03 \rightarrow 0.66$ sequential), with gains compounding as observations accumulate. The same fine-tuned weights also improve cross-dataset generalization on LaMAR with no LaMAR training (sequential R@1m $0.048 \rightarrow 0.143$ for F$^3$Loc and $0.063 \rightarrow 0.127$ for UnLoc), whereas train-from-scratch on SlugTrails alone stays far below fine-tuning from stock weights -- evidence that floor plan localization is currently limited by indoor data rather than by architecture. We release the dataset, protocols, and tools at https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SlugTrails，一个面向大型室内空间的楼层平面图视觉定位基准，基于Aria眼镜真实自我中心感知数据，评估现有方法并发现微调可显著提升性能并改善跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有楼层平面图室内视觉定位方法多在小型住宅环境开发和评估，而真实部署场景常为大型公共建筑，缺乏大规模、真实感知的基准。
AI.method: 构建SlugTrails基准：30Hz Aria眼镜记录，覆盖3栋校园建筑6层（22089平方米），提供带语义类和通行空间掩码的CAD楼层平面图，使用激光测量锚点将轨迹对齐到平面图坐标系。设计三种协议：单帧行走、静止多视角扫描、带里程计的行走流。评估五种代表性几何与学习系统。
AI.result: 官方预训练权重在SlugTrails上表现接近零（单帧行走R@1m30°最高0.004）；在SlugTrails上微调可提升所有可训练族（如F³Loc单帧0.0→0.141，序列0.03→0.66），增益随观测累积；微调权重在无LaMAR训练下提升跨数据集泛化（F³Loc序列R@1m 0.048→0.143，UnLoc 0.063→0.127）；从零训练远低于从预训练权重微调。
AI.conclusion: 楼层平面图定位当前受限于室内数据而非架构，SlugTrails数据集、协议和工具已开源。

title: ReShoot: Generative Visual Domain Randomization of Recorded Robot Demonstrations for Visuomotor Policy Learning
summary: Imitation-learned robot policies are frequently overfit to the visual conditions present in their training demonstrations. Consequently, variations in object color or background appearance often induce substantial performance degradation. A common mitigation strategy is to acquire additional demonstrations in each novel visual context; however, this approach is resource-intensive, requiring repeated access to a robot, a controlled environment, and human operation for every appearance condition to be covered. We introduce ReShoot, a framework that synthesizes visual diversity by re-rendering previously recorded demonstrations under altered appearances, thereby shifting the burden from data collection to generation. A vision-language model captions the scene, edits a targeted attribute (e.g., background, object color, or material), and an edge-conditioned video generator re-renders both camera views to match. The instruction is updated accordingly. The action sequence and proprioceptive trajectory are copied verbatim without relabeling, so each generated episode retains the recorded action and proprioceptive labels. On LIBERO, a policy trained on an equal mixture of recorded and re-rendered demonstrations matches the performance of recorded-only training (96.5% vs. 96.9%). Moreover, the mixed training set improves robustness to scene perturbations on LIBERO-Plus (85.5% vs. 82.3%). Across two physical robotic platforms, deploying ReShoot with 43 and 100 pre-collected demonstrations increased the success rate on recolored objects from 0.0% to 42.9% and 47.5%, respectively, while maintaining performance under the original recorded appearance.

AI.tldr: ReShoot 通过视觉语言模型编辑属性并用边缘条件视频生成器重渲染已有示范，从而在不重新采集数据的情况下增加视觉多样性，提升模仿学习策略对颜色、背景等变化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习机器人策略常对训练演示中的视觉条件过拟合，物体颜色或背景变化会导致性能大幅下降；而针对每个新视觉环境重新采集示范需反复使用机器人、受控环境和人工操作，成本高昂。
AI.method: ReShoot 利用视觉语言模型为场景生成描述并编辑目标属性（如背景、物体颜色或材质），再由边缘条件视频生成器重渲染两个相机视角并相应更新语言指令；动作序列和本体感受轨迹原样复制、不重新标注，使生成片段保留原有动作与标签。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上，使用录制与重渲染示范等量混合训练的策略性能与仅录制训练相当（96.5% vs. 96.9%），并在 LIBERO-Plus 上提升了对场景扰动的鲁棒性（85.5% vs. 82.3%）。在两个实体机器人平台上，使用 43 和 100 条预采集示范部署 ReShoot，使重着色物体上的成功率分别从 0.0% 提升到 42.9% 和 47.5%，同时保持原始录制外观下的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReShoot 将视觉多样性获取的负担从数据采集转移到数据生成，能在不牺牲原始分布性能的情况下提升视觉鲁棒性，并可迁移到真实机器人任务。

title: BinoGen: Scaling egocentric binocular data for embodied visual perception and learning
summary: Embodied visual perception relies on temporally coherent visual experience accumulated through continuous engagement with the environment. However, collecting large-scale egocentric binocular observations together with dense annotations remains costly and difficult. Moreover, visual experience is shaped not only by the environment but also by the embodiment of the observer, including viewing height, field of view, binocular geometry, and motion through the scene. To address these challenges, we present BinoGen, an automated framework for generating large-scale, embodiment-aware egocentric binocular visual experiences in indoor environments. BinoGen jointly models environmental and observer variation through generative scene synthesis, probabilistic object instantiation, appearance randomization, stochastic trajectory generation, and configurable binocular camera setups. The framework produces synchronized binocular videos together with dense multimodal supervision, including depth maps, optical flow, surface normals, semantic maps, object coordinates, and camera poses. Using BinoGen, we construct a dataset comprising more than 20 million annotated images for supervised learning. We demonstrate two complementary utilities of BinoGen. First, incorporating BinoGen data consistently improves real-world visual perception, including depth estimation, object detection, and video object tracking. Second, paired human-inspired and mouse-inspired observations from the same environments enable controlled investigation of how observer embodiment affects perceptual learning. Embodiment-specific adaptation substantially improves performance, while joint training enables a single model to perform competitively across both embodiments. Together, these results demonstrate that large-scale, controllable visual experience can improve embodied perception...

AI.tldr: 提出BinoGen自动生成大规模、具身感知的室内自中心双目视觉体验，构建超2000万标注图像数据集，并证明其可提升真实世界视觉感知及支持具身差异研究。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉依赖连续环境交互形成的时间连贯经验，但大规模自中心双目观测与密集标注采集成本高、难度大；同时视觉经验受观察者具身参数（视高、视场、双目几何、运动）影响，需可控生成环境与观察者变化。
AI.method: BinoGen联合建模环境与观察者变化，采用生成式场景合成、概率物体实例化、外观随机化、随机轨迹生成和可配置双目相机设置，生成同步双目视频及深度、光流、表面法线、语义、物体坐标、相机位姿等密集多模态监督。
AI.result: 构建超2000万标注图像数据集；引入BinoGen数据持续提升深度估计、目标检测和视频目标跟踪等真实世界视觉感知；同环境的人类启发与鼠类启发配对观测可受控研究具身对感知学习影响，具身特定自适应显著提升性能，联合训练使单模型在两种具身上下均有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、可控的视觉经验能够改进具身感知，并为研究观察者具身差异如何影响感知学习提供了有效途径。

title: Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training
summary: Imitation-learned vision--language--action (VLA) foundation models acquire broad manipulation capabilities by scaling robot data across tasks and embodiments, but reliable deployment on a specific downstream task and hardware platform still requires post-training. Dexterous hands make this adaptation particularly difficult: their broad behavioural repertoire and high degree of freedom create a large and structured action space. Three obstacles are central: open-source VLAs do not natively provide an action interface for high-DoF hands; gesture mismatch during human-gated DAgger takeover creates command discontinuities and contaminates corrective trajectories; and reinforcement learning in the raw joint space is sample-inefficient. We present a unified four-step post-training pipeline comprising a learned temporal hand-action codec, supervised fine-tuning, DAgger, and real-world residual reinforcement learning. The codec adapts a pretrained VLA to absolute dexterous-hand commands. Buffered rollback, pose alignment, and smooth command blending enable continuous, task-relevant DAgger corrections, while latent residual RL confines exploration to coordinated hand motions captured by the codec. We evaluate the pipeline on five diverse real-world tasks spanning bimanual transfer, in-hand reorientation, and tool use. Within the reported post-training budgets, the resulting policies achieve 100\% success on every evaluated task over 20 trials per task. These results provide a practical path for adapting VLA foundation models to reliable real-world dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出一个四步后训练流程，将模仿学习得到的VLA基础模型适配到高自由度灵巧手和特定下游任务，并在五个真实世界任务上实现100%成功率。
AI.motivation: 开源VLA模型缺乏高自由度灵巧手的原生动作接口；人类接管DAgger时手势不匹配导致命令不连续并污染纠正轨迹；原始关节空间强化学习样本效率低。
AI.method: 统一四步后训练流程：学习式时序手部动作编解码器、监督微调、DAgger、真实世界残差强化学习。编解码器将预训练VLA适配为绝对灵巧手命令；缓冲回滚、姿态对齐和平滑命令混合实现连续任务相关DAgger纠正；潜在残差RL将探索限制在编解码器捕获的协调手部动作中。
AI.result: 在五个真实世界任务上评估，涵盖双手迁移、手内重定向和工具使用。在报告的后训练预算内，所得策略在每个任务20次试验中均达到100%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 该流程为将VLA基础模型适配到可靠的真实世界灵巧操作提供了一条实用路径。

title: A Dual-Process Perspective on Nudge Susceptibility in LLM-Based GUI Agents
comment: Preprint of a manuscript completed in November, 2025
summary: LLM-based GUI agents increasingly act on behalf of users in digital environments that were designed with human users in mind. These graphical user interfaces were designed to support, but also deliberately steer, the behaviour and decisions of users. While behavioural biases in the textual outputs of LLMs are well-documented, far less is known about how such influence operates when models act as agents that perceive interfaces and execute decisions---and, in particular, whether the reasoning capabilities increasingly built into these agents make them more robust to it. Drawing on Dual-Process Theory, we empirically investigate whether LLM-based GUI agents are susceptible to automatic (Type 1) and reflective (Type 2) digital nudges, and how their reasoning configuration moderates this susceptibility. In a randomized online shopping experiment with 3,600 agents and a total of 21,600 simulations across six frontier models from three providers, we found that agents were vulnerable to both nudge types. Crucially, the reasoning configuration moderated these effects in opposing directions, reducing susceptibility to automatic default nudges while heightening it to reflective social influence nudges. Extensive reasoning therefore did not make agents more robust but redirected the route through which choice architecture takes effect. Exploratory analysis further showed this redirection to be systematically structured by model scale. Beyond establishing nudge susceptibility as a behavioural property of agentic AI, the study positions interface design as a governance concern for organizations that delegate decisions to autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于双过程理论，通过在线购物实验考察LLM图形界面代理是否易受数字助推影响，以及推理配置如何调节这种易感性。
AI.motivation: LLM图形界面代理越来越多地代表用户在为人设计的数字环境中行动，而这些界面会引导用户行为与决策。现有研究多关注LLM文本输出中的行为偏差，但对代理感知界面并执行决策时如何受界面影响、推理能力是否增强其鲁棒性知之甚少。
AI.method: 采用随机在线购物实验，覆盖3家提供商的6个前沿模型，共3,600个代理、21,600次模拟；基于双过程理论，检验代理对自动型（Type 1）与反思型（Type 2）数字助推的易感性，并分析推理配置的调节作用。
AI.result: 代理对两类助推均表现出脆弱性。推理配置产生方向相反的调节作用：降低对自动默认助推的易感性，却提高对反思型社会影响助推的易感性。广泛推理并未使代理更鲁棒，而是改变了选择架构起效的路径。探索性分析显示，这种路径转移受模型规模系统性影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究将助推易感性确立为代理式AI的一种行为属性，并表明界面设计应成为组织向自主代理委托决策时的治理关切。

title: GS-PI: An Optimization-Decoupled Appearance Decomposition Approach for Generating PBR Gaussian Assets
summary: Gaussian Splatting (GS) excels at novel-view synthesis but encodes baked-in radiance, tightly entangling illumination with geometry and preventing seamless integration into physically based rendering (PBR) pipelines. Existing inverse-rendering methods attempt to disentangle materials via joint optimization, but often suffer from competing objectives that cause severe ambiguities and residual lighting artifacts. To overcome this, we present GS-PI, a novel optimization-decoupled framework that casts PBR material generation as a geometry-conditioned diffusion process on 3D point clouds. By operating directly in the 3D domain, our method inherently guarantees multi-view consistency, sidestepping the severe pixel correspondence issues that challenge 2D diffusion approaches.
