We introduce a multi-scale cross-view conditioning mechanism that integrates three complementary components: a global semantic prior, source-anchored photometric cues, and an absolute spatial learned view-direction conditioning signal. This design efficiently compresses complex multi-view evidence, mitigating cross-view projection misalignment and successfully preventing specular highlights from baking into intrinsic colors. By extracting a point cloud from a pre-trained Gaussian model, predicting PBR attributes via conditional diffusion, and distilling them back through differentiable rasterisation, we yield a fully relightable PBR-GS asset. GS-PI outperforms recent inverse-rendering baselines while replacing per-scene joint illumination/BRDF optimization with a learned diffusion pass followed by a short target-driven distillation, without requiring proxy meshes.

AI.tldr: 提出 GS-PI，一种将 PBR 材质生成建模为 3D 点云上几何条件扩散过程的优化解耦框架，可从预训练 Gaussian Splatting 中提取可重光照的 PBR-GS 资产。
AI.motivation: Gaussian Splatting 虽擅长新视角合成，但将光照与几何烘焙进辐射场，难以直接接入 PBR 管线；现有逆渲染联合优化方法存在目标冲突，导致材质与光照歧义及残余光照伪影。
AI.method: 将 PBR 材质生成视为 3D 点云上的几何条件扩散过程，直接在 3D 域操作以保证多视角一致性；引入多尺度跨视角条件机制，融合全局语义先验、源锚定光度线索和绝对空间学习视角方向条件；从预训练 Gaussian 模型提取点云，用条件扩散预测 PBR 属性，再通过可微光栅化蒸馏回 Gaussian，得到可重光照 PBR-GS。
AI.result: GS-PI 优于近期逆渲染基线，将逐场景联合光照/BRDF 优化替换为一次学习式扩散加短时目标驱动蒸馏，且无需代理网格。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能缓解跨视角投影错位并防止高光烘焙进本征颜色，生成完全可重光照的 PBR-GS 资产，同时避免 2D 扩散方法的像素对应问题并 inherent 保证多视角一致性。

title: Before the Arrest: Benchmarking LLMs on Criminal Profiling from Incomplete Evidence
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings. Codes are available at: https://github.com/NLP2CT/PIJ-benchmark
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to legal and criminal justice tasks, yet existing work focuses almost exclusively on post-arrest scenarios where the suspect's identity is already known, leaving the critical pre-arrest challenge of inferring suspect characteristics from incomplete evidence largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce the Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment (PIJ), comprising 2,500 real homicide cases from five countries. PIJ evaluates LLMs across three tasks that span the entire criminal investigation pipeline: criminal profiling, which requires abductive reasoning to infer suspect attributes from fragmentary scene evidence, crime process reconstruction, which tests structured information extraction, and sentence prediction, which demands legal deductive reasoning. We evaluate 9 powerful LLMs and find that performance degrades systematically as tasks shift from explicit fact extraction to implicit reasoning over unknown suspect profiles. Categories requiring inferential reasoning, such as motivation and victim-offender relationships, remain the primary bottlenecks. Further analysis reveals substantial gaps between LLMs and human experts, along with pervasive biases in gender, age, and motive attribution. Our findings indicate that pre-arrest inference from incomplete evidence remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PIJ基准，包含5国2500起真实凶杀案，用于评估LLM在逮捕前刑事调查中的犯罪画像、犯罪过程重建和刑期预测能力，发现其推理任务表现明显不足且存在偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在法律与刑事司法中的应用多集中在已知嫌疑人身份的事后场景，而逮捕前从不完整证据推断嫌疑人特征这一关键挑战尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment（PIJ）基准，涵盖2500起真实凶杀案，设计三项任务：犯罪画像（从片段现场证据溯因推断嫌疑人属性）、犯罪过程重建（结构化信息抽取）和刑期预测（法律演绎推理），并评估9个强大LLM。
AI.result: LLM性能随任务从显性事实抽取转向对未知嫌疑人画像的隐性推理而系统性下降；动机、受害者-犯罪者关系等需要推理的类别是主要瓶颈；LLM与人类专家存在显著差距，并在性别、年龄和动机归因上存在普遍偏差。
AI.conclusion: 从不完整证据进行逮捕前推断仍是开放挑战，当前LLM在该场景下能力有限且偏差明显。

title: Constraint-Safe Graph-Context Scoring for Stable Point-Feature Labels Under Text-Width and Accessibility-Inspired Profiles
summary: Point-feature label placement on interactive maps must reconcile geometric validity, display yield, local placement utility, and stability across camera motion. Accessibility and multilingual requirements further change label dimensions, yet algorithmic evaluations often collapse these concerns into overlap counts. We present LABELSENSE-Pilot, a reproducible prototype that generates eight compass candidates per feature, scores candidates with a multilayer perceptron over graph-context summaries, adds a previous-placement bonus, and selects a layout through mixed-integer optimization. The executed scorer is deliberately not described as a graph transformer. Every returned layout is checked for viewport containment, per-feature uniqueness, and pairwise clearance. Experiments use 2,500 airport coordinates and names spanning 155 countries, with country-grouped splits and generated density, camera, text-suffix, preference, and enlarged-font stressors. Across five seeds, LABELSENSE-Pilot displayed 85.62 percent of labels with 2.09 percent flicker and zero collisions. Versus a handcrafted-utility integer program, LABELSENSE-Pilot sacrificed 1.43 percentage points of display while reducing flicker by 12.04 points. Enlarged-box-aware layouts produced zero proxy violations, whereas standard geometry reevaluated at 1.5x violated 52.57 percent of selected placements. These results establish an auditable engineering trade-off, not human accessibility, multilingual usability, or preference. Official recent baselines and participant evidence remain required before submission.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可复现原型 LABELSENSE-Pilot，用于交互地图点要素标签放置：每要素生成8个方向候选，用MLP对图上下文摘要评分，加入上一布局奖励，并通过混合整数优化选取布局。
AI.motivation: 交互地图标签放置需同时兼顾几何有效性、显示率、局部放置效用和相机运动稳定性；可访问性与多语言需求会改变标签尺寸，但已有评估常只关注重叠数量。
AI.method: 方法包括：每要素生成8个罗盘候选；用多层感知机在图上下文摘要上评分；加入历史放置奖励；通过混合整数优化选择最终布局；检查视口包含、每要素唯一性和成对间距。实验使用155国2500个机场坐标与名称，按国家分组划分，并加入密度、相机、文本后缀、偏好和放大字体压力测试，对比手工效用整数规划，运行5个随机种子。
AI.result: 5个种子下，LABELSENSE-Pilot显示85.62%标签，闪烁2.09%，零碰撞；相比手工效用整数规划，显示率低1.43个百分点，但闪烁减少12.04个百分点。放大框感知布局零代理违规，而标准几何在1.5倍下重新评估时52.57%的选中放置违规。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了可审计的工程权衡，但不代表人类可访问性、多语言可用性或偏好；正式提交前仍需官方近期基线和参与者证据。

title: Runtime Safety Filtering for Two-Terminal Hazards in Robotic Battery Recycling
summary: Runtime safety filters for learned manipulation policies typically define unsafe states as unions of object-wise keep-out regions. This representation can be unnecessarily restrictive for hazards that depend on a joint spatial relation, such as battery recycling, where a conductive payload can short a charged cell only when it approaches both terminals simultaneously. We study runtime filtering for this two-terminal hazard in LIBERO using frozen OpenVLA policies. We factor a runtime filter into three design choices: the predicate structure, its geometric margin, and the fallback action applied when a commanded action is rejected. We compare a conjunctive predicate, a conventional two-site keep-out, and a composite of the two. For each predicate, we vary its margin to obtain a frontier between task success and residual hazard. We then compare four fallback strategies at matched operating points: holding, retreat, sampled search, and a continuous-action barrier projection. Across three workcells, the three predicate families trace nearly identical safety--utility frontiers once each is evaluated over its own margin. In contrast, the fallback strategy has a substantially larger effect: holding reduces task success by up to 0.302 relative to retreat without reducing hazard, while both minimally invasive fallbacks leave substantially more residual hazard. This ordering transfers to a second policy and task suite, while retreat-based filtering remains effective under standing errors in the clearances available to the filter, although correlated error in the estimated payload size is more damaging than larger independent errors in terminal position. These results show that, for proximity-defined manipulation hazards, margin selection and fallback strategy can matter more than predicate structure in determining the safety--utility trade-off of a runtime filter.

AI.tldr: 研究学习操作策略的运行时安全过滤器，针对依赖联合空间关系的双端危险（如电池回收中导电负载同时接近两个端子），在LIBERO上用冻结OpenVLA策略，比较谓词结构、几何余量和回退策略对安全-效用权衡的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统安全过滤器将不安全状态定义为对象级禁入区域的并集，对依赖联合空间关系的危险过于严格，如导电负载需同时接近两个端子才短路。因此需要研究此类双端危险的运行时过滤设计。
AI.method: 将运行时过滤器分解为谓词结构、几何余量、拒绝动作后的回退动作三个设计选择。比较合取谓词、传统双点禁入区及其复合。对每种谓词调整余量得到成功-危险前沿。在匹配工作点比较四种回退策略：保持、后退、采样搜索、连续动作障碍投影。在三个工作单元、第二个策略和任务套件上验证，并测试间隙误差下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 三个谓词族在其各自余量下追踪几乎相同的安全-效用前沿。回退策略影响更大：保持比后退最多降低任务成功0.302且不减少危险，而两种最小侵入回退留下更多残余危险。该排序可迁移到第二策略和任务套件；基于后退的过滤在间隙常驻误差下仍有效，但估计负载大小的相关误差比端子位置的大独立误差更有害。
AI.conclusion: 对于接近定义的操作危险，余量选择和回退策略可能比谓词结构更决定运行时过滤器的安全-效用权衡。

title: CitySTAR: Structured and Topology-Aware Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Urban 3D Grounding
summary: 3D grounding aims to localize target entities in complex scenes from natural language and plays a fundamental role in embodied perception and spatial reasoning. However, existing approaches mostly rely on feature similarity or direct matching, making it difficult to connect natural-language intent with the implicit semantic and geometric structures hidden in billion-scale urban point clouds. We reformulate city-scale 3D grounding as structured constraint reasoning, where description semantics are organized into computable cross-modal constraints over open-vocabulary 3D entities, attributes, and spatial relations. We present CitySTAR, a training-free framework for reasoning-driven urban 3D grounding. CitySTAR lifts raw billion-scale urban point clouds into a query-ready scene graph of open-vocabulary 3D instances, with CodeLLM-driven tools supplying multimodal evidence for node attributes and 3D spatial relations. It then models target-context topology with paired hypergraphs and performs bidirectional topology verification for structural disambiguation. Finally, a Reflective Cross-modal Grounding module integrates topology consistency and candidate-centered 2D visual evidence to make decisions over a metric-aware 3D context graph. To further support this setting, we introduce CitySTAR-3D, an enhanced benchmark that improves semantic coverage, instance completeness, bounding-box fidelity, and spatial-relation complexity in city-scale 3D grounding. Extensive experiments show that CitySTAR consistently improves open-world urban 3D grounding while maintaining strong interpretability and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CitySTAR，一个无需训练的城市级3D grounding框架，将城市规模3D grounding重构为结构化约束推理，并在新基准CitySTAR-3D上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D grounding方法多依赖特征相似度或直接匹配，难以将自然语言意图与十亿级城市点云中隐含的语义和几何结构关联，导致城市规模开放世界3D grounding困难。
AI.method: 提出CitySTAR：将原始十亿级城市点云提升为开放词汇3D实例的查询就绪场景图；使用CodeLLM驱动工具提供多模态证据以获取节点属性和3D空间关系；用配对超图建模目标-上下文拓扑，并进行双向拓扑验证以消歧；最后通过Reflective Cross-modal Grounding模块融合拓扑一致性和候选为中心的2D视觉证据，在度量感知3D上下文图上决策。同时构建CitySTAR-3D基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CitySTAR在开放世界城市3D grounding上持续提升，同时保持强可解释性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CitySTAR为城市级3D grounding提供了无需训练、可解释且泛化性强的结构化推理方案，并推动该方向基准发展。

title: Intrinsic Sequence-Likelihood Confidence in Retrieval-Dominated Extractive QA: Two Pre-Specified Negatives, and What They Do and Do Not Attribute
comment: 26 pages main text + 26 pages supplementary (Online Resource 3). Submitted to Applied Intelligence. Code and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22710121, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22721044
summary: In extractive document question answering whose questions were generated from the passages that contain their answers -- so that retrieval recovers 92-99.8% of what any mode combination could reach, whatever its absolute accuracy -- confidence-driven mechanisms have little to gain. Fine-tuning an open language model on a specialized domain corpus yields a model whose own confidence is a tempting control signal: it could decide which queries warrant further adaptation, and which answers to trust. We evaluate both uses under criteria fixed before the runs were executed, across four 7-9B model families whose adaptation moved closed-book F1 by at most +0.03, and both fail: a distillation trigger on all four families, under its pre-specified three-step transfer budget, and a routing-and-abstention policy in its single-model pilot. Retrieval alone recovers 92-99.8% of best-case combined accuracy under every correctness criterion we test, leaving routers no meaningful gain. The sequence-likelihood signal is insufficient relative to that mode -- area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.65-0.81 under the registered criterion -- before adaptation as well as after, unchanged by scalar recalibration and not consistently improved by token-level temperature rescaling. And the finer diagnostics depend on the correctness criterion and on answer length; on the three adapted combinations where we could test it, selector ablations show no statistically detectable downstream benefit from the confidence term on any seed; on Gemma, removing it changes the selector from failing to passing both registered criteria. The usable product is a set of pre-specified negatives with their dependencies made explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文检验在抽取式文档问答中，微调开源语言模型后的置信度信号能否用于触发额外适配或决定答案取舍；在四个7-9B模型家族上，两类用途均失败，检索本身已恢复最佳组合准确率的92-99.8%，置信度信号不足以带来有意义增益。
AI.motivation: 问题由包含答案的段落生成，检索能覆盖几乎全部可达到的准确率，因此作者想验证：在一个经过领域语料微调的开源模型上，模型自身的置信度是否能作为控制信号，用于选择需要进一步适配的查询以及决定信任哪些答案。
AI.method: 在四个7-9B模型家族上微调领域语料，并按预先注册的标准评估两种用途：蒸馏触发器（三步迁移预算）和路由与弃答策略。分析序列似然置信度（AUROC）、标量重校准、token级温度缩放，并进行选择器消融。
AI.result: 两种用途均失败：蒸馏触发器在四个家族上都未达标，路由与弃答在单模型试点中失败。检索单独恢复最佳组合准确率的92-99.8%，使路由器无显著收益。置信度AUROC为0.65-0.81，适配前后不变，标量重校准无效，token级温度缩放不一致改善。选择器消融未显示置信度项的统计显著下游收益；在Gemma上移除该置信度项反而使选择器通过两项注册标准。
AI.conclusion: 在检索已接近上限的抽取式文档问答中，模型置信度不是可靠的适配触发或答案信任信号；本文的主要可复用产出是一组预先规定的负面结果及其依赖条件。

title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
summary: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了LLM标注的高可重复性是否等同于构念效度。基于欧盟委员会AI法案咨询中同一利益相关者的调查问卷与自由文本提交数据，发现LLM标注虽高度可重复，但与调查测得的同一构念收敛有限，且分歧随利益相关者群体和欧洲国家空间分布呈现系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 高标注可重复性常被误认为LLM推断测量有效，但可重复性并不必然意味着其捕捉了目标构念。作者希望区分可重复性、构念效度和沟通语境差异，检验LLM作为测量工具时的效度问题。
AI.method: 使用欧盟委员会AI法案咨询数据，将同一利益相关者的结构化调查回答与自由文本咨询提交相链接；用LLM标注自由文本，并与调查中名义上对应的构念测量进行比较；分析不同利益相关者群体的分歧，并检验欧洲国家间分歧的空间自相关；同时考察调查所报告的关切与对可解释性支持之间的关系。
AI.result: LLM标注咨询文本具有极高可重复性（组内相关系数>0.99），但与调查测量的目标构念收敛有限。分歧在不同利益相关者群体中系统变化：商业协会在文本咨询中比调查中表达更高AI风险关切（g=+1.0），公共当局和若干非商业团体分歧较小或为负。分歧得分在欧洲国家间显示正空间自相关（Moran's I=0.347，p=0.036），邻国利益相关者对AI安全关切的文本立场更相似。尽管存在分歧，调查报告的关切在所有分歧水平上仍与支持可解释性强烈相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM标注可重复性可能与较差的构念对应并存。将LLM用作测量工具时，需要采用能够区分可重复性、构念效度和沟通语境变异的验证程序。

title: DirtyMoCap: Robust Motion Capture from Unconstrained Markers
summary: Optical motion capture delivers high-fidelity human motion, but its reliance on strict marker layouts and clean trajectories severely limits its real-world applicability. In practice, tracking systems frequently output unconstrained markers: sparse, noisy, and unordered point clouds with unknown or varying configurations. To bridge the gap between corrupted raw markers and parametric human models, we introduce DirtyMoCap, a robust, marker-layout-free framework. Our core insight is to map unordered marker observations to a fixed set of "proxy anchors" comprising skeletal joints and body surface points, which serve as a stable intermediate representation. We first initialize and track these anchors over long sequences using a recurrent sliding-window architecture. Then, a custom differentiable Gauss-Newton solver fits the SMPL-H model to the tracked anchors to recover full-body pose, translation, and shape. By explicitly deriving geometric residuals, our solver learns adaptive observation confidence, smoothness, and prior weights end-to-end, adapting dynamically to the reliability of the input data. Extensive experiments on diverse, noisy marker configurations demonstrate that DirtyMoCap successfully generalizes across arbitrary layouts using only a single trained model. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art configuration-specific baselines in both joint and vertex reconstruction accuracy, while our custom CUDA solver achieves up to a 100x speedup over standard PyTorch implementations. We further apply DirtyMoCap to heterogeneous raw optical MoCap recordings of traditional Chinese martial arts, yielding a Kung Fu motion dataset of temporally coherent SMPL-H reconstructions. Code and data are available at https://wanglongzju.github.io/DirtyMoCap-Project-Page.

AI.tldr: DirtyMoCap 是一个无需固定标记布局的鲁棒光学动捕框架，将无序、稀疏、带噪的标记映射到骨骼关节与体表代理锚点，再拟合 SMPL-H 模型，恢复全身姿态、平移和体型。
AI.motivation: 传统光学动捕依赖严格标记布局和干净轨迹，实际系统常输出稀疏、噪声、无序且配置未知的标记点云，难以直接拟合参数化人体模型。
AI.method: 将无序标记观测映射到固定代理锚点（骨骼关节和体表点）作为稳定中间表示；使用循环滑窗架构初始化并长序列跟踪锚点；设计可微 Gauss-Newton 求解器将 SMPL-H 拟合到跟踪锚点；显式推导几何残差，端到端学习自适应观测置信度、平滑项和先验权重；并实现 CUDA 求解器加速。
AI.result: 在多样噪声标记配置上，仅用单个训练模型即可泛化到任意布局，关节和顶点重建精度持续优于配置特定 SOTA 基线；自定义 CUDA 求解器相比标准 PyTorch 实现最高加速 100 倍；应用于中国传统武术异构原始动捕数据，构建了时序连贯的 SMPL-H 功夫动作数据集。
AI.conclusion: DirtyMoCap 弥合了脏标记观测与参数化人体模型之间的差距，实现布局无关、鲁棒且高效的人体运动重建，并在真实复杂动捕场景中具有应用价值。

title: Benchmarking LLM Compliance with China AI Generated Content Regulations
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, with appendix still improving
summary: The widespread adoption of LLMs has led to escalating content compliance risks. Prior works have contributed to addressing these risks in the English context, downplaying the complexity of Chinese language content. This paper follows China's current AI-Generated content compliance requirements and provides evaluation results on 20 notable LLMs, offering insight into China's regulatory landscape. We design a novel framework to assess the compliance and refusal rates with 2303 questions spanning six distinct dimensions, including 203 self-constructed constitutional questions. The framework employs several judges to generate verdicts independently based on their hierarchical alignment memory. Our findings show that international models also exhibit high levels of compliance despite the use of standard Chinese questions, and the main differences may stem from dimensions closely related to ideological alignment. We establish a regulatory benchmark that enables the global AI community to evaluate both Chinese and non-Chinese LLMs under a unified set of legally grounded compliance requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕中国AI生成内容合规要求，提出一套评估框架，对20个主流大模型进行合规性与拒答率评测，并建立可统一评估中外大模型的监管基准。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛应用带来内容合规风险，已有研究多聚焦英文语境，忽视中文内容合规的复杂性；同时中国现行AI生成内容合规要求需要系统性评估与监管视角。
AI.method: 设计新评估框架，包含2303个问题，覆盖六个维度，其中含203个自建宪法类问题；采用多个裁判模型基于分层对齐记忆独立生成裁决，评估模型的合规率与拒答率。
AI.result: 对20个知名LLM的评测显示，国际模型在使用标准中文问题时也表现出较高合规水平；主要差异可能来自与意识形态对齐密切相关的维度。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了具有法律依据的监管基准，使全球AI社区能够在统一合规要求下评估中国与非中国LLM，并为理解中国监管格局提供参考。

title: VAST: V2X/Dynamic Map-Aware Autonomous Driving Systems Validation Toolchain
summary: Cooperative autonomous driving in the IoT-to-Edge-to-Cloud continuum requires system-level validation across vehicles, infrastructure sensors, edge-side Dynamic Map services, and in-vehicle autonomous-driving stacks. This paper presents VAST, a V2X/Dynamic Map-aware validation toolchain that connects Scenic, Scenario Simulator v2, AWSIM, Autoware, and SIM-LDM. VAST does not introduce a new search algorithm; instead, it addresses interoperability challenges, including Lanelet2-to-Scenic mapping, ROS 2-based co-simulation through SS2, Dynamic Map object injection into Autoware, and collection of TTC, PET, collision, timeout, and performance measurements. In occluded-intersection scenarios, Lanelet2-compatible constrained sampling increases the edge-case discovery rate from 40.0% to 80.0% and reduces the average time per discovered edge case from 259.7 s to 110.4 s. Under the same generated scenario distribution, Dynamic Map availability reduces the collision rate from 78.0% to 40.0% and increases non-collision outcomes from 22.0% to 60.0%, with statistically significant TTC/PET shifts. A throughput study with 1-16 NPCs shows that sampling remains below 0.1 s, whereas AWSIM/Autoware execution and restart overhead dominate runtime. These results position VAST as a practical validation infrastructure for cooperative autonomous-driving CPSs.

AI.tldr: VAST是一个面向V2X/动态地图的验证工具链，连接Scenic、SS2、AWSIM、Autoware和SIM-LDM，用于协作自动驾驶的系统级验证。
AI.motivation: 协作自动驾驶在物联网-边缘-云连续体中需要跨车辆、基础设施传感器、边缘动态地图服务和车载自动驾驶栈的系统级验证，但存在互操作性挑战。
AI.method: VAST不提出新搜索算法，而是解决Lanelet2到Scenic映射、基于ROS 2的SS2联合仿真、动态地图对象注入Autoware，以及TTC、PET、碰撞、超时和性能指标的采集。
AI.result: 在遮挡交叉口场景中，Lanelet2兼容的约束采样将边缘案例发现率从40.0%提升至80.0%，平均发现时间从259.7秒降至110.4秒。相同场景分布下，动态地图可用性将碰撞率从78.0%降至40.0%，非碰撞结果从22.0%升至60.0%，TTC/PET有统计显著变化。1-16个NPC的吞吐量研究表明采样低于0.1秒，而AWSIM/Autoware执行和重启开销主导运行时间。
AI.conclusion: VAST可作为协作自动驾驶信息物理系统的实用验证基础设施。

title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
summary: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy. Although prior work has substantially reduced the cost of long-context computation, prefill remains computationally expensive, and large KV caches continue to strain HBM and SSD capacity and data-transfer bandwidth. Together, these compute, storage, and bandwidth demands constitute the primary bottleneck to further lowering deployment costs. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. With its Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, the model activates 16B parameters per token during decode but only 8B parameters during prefill, substantially improving cost efficiency for agentic workloads. To push the limits of KV cache compression, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Further, through a dedicated deployment optimization known as SWA Bounded Replay, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Despite its much smaller KV cache footprint, the model delivers substantially better performance than the baseline. In addition, we streamline the DeepSeek-V4 architecture and introduce several efficient architectural extensions. We pretrain DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens and conduct comprehensive post-training, yielding strong performance across diverse text-based and multimodal agentic scenarios. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

AI.tldr: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 是一个多模态 MoE 模型，拥有 552B 主干参数，支持百万级 token 上下文，通过 CED 架构、CSA2、FP4 KV 缓存和 SWA Bounded Replay 等设计，大幅降低预填充与 KV 缓存成本，并在文本与多模态智能体任务上取得优于基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体使模型工作负载日益偏向输入密集型，虽然长上下文计算成本已有所下降，但预填充仍然昂贵，大型 KV 缓存持续给 HBM、SSD 容量和数据传输带宽带来压力。计算、存储和带宽需求共同构成进一步降低部署成本的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash：多模态 MoE 模型，552B 主干参数，支持最多一百万 token 上下文；采用 Causal Encoder-Decoder（CED）架构，解码时每 token 激活 16B 参数，预填充时仅激活 8B 参数；结合 Compressed Sparse Attention 2（CSA2）中的跨层 KV 缓存复用与 FP4 KV 缓存；使用 SWA Bounded Replay 优化持久化 KV 缓存；简化 DeepSeek-V4 架构并引入高效架构扩展；在 45T token 多模态语料上预训练，并进行全面后训练。
AI.result: 全局 KV 缓存占用降至每 token 890 字节，约为 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的 1/4；持久化 KV 缓存占用约为 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的 1/8；尽管 KV 缓存占用显著更小，模型性能仍大幅优于基线，并在多种文本与多模态智能体场景中表现强劲。模型检查点已公开。
AI.conclusion: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 针对计算、存储和带宽瓶颈，通过高效架构与 KV 缓存压缩设计显著降低部署成本，同时提升多模态智能体任务性能，并已发布模型检查点。

title: Physical knowledge on historical data matters more than enforcing physical constraints on the forecast
summary: Time series forecasting has seen signicant advancements with the emergence of new deep learning models. However, forecasting time series in applications involving physical processes remains a major challenge. Despite the apparition of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINN), recent models do not estimate unobservable intermediate physical variables, which are important for domain experts to understand the target behavior. To this end, we propose a Physics Informed Recurrent Neural Network (PIRNN) which predicts, along the target, unobservable variables on both historic data and forecast target. This approach enhances the model robustness and results interpretation using domain knowledge. Our method is easily adaptable to any physical model using several equations, each having its own set of unobservable variables, to describe it-self. As a case study, we incorporate physical equations used for groundwater levels predictions by the physical model called Gardenia. This model uses transfers equations between reservoirs, optimized with data assimilation, to simulate the evolution of groundwater levels. Evaluation includes several well known neural network models and the Gardenia model compared on twelve real world datasets. In addition, we study the impact of each component through an ablation study. Our model outperforms other models on ve out of the twelve datasets and our ablation study underlines the importance of having a physical background in our time series forecasting task. Finally, the coherence of the physical variables predicted by our neural network is assessed by a domain expert.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理信息循环神经网络（PIRNN），在预测目标时间序列的同时估计不可观测的中间物理变量，并在地下水水位预测案例中验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 物理过程相关的时间序列预测仍具挑战；现有物理信息神经网络（PINN）类模型通常不估计对领域专家理解目标行为重要的不可观测中间物理变量。
AI.method: 提出PIRNN，结合物理方程与循环神经网络，预测目标及历史数据和预测目标中的不可观测变量；方法可适配包含多个方程及各自不可观测变量的物理模型。案例研究采用地下水水位模型Gardenia，基于水库间传输方程和数据同化。在12个真实数据集上与多种神经网络模型及Gardenia比较，并进行消融研究。
AI.result: PIRNN在12个数据集中有5个优于其他模型；消融研究强调物理背景对时间序列预测任务的重要性；领域专家评估认为神经网络预测的物理变量具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: PIRNN利用领域知识增强了模型鲁棒性和结果可解释性，表明引入物理背景有助于物理过程时间序列预测。

title: LYRIC: Language-Driven Physics-Based Character Control for Contact-Rich Whole-Body Object Interaction
summary: We present LYRIC, a generative flow-matching controller for language-driven physics-based contact-rich interaction control, that enables simulated characters to perform contact-rich whole-body object interactions from a free-form language instruction and a sparse terminal object goal. To obtain reliable expert trajectories from imperfect motion-capture references, a single tracking policy is trained using geometry-conditioned interaction rewards and relaxed reference tracking near hand-object contact. To guide interaction progress without prescribing a full-body kinematic reference, we factorize the controller into a task-level planner that predicts short-horizon object and humanoid-root trajectories, and an action generator that resolves whole-body motion and contacts in closed loop. After behavior cloning, we freeze the planner and post-tune the action generator on policy using the planner's predictions as stable supervision for intermediate task progression. In a controlled OMOMO evaluation, our tracker achieves 64.3% success compared with 53.2% for an InterMimic reimplementation, while a unified policy achieves 76.5% on the full OMOMO dataset. On the held-out split, LYRIC achieves 90.3% task success, compared with 74.2% for the strongest matched kinematic-planner baseline, with better semantic alignment and motion quality. Without retraining, the controller also supports test-time object-waypoint guidance. Qualitative results further demonstrate robust, natural contact-rich interactions and zero-shot transfer to novel object shapes. The webpage is available at https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/

AI.tldr: LYRIC 是一种语言驱动的生成式流匹配控制器，用于基于物理的富接触全身物体交互。它结合任务级规划与闭环动作生成，能从自由语言指令和稀疏终端物体目标控制仿真角色完成复杂接触交互。
AI.motivation: 从语言指令和稀疏目标实现富接触全身交互很难，现有方法常依赖完整运动学参考，且不完美动捕参考难以直接获得可靠专家轨迹，接触处理与任务推进也缺乏稳定监督。
AI.method: 训练单一跟踪策略，使用几何条件交互奖励，并在手-物接触附近放松参考跟踪；将控制器分解为预测短时物体与人体根轨迹的任务级规划器，以及闭环求解全身运动和接触的动作生成器；行为克隆后冻结规划器，以其预测作为稳定监督在线微调动作生成器。
AI.result: 在受控 OMOMO 评估中，跟踪器成功率为 64.3%，高于 InterMimic 重实现的 53.2%；统一策略在完整 OMOMO 数据集上达到 76.5%；在留出划分上任务成功率为 90.3%，优于最强匹配运动学规划基线的 74.2%，且语义对齐和运动质量更好；无需重训练支持测试时物体路点引导，并能零样本迁移到新物体形状。
AI.conclusion: LYRIC 能有效实现语言驱动的富接触全身物体交互，在成功率、语义对齐、运动质量和泛化能力上优于基线，并具备测试时引导与新物体零样本迁移能力。

title: Enhanced Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer via Teacher Prediction Refinement
summary: Detection Transformers (DETRs) achieve strong performance in object detection but remain challenging to deploy on edge devices due to their high computational cost. Existing DETR distillation methods mainly focus on aligning distillation points, while largely overlooking the quality of the teacher's supervision itself. We observe that due to stage-wise non-monotonic prediction behavior in DETRs, well-localized or correctly classified predictions from earlier stages may degrade in later ones, and some negative predictions become increasingly overconfident. As a result, relying solely on the current stage's predictions yields inaccurate and inconsistent supervision. To address this issue, we propose Teacher Prediction Refinement Distillation (TPRD), a plug-and-play module that refines teacher predictions before distillation by exploiting stage-wise prediction information. TPRD improves supervision quality through Positive Prediction Correction (PPC), which corrects degraded positive predictions by restoring more accurate ones from earlier stages, ensuring reliable localization and classification signals, and Negative Prediction Suppression (NPS) suppresses the influence of overconfident negatives, preventing them from providing misleading supervision to the student. To preserve informative dark knowledge, we further introduce Maximum Dark Knowledge Preservation (MDKP), which selectively refines target-class logits while retaining non-target relations. Extensive experiments on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Our code is available at https://github.com/xingyitong1/TPRD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种即插即用的DETR蒸馏方法TPRD，通过利用教师模型不同阶段的预测信息来优化监督信号，从而提升边缘设备上DETR压缩模型的检测性能。
AI.motivation: DETR检测性能强但计算开销大，难以部署在边缘设备；现有DETR蒸馏方法主要关注对齐蒸馏点，却忽视了教师监督信号本身的质量。由于DETR存在阶段间非单调预测行为，早期定位或分类正确的预测可能在后期退化，部分负样本预测还会变得过度自信，导致仅依赖当前阶段预测会产生不准确且不一致的监督。
AI.method: 提出Teacher Prediction Refinement Distillation（TPRD），在蒸馏前利用阶段间预测信息精炼教师预测。包括：Positive Prediction Correction（PPC），从早期阶段恢复更准确的正样本预测以修正退化预测，提供可靠定位与分类信号；Negative Prediction Suppression（NPS），抑制过度自信负样本的误导性监督；Maximum Dark Knowledge Preservation（MDKP），选择性精炼目标类logits，同时保留非目标类关系以维持暗知识。
AI.result: 在MS COCO和PASCAL VOC上的大量实验表明，所提方法有效且鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 通过提升教师监督质量而非仅对齐蒸馏点，TPRD能够改善DETR蒸馏效果，是一种有效且通用的即插即用模块，代码已开源。

title: UniExo: Unified Multi-Skill Policies for Musculoskeletal Locomotion and Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control
summary: Daily locomotion encompasses diverse activities and frequent transitions between them, yet most exoskeleton controllers are designed for a single activity or a narrow set of related movements. Changes in activity therefore typically require explicit mode switching and separately tuned or retrained controllers. Simulation-based learning reduces the need for hardware-based tuning but generally retains this limitation. Here we present UniExo, a framework that first constructs a multi-skill musculoskeletal human policy and then jointly trains an exoskeleton control policy with it. Four single-skill imitation experts for walking, turning, running and backward walking are distilled into a single network structured by a skill latent and subsequently fine-tuned through reinforcement learning on transition sequences. The resultant unified human policy achieves a mean tracking success rate of 94.7% on unseen clips of the four skills and exhibits greater robustness to perturbations than its constituent experts. A single hip exoskeleton controller (UniExo) is initialized from hip moment prediction of the human policy and co-adapted with it through multi-agent reinforcement learning across the four skills. This co-adaptation shifts the timing of the assistance torque and raises the fraction of positive work delivered to the hip. When deployed on a custom hip exoskeleton, the controller generalizes across four treadmill speeds in six participants and assists one participant through a continuous route of all four skills and their transitions, without skill labels or explicit mode switching. UniExo thus provides a step towards replacing activity-specific controllers with unified, user-specific controllers that support diverse locomotor activities and the transitions between them.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniExo 框架，先构建多技能人体肌肉骨骼策略，再与其联合训练外骨骼控制策略，实现无需显式模式切换即可支持行走、转身、跑步和倒走及其转换的统一髋关节外骨骼控制。
AI.motivation: 日常运动包含多种活动和频繁转换，但多数外骨骼控制器仅针对单一活动或少量相关动作设计，切换活动时通常需要显式模式切换以及单独调参或重新训练。
AI.method: 将行走、转身、跑步和倒走的四个单技能模仿专家蒸馏为一个由技能潜变量组织的统一人体策略，并在转换序列上通过强化学习微调；外骨骼控制器由人体策略的髋关节力矩预测初始化，并通过多智能体强化学习在四种技能中与人体策略共同适应。
AI.result: 统一人体策略在四种技能的未见片段上平均跟踪成功率达 94.7%，且比各专家更抗扰动。共同适应改变了辅助力矩时序并提高了向髋关节输送正功的比例。在定制髋关节外骨骼上，控制器在六名参与者、四种跑步机速度下具备泛化能力，并帮助一名参与者连续完成四种技能及其转换，无需技能标签或显式模式切换。
AI.conclusion: UniExo 朝着用统一的、用户特定的控制器替代活动特定控制器迈出一步，可支持多种运动活动及其之间的转换。

title: TRACE: Accountable Agentic Retrieval for Source Discovery in Digital Archives
summary: Historical archives pose a difficult retrieval problem for retrievalaugmented generation systems: documents are OCR-degraded, heterogeneous across genres and sources, and require strong source traceability for scholarly and institutional use. We introduce TRACE, a training-free agentic retrieval framework designed for accountable source discovery over historical corpora. The system was developed in the context of DECIDON, an interdisciplinary project on the circulation of political discourse between parliamentary debates and the press during the French Third Republic, involving digitised historical collections and institutional use cases. The prototype is currently deployed internally within the project and accessible to 24 researchers across six partner institutions. We evaluate TRACE on HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic, a benchmark of 1,752 French historical questions over parliamentary debates and newspapers from 1887, with documents derived from Biblioth{è}que nationale de France digitised collections. TRACE achieves R@10 = 0.856 and MRR = 0.653, outperforming sparse, dense, graph-based, and agentic RAG baselines, with the largest gains on multi-hop and cross-corpus questions. At approximately $0.02 per question under the default hosted inference configuration, TRACE also remains economically feasible for heritage institutions, laboratories or companies that cannot rely on costly local GPU infrastructure. These results suggest that, for large digital libraries and archives, retrieval accountability and corpus-aware agent design can provide a practical alternative to heavier training-based or graph-construction approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TRACE，一个面向历史档案的免训练智能体检索框架，用于可追溯的来源发现，并在法国第三共和国历史问答基准上验证其检索效果与成本可行性。
AI.motivation: 历史档案给检索增强生成带来困难：OCR 退化、跨体裁与来源异构，并且学术和机构使用需要强来源可追溯性。
AI.method: TRACE 是免训练的智能体检索框架，强调可问责的来源发现和语料感知的智能体设计；在 DECIDON 项目背景下开发，评估于 HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic 基准，该基准包含 1,752 个关于 1887 年议会辩论和报纸的法国历史问题，文档来自法国国家图书馆数字化馆藏。
AI.result: TRACE 达到 R@10 = 0.856、MRR = 0.653，优于稀疏、稠密、基于图和智能体 RAG 基线，在多跳和跨语料问题上提升最大；默认托管推理配置下约每问题 0.02 美元。
AI.conclusion: 对于大型数字图书馆和档案馆，检索可问责性与语料感知的智能体设计，可作为比训练型或图构建型更重方法更实用的替代方案。

title: Decoupling Physical Speed from Path Parameterization in Singularity-Free Guiding Vector Fields
summary: The existing singularity-free guiding vector field (SF-GVF) with an additional virtual coordinate can eliminate singular points (i.e., points where the vector field vanishes) inherent in conventional GVFs and guarantee global convergence of robot trajectories to closed and self-intersecting desired paths. However, the desired speed given by the GVF along the desired path in the original lower-dimensional space cannot be arbitrarily specified but depends on path parameterizations. One possible workaround is to partially normalize the physical projection of the SF-GVF and assign a user-designed speed. However, we show that this workaround may introduce new singularities since the normalization denominator can become zero. To address this issue, we propose a new SF-GVF with prescribed physical speed (PPS). The integral curves of the new SF-GVF converge exponentially to the desired path from any initial condition in the higher-dimensional space (including virtual dimension); more importantly, the robot's physical speed converges to the PPS, while the path-error dynamics remain invariant under regular reparameterizations of the desired path. We further develop a saturated acceleration control law for second-order kinematic models. Finally, comparative simulations and 3D path-following experiments with a quadrotor under different PPS profiles validate the theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有无奇异引导向量场（SF-GVF）无法任意指定沿期望路径物理速度的问题，提出一种具有指定物理速度（PPS）的新型SF-GVF，并验证其在路径跟踪中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 原有SF-GVF虽可消除奇点并保证全局收敛，但其沿期望路径给出的速度依赖路径参数化，不能任意指定；简单归一化物理投影的方法可能因归一化分母为零而引入新奇点。
AI.method: 提出一种新的SF-GVF with PPS，使积分曲线从高维空间任意初始条件指数收敛到期望路径；保证机器人物理速度收敛到指定速度，且路径误差动态在正则重参数化下保持不变；并针对二阶运动学模型设计饱和加速度控制律。
AI.result: 理论分析表明新方法可避免额外奇点并实现PPS收敛；通过对比仿真以及四旋翼在不同PPS剖面下的三维路径跟踪实验，验证了理论结果和方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的新型SF-GVF能够实现无奇异、全局收敛且物理速度可指定的路径跟踪，为机器人路径跟随控制提供有效方案。

title: Reading Emotions in the Token Space: Discriminative Adaptation of SpeechLLMs for Emotion Recognition
summary: SpeechLLMs have shown strong potential for emotion recognition, yet they read the predicted emotion off a generative decoder not suited for classification: it can emit labels outside the target set and favors frequent classes. We propose a discriminative adaptation that reads the final prompt token's hidden state through a classification head, producing a label in one forward pass without modifying the backbone. Because this readout starts from the hidden state the model would otherwise decode, it gives a controlled comparison of generative and discriminative inference in an otherwise identical speechLLM. We keep the head a single linear layer, trading little accuracy for interpretability: each emotion becomes one direction in the LLM output token space, revealing associated tokens. On IEMOCAP, across two speechLLM architectures, it improves Macro F1 and removes hallucinations, with largest gains on realistic ASR transcripts. Our analysis reveals that these emotion directions encode indirect associations mirroring biases in web-scale text.

AI.tldr: 提出一种判别式适配方法，通过分类头读取SpeechLLM最终提示词的隐藏状态，一次前向传播输出情感标签，不修改骨干网络，提升Macro F1并消除幻觉。
AI.motivation: 生成式解码器不适合分类任务，可能输出目标集外的标签，并偏向高频类别；希望在同一SpeechLLM中控制比较生成式与判别式推理。
AI.method: 在SpeechLLM上添加单层线性分类头，读取最终提示词token的隐藏状态，一次前向传播完成分类，不修改骨干网络；单层线性设计提升可解释性，每个情感对应LLM输出token空间中的一个方向。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP上，两种SpeechLLM架构均提升Macro F1并消除幻觉，在真实ASR转录上增益最大；分析显示情感方向编码了反映网络文本偏差的间接关联。
AI.conclusion: 判别式适配能有效提升SpeechLLM情感识别性能并增强可解释性，揭示了生成式与判别式推理的差异以及情感方向与网络偏见之间的关联。

title: From "Who Is This User?" to "What Does This Purchase Mean?": A Deployed Pipeline for Semantic User Profiling at Bank Scale
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, IEEE International Conference on Data Mining 2026 (ICDM)
summary: Per-user LLM inference on transaction histories binds the inference budget linearly to user count, which becomes prohibitive at applied scale. We re-cast attribute inference from per-user to per-transaction-pattern. The pipeline runs in three phases: Resolve abstracts item names with optional web grounding, Profile infers attributes for each frequent pattern, and Tag clusters free-text attributes into a queryable database. In Profile, a single LLM call per pattern emits predefined categorical labels, free-text attributes, and per-attribute prevalence estimates. Because inference runs over patterns rather than users, the budget grows with the pattern count rather than the user count. On the public Open e-commerce corpus, the database is statistically indistinguishable from an LLM that reads each user's raw history directly in AUC across the evaluated attributes, and the prevalence estimates carry discriminative signal between positive and negative users. The pipeline is deployed at a major Japanese bank profiling on the order of tens of millions of users, with close to a three-order-of-magnitude reduction in LLM inference targets versus a per-user pipeline. The code is publicly available on https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/profiling-agent-open-ecommerce.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将用户属性推断从“按用户”转为“按交易模式”进行，通过 Resolve、Profile、Tag 三阶段流水线构建可查询数据库，在公开电商语料上效果与逐用户 LLM 推断相当，并在日本大型银行部署，显著降低 LLM 推理成本。
AI.motivation: 按用户交易历史逐用户调用 LLM 会使推理预算随用户数线性增长，在实际应用规模下成本过高，因此需要降低推理目标数量。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线：Resolve 解析物品名称并可选用网页 grounding；Profile 对每个频繁模式调用一次 LLM，输出预定义类别标签、自由文本属性和属性流行度估计；Tag 将自由文本属性聚类成可查询数据库。推理对象从用户变为交易模式，预算随模式数而非用户数增长。
AI.result: 在公开 Open e-commerce 语料上，该数据库在评估属性的 AUC 上与直接读取每个用户原始历史的 LLM 统计上不可区分，且流行度估计对正负用户具有区分信号。该流水线已部署于一家日本大型银行，覆盖数千万用户，相比逐用户流水线将 LLM 推理目标减少近三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 按交易模式进行属性推断可在保持效果的同时大幅降低 LLM 推理成本，适合大规模实际部署；代码已在 GitHub 公开。

title: Beyond the Foreground: FOV-Aware Polyp Image Synthesis via Lesion-Guided Adaptive Mucosal Context Propagation
summary: Synthetic image and mask pairs can alleviate scarce colonoscopy annotations, but realistic synthesis requires preserving the supplied lesion while generating compatible mucosa. Existing foreground-guided methods treat all non-foreground pixels as background and rely mainly on local integration. Directly applying them to colonoscopy causes two problems: non-mucosal black regions contaminate generated tissue, and local reasoning produces inconsistent mucosal texture and illumination. We propose LAMP, the first foreground-guided framework for polyp image synthesis based on lesion-guided adaptive mucosal context propagation. LAMP explicitly separates the lesion, valid mucosa, and camera exterior using a field-of-view (FOV) mask. Lesion-to-Mucosa cross-attention extracts lesion appearance conditions for valid-mucosa locations, while FOV-constrained multidirectional Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value propagates them over legal tissue support. An adaptive gate then controls their residual fusion into the diffusion U-Net. Extensive experiments on five polyp datasets demonstrate that LAMP substantially outperforms existing methods in overall generation quality and consistently improves five downstream segmentation models. Our code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAMP，一种面向结肠镜息肉图像合成的病灶引导自适应黏膜上下文传播框架，通过显式区分病灶、有效黏膜与镜头外部区域，提升合成图像真实感并改善下游分割性能。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜标注稀缺，合成图像与掩码对可缓解该问题；但现有前景引导方法将非前景像素统一视为背景且主要依赖局部整合，直接用于结肠镜会导致非黏膜黑色区域污染生成组织，以及黏膜纹理和光照不一致。
AI.method: LAMP利用视场（FOV）掩码显式分离病灶、有效黏膜和镜头外部区域；通过病灶到黏膜的交叉注意力为有效黏膜位置提取病灶外观条件，并使用FOV约束的多方向Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value在合法组织支撑上传播这些条件；最后通过自适应门控将其残差融合到扩散U-Net中。
AI.result: 在五个息肉数据集上的大量实验表明，LAMP在整体生成质量上显著优于现有方法，并持续提升五个下游分割模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: LAMP能有效解决结肠镜息肉合成中的背景污染与局部推理不一致问题，生成更高质量的息肉图像并促进下游分割任务，代码将在 https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP 发布。

title: Design of the IBM Granite 5.0 TurboCTC ASR Model
summary: We describe the architecture, training methodology and inference speedups of Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC, a 470 million parameter encoder-only model with an excellent speed-accuracy tradeoff. The architecture uses pyramidal temporal subsampling within Conformer blocks using strided depthwise convolutions, block-diagonal (chunk-wise) self-attention, and conditioning on intermediate predictions from the middle layer. Training highlights are the use of only publicly available data, the novel use of a Muon optimizer, and balanced data sampling. Inference speedups include replacing 1 x 1 convolutions with linear layers and optimizing the attention computation in the Conformer blocks. Collectively, these result in a model that is on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of the Open ASR leaderboard for English short-form ASR while being twice as fast as the fastest competitor. The model can be used under a permissive license and downloaded from https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC，一个 4.7 亿参数的仅编码器语音识别模型，在速度与准确率之间取得优异权衡，并在 Open ASR 排行榜上达到速度-准确率帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是构建一个在英语短格式 ASR 任务中兼具高准确率和极快推理速度的模型，同时仅使用公开数据训练，并以宽松许可证开放使用。
AI.method: 模型采用 Conformer 块，并在其中使用带步长深度卷积的金字塔时间下采样、块对角（分块）自注意力，以及来自中间层预测的条件化。训练方面仅使用公开数据，采用 Muon 优化器和平衡数据采样。推理加速包括将 1x1 卷积替换为线性层，并优化 Conformer 块中的注意力计算。
AI.result: 该模型为 470M 参数仅编码器模型，在 Open ASR 排行榜英语短格式 ASR 任务中处于速度-准确率帕累托前沿，并且比最快竞争对手快两倍。
AI.conclusion: Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC 在速度与准确率之间实现了优秀权衡，模型可在宽松许可证下使用，并已发布在 Hugging Face 上供下载。

title: An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras
comment: @inproceedings{ikura2026event, title={An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras}, author={Ikura, Mikihiro and Gava, Luna and Wu, Jiahang and Glover, Arren and Bartolozzi, Chiara}, year={2026}, booktitle={ECCV 2026 Workshop-Event-Based Multimodal Vision: From Imaging to Perception and Understanding} }
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, high temporal resolution perception for real-time vision tasks such as robotics.The novel circuitry (i.e. asynchronous, independent pixels) that enables these advantages also introduces new algorithmic challenges. Velocity-invariant representations alleviate missing observations under slow motion and motion blur under fast motion, but most discard temporal information by converting events into image-like representations. We propose Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF), a real-time velocity-invariant representation that preserves raw events while consistently handling fast motion, stationary scenes, and independently moving objects. SCARF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both computational efficiency and representation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SCARF——一种实时速度不变的事件表示，保留原始事件并处理快速运动、静止场景和独立运动物体，在计算效率与表示质量上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合实时视觉任务，但异步独立像素电路带来算法挑战；现有速度不变表示虽能缓解慢动作观测缺失和快动作运动模糊，却多将事件转为图像状表示而丢失时间信息。
AI.method: 提出Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF)，一种实时速度不变表示，基于中心活跃感受野集合，保留原始事件，并一致处理快速运动、静止场景及独立运动物体。
AI.result: SCARF在计算效率和表示质量两方面均取得当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: SCARF能够保留原始事件的时空信息并兼顾多种运动场景，为事件相机实时视觉提供高效且高质量的表示。

title: Equivariant Filter Design for Acoustic and Depth Aided Inertial Navigation Systems
summary: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) navigating without GPS typically fuse inertial measurements with acoustic Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) velocities and pressure-derived depth. Posing the navigation state on a Lie group improves accuracy and consistency. However, state-of-the-art filters based on the Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (IEKF) append the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) biases as a Euclidean extension, which breaks the group-affine structure required for exact log-linear error dynamics, causing the reported covariance to degrade alongside the estimate. We apply the Tangent-Group (TG) symmetry, which carries the biases within the geometry of the state space, to derive an Equivariant Filter (EqF) for this system, leaving zero linearization error in the navigation states and second-order error only in the biases. We develop an equivariant output model for the DVL, whose update incurs only third-order linearization error, together with a direct pressure output. Monte Carlo simulations benchmark the TG-EqF against a Two-Frame-Group IEKF and a Multiplicative EKF. The TG-EqF reduces error by 18--25\% against both alternatives in each of attitude, velocity, and position. The main benefit is in the covariance it estimates: its Average Normalized Estimation Error Squared (ANEES) stays closer to its nominal value of one than that of the others. Offline analysis on AUV field data corroborates the findings of the simulations, demonstrating reduced position drift.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无GPS的自主水下航行器导航，提出基于切群对称性的等变滤波器（TG-EqF），将IMU偏置纳入状态空间几何，以改善估计精度和协方差一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于IEKF的AUV导航滤波器将IMU偏置作为欧氏扩展附加，破坏了群仿射结构，使对数线性误差动力学不再精确，导致协方差和估计精度退化。
AI.method: 应用切群（TG）对称性，将偏置包含在状态空间几何中，推导等变滤波器；为DVL建立等变输出模型，其更新仅产生三阶线性化误差，并加入直接压力输出；通过蒙特卡洛仿真与双帧群IEKF和乘性EKF对比，并用AUV现场数据离线验证。
AI.result: TG-EqF在姿态、速度和位置上较两种对比方法误差降低18–25%；其ANEES更接近名义值1，表明协方差估计更一致；现场数据也显示位置漂移减小。
AI.conclusion: 将IMU偏置纳入切群几何的等变滤波框架，能提升AUV导航的估计精度和协方差一致性，并在真实数据中减少位置漂移。

title: MaSCoD: A Multi-Agent Framework for Structural-Context-Guided Candidate Causal Graph Generation
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been applied to causal discovery, but candidate-graph generation rarely treats premature omission of potentially relevant causal relations as an explicit design objective. We propose MaSCoD, a multi-agent framework that organizes candidate third variables and local structural patterns before direct-edge judgment. We evaluate MaSCoD on Auto-MPG, DWD, and Sachs using GPT-5.4 as the primary backbone and GPT-4o for replication. MaSCoD exhibits a dataset- and backbone-dependent retention-selectivity profile rather than uniform superiority. Across all six dataset-backbone settings, Full, which supplies structural hypotheses before direct-edge judgment, achieved higher mean Recall and F1 than No Phase 1, which instead constructs them within the judgment procedure, while also increasing false-positive rates. Additional reference-edge retention over all evaluated baselines was observed on DWD with GPT-5.4 and on Sachs with GPT-4o, rather than uniformly across settings. Partial ablations showed that supplying both information components did not always outperform supplying only one. For GPT-5.4, stage-wise analysis showed that the Full-No Phase 1 retention gap was already present after direct-edge judgment, while reconciliation introduced additional reference-edge loss for Full on Sachs. These findings support structural pre-organization as an explicit design and evaluation target for omission control and motivate evaluating context construction jointly with its utilization in judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多智能体框架 MaSCoD，在直接边判断前先组织候选第三变量和局部结构模式，以控制因果发现中潜在因果关系的过早遗漏。在 Auto-MPG、DWD 和 Sachs 数据集上使用 GPT-5.4 和 GPT-4o 评估，发现其保留-选择性表现依赖于数据集和骨干模型，并非一致优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的因果发现方法在生成候选图时，很少将“过早遗漏潜在相关因果关系”作为明确的设计目标，导致可能丢失真实因果边。
AI.method: 提出 MaSCoD 多智能体框架，先组织候选第三变量与局部结构模式，再进行直接边判断。在 Auto-MPG、DWD、Sachs 三个数据集上，以 GPT-5.4 为主干、GPT-4o 为复现，对比 Full（判断前提供结构假设）与 No Phase 1（在判断过程中构建结构假设）等设置，并进行部分消融和阶段分析。
AI.result: 在所有六种数据集-主干组合中，Full 比 No Phase 1 获得更高的平均召回率和 F1，但假阳性率也增加。仅在 DWD+GPT-5.4 和 Sachs+GPT-4o 上，Full 比所有基线保留更多参考边，并非普遍成立。部分消融显示同时提供两种信息组件并不总是优于只提供一种。阶段分析表明，GPT-5.4 上 Full 与 No Phase 1 的保留差距在直接边判断后已存在，而协调步骤额外导致 Full 在 Sachs 上损失参考边。
AI.conclusion: 结构预组织应作为遗漏控制的明确设计与评估目标，并且需要将上下文构建与其在判断中的利用联合评估。

title: QCPruner: Query-Conditioned Population Coverage for Visual Token Pruning
summary: The high visual-token load in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) motivates training-free pruning to reduce later-layer computation, but under a fixed budget, pruning must preserve query-relevant evidence while avoiding redundancy. Existing methods rank tokens, diversify selected subsets, or optimize coverage without using a shared per-visual query utility to weight both visual targets and candidate representatives. We introduce QCPruner, which makes both roles query-conditioned through bilateral utility weighting. Using keyword-matched query anchors, QCPruner fuses two cross-modal cues into utility and applies it to both visual targets and candidate representatives within visual-affinity-based coverage. The resulting nonnegative facility-location objective is monotone and submodular, retains the standard (1-1/e) greedy guarantee, and requires no model training or parameter updates. Across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-Video, and Qwen2.5-VL, QCPruner achieves the highest average relative performance among evaluated complete-system pruning methods at every reported token budget. At 32 of 576 tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it retains 96.1% of unpruned performance, versus 93.9% for the strongest evaluated baseline. At 256 of 1296 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the corresponding values are 96.7% and 92.5%.

AI.tldr: QCPruner 是一种无需训练的多模态大模型视觉 token 剪枝方法，通过双边查询条件化效用加权，在固定预算下同时衡量视觉目标与候选代表，保持查询相关证据并减少冗余。
AI.motivation: MLLM 中视觉 token 负载高，固定预算下的免训练剪枝必须保留查询相关信息并避免冗余；现有方法在排序、多样化或覆盖优化时，未使用共享的逐视觉查询效用同时加权视觉目标和候选代表。
AI.method: 利用关键词匹配的查询锚点，融合两种跨模态线索形成效用，并将其应用于基于视觉亲和力的覆盖中的视觉目标和候选代表；所得非负设施选址目标单调且子模，保留标准 (1-1/e) 贪心保证，且无需模型训练或参数更新。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-Video 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上，QCPruner 在每个报告 token 预算下取得评估的完整系统剪枝方法中最高的平均相对性能。LLaVA-1.5-7B 在 576 个 token 中保留 32 个时，保留未剪枝性能的 96.1%，最强基线为 93.9%；Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 1296 个 token 中保留 256 个时，对应为 96.7% 和 92.5%。
AI.conclusion: QCPruner 通过查询条件化的双边效用加权和子模贪心剪枝，在无需训练的情况下实现高效视觉 token 压缩，并在多个 MLLM 上优于现有完整系统剪枝基线。

title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Controlling Speculative Decoding via Intrinsic Model Signals
summary: Speculative Decoding (SD) has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet existing approaches face a fundamental tradeoff between two drafting strategies: neural drafting and context-based copying. Neural drafts (e.g., EAGLE3) provide robust performance across diverse text settings, while copy-based methods achieve higher speedups in copy-intensive regimes by generating candidates faster and exploiting long repetition spans for near-perfect speculation. We analyze existing copy-based methods and find that they are prone to accidental repetitions where surface-level n-gram overlap does not reflect a structural intent to copy, leading to false-positive triggers that ultimately degrade throughput. We introduce SwitchSD, an adaptive framework that treats copying as a latent control signal of the LLM. By training lightweight probes on the target model's internal representations, SwitchSD identifies genuine copy-intent with high precision (AUC > 0.99). This allows the system to dynamically switch between neural drafting (e.g., EAGLE) and context-based copying. Our results across Llama and Qwen families demonstrate throughput gains of up to 15% over state-of-the-art baselines like EAGLE3, effectively turning copying from a noisy heuristic into a principled, model-aware decoding regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwitchSD，一种自适应推测解码框架，通过检测大语言模型内部的真实复制意图，在神经草稿与上下文复制之间动态切换，从而提升推理吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码在神经草稿与基于复制的草稿之间存在权衡：神经草稿通用性强，复制方法在重复文本场景更快，但容易因表面n-gram重叠产生误判，导致错误触发并降低吞吐。
AI.method: SwitchSD将复制视为LLM的潜在控制信号，在目标模型内部表示上训练轻量级探针，以高精度识别真实复制意图，并据此动态选择神经草稿（如EAGLE）或基于上下文的复制。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen系列模型上，SwitchSD的吞吐量相比EAGLE3等先进基线最高提升15%，复制意图检测的AUC超过0.99。
AI.conclusion: SwitchSD将复制从噪声启发式转变为有原则、模型感知的解码机制，有效结合神经草稿与复制方法的优势，提升LLM推理效率。

title: Fine-Tuning Models for Biomedical Relation Extraction
summary: Next-Generation Sequencing has revolutionized the study of genetic mutations, enabling large-scale investigations into their roles in disease development. However, extracting meaningful insights from the vast amount of biomedical literature remains a complex challenge that cannot be addressed manually. In this paper, we present pre-trained models (PTMs) for the automatic extraction of relations from biomedical text, specifically targeting the variant-phenotype domain. Our evaluation on the SNPPhenA corpus demonstrates that fine-tuning small BERT-based models, particularly DeBERTa, yields strong performance, approaching the current state-of-the-art (SOTA). Additionally, our results indicate that carefully fine-tuning Google's Gemini Pro 1.0 outperforms the existing SOTA for both sentence-level tasks (where the model processes only the target sentence) and abstract-level tasks (where the model processes the entire abstract).

AI.tldr: 本文针对生物医学文本中变异-表型关系的自动抽取，评估了预训练模型。在SNPPhenA语料上，微调小型BERT类模型（尤其DeBERTa）接近当前最优；而精心微调的Gemini Pro 1.0在句子级和摘要级任务上均超过现有最优。
AI.motivation: 下一代测序产生了大量遗传突变与疾病关联数据，但仅靠人工从海量生物医学文献中提取有意义的关系非常困难，因此需要自动化的关系抽取方法。
AI.method: 使用预训练模型进行生物医学文本关系抽取，聚焦变异-表型领域；在SNPPhenA语料上微调小型BERT类模型（如DeBERTa），并精心微调Google Gemini Pro 1.0，分别评估句子级和摘要级任务。
AI.result: 微调小型BERT类模型表现较强，其中DeBERTa接近当前最先进水平；精心微调的Gemini Pro 1.0则在句子级和摘要级任务上均超过了现有最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 预训练模型，尤其是经过良好微调的大模型如Gemini Pro 1.0，能有效用于生物医学变异-表型关系抽取，并达到或超越当前最优性能。

title: Beyond Depth Truncation: Controlled Evaluation of Depth Utilization in Recursive Language Models
summary:
Depth-recurrent language models iteratively apply a small layer stack, decoupling per-token compute from distinct parameter count. To determine whether such a model genuinely utilizes its depth, both recurrence and layer-pruning literatures rely on a shared evaluation: truncating depth at inference time, plotting quality against retained depth fraction, and reading off the slope. While cheap and training-free, this metric suffers from an unexamined flaw: it extracts a single scalar from an intervention that alters multiple model properties simultaneously. Depth truncation concurrently reduces the number of block applications, decreases the volume of distinct computation performed, and pushes the readout head onto an out-of-distribution residual stream. The observed slope conflates all three factors, yet is conventionally interpreted as reflecting solely the second.
  We propose the Depth Control Protocol (DCP), a diagnostic suite that disentangles these three quantities. DCP comprises three positive controls that isolate each factor while varying the others, a negative control applying the identical interventions to dense transformers to ensure the effect is not an artifact of the measurement protocol, and a controlled training intervention to verify causality. The linchpin control, running the full budget of block applications while executing only a single distinct iteration, is strictly realizable only in depth-wise weight-sharing architectures, since in a dense network repeating a layer yields an entirely different model rather than the same model in an alternative configuration.

AI.tldr: 论文指出深度递归语言模型常用的深度截断评估指标存在缺陷：它同时改变块应用次数、不同计算量和读出头的分布外残差流，却通常只被解释为反映不同计算量。作者提出 Depth Control Protocol (DCP) 来解耦这三类因素。
AI.motivation: 判断深度递归语言模型是否真正利用其深度时，递归与层剪枝文献常依赖推理时截断深度、绘制质量与保留深度比例并读取斜率。该指标虽廉价且免训练，但存在未经审视的缺陷：深度截断同时改变多个模型属性，导致斜率被混淆解释。
AI.method: 提出 DCP 诊断套件，包含三个阳性对照分别隔离每个因素并变化其他因素，一个阴性对照在稠密 Transformer 上施加相同干预以排除测量协议假象，以及一个受控训练干预以验证因果性。关键控制是运行完整块应用预算但只执行单一不同迭代；该控制在深度权重共享架构中严格可实现，因为稠密网络中重复层会得到不同模型而非同一模型的替代配置。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值结果。主要结果是提出 DCP 诊断协议，用于解耦深度截断指标中混淆的三类因素，并指出关键控制仅能在深度权重共享架构中实现。
AI.conclusion: 传统深度截断斜率不能可靠解释为仅反映不同计算量；需要 DCP 这类诊断套件来分离因素并通过训练干预验证因果性。该工作为评估深度递归语言模型是否真正利用深度提供了更严格的测量框架。

title: Not All AI Agents Are Equal: Characterizing Resource and Performance Dynamics
summary: LLM-based AI agents process user requests through iterative reasoning and tool execution, often involving the invocation of remote LLM APIs with local tool containers. This execution model can make the optimization of agent serving difficult because latency, local resource demand, and container bottlenecks inter-mix across requests. However, the current agent ecosystem runs without much consideration of resource dynamics, which results in significant waste of the precious resources. This paper analyzes the resource inter-mix of AI agents for three representative tasks: retrieval-augmented question answering, web search, and software coding. To this end, we characterize the latency with respect to the resource dynamics of processing multiple requests and tasks concurrently. Our measurements show that agents have a wide range of behaviors depending on tasks, so that even the same tool can differ substantially in resource dynamics. We also find that running multiple requests concurrently exposes task-dependent bottlenecks in resource dynamics such as CPU, disk I/O, and memory. Furthermore, we uncover that faster LLM responses or more CPU cores do not always accelerate agents. Based on these observations, we demonstrate new optimization opportunities that exploit the resource dynamics of tasks: CPU-aware tool admission and task-aware CPU allocation. Our results show that the latency of CPU-sensitive agent tasks improves $\sim$5.4$\times$, and the average latency across multiple tasks is reduced $\sim$32% compared to native agents.

AI.tldr: 本文分析LLM智能体在检索问答、网页搜索和软件编程任务中的资源动态与延迟表现，发现任务和工具会导致CPU、磁盘I/O、内存等瓶颈差异显著，并提出CPU感知工具准入与任务感知CPU分配优化。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过迭代推理和工具执行处理请求，常涉及远程LLM API和本地工具容器。其延迟、本地资源需求和容器瓶颈跨请求混合，使服务优化困难；当前智能体生态较少考虑资源动态，造成宝贵资源浪费。
AI.method: 针对三类代表性任务：检索增强问答、网页搜索和软件编程，刻画并发处理多请求和多任务时的延迟与资源动态关系。通过测量分析不同任务、同一工具、并发请求下的CPU、磁盘I/O和内存瓶颈，并评估LLM响应速度和CPU核心数对智能体加速的影响。
AI.result: 测量显示智能体行为随任务变化很大，同一工具的资源动态也可能显著不同；并发请求会暴露任务相关的CPU、磁盘I/O和内存瓶颈；更快的LLM响应或更多CPU核心并不总能加速智能体。基于此提出CPU感知工具准入和任务感知CPU分配，CPU敏感任务延迟提升约5.4倍，多任务平均延迟降低约32%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体服务优化应重视任务与工具的资源动态，利用CPU感知和任务感知策略可显著降低延迟并减少资源浪费。

title: GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 as a Spotlight presentation
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向长单目序列的稳定、可扩展前馈3D重建统一框架，通过轨迹对齐、几何先验注入与射线场优化，缓解显存、局部几何退化和长期轨迹漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建虽高效，但扩展到大规模单目场景时受限于GPU显存过高、局部几何质量下降和长期轨迹漂移；现有分块优化方法几何约束有限，难以在长轨迹上保持全局一致性。
AI.method: 构建由粗到细的轨迹对齐框架，并结合轻量几何先验注入；通过LoRA适配将单目几何线索蒸馏到前馈骨干中，在保持推理效率的同时提升细结构深度精度；提出混合权重稀疏射线场优化，利用高频几何特征引导局部点云细化并施加一致的帧间射线约束；最后采用联合射线误差优化的轨迹拼接策略显式减少累积漂移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在轨迹精度上可与代表性SLAM系统竞争，同时在大规模场景中保持全局一致的3D重建。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架能够实现稳定且可扩展的长单目序列前馈3D重建，在精度、效率和全局一致性之间取得良好平衡。

title: AVTrace: Diagnosing Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning in Omni Models
summary: Omni models can describe video content, but can they locate events in time, preserve event order, and judge audio-visual synchronization? We introduce AVTrace (Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning Assessment and Capability Evaluation), a silver-standard diagnostic suite spanning onset and span grounding, synchronization, next-step prediction, cross-modal localization, chain parsing, and event-conditioned comprehension. It contains 34,114 training examples and category-balanced development and test splits of 3,500 and 7,000 examples. We evaluate five open omni models under their respective input configurations using reference-blind response normalization followed by deterministic scoring. All five off-the-shelf systems score below the test split's majority-label baseline of 0.556 on synchronization verification, and obtain low scores on chain parsing and event-conditioned grounding and comprehension. Development-set perturbations reveal task-dependent sensitivity in Qwen3-Omni-30B to modality removal and changes in visual input processing, without isolating their underlying causes. Parameter-efficient temporal post-training improves Gemma4-E4B-it on several benchmark metrics. On three external image benchmarks, task metrics change modestly, including some degradations, while teacher-forcing perplexity decreases. Together, these findings show that semantic reference-text overlap should not be treated as a proxy for temporal localization, and that AVTrace can identify task-specific weaknesses while providing a testbed for temporal post-training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AVTrace 音视频时序推理评估套件，覆盖事件定位、同步判断、链解析等任务，评测五个开放全模态模型，发现它们普遍表现不佳，并验证参数高效时序后训练的有效性。
AI.motivation: 全模态模型能描述视频内容，但尚不清楚它们能否在时间上定位事件、保持事件顺序并判断音视频同步。
AI.method: 构建 AVTrace 诊断套件，包含 onset/span grounding、同步验证、下一步预测、跨模态定位、链解析和事件条件理解等任务，含 34,114 个训练样本及 3,500/7,000 的开发/测试集；采用参考盲响应归一化与确定性评分评估五个开放模型，并进行扰动消融和参数高效时序后训练实验。
AI.result: 五个模型在同步验证上均低于多数标签基线 0.556，链解析和事件条件定位/理解得分低；Qwen3-Omni-30B 对模态移除和视觉输入处理变化表现出任务相关敏感性；时序后训练提升 Gemma4-E4B-it 多项指标；外部图像基准指标小幅变化（部分下降），教师强制困惑度降低。
AI.conclusion: 语义参考文本重叠不应作为时序定位的代理指标；AVTrace 能识别任务特定弱点，并为时序后训练提供测试平台。

title: LIFD: Anchored Diffusion for 3D-Aware Scene Memory in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation under partial observability requires spatial information that extends beyond the current view. Geometry-aware RGB features describe visible structure, but previously observed regions may disappear as the robot or scene moves. Maintaining a useful scene representation therefore requires retaining observation history while inferring missing content without losing its connection to visible evidence. We introduce LIFD (Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do), a framework for persistent, 3D-aware scene memory. LIFD learns a scene-token representation from multi-view agreement and completes it from a single RGB view and recurrent memory. A rectified-flow model generates the tokens while Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention conditions completion on current geometric features. Compact slot features connect this representation to a manipulation policy. Multi-view and geometric supervision are used during representation learning; deployment requires one RGB camera, proprioception, and a task instruction. LIFD (Staged) reaches 91.6% average success on LIBERO and 79.8% on MetaWorld, improving LIBERO average success by 3.1 percentage points over Joint training. On four UR5e task families with ten demonstrations per family, it achieves 56.0% mean success, compared with 40.5% for OpenVLA-7B.

AI.tldr: LIFD是一个用于部分可观测下机器人操作的持久化3D场景记忆框架，通过学习场景令牌表示并补全缺失区域，提升操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测下需要当前视野外的空间信息；仅靠几何感知RGB特征只能描述可见结构，而先前观察区域可能消失，因此需要在保留观察历史的同时推断缺失内容且保持与可见证据的联系。
AI.method: 提出LIFD，从多视角一致性学习场景令牌表示，利用单RGB视图和循环记忆补全；使用整流流模型生成令牌，锚引导交叉注意力以当前几何特征为条件；紧凑槽特征连接操作策略；训练时使用多视角和几何监督，部署仅需单RGB相机、本体感知和任务指令。
AI.result: LIFD（分阶段）在LIBERO上平均成功率91.6%，MetaWorld上79.8%，比联合训练在LIBERO上提高3.1个百分点；在四个UR5e任务族（每族10次演示）上平均成功率56.0%，而OpenVLA-7B为40.5%。
AI.conclusion: LIFD通过持久化、3D感知的场景记忆有效应对部分可观测性，显著提升机器人操作成功率，且部署时仅需单目RGB相机等。

title: Affective Shared Autonomy: Temporal Affect Dynamics and Subjective Evaluation in Bimanual Teleoperation Tasks
summary: Physical teleoperation integrates human cognitive flexibility with robotic precision, yet demanding manipulation tasks frequently induce severe cognitive workload, acute frustration, and execution breakdown. Conventional shared autonomy paradigms rely primarily on task-based rules, such as spatial error boundaries, which disregard the operator's transient affective state and risk misaligned control interventions. To address this limitation, we propose an affect-aware shared autonomy teleoperation framework that dynamically modulates robotic assistance based on real-time operator state estimation. The system estimates operator affective states from synchronized facial video, cardiac signals, and bilateral arm kinematics, outputting a seven-state affective distribution and a three-category operational abstraction (neutral, productive, adverse). Affect-aware assistance is selectively triggered when the user is detected in a continuous adverse state, preserving task-positive engagement without unnecessary disruption. The empirical user study ($N = 30$) confirms that the proposed affective assistance increases the productive states by up to 39.7% without compromising user agency. The collected dataset represents the first multimodal dataset that provides continuous visual, physiological, and operator's bilateral motion tracking of temporal affective state shifts during bimanual teleoperation. Our multimodal fusion model outperforms zero-shot baselines (Qwen, MiniCPM-V) in tracking temporal state dynamics. This real-world deployment offers a new human-centric framework that integrates visual, physiological, and motion tracking for physical human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种情感感知的共享自主遥操作框架，基于面部视频、心脏信号和双臂运动学实时估计操作员情感状态，仅在检测到持续不利状态时触发机器人辅助。N=30用户研究显示，该方法使生产性状态最高提升39.7%，且不损害用户自主性，并发布了首个相关多模态数据集。
AI.motivation: 物理遥操作虽能结合人类认知灵活性与机器人精度，但高难度操作常导致严重认知负荷、挫败感和执行崩溃。传统共享自主主要依赖任务规则（如空间误差边界），忽视操作员瞬态情感状态，可能导致控制干预错位。
AI.method: 同步采集面部视频、心脏信号和双臂运动学数据，通过多模态融合估计操作员七类情感分布和三分类操作抽象（中性、有效、不利）。当检测到持续不利状态时，选择性触发情感感知辅助。开展N=30用户研究，并与Qwen、MiniCPM-V等零样本基线比较时间状态动态跟踪性能。
AI.result: 情感感知辅助将生产性状态最高提升39.7%，同时不损害用户自主性。多模态融合模型在跟踪时间状态动态方面优于零样本基线。所收集数据集是首个提供双机械臂遥操作期间视觉、生理和操作员双臂运动连续跟踪的多模态数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该真实部署提出了一种以人为中心的框架，整合视觉、生理和运动跟踪，用于物理人机交互，实现情感感知共享自主遥操作。

title: HEROIC: Heterogeneous Evidential Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Identification and Cross-Robot Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent heterogeneous air-ground robot teams are attractive for open world search, with applications for reconnaissance, urban search and rescue missions (USAR), disaster response and recovery, and hazardous environments. These two platforms have different failure modes: aerial robots cover ground quickly but cannot resolve small or occluded targets from altitude, while ground robots can identify objects-of-interest, such as people or hazardous objects, at close range but cover less area. Existing language-tasked teams either have roles fixed prior, or have a language model assign them from hand-written capability tags, so the team is unable to know when within a mission an asset is no longer useful. We present HEROIC, a decentralized heterogeneous multi-agent open-vocabulary search coordination framework that requires agents to communicate in natural language only. HEROIC's initial agent role assignment is derived from sensor properties and a scale law to determine whether targets can be detected with a high confidence. From the mission's natural language prompt alone, this law assigns aerial flight altitudes and sweep spacing. When this calculated height falls below the altitude for safe flight, aerial agents re-task themselves from searcher to aerial triage, escort, and route guide for ground agents. Both robots maintain an evidential belief over the search area (bearing rays for positive evidence, a log-odds posterior for negative evidence) and gate any arrival on close-range verification. In full-stack experiments, HEROIC reaches the target 84% of the time across all 6 scenes, compares to 35-54% for vision-language frontier baselines, frontier-based search, lawnmower, and random-walk running the same perception, all while being 2-4x sooner to arrive at the target.

AI.tldr: 提出HEROIC，一种仅通过自然语言通信的分散式异构空地多智能体开放词汇搜索协调框架，能根据任务提示动态分配和调整角色。
AI.motivation: 空地机器人团队适合开放世界搜索与救援等任务，但两者失败模式不同：空中覆盖快却难分辨小或被遮挡目标，地面识别近但覆盖小。现有语言任务团队角色固定或依赖人工能力标签，无法判断任务中某资产何时不再有用。
AI.method: HEROIC从任务自然语言提示出发，利用传感器属性与尺度律推导初始角色，并确定空中飞行高度与扫描间距；当计算高度低于安全飞行高度时，空中智能体从搜索者重新任务为空中分诊、护航和路线引导。机器人维护对搜索区域的证据信念：正证据用方位射线，负证据用对数几率后验，并需近距验证才确认到达。
AI.result: 全栈实验中，HEROIC在6个场景中达到目标成功率为84%，而视觉语言前沿基线、基于前沿搜索、割草机式和随机游走等使用相同感知的基线为35%-54%；同时到达目标时间快2-4倍。
AI.conclusion: HEROIC通过自然语言驱动的动态角色重分配和证据化搜索协调，显著提升异构空地机器人团队在开放世界搜索中的成功率与效率。

title: Customizable and Jointly Optimized Route Planning: A Deep Architecture Enabling Differentiable Shortest-Path Search
summary: With the widespread use of online navigation and ride-hailing services, achieving optimal route planning for diverse user preferences has recently attracted increasing attention. Classic graph algorithms for pathfinding use heuristic cost functions to define edge weight, thus providing no optimality guarantee of route quality. Prior data-driven approaches equating ground truth of the optimal route with user trajectory, which is however moderately influenced by the navigation service, suffers from the feedback loop problem. To address these issues, we propose a deep architecture that is able to jointly optimize cost functions and route-ranking model towards any route preference. First, we run a multi-objective Dijkstra algorithm offline to collect the set of Pareto optimal routes, deeming it as the complete candidate set. Exploiting the property of such a set, we design a neural network structure that emulates shortest-path search and route ranking in an end-to-end differentiable manner. Second, we define route preference as a task of constrained optimization of route attributes, and propose a novel loss function that optimizes a single-objective variable, with other variables strictly under constraints. We conduct extensive experiments on real-world datasets. The results show that our architecture significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in route quality and customizability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种端到端可微的深度架构，联合优化代价函数与路径排序模型，以支持多样化用户偏好的最优路径规划。
AI.motivation: 经典图搜索算法依赖启发式代价函数，无法保证路径质量最优；已有数据驱动方法将用户轨迹视为最优路径，但轨迹受导航服务影响，存在反馈循环问题。
AI.method: 离线运行多目标Dijkstra算法收集Pareto最优路径作为完整候选集；设计模拟最短路径搜索与路径排序的神经网络，实现端到端可微学习；将路径偏好定义为路径属性的约束优化任务，并提出在约束下优化单目标变量的新损失函数。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，该架构在路径质量和可定制性方面显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该深度架构能够有效联合学习代价函数与路径排序，为不同用户偏好提供更优且可定制的路径规划方案。

title: Foundations of Stochastic Lexical Calculus: Semantic Descent and Random Dynamics on Probability Simplices
summary: Large language models produce prompt-dependent probabilities over words, whereas scientific systems require uncertainty over meaningful states that can be updated as evidence arrives. We develop an observable framework for determining when language-derived probabilities support such a sequential state representation. Theoretically, we define typed measurable transformations of contextual language, construct a minimal closed representation, and give necessary and sufficient conditions for semantic updates to exist uniquely. We bound irreducible nonclosure and accumulated error, and under average contraction prove existence, uniqueness and stability of an external random recursion on a probability simplex. These results define a stochastic lexical calculus without attributing an internal calculus to the language model. Empirically, frozen experiments test the observable implications. Raw prompt-conditioned probabilities fail the prespecified invariance gate; after prompt-specific calibration, a common three-state representation passes the stability gates and covers 28 of 30 untouched eight-step paths, or 0.933 at nominal level 0.90. Accordingly, language probabilities support a stochastic state only conditionally on verified closure, stability and coverage within a declared operating domain.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个可观测框架，判断语言模型基于提示词产生的词概率何时能支持可随证据更新的序列状态表示。理论给出语义更新存在唯一的条件，实验显示原始提示条件概率不满足不变性门槛，经提示特定校准后三状态表示可通过稳定性门槛并在未触碰路径上达到0.933覆盖。
AI.motivation: 科学系统需要关于有意义状态的不确定性，并能在新证据到来时更新；而大语言模型只产生依赖提示词的词概率，二者之间存在鸿沟。因此需要确定语言导出的概率何时能支持这种序列状态表示。
AI.method: 理论上定义上下文语言的类型化可测变换，构造最小闭表示，给出语义更新唯一存在的充要条件，并界定不可约非闭性与累积误差；在平均收缩条件下证明概率单纯形上外部随机递归的存在性、唯一性与稳定性。实验上采用冻结实验检验可观测含义。
AI.result: 原始提示条件概率未通过预设的不变性门槛；经过提示特定校准后，一个共同的三状态表示通过稳定性门槛，并在30条未触碰的八步路径中覆盖28条，覆盖率为0.933，名义水平为0.90。
AI.conclusion: 语言概率只有在声明操作域内验证了闭性、稳定性和覆盖性之后，才能有条件地支持随机状态表示。

title: A Free Lunch? Adapting PP-OCRv6 for Historical Text Recognition
summary: Despite impressive reported scores, large vision-language models have seen limited practical uptake in historical automatic text recognition because of their computational cost, dependence on large-scale pretraining, and hallucination. Historical ATR therefore continues to rely largely on compact CRNN line recognizers, which are visually grounded and trainable on modest data. Lightweight recurrence-free recognizers promise the accuracy of larger models with the practical advantages of CRNNs, yet have not been comprehensively evaluated on historical writing. We adapt PP-OCRv6, a recent compact text recognizer without strong language modeling, for historical line recognition and compare it with a conventional CRNN across generalized pretraining, domain-specific training, corpus-level fine-tuning, and manuscript-specific few-shot adaptation on multilingual Latin- and Arabic-script material. While PP-OCRv6 does not consistently outperform the baseline when trained from scratch, heterogeneous pretraining produces markedly better generalization. Comparisons with the Qwen3.5-based Medusa recognizer further show that fine-tuned PP-OCRv6 can outperform a large VLM tailored towards historical Latin-script HTR.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了轻量级无循环文本识别器 PP-OCRv6 在历史手写文本识别（ATR）中的表现，并与传统 CRNN 及基于 Qwen3.5 的大型视觉语言模型 Medusa 进行对比。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽得分高，但因计算成本高、依赖大规模预训练和幻觉问题，在历史 ATR 中实用受限；历史 ATR 仍主要依赖紧凑的 CRNN 识别器。轻量级无循环识别器有望兼顾高精度与实用性，但尚未在历史书写上被全面评估。
AI.method: 将 PP-OCRv6 适配于历史行识别，并与传统 CRNN 在通用预训练、领域特定训练、语料级微调及手稿特定少样本适应四种设置下对比，涵盖多语言拉丁字母和阿拉伯字母材料；同时与基于 Qwen3.5 的 Medusa 识别器进行比较。
AI.result: 从头训练时 PP-OCRv6 未持续优于 CRNN 基线；但异构预训练带来显著更好的泛化性能；微调后的 PP-OCRv6 可超越针对历史拉丁字母 HTR 定制的大型视觉语言模型 Medusa。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级无循环识别器经异构预训练和微调后，能在历史 ATR 中达到甚至超越大型 VLM 的效果，为历史 ATR 提供了一种实用且高效的替代方案。

title: Vehicle Trajectory Prediction via Neural Fusion of Multiple EKF-Based Trajectory Candidates
summary: Predicting the future trajectories of surrounding vehicles in autonomous driving is important for collision risk assessment and safe ego-vehicle path planning. Conventional neural network-based trajectory predictors typically achieve strong prediction performance by exploiting agent history, dynamic scene graphs, and semantic maps. However, in specific motion regimes such as acceleration, deceleration, and turning, these predictors may fail to reflect physically feasible trajectories. To address this issue, this study proposes a framework that fuses the output of Trajectron++, a neural network-based trajectory predictor, with extended Kalman filter (EKF)-based multiple trajectory candidates at a late stage. On the nuScenes dataset, the proposed method reduces the average displacement error and final displacement error of the Trajectron++ robot baseline by 13.7% and 14.6%, respectively, without modifying the baseline architecture. These results indicate that EKF-based trajectory candidates can effectively complement neural trajectory prediction through learned fusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种将Trajectron++神经网络轨迹预测输出与基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的多条候选轨迹进行后期融合的框架，用于提升自动驾驶中周围车辆未来轨迹预测的物理可行性和精度。
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络轨迹预测器虽能利用智能体历史、动态场景图和语义地图取得较好性能，但在加速、减速和转弯等特定运动模式下，可能无法输出物理上可行的轨迹。
AI.method: 在不修改Trajectron++基线架构的前提下，将其输出与基于EKF生成的多条轨迹候选进行后期融合，并通过学习式融合方法结合两类预测结果。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，该方法使Trajectron++基线的平均位移误差和最终位移误差分别降低13.7%和14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 基于EKF的轨迹候选能够通过学习式融合有效补充神经网络轨迹预测，从而提升预测精度和物理合理性。

title: Before the Warning Comes Too Late: Incremental Phone-Scam Detection from Speech
