Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.

AI.tldr: 论文分析大语言模型报告数值置信度的可靠性，发现直接口头表达的置信度在经基准错误审计后是意外强基线，而三样本一致性较弱，且固定插值无统计可靠增益；置信度对提问方式敏感，并存在相关错误与基准噪声。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能在生成内容时报告数值置信度，但不清楚这种报告是否真正校准，还是只是校准修辞。研究旨在检验其可靠性及不同无训练置信信号的有效性。
AI.method: 在100个TriviaQA问题上，对两个模型家族分析三种无训练信号：随答案口头表达的置信度、事后P(True)、与额外三次生成的一致性。还进行固定答案的等价提示重问置信度实验，并探索性审计100个带置信度标签的传记声明。
AI.result: 经基准错误审计后，直接口头置信度达到AUROC 0.956和0.937；三样本一致性明显较弱，为0.765和0.790；与口头置信度的固定插值没有统计可靠收益。一个模型9个错误中有4个、另一个8个错误中有2个获得全样本支持，说明自一致性会放大共同误解。对同一固定答案用等价提示重问，置信度平均变化0.043至0.084，在0.8阈值下翻转4%至9%的决策。传记声明审计仅发现被支持与被反驳声明之间存在 modest 置信度差距。
AI.conclusion: 有用的自我报告仍对提示方式、相关错误和基准噪声敏感。因此，大语言模型的置信度报告虽有潜力，但不应被简单视为稳定可靠的校准信号。

authors: Henrique Curi de Miranda e Lourenço Alves Pereira
title: A Proposal for an Agentic AI Architecture to Support Multi-Domain Decision-Making in the Brazilian Armed Forces
comment: This paper was accepted for publication in the XXVIII SIGE (Simpósio de Aplicações Operacionais em Áreas de Defesa)
summary: The growing complexity of multi-domain operational environments (land, aerospace, naval, cyber, and electromagnetic spectrum) has increased the volume and velocity of data reaching command-and-control (C2) centers, straining the observe-orient-decide-act (OODA) decision cycle. Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems currently employed in defense are, in general, reactive and isolated tools that still rely heavily on human operators to integrate information, assess scenarios, and formulate courses of action. This paper proposes a conceptual Agentic AI architecture for AI systems that can plan, access data sources, execute tools, and act autonomously and audibly, aimed at supporting decision-making across the three Brazilian Armed Forces (Navy, Army, and Air Force). Four application fronts are discussed (decision support, situational analysis, feasibility studies, and countermeasure suggestion), as well as the data and sensor access requirements and the security and permission safeguards necessary for responsible employment across administrative, strategic, operational, and tactical contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向巴西三军的Agentic AI概念架构，旨在通过自主规划、数据访问、工具执行和行动来缓解多域作战环境中C2中心的决策压力。
AI.motivation: 多域作战环境（陆、空、海、网络、电磁频谱）使数据量和速度激增，当前国防AI多为被动、孤立工具，仍需人工整合信息、评估态势和制定行动方案，加重了OODA决策周期负担。
AI.method: 提出概念性Agentic AI架构，使AI系统能自主且可听地规划、访问数据源、执行工具并行动；讨论四个应用方向（决策支持、态势分析、可行性研究、对策建议），并分析数据与传感器访问需求以及安全与权限保障措施。
AI.result: 形成了支持巴西海军、陆军和空军决策的概念架构，明确了四个应用前沿、数据/传感器访问要求，以及适用于行政、战略、战役和战术层面的安全与权限保障。
AI.conclusion: 该Agentic AI架构有望增强多域C2决策支持，但需在数据访问、安全与权限方面建立负责任使用机制，以支持巴西三军各层级决策。

title: Steering the Compass: Aligning Dynamic Psychological Counseling Conversations with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Strategies
summary: Recent advancements in large language models have revolutionized the field of psychological counseling, especially in the context of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). While the success of CBT relies heavily on dynamic decision-making informed by the client's real-time mental state, this aspect has often been overlooked in current research, limiting both flexibility and therapeutic outcomes. In this paper, we introduce StratCBT, a dataset specifically designed for psychological counseling conversations with CBT Strategies, consisting of 9,688 sessions and around 256K utterances, with each counselor's response aligned with one of eight distinct strategies. The creation of StratCBT involves modeling clients based on their negative thoughts and generating high-quality counseling conversations through self-chat, incorporating realistic sessions as guidance, thereby significantly surpassing existing datasets in both general counseling and CBT-specific skills. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of strategy-aligned generation and evaluate its efficacy in delivering professional and effective counseling with LLM-simulated clients to reflect real-world scenarios. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StratCBT，一个面向认知行为疗法（CBT）心理咨询对话的数据集，包含 9,688 个会话、约 25.6 万条话语，并将咨询师回复对齐到八种 CBT 策略，用于提升大语言模型在心理咨询中的策略性决策与生成能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在心理咨询尤其是 CBT 中取得进展，但 CBT 的成功依赖根据来访者实时心理状态进行动态决策，这一方面在现有研究中常被忽视，限制了咨询灵活性和治疗效果。
AI.method: 构建 StratCBT 数据集：基于来访者负面思维对其建模，通过 self-chat 生成高质量咨询对话，并引入真实会话作为指导；将每条咨询师回复对齐到八种 CBT 策略之一。随后进行大量实验，评估策略对齐生成的有效性，并使用 LLM 模拟来访者反映真实场景。
AI.result: StratCBT 包含 9,688 个会话和约 256K 条话语，在通用咨询和 CBT 特定技能上显著超越现有数据集；实验表明策略对齐生成有效，并能在 LLM 模拟来访者场景中提供专业且有效的咨询。
AI.conclusion: StratCBT 为 CBT 心理咨询中的策略感知对话生成与动态决策提供了高质量数据支持，有助于推动 LLM 在心理咨询中的专业应用。数据集已在 GitHub 公开。

title: MoSSGate: Memory-Modulated State-Space Gating for Skin Lesion Segmentation
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, accepted on International Conference on Cloud and Network Computing
summary: Accurate skin lesion segmentation is crucial for reliable computer-aided dermatological diagnosis, yet existing convolutional and transformer-based models often struggle to jointly capture long-range spatial dependencies and fine boundary details under limited computational budgets. This trade-off between global context modeling and boundary-aware localization frequently leads to over-segmentation, fragmented predictions, or missing thin peripheral structures. To address this challenge, we propose MoSSGate, a plug-and-play module for U-Net that integrates (i) boundary-aware spatial gating to restrict long-range propagation to informative regions, (ii) an external memory modulator that provides sample-adaptive dynamic control, and (iii) parallel 2D state-space modeling for efficient global context aggregation with linear complexity. The proposed design enables adaptive, context-aware information propagation while preserving sharp and accurate lesion boundaries. Extensive experiments on the ISIC 2017 and ISIC 2018 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy with strong efficiency, achieving 86.3% and 85.9% mIoU and 92.6% and 90.6% Dice, respectively, while requiring substantially fewer FLOPs than most competing CNN-based methods. These results highlight a favorable accuracy efficiency trade-off for high-resolution medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoSSGate模块，用于U-Net皮肤病变分割，通过边界感知空间门控、外部记忆调制器和并行2D状态空间建模，在低计算量下实现高精度分割。
AI.motivation: 现有卷积和Transformer模型难以在有限计算预算下同时捕捉长距离空间依赖和精细边界细节，导致过分割、分割碎片化或遗漏细小边缘结构。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的MoSSGate模块，集成边界感知空间门控（限制长距离传播到信息区域）、外部记忆调制器（提供样本自适应动态控制）和并行2D状态空间建模（线性复杂度高效聚合全局上下文）。
AI.result: 在ISIC 2017和ISIC 2018基准上分别达到86.3%和85.9% mIoU、92.6%和90.6% Dice，且FLOPs显著低于多数CNN方法。
AI.conclusion: MoSSGate在高分辨率医学图像分割中实现了优越的精度-效率权衡，具有实际应用价值。

title: MTF-Net: Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network for Pedestrian Intention Prediction
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, accepted on International Conference on Cloud and Network Computing
summary: Accurately predicting pedestrian intentions is crucial for ensuring safe and proactive interaction between autonomous vehicles and pedestrians. However, existing approaches often depend on architectures that either model temporal dependencies within individual modalities or fuse modalities only at coarse semantic levels. To address these limitations, we propose MTF-Net, a novel Multi-Modal Temporal Feature Fusion Network that jointly models kinematic, appearance, and contextual cues for pedestrian intention prediction. MTF-Net integrates four complementary modalities-bounding-box dynamics, human pose keypoints, local context, and scene-level semantics within a recurrent fusion framework enhanced by gated linear units (GLUs). These GLU-based modules adaptively regulate cross-modal information flow, enabling interpretable and efficient feature interaction across temporal scales. Through three dedicated temporal encoding branches and an attention-guided fusion head, the proposed model robustly anticipates pedestrian crossing intentions several frames before they occur. Extensive evaluations on the PIE and JAAD benchmarks demonstrate that MTF-Net surpasses recent transformer- and graph-based models, achieving up to 0.95 AUC on PIE and 0.94 AUC on JAAD, while maintaining real-time performance. The results highlight that reliable pedestrian intention prediction arises from principled multi-modal fusion rather than excessive architectural complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出MTF-Net多模态时序特征融合网络，融合边界框动态、人体姿态关键点、局部上下文和场景语义，用于行人过街意图预测，在PIE和JAAD上取得高AUC并保持实时性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么只建模单模态内部的时序依赖，要么仅在粗粒度语义层面融合多模态信息，难以在自动驾驶与行人交互中准确、及时地预测行人意图。
AI.method: MTF-Net在递归融合框架中联合建模运动学、外观和上下文线索，使用门控线性单元（GLU）自适应调节跨模态信息流，并设计三个时序编码分支和注意力引导融合头，提前数帧预测行人过街意图。
AI.result: 在PIE和JAAD基准上分别达到最高0.95 AUC和0.94 AUC，优于近期基于Transformer和图模型的方案，同时保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的行人意图预测主要来自有原则的多模态融合，而非过度复杂的网络架构。

title: Execution-Aware Pre-Execution Ranking for Grasp-Conditioned Robotic Placement
summary: A geometrically valid placement can still be difficult to execute because the selected grasp changes the required end-effector pose, collision geometry, and transport motion. Placement is formulated as a pre-execution ranking problem in which supplied grasp-placement candidates are scored before planning. The model combines a typed target-conditioned point cloud with three pose descriptors and hierarchical heads for planning success and execution success conditioned on planning. On a 30-object, 1,235-scene dataset with scene-group-held-out splits, three-seed top-1 success on covered test groups reaches 85.63 +/- 1.08% for joint selection and 79.84 +/- 0.16% for fixed-target ranking. For the designated frozen seed-42 checkpoint, top-1 success improves from 72.84% to 85.78% over full-pool cuMotion for joint ranking and from 59.65% to 79.67% for fixed-target ranking. Frozen transfer to xArm7/MoveIt requires no xArm-specific retraining. Across 27 locked cases, 13 complete end to end (48.15%). Of the 16 cases that pass Top-5 preflight and begin execution, 13 succeed (81.25%). Candidate-level deployment-feasibility prediction reaches 81.25% recall, 85.20% specificity, and 83.23% balanced accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文将机器人放置任务建模为执行前的抓取-放置候选排序问题，通过学习模型预测规划成功率和条件于规划的执行成功率，从而在规划前筛选更可行的候选。
AI.motivation: 几何上可行的放置不一定容易执行，因为所选抓取会改变末端执行器位姿、碰撞几何和运输运动；因此需要在规划前对候选进行可行性排序。
AI.method: 模型结合类型化目标条件点云与三种位姿描述子，并使用分层预测头分别预测规划成功率和条件于规划的执行成功率；在30个物体、1235个场景的数据集上采用场景组留出划分评估。
AI.result: 三随机种子top-1成功率：联合选择85.63±1.08%，固定目标排序79.84±0.16%；指定seed-42检查点相比full-pool cuMotion，联合排序从72.84%提升至85.78%，固定目标排序从59.65%提升至79.67%。冻结迁移到xArm7/MoveIt无需xArm特定重训练；27个锁定案例中13个端到端完成，成功率48.15%；通过Top-5预检并开始执行的16个案例中13个成功，成功率81.25%；候选级部署可行性预测达到81.25%召回率、85.20%特异度和83.23%平衡准确率。
AI.conclusion: 执行前对抓取-放置候选进行分层成功预测与排序，可显著提升放置任务成功率，并具备跨平台冻结迁移能力和较好的部署可行性预测性能。

title: LapaTrack-3D: 6 DoF pre-operative shape tracking for laparoscopic surgery
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Robotics and Bionics (T-MRB)
summary: This work proposes a real-time 6 Degree-of-Freedom (6 DoF) tracking algorithm for monocular laparoscopic surgery. It provides alignment between intra-operative video and pre-operative data (e.g., CT). The 6 DoF tracking offers a solution for accurately locating the internal anatomy of the target organ despite the lack of tactile feedback and transparency. The ORB-SLAM2 framework is adopted and modified for prior-based 3D tracking with four major modifications. First, the primitive 3D shape is used for fast initialization of the ORB-SLAM2 monocular mode. Second, a pseudo-segmentation strategy is employed to separate the target organ from the background for tracking. Third, the 3D shape is incorporated as a geometric prior in its pose graph optimization. Fourth, the Multi-Scale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) algorithm is leveraged and modified for image enhancement in challenging illumination scenarios. In-vivo and ex-vivo experiments validate that LapaTrack-3D provides robust 3D tracking and effectively handles typical challenges such as poor illumination, fast motion, out-of-field-of-view scenarios, partial visibility, and ``organ-background'' relative motion. LapaTrack-3D achieves a processing rate of 13 Hz for 1280*720 pixel video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LapaTrack-3D，一种用于单目腹腔镜手术的实时 6 自由度跟踪算法，可将术中视频与术前数据（如 CT）对齐，并在挑战性条件下实现稳健的 3D 跟踪。
AI.motivation: 腹腔镜手术缺乏触觉反馈且组织透明，难以准确定位目标器官内部解剖结构，因此需要将术中视频与术前影像对齐的实时 6 DoF 跟踪方案。
AI.method: 在 ORB-SLAM2 框架基础上进行四项改进：1）利用原始 3D 形状快速初始化单目模式；2）采用伪分割策略分离目标器官与背景；3）在位姿图优化中引入 3D 形状作为几何先验；4）改进 MSRCP 算法以增强困难光照下的图像。
AI.result: 体内和体外实验表明，LapaTrack-3D 能稳健地进行 3D 跟踪，有效应对弱光照、快速运动、视野外、部分可见及“器官-背景”相对运动等典型挑战，并在 1280×720 视频上达到 13 Hz 处理速度。
AI.conclusion: LapaTrack-3D 可为单目腹腔镜手术提供实时、稳健的 6 DoF 跟踪，实现术中视频与术前数据的对齐，有助于在缺乏触觉反馈和透明视野下定位目标器官内部解剖结构。

title: UnifiedPlayers: Enhance Tool-Integrated Reasoning in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Self-evolving methods reduce the need for human-annotated trajectories by allowing tool-using agents to generate their own training data. Yet existing methods typically separate trajectory generation from evaluation, relying on static verifiers that cannot adapt to emerging failure modes or self-consistency signals that may reinforce errors shared across trajectories. Jointly adapting planning, execution, and evaluation offers a promising alternative, but introduces a fundamental coordination challenge: each component continuously changes the data or feedback used to train the others. We address this challenge with \textbf{UnifiedPlayers}, a cooperative framework comprising a Planning Player that generates tasks, an Execution Player that produces multi-turn trajectories with Python tool calls, and an Evaluation Player that constructs executable verifiers. We design role-specific rewards that coordinate the three players toward a shared learning objective under GRPO. Across two model backbones and twelve reasoning benchmarks, UnifiedPlayers outperforms the strongest prior baseline by at least 3.5\% on mathematical reasoning and 3.9\% on general reasoning tasks. Moreover, the learned verifier achieves 84.2\% adversarial detection accuracy, while its reward signal exhibits 2.03$\times$ higher per-question variance than a self-consistency baseline, providing more discriminative verifications. These results highlight cooperation among specialized players as a promising path toward self-enhanced tool-integrated agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UnifiedPlayers，一个由规划、执行和评估三类智能体组成的协作框架，通过角色特定奖励和 GRPO 联合优化，实现工具使用智能体的自进化，并在推理任务和验证器质量上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化方法通常将轨迹生成与评估分离，依赖静态验证器，难以适应新出现的失败模式；而自一致性信号可能强化跨轨迹共享的错误。因此，需要联合适应规划、执行和评估，但这带来各组件相互改变训练数据与反馈的协调难题。
AI.method: 提出 UnifiedPlayers 协作框架：Planning Player 生成任务，Execution Player 产生带 Python 工具调用的多轮轨迹，Evaluation Player 构建可执行验证器。设计角色特定奖励，在 GRPO 下协调三个玩家朝共享学习目标优化。
AI.result: 在两种模型骨干和十二个推理基准上，UnifiedPlayers 相比最强先前基线，在数学推理上至少提升 3.5%，在通用推理任务上至少提升 3.9%。学习到的验证器达到 84.2% 的对抗检测准确率，其奖励信号相比自一致性基线具有 2.03 倍的每题方差，验证更具判别性。
AI.conclusion: 专业化玩家之间的协作是迈向自我增强、工具集成智能体的一条有前景的路径。

title: Solving Minimum Span Antibandwidth and Cyclic Antibandwidth Labeling Problems
summary: The Antibandwidth and Cyclic Antibandwidth problems are NP-hard graph labeling problems that aim to maximize the minimum (cyclic) distance between labels assigned to adjacent vertices. Extensive research on these problems has resulted in a variety of mathematical formulations and computational approaches. However, their minimum span perspective, in which a prescribed minimum (cyclic) distance is fixed and the objective is to minimize the label span, has received comparatively little attention. In this paper, we consider this complementary perspective by introducing the Minimum Span Antibandwidth/Cyclic Antibandwidth Labeling (MSABL/MSCABL) problems and developing a unified Boolean Satisfiability (SAT)-based framework for solving them. The SAT-based framework formulates MSABL/MSCABL as a sequence of decision problems and exploits their monotonicity to accelerate the search process. We also consider two SAT solving strategies, parallel and incremental SAT solving: the former examines multiple candidate spans concurrently, while the latter reuses a single SAT instance while progressively restricting the label domain. The proposed approaches are evaluated on benchmark instances from the Harwell-Boeing Sparse Matrix Collection and compared with CPLEXCP, CPLEXMIP, and Gurobi. The results show that SAT-based approaches are highly competitive in solution quality, with the parallel approach performing best overall for MSCABL and the incremental approach for MSABL. With the no-hole constraint, they remain competitive with CPLEXCP and significantly outperform CPLEXMIP and Gurobi, particularly for MSCABL. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SAT solving as an exact approach for MSABL and MSCABL.

AI.tldr: 本文从最小跨度视角研究 Antibandwidth 与 Cyclic Antibandwidth 问题，提出 Minimum Span Antibandwidth/Cyclic Antibandwidth Labeling（MSABL/MSCABL）问题，并构建统一的 SAT 求解框架。
AI.motivation: Antibandwidth 和 Cyclic Antibandwidth 是 NP-hard 图标记问题，已有研究多关注最大化最小（循环）距离，而其互补的最小跨度视角研究较少。
AI.method: 将 MSABL/MSCABL 形式化为一系列决策问题，利用单调性加速搜索；采用并行 SAT 求解和增量 SAT 求解两种策略，并在 Harwell-Boeing Sparse Matrix Collection 基准实例上评估。
AI.result: SAT 方法在解质量上很有竞争力；并行策略在 MSCABL 上整体表现最好，增量策略在 MSABL 上表现最好。在无洞约束下，SAT 方法与 CPLEXCP 竞争力相当，并显著优于 CPLEXMIP 和 Gurobi，尤其对 MSCABL。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，SAT 求解是解决 MSABL 和 MSCABL 问题的有效精确方法。

title: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
summary: Placing a grasped book into a tight shelf is a compact but difficult contact-rich control problem: millimetre-scale pose error can turn a geometrically valid approach into jamming, failed release, or incomplete seating. We study this final phase after grasp acquisition and global approach, and ask how control authority should be divided between known geometry and learned behaviour. Our method retains a nominal task-space controller for structured insertion and seating, while residual PPO supplies bounded local corrections and decides when to release. Only the brief open-retreat-reclose transition is scripted. For the final policy used on hardware, a deployment-matched simulation evaluation over 512 fixed conditions yields 98.50 percent mean success (0.23 percentage-point sample SD) across three independent training runs, compared with 37.89 percent for nominal control. On the physical xArm7, 60 trials over 30 matched conditions show the same qualitative advantage: residual control raises success from 26.7 percent to 63.3 percent, reduces failures from 22 to 11, and wins 13 of the 15 matched conditions in which the two controllers differ. Robustness tests show that performance remains above 87 percent under initialization perturbations up to 1.5x, while very tight clearances expose the geometric limit of local correction. These results support a hybrid design in which geometry preserves reliable task structure and learning is concentrated on the contact-sensitive behaviour that fixed rules handle poorly.

AI.tldr: 研究将抓取的书插入狭窄书架这一接触丰富的控制问题，提出混合控制方法：名义任务空间控制器负责结构化插入与就位，残差PPO提供有界局部修正并决定释放时机，仅开-退-闭过渡阶段采用脚本。仿真与真机实验均表明该方法显著优于纯名义控制。
AI.motivation: 毫米级位姿误差就可能使几何上可行的接近变为卡阻、释放失败或未完全就位，因此需要研究在抓取后最终插入阶段，控制权限应如何在已知几何与学习行为之间分配。
AI.method: 保留名义任务空间控制器用于结构化插入和就位，残差PPO提供有界局部修正并决定何时释放，仅开-退-闭过渡阶段脚本化。仿真采用部署匹配评估，在512个固定条件上对三个独立训练运行进行测试；真机在xArm7上对30个匹配条件进行60次试验，并进行初始化扰动鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 仿真中最终策略平均成功率为98.50%（样本标准差0.23个百分点），名义控制为37.89%；真机上残差控制将成功率从26.7%提升至63.3%，失败次数从22降至11，在15个控制器表现不同的匹配条件中赢13个。初始化扰动达1.5倍时性能仍高于87%，但极紧间隙暴露了局部修正的几何极限。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种混合设计：利用几何保持可靠的任务结构，将学习集中在固定规则难以处理的接触敏感行为上。

title: SAFARI: An Industrial Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for safety-critical engineering, yet their reliability in regulated functional-safety workflows remains underexplored. We introduce SAFARI (Safety-Aware Functional Automotive Risk Inference), the first industrial benchmark for LLM-assisted automotive Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) under ISO 26262. It contains 3,000 de-identified industrial HARA cases and evaluates two coupled tasks: open-ended hazard analysis and standards-grounded risk assessment. To evaluate open-ended HARA artifacts, we propose the first reference-anchored LLM-as-a-judge protocol with high expert correlation. Experiments with nine frontier LLMs show that models often produce plausible hazard narratives but remain weak at ISO 26262 risk classification, with the best ASIL macro-F1 reaching only 0.261. Chain-of-Thought prompting provides limited benefit and often degrades categorical risk assessment. Error analysis further localizes major failures to scenario-critical context omissions during hazard generation and to controllability misjudgments during risk assessment, indicating where expert oversight should be concentrated. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/xixi47520-hash/HARA.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SAFARI，首个用于ISO 26262下LLM辅助汽车危害分析与风险评估（HARA）的工业基准，包含3000个案例，评估两个任务：开放式危害分析和基于标准的风险评估。实验表明，九种前沿LLM能生成合理的危害描述，但在ISO 26262风险分类上表现不佳，最佳ASIL宏F1仅为0.261。
AI.motivation: LLM在安全关键工程中日益受到关注，但其在受监管的功能安全工作流程中的可靠性尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了SAFARI基准，包含3000个去标识化的工业HARA案例；评估两个耦合任务：开放式危害分析和基于标准的风险评估；提出了首个参考锚定的LLM-as-a-judge协议；对九种前沿LLM进行了实验，并测试了思维链提示。
AI.result: 模型常产生合理的危害叙述，但在ISO 26262风险分类上表现薄弱，最佳ASIL宏F1仅为0.261；思维链提示收益有限，且常降低分类风险评估性能；错误分析将主要失败定位为危害生成中的场景关键上下文遗漏和风险评估中的可控性误判。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出了专家监督应集中的领域，并表明LLM在安全关键工程中的可靠性仍需提升。

title: MaskHarness-WAM: Instance-Grounded Harnessing for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires not only stable local visuomotor control, but also continuous target tracking and reliable task progress assessment throughout execution. This challenge becomes particularly critical when multiple objects share identical appearances and must be manipulated in a prescribed order. In such scenarios, relying solely on a limited-horizon manipulation policy is often insufficient to determine which instance should be operated on and when the task should transition to the next stage. To address this challenge, we propose MaskHarness-WAM, an instance-grounded harness for long-horizon manipulation. The proposed system connects high-level task planning with low-level manipulation policies through target masks, while leveraging visual feedback for subtask scheduling and continuous execution. Since each subtask corresponds to a different target instance, the low-level policy requires a newly established initial target mask under the updated scene at each subtask transition. The harness continuously re-observes the environment, generates, and verifies the target mask at subtask boundaries, thereby updating the instance-level spatial condition provided to the low-level policy. Furthermore, the system advances the manipulation process by switching target instances according to the verified completion status of each subtask. Experiments on a real robot platform demonstrate that MaskHarness-WAM substantially outperforms limited-horizon policies on sequential multi-object manipulation, showing its effectiveness in extending local manipulation skills to reliable long-horizon execution.

AI.tldr: 提出MaskHarness-WAM，一个基于实例掩码的长期机器人操作框架，将高层任务规划与低层操作策略通过目标掩码连接，并利用视觉反馈进行子任务调度与持续执行。
AI.motivation: 长期机器人操作不仅需要稳定的局部视觉运动控制，还需要持续目标跟踪和可靠的任务进度评估；尤其当多个物体外观相同且必须按指定顺序操作时，有限视野策略难以判断应操作哪个实例以及何时进入下一阶段。
AI.method: 通过目标掩码连接高层任务规划与低层操作策略；每个子任务对应不同目标实例，在子任务切换时重新观察环境，生成并验证目标掩码，更新提供给低层策略的实例级空间条件；根据已验证的子任务完成状态切换目标实例，从而推进操作。
AI.result: 在真实机器人平台上的实验表明，MaskHarness-WAM在顺序多物体操作任务上显著优于有限视野策略。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效将局部操作技能扩展为可靠的长期机器人操作执行。

title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中，教师模型看到参考答案或解题过程所带来的额外收益，并区分其与无参考蒸馏本身的贡献。
AI.motivation: 已有OPSD让语言模型从能看到答案或解题过程的冻结自身副本中学习，但尚不清楚这种特权参考信息相对于蒸馏本身究竟增加了多少价值。
AI.method: 构建AMPLE-Math，包含5,319道数学题和六种共享同一答案的推理视图；将每种视图与匹配的无参考蒸馏对比；使用思考型教师监督直接回答式rollout，并在Qwen3-1.7B和SmolLM3-3B上评估，还进行教师画像与匹配损失干预。
AI.result: 无参考蒸馏解释了Qwen3-1.7B在思考型评估下的大部分提升，领域内和外部基准均如此；额外参考收益在Qwen中有限，精修解答最强，而完整轨迹在SmolLM3-3B第50步增加2个百分点。收益依赖学生训练状态；同一检查点下用长思考型rollout替代短直接回答rollout会使收益转为损失。Qwen中改变token级监督也可使行为基本不变。
AI.conclusion: OPSD可能通过直接回答与思考型推理共享的参数，改善对已有推理能力的调用；特权参考的价值在于促进这种跨模式迁移，而非揭示多少解题过程。

title: WiC is Not WSD: A Study on LLMs and Lexical Ambiguity Resolution
summary: Word-in-Context (WiC) remains challenging for language models, despite recent progress on lexical-semantic tasks. We hypothesise that this difficulty arises not only from comparing two contextual uses of a word, but also from the absence of an explicit sense inventory that specifies the relevant level of semantic granularity. We evaluate open LLMs on WiC and traditional Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) under similar settings. We find that providing candidate senses, similar to what is done in traditional WSD, improves WiC performance in all settings. In general, explicit sense information helps models make more consistent and targeted judgements. Human evaluation further shows that many apparent WiC errors reflect label ambiguity or mismatches between model and annotator sense boundaries rather than simple failures of lexical understanding. In particular, results show that LLMs overthink the sense distinction often leading to errors based on overly fine-grained distinctions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨 Word-in-Context（WiC）对语言模型困难的原因，认为除比较同一词的两个上下文用法外，缺乏明确义项清单和语义粒度也是关键。通过对比 WiC 与传统 WSD，发现提供候选义项可提升 WiC 表现；人类评估表明许多错误源于标签歧义或义项边界不一致，LLM 常因过度细粒度区分而犯错。
AI.motivation: WiC 仍是语言模型的难题。作者假设困难不仅来自比较同一词的两个上下文用法，还来自缺少指定相关语义粒度的显式义项清单。研究希望检验显式义项信息能否帮助模型，并理解 WiC 错误的真正性质。
AI.method: 在相似设置下评估开放 LLM 在 WiC 和传统 Word Sense Disambiguation（WSD）上的表现；在 WiC 中提供候选义项，类似传统 WSD；并进行人工评估，分析模型错误与标签歧义、义项边界差异之间的关系。
AI.result: 在所有设置中，提供候选义项均提升 WiC 性能。显式义项信息帮助模型做出更一致、更有针对性的判断。人类评估进一步显示，许多表面上的 WiC 错误反映的是标签歧义或模型与标注者义项边界不匹配，而非简单的词汇理解失败。LLM 常过度思考义项区分，导致基于过度细粒度区分而产生错误。
AI.conclusion: WiC 的困难部分源于语义粒度和显式义项清单的缺失。引入显式义项信息有助于提升并校准模型判断。未来应关注义项边界与标注模糊性，避免模型进行过度细粒度的义项区分。

title: Scene-Q: Confidence-Aware Coarse-to-Fine Querying of 3D Scenes with Selective VLM Reasoning
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IROS 2026
summary: Indoor mobile robots require open-vocabulary scene understanding that grounds natural-language queries in a consistent 3D map. Many existing systems ultimately rely on cosine-similarity retrieval with contrastive image--text encoders, which is efficient but brittle when labels are near-synonymous or multiple similar instances appear. We present Scene-Q, a confidence-aware coarse-to-fine querying framework that normalizes encoder scores with temperature scaling and selectively invokes a reasoning VLM only for low-confidence cases. High-confidence queries are answered by fast retrieval, while ambiguous ones are reranked over a small top-K candidate set using the original multi-view images and instance bounding boxes, enabling context-aware disambiguation at low cost. Scene-Q improves open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation on ScanNet200 and natural-language 3D instance retrieval on real-world reconstructions, with the largest gains on spatial and relational queries while keeping a substantial fraction of queries on the fast path.

AI.tldr: 提出Scene-Q，一种置信度感知的粗到细查询框架，用于室内移动机器人的开放词汇3D场景理解，结合快速检索与选择性VLM推理。
AI.motivation: 现有系统多依赖对比图像-文本编码器的余弦相似度检索，效率高但在标签近义或多个相似实例时表现脆弱，需要更鲁棒的开放词汇3D场景理解。
AI.method: 使用温度缩放归一化编码器分数，高置信度查询直接快速检索，仅对低置信度查询调用推理VLM，并在小规模top-K候选集上利用原始多视图图像和实例边界框进行重排序。
AI.result: 在ScanNet200上提升开放词汇3D实例分割，在真实重建上提升自然语言3D实例检索，空间和关系查询增益最大，同时大量查询仍走快速路径。
AI.conclusion: Scene-Q能以低成本实现上下文感知消歧，提升开放词汇3D理解，并保持较高效率。

title: Perception, Layout, and Validation: Calibrated Confidence for Reliable Straight-Through Processing of Financial Documents
summary: Straight-through processing (STP) on extracted key-value fields from financial documents without human review requires a calibrated probability together with a bounded guarantee on the residual error of the auto-approved tier. The emergence of modern Vision Language Models (VLMs) provides an out-of-the-box capability for extracting the key-values, but their verbalized confidence signals are unreliable and weakly track field correctness. This paper introduces a decomposed confidence layer along three interpretable channels, including perception, layout, and validation. Together with a final conformal risk control, the score can be used for reliable STP of financial documents. The method is validated on three public datasets covering real invoices, synthetic invoices, and ad-buy forms, using two different VLM families (Qwen3.6-27B and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite). Our decomposed score consistently improves the separation of correct from incorrect extractions, substantially raising the AUROC from 0.54-0.74 for VLM verbalized signals to 0.90-0.99 with contributions from all three designed channels. Crucially for industrial deployment, this enables usable STP. The native VLM confidence signals could clear only 0.1%-7.0% of fields under risk control at a target error of <10%. In contrast, the proposed method auto-approves 49-72% of fields while holding the empirical error of the accepted tier at or below the target.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分解式置信度层，包含感知、布局和验证三个可解释通道，并结合保形风险控制，用于金融文档键值提取的直通处理（STP）。在三个公开数据集和两种VLM模型上验证，AUROC从0.54-0.74提升至0.90-0.99，自动批准率可达49-72%且错误率低于10%目标。
AI.motivation: 金融文档的STP需要校准概率并对自动批准层的残余误差提供有界保证。现有VLM的言语化置信度信号不可靠，与字段正确性关联弱，无法满足工业部署需求。
AI.method: 设计三个可解释置信度通道：感知、布局和验证，并最终结合保形风险控制，形成分解式置信度评分。在三个公开数据集（真实发票、合成发票、广告表单）和两种VLM家族（Qwen3.6-27B、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite）上验证。
AI.result: 分解式评分持续改善正确与错误提取的分离，AUROC从VLM言语化信号的0.54-0.74提升至0.90-0.99，三个通道均有贡献。在目标错误率<10%的风险控制下，原生VLM置信度仅能清除0.1%-7.0%字段，而本方法可自动批准49-72%字段，同时保持接受层经验错误率不超目标。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可实现可靠的金融文档STP，显著提升自动批准率并维持有界误差，适用于工业部署。

title: Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents
summary: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 μs per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Chronicle，通过在智能体运行的非确定性边界处记录不可变信封（envelope）并支持回放，将一次记录的失败事件转化为可在 CI 中运行的回归测试；其核心操作 cut-point replay 可选择性地从记录中重放部分边界、其余边界用新代码实时执行。
AI.motivation: LLM 响应具有非确定性，且智能体依赖会变化的外部工具状态与多步轨迹，导致失败难以复现。现有记录-回放工具仅用于追踪（trace）或评分，无法用于针对代码改动的测试。
AI.method: 在非确定性边界处将智能体运行记录为不可变信封；提出 cut-point replay：指定一部分边界从记录中服务，互补部分用新代码实时执行，从而把已记录的事故变成 CI 中的回归测试；并在 6 个含模拟模型边界的记录失败基准及变异研究上评估。
AI.result: 记录开销为每次跨越 23 μs（约为假定 300 ms 模型调用的 0.008%）；完整回放零模型调用，且在 20 次重复中位稳定；cut-point 测试对 6 个事故均在错误代码上失败、在受保护与良性改动上通过；在受保护工具的变异研究中，cut-point 测试能捕获所有让已记录不安全动作通过的变异体，而将所有边界打桩（stub）的基线在同一断言下捕获率为零。
AI.conclusion: Chronicle 能高效、稳定地记录与回放智能体运行，并使 cut-point replay 成为一种有效的回归测试手段，代码与基准已公开于 https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle。

title: A Two-Stage Multi-Scale Attention-Based Network for Weakly Supervised Cataract Fundus Image Enhancement
summary: Cataract is a major cause of vision loss and hinders further diagnosis. However, cataract fundus image enhancement often grapples with challenges such as limited paired cataract retinal images and insufficient recovery of fine details in the retinal images. To mitigate these challenges, we in this paper propose a two-stage multi-scale attention-based network (TSMSA-Net) for weakly supervised cataract fundus image enhancement. Our TSMSA-Net leverages the domain transformation to synthesis paired real-like cataract images, solving the problem of difficult acquisition of paired images. To further extract detailed information from fundus images and reduce the generation of artifacts during the enhancement process, we propose a multi-scale attention-based stage to learn more useful features for cataract image enhancement. Experimental results on Kaggle and ODIR-5K demonstrate that our TSMSA-Net outperforms current state-of-the-art cataract fundus images enhancement even without paired images and exhibits certain generalization ability. Experimental results on Kaggle and ODIR-5K datasets indicate that our TSMSA-Net outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods for cataract fundus image enhancement, even in the absence of paired images. Additionally, it demonstrates a certain level of generalization capability. The enhancement also can improve the performance of vessel segmentation and classification in cataract images.

AI.tldr: 白内障是视力丧失的主要原因，但白内障眼底图像增强面临配对图像有限和细节恢复不足的挑战。本文提出了一种两阶段多尺度注意力网络（TSMSA-Net）用于弱监督白内障眼底图像增强。该方法通过域变换合成配对的白内障图像，并利用多尺度注意力阶段提取细节、减少伪影。在Kaggle和ODIR-5K数据集上，TSMSA-Net优于现有方法，且具有泛化能力，并能提升血管分割和分类性能。
AI.motivation: 白内障导致视力下降并阻碍进一步诊断，但白内障眼底图像增强存在配对白内障视网膜图像有限以及视网膜图像细节恢复不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段多尺度注意力网络（TSMSA-Net）用于弱监督白内障眼底图像增强。利用域变换合成配对的真实感白内障图像，解决配对图像获取困难的问题；提出多尺度注意力阶段，学习更有用的特征以增强白内障图像，并减少伪影。
AI.result: 在Kaggle和ODIR-5K数据集上的实验表明，即使没有配对图像，TSMSA-Net也优于当前最先进的白内障眼底图像增强方法，并表现出一定的泛化能力。增强还能提高白内障图像中血管分割和分类的性能。
AI.conclusion: TSMSA-Net能有效增强白内障眼底图像，解决配对图像缺乏和细节恢复问题，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法，具有泛化能力，且能提升后续任务性能。

title: MTVA-Bench: Evaluating the Language Model Inside Cascaded Voice Agents
summary: Generally, most voice agents are cascaded systems, i.e., an ASR model transcribes the caller's audio, a language model reads the transcript and decides what to say and which backend tools to call, and a TTS model speaks the reply. Nearly all of the decision making happens in the language model, but existing evaluations measure it either too broadly or too narrowly. End-to-end voice benchmarks score the full pipeline, so recognition errors and model errors mix into a single number. LLM benchmarks isolate the model but they do not evaluate what makes real phone calls hard, such as transcription issues, caller's voice being split across messages and the requirement that replies follow the language and script specified. We introduce the Multi-Turn Voice Agent Benchmark (MTVA-Bench), which evaluates the language model on the same conditions it faces inside a cascaded system. The caller is played by an LLM following a set of rubrics and tool calls are answered by a mock backend which responds to the arguments the model actually sent. The benchmark contains 49 agents working across 490 reviewed scenarios and supports 7 languages. Scoring is a combination of deterministic checks on tool calls with two LLM judges, one that scores scenario specific rules and one that grades conversation quality without access to the task. Both judges must cite specific messages from the transcript. Task and conversation scores are weighted equally, since a call can complete its task and still go badly for the caller. In a seven-model study, six of the models select the correct tool within 6.4 points of one another, but their overall scores span 24.4 points. Most of the gap comes from argument values, action ordering, rule compliance, and what the model says around its tool calls.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MTVA-Bench，用于在级联语音代理的真实条件下评估语言模型，包含多轮对话、工具调用、多语言和双评委评分。
AI.motivation: 现有评估要么端到端测试整条流水线，混入ASR/TTS错误；要么只测LLM，忽略真实电话场景中的转录问题、多消息拆分和语言/文字要求。
AI.method: 构建49个代理、490个审核场景、支持7种语言的基准；由LLM扮演呼叫者，mock后端响应工具调用参数；评分结合确定性工具调用检查和两个LLM评委，分别评估场景规则与对话质量，且评委需引用具体消息；任务分与对话分等权。
AI.result: 在7个模型研究中，6个模型选择正确工具的分差在6.4分以内，但总体得分差距达24.4分；主要差距来自参数值、动作顺序、规则遵循以及工具调用前后的表述。
AI.conclusion: MTVA-Bench能在级联系统条件下更精准评估语言模型决策能力，表明仅看工具选择不足，需关注参数、顺序、合规和对话质量。

title: SAGE-Yoga: Multi-Cue Learning for Yoga Pose Classification and Joint-Level Correction
summary: Automated yoga analysis requires both accurate pose classification and interpretable feedback on pose execution. However, existing methods often rely on a single visual prediction, struggle to distinguish visually similar poses, and treat pose classification and correction as separate tasks. To address these limitations, we propose SAGE-Yoga, a unified coarse-to-fine framework for yoga pose classification and joint-level correction from a single RGB image. Inspired by how yoga instructors assess posture using multiple complementary cues, SAGE-Yoga first employs a bagging-based ensemble of complementary visual backbones to generate a ranked set of candidate pose classes. Additionally, a margin-based gating mechanism preserves confident visual predictions while invoking geometric verification only for ambiguous cases. Moreover, once the final pose class is determined, SAGE-Yoga retrieves a medoid reference pose and compares the observed joint angles with class-specific distributions to identify misaligned joints. Finally, these deviations are translated into actionable corrective feedback. Empirically, experiments on the Yoga-82 dataset show that the visual ensemble achieves 89.0% Top-1 accuracy, while the complete framework improves performance to 90.7% Top-1 accuracy and 90.1% Macro-F1. These results demonstrate that combining complementary visual evidence with selective geometric verification improves fine-grained pose classification while enabling interpretable, joint-level correction.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAGE-Yoga，一个从单张 RGB 图像进行瑜伽姿态分类与关节级纠正的统一粗到细框架，结合视觉集成与选择性几何验证。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常依赖单一视觉预测，难以区分视觉相似姿态，且将姿态分类与纠正视为独立任务，因此需要同时实现准确分类与可解释反馈。
AI.method: 采用基于 bagging 的互补视觉骨干集成生成候选姿态类别；用基于 margin 的门控机制在高置信时保留视觉预测，模糊时调用几何验证；确定类别后检索 medoid 参考姿态，比较关节角度与类别特定分布以识别错位关节，并转化为纠正反馈。
AI.result: 在 Yoga-82 数据集上，视觉集成达到 89.0% Top-1 准确率，完整框架提升至 90.7% Top-1 准确率和 90.1% Macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: 结合互补视觉证据与选择性几何验证可提升细粒度姿态分类性能，并实现可解释的关节级纠正。

title: Compliance for Free: Learning Identifiable Impedance via Bilateral Teleoperation
summary: Vision-language-action models tell a robot where to move, but not how hard to push. Contact-rich tasks depend on that second quantity, compliance, yet no widely used demonstration interface records it. The obstacle is identifiability as realized pose and measured force cannot separate the operator's intended equilibrium from their stiffness, so VR controllers, SpaceMouse and handheld grippers cannot supply compliance supervision even in principle. Prior compliance-output policies work around this with hand-specified task structure, privileged simulation contact state, or dedicated force and tactile hardware. Four-channel bilateral teleoperation removes the ambiguity directly by using the leader arm as a separate measurement of the intended equilibrium, making per-axis stiffness identifiable by regression using only the joint-torque sensing already on the manipulator. This yields per-timestep, direction-dependent compliance labels at zero annotation cost, which we use to fine-tune a VLA to emit stiffness alongside pose. On a Franka Research 3 wiping task, ours is the only policy of five whose contact force changes when the instruction asks for a firm wipe rather than a normal one (6.4N (normal) to 9.1N (firm) RMS, Cohen's d = 0.89, p = 0.023

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用四通道双边遥操作，从机械臂已有的关节力矩传感中识别每轴刚度，从而零额外标注地获得逐时刻、方向相关的柔顺标签，并用于微调VLA，使其在输出位姿的同时输出刚度。
AI.motivation: VLA能告诉机器人往哪移动，却不能告诉它用多大力。接触丰富任务依赖柔顺性，但现有示范接口无法记录该信息。核心障碍是可识别性：实际位姿与测得力无法分离操作者意图的平衡位置与刚度，因此VR控制器、SpaceMouse和手持夹爪原则上无法提供柔顺监督。
AI.method: 采用四通道双边遥操作，将主臂作为意图平衡位置的独立测量，使每轴刚度仅利用机械臂已有的关节力矩传感即可通过回归识别；由此生成逐时刻、方向相关的柔顺标签，零标注成本；再用这些标签微调VLA，使其同时输出位姿与刚度。
AI.result: 在Franka Research 3擦除任务中，对比五种策略，只有该策略在指令要求“用力擦”而非“普通擦”时接触力发生变化：RMS从6.4N（普通）增至9.1N（用力），Cohen's d=0.89，p=0.023。
AI.conclusion: 四通道双边遥操作可消除柔顺监督中的可识别性歧义，无需专用力/触觉硬件或特权仿真接触状态，就能为VLA提供零标注的刚度监督，使其响应柔顺性指令。

title: Mechanical Precision Weeding with a Quadruped Robot
summary: Herbicide-based weed control is increasingly unsustainable due to rising weed resistance and the adverse environmental impacts of chemical use. While mechanical weed control avoids these drawbacks, it is typically implemented using large machines that cause soil compaction. We propose a novel alternative based on small mobile robots for mechanical weeding. Compared with existing automated mechanical weeding approaches, the proposed method offers reduced soil compaction, simpler automation, and improved scalability. Our solution involves a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped robot equipped with a custom weed removal tool featuring a milling bit at its end. The tool is rigidly attached to the robot and uses the degrees of freedom of the robot base by actuating the legs, while keeping the feet stationary. We develop a software architecture that enables autonomous weed removal and integrate this system with all other required components. We analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the current proof of concept both in an indoor and outdoor environment and provide recommendations for future work to make the system more accurate and efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于小型四足机器人Spot的机械除草方案，通过刚性连接的铣刀工具和自主软件架构实现除草，并在室内外评估概念验证的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 除草剂因杂草抗性上升和化学环境危害而日益不可持续；机械除草虽可避免这些问题，但大型机械会造成土壤压实，因此需要小型机器人替代方案。
AI.method: 使用Boston Dynamics Spot四足机器人，配备末端带铣刀的自定义除草工具，工具刚性连接，通过驱动腿部使机器人基座运动而保持足端静止；开发自主除草软件架构并集成所需组件，在室内外环境测试。
AI.result: 对当前概念验证系统在室内外环境中的除草精度和效率进行了分析，并提出了提升精度与效率的未来工作建议。
AI.conclusion: 小型移动机器人机械除草可减少土壤压实、简化自动化并提高可扩展性，但当前系统在精度和效率上仍需改进。

title: HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to the 2026 International Conference on Large Language Models (LLM 2026)
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HerHealthEval，一个用于多语言女性健康沟通理解的可控评估框架，覆盖英语、法语和现代标准阿拉伯语，并通过六种沟通形式测试模型对关切分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性与跨形式一致性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多用于医疗沟通，但现有评估多关注回答质量，并默认模型已正确理解用户关切，忽略了语言、表达方式差异及信息不足时的澄清需求，可能掩盖安全相关失败。
AI.method: 构建 HerHealthEval：每个临床案例提供英语、法语、现代标准阿拉伯语的匹配版本，包含规范、临床、外行、间接/模糊、情绪担忧、故意信息不足六种沟通形式；前五种保留相同临床信息，最后一种故意省略细节以测试是否需澄清。评估多语言指令模型及 QLoRA 适配变体在关切分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规和跨形式一致性上的表现。
AI.result: 聚合准确率和一致性会掩盖安全相关失败。多语言适配模型在语言不对称风险监督下，法语和阿拉伯语的漏诊/低估风险（under-triage）达 0.994。使用源数据派生、语言不变的 风​​险标签进行受控再适配后，法语和阿拉伯语的 under-triage 分别降至 0.572 和 0.558。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的多语言医疗评估必须显式测试语域变化、不确定性处理，以及适配标签的来源与语言不变性。

title: FlipToSee: A Probabilistic Stable Placement Prior for Active Visual Exploration via Regrasping
summary: Active visual exploration of tabletop objects often requires reorienting an unknown resting object onto a different stable support face to expose occluded surfaces. To identify such placements without exhaustive physical search, we learn a probabilistic placement prior from a single-view point cloud. Stable placement prediction is inherently multimodal, and conventional 6-DoF regression introduces further ambiguity by modeling translation and in-plane yaw. We therefore propose FlipToSee, a probabilistic framework that removes this representational ambiguity by parameterizing placements as unit support normals on $S^2$ while modeling their multimodal conditional distribution via a von Mises--Fisher mixture density network. To decouple mode diversity from physical robustness, FlipToSee deterministically extracts a compact candidate set from the mixture components and applies robustness-aware reranking using an auxiliary head trained with candidate-aligned supervision. In simulation, FlipToSee achieves $98.4\%$ first-proposal success on in-distribution objects, $95.3\%$ on out-of-distribution shapes, and $90.0\%$ under zero-shot transfer to household YCB objects. We further demonstrate the learned placement prior on a physical robot by integrating it with grasp and motion planning for exploratory regrasping.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlipToSee 概率框架，从单视角点云学习稳定放置先验，用于桌面物体主动视觉探索中的重新定向与遮挡表面暴露。
AI.motivation: 主动视觉探索常需将未知静止物体重新定向到不同稳定支撑面，但穷举物理搜索效率低。稳定放置预测本质多模态，传统 6-DoF 回归建模平移和平面偏航会引入额外歧义。
AI.method: 将放置参数化为 S^2 上的单位支撑法线，使用 von Mises--Fisher 混合密度网络建模多模态条件分布；从混合分量中确定性提取紧凑候选集，并用候选对齐监督训练的辅助头进行鲁棒性重排序。
AI.result: 仿真中首次提案成功率：分布内物体 98.4%，分布外形 95.3%，零样本迁移到 YCB 家庭物体 90.0%；并在物理机器人上结合抓取与运动规划验证了探索性重抓取。
AI.conclusion: FlipToSee 能有效学习稳定放置先验，减少穷举物理搜索，并支持机器人主动视觉探索中的重定向与探索性重抓取。

title: PaGNet: A Panel-Aware GBDT--Neural Network for Multi-Target Corporate Tax Avoidance Proxy Forecasting
summary: Forecasting corporate tax avoidance proxies from firm--year panel data is challenging because predictive signals are distributed across short firm histories and related targets, while screening-oriented use requires transparent model behavior. We propose PaGNet (Panel-Aware GBDT--Neural Network), a two-branch hybrid that combines a LightGBM branch using panel-temporal summaries with a Panel-MLP branch using attention-pooled temporal aggregation and shared-trunk multi-task learning. A per-target validation-optimal blender produces both the final prediction and a compact branch-reliance diagnostic without trainable fusion parameters. On the KoTaP panel of 1{,}754 Korean listed firms from 2011--2024, PaGNet is evaluated under a leakage-free, shared-hyperparameter protocol across four feature regimes. In the direct-proxy-lag-excluded FS1 regime and the tax-history-augmented FS2 regime, accrual targets (TSTA, TSDA) route stably to the LightGBM branch, where PaGNet raises explained variance over the strongest of six baselines by roughly $0.08$--$0.11$ on the primary split. GETR often leans toward the neural branch, while CETR exposes a validation--test branch-selection mismatch rather than a stable branch assignment. A panel-flatten control shows that most accrual gains come from observed multi-year base-panel values, with PaGNet's panel-aware representation adding a smaller but directionally consistent refinement. Rolling-origin analysis confirms stable accrual routing, bounds ETR diagnostics to split-specific behavior, and identifies a far-horizon split where supervised models underperform naive persistence. PaGNet is therefore best viewed not as a universally superior tabular learner, but as a proxy-aware panel model that combines competitive forecasting with explicit per-target branch-reliance reporting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PaGNet，一种结合 LightGBM 与 Panel-MLP 的双分支混合模型，用于从公司—年度面板数据预测企业避税代理指标，并在韩国 KoTaP 数据上进行无泄漏、共享超参数评估。
AI.motivation: 企业避税代理指标的预测信号分散在较短的公司历史和多个相关目标中，同时筛选式应用要求模型行为透明可解释。
AI.method: PaGNet 包含两个分支：LightGBM 分支使用面板—时间汇总特征，Panel-MLP 分支使用注意力池化时间聚合与共享主干多任务学习。通过按目标验证集最优的混合器生成最终预测和分支依赖诊断，且不引入可训练融合参数。在 KoTaP 面板的 1,754 家韩国上市公司 2011—2024 年数据上，采用无泄漏、共享超参数协议跨四种特征制度评估。
AI.result: 在排除直接代理滞后的 FS1 和加入税务历史的 FS2 制度中，应计目标 TSTA、TSDA 稳定路由到 LightGBM 分支，PaGNet 在主划分上比六个基线中最强者提高解释方差约 0.08—0.11。GETR 常偏向神经分支，CETR 暴露出验证—测试分支选择不一致而非稳定分支分配。面板展平控制显示，应计收益主要来自观测到的多年基础面板值，PaGNet 的面板感知表示带来较小但方向一致的改进。滚动起点分析确认应计路由稳定，将 ETR 诊断限制为划分特定行为，并发现远期限划分中监督模型不如朴素持续性。
AI.conclusion: PaGNet 不应被视为普遍更优的表格学习器，而应被视为一种代理感知面板模型，它将有竞争力的预测能力与显式的按目标分支依赖报告结合起来。

title: UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising
summary: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.

AI.tldr: 提出UniPolicy，一种面向多目标的多策略对齐框架，用于搜索广告，通过分层参数解耦和多策略束搜索平衡相关性、点击倾向与商业价值，离线与在线实验均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索广告系统通常仅对齐单一商业奖励（如eCPM）或简单融合多奖励，难以兼顾异质目标，且梯度竞争易导致全局次优，需同时优化用户体验与商业价值。
AI.method: UniPolicy采用目标特定前缀token、稀疏MoE-LoRA路由和目标特定残差FFN，在共享主干中分层解耦参数，为不同目标提供差异化策略表达空间；构建多阶段行为反馈的成对偏好，补充曝光未点击样本的相对偏好，增强点击候选优势；推理时支持并行、业务可定制的多策略束搜索，在固定检索预算下灵活分配各目标候选配额。
AI.result: 离线实验表明UniPolicy在多个指标上均衡提升并保持检索质量，优于单目标强化学习和朴素奖励融合基线；在真实搜索广告系统7天在线A/B测试中，CTR提升0.71%，RPS提升1.58%，广告收入提升1.32%，服务延迟稳定。
AI.conclusion: UniPolicy能有效平衡搜索广告中的多目标，兼顾用户体验与商业价值，并具备实际部署可行性。

title: Distance to Class Prototypes: Active Learning for Object Detection
summary: Deploying a deep object detector in a new setting is limited less by architecture than by the cost of annotating data from that setting. Active learning lowers the cost by choosing which images to label, and the choice is only as good as the signal used to score an unlabeled image. That signal is usually the class posterior, which is cheap but poorly calibrated, or the disagreement across several models or several stochastic passes, which is better but multiplies inference over a pool far larger than the labeled set. We propose a signal richer than the posterior yet still read from one forward pass of one network. A supervised contrastive term added to the training objective shapes a per-object embedding space in which distance encodes class membership, and an unlabeled detection is scored by how far it lies from the region occupied by its predicted category, weighted by its confidence. The criterion needs no ensemble, no auxiliary predictor and no repeated inference, and its entire cost is 2.89M parameters, an increase of 8.3% over a bare detector. On PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO it beats the posterior of the same detector in every round in which a selection is made, by up to 1.08% mAP50 against run to run deviations of 0.02% to 0.18%, and it stays competitive with ensemble and Monte Carlo dropout criteria costing three to fifty forward passes per unlabeled image. Experiments use the single-stage detector under which the compared criteria report their results, so that the selection decision is isolated from the strength of the detector.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种用于目标检测主动学习的单次前向传播评分信号：在训练目标中加入监督对比项，使每个目标的嵌入空间中距离编码类别归属，并用预测类别区域的偏离程度加权置信度来给未标注检测打分。
AI.motivation: 在新场景部署深度目标检测器的主要限制不是架构，而是标注成本。主动学习通过选择要标注的图像来降低成本，但选择质量取决于未标注图像的评分信号。常用类别后验概率便宜但校准差，而多模型或多次随机前向的不一致性更好但推理成本高，需在整个未标注池上多次前向。
AI.method: 在检测器训练中加入监督对比损失，塑造逐目标嵌入空间，使距离反映类别成员关系。对未标注检测，依据其嵌入与预测类别所在区域的距离进行评分，并用检测置信度加权。该方法只需单网络单次前向，无需集成、辅助预测器或重复推理；额外参数仅2.89M，相比裸检测器增加8.3%。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO上，该方法在每一轮选择中都优于同一检测器的后验概率准则，最高提升1.08% mAP50，而运行间波动仅0.02%至0.18%。其表现与需要每个未标注图像3到50次前向的集成和Monte Carlo dropout准则相当。实验使用单阶段检测器，与对比准则报告结果所用检测器一致，从而隔离选择决策与检测器强度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于单次前向对比嵌入的评分准则能有效且高效地用于目标检测主动学习，在显著降低推理成本的同时优于廉价后验准则，并可与高成本集成或MC dropout方法竞争。

title: Graph-Based Design of Soft Grippers with Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Optimisation
summary:
Effective manipulation across diverse objects is critical for applications ranging from agricultural harvesting to laboratory and domestic automation. While the inherent compliance of soft robotics is well suited to this challenge, designing grippers that generalize across tasks remains difficult due to the vast design space of continuum mechanics and the risk of overfitting to specific scenarios.
  We propose a graph-based design space for representing soft structures and mechanisms, coupled with a multi-objective, diversity-driven genetic optimization framework that explicitly promotes solution variety throughout the design process. Using multiple grasping scenarios during optimization, we study how task diversity influences the emergence of generalization to unseen objects and contact conditions.
  Our results show that optimization over a sufficiently diverse set of grasping cases leads to designs with emergent generalization, exhibiting improved robustness compared to task-specific solutions on novel scenarios. These findings suggest that diversity-driven optimization offers a principled pathway toward general-purpose soft grippers, aligned with the adaptable nature of soft robotics.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于图的软体结构设计空间，并结合多目标、多样性驱动的遗传优化，以提升软体抓取器对多种物体的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人虽具顺应性，但设计空间大且易过拟合特定任务，难以开发能跨任务通用的抓取器。
AI.method: 构建基于图的软体结构与机构设计表示，采用多目标、多样性驱动的遗传优化框架，并在优化过程中引入多种抓取场景，研究任务多样性对泛化能力的影响。
AI.result: 在足够多样的抓取案例集上优化，可涌现出泛化能力；与任务特定方案相比，这些设计在新颖场景中表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多样性驱动优化为设计通用软体抓取器提供了原则性路径，契合软体机器人的可适应特性。

title: Sequential Contextual Fit Predicts Human Behavioural and Neural Dynamics Across Domains
summary: Human perception, action and decision making unfold in sequences, but computational predictors are often domain-specific. This study computes and tests sequential contextual fit (SCF), an embedding-based measure of how well a current information state matches its recent context. The metric uses a simple recency-weighted similarity kernel and can be applied to words, sounds, visual scenes, affective states, choices, actions and neural representations. Across language processing, music-evoked emotion, a subset of audiovisual emotion EEG data, gambling decisions, human activity recognition and decision-related EEG, lower contextual fit predicted longer processing times, larger affective or behavioural transitions and stronger neural-state changes. These effects remained after controlling for established predictors including surprisal, reinforcement-learning prediction error, acoustic change, visual change and sensor change. SCF therefore provides a computational measurement layer for relating contextual compatibility to behavioural processing and cognitive/neural state-transition dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并检验顺序情境契合度（SCF），一种基于嵌入的指标，用于衡量当前信息状态与近期情境的匹配程度；跨语言、音乐情绪、视听情绪EEG、赌博决策、活动识别和决策EEG等任务，较低SCF预测更长加工时间、更大情感或行为转变以及更强神经状态变化。
AI.motivation: 人类感知、行动和决策以序列方式展开，但现有计算预测器通常局限于特定领域，缺乏可跨领域衡量当前信息与近期情境兼容性的通用指标。
AI.method: 使用简单的近因加权相似核计算嵌入相似度，得到SCF；该指标可应用于词语、声音、视觉场景、情感状态、选择、动作和神经表征。研究在语言加工、音乐诱发情绪、部分视听情绪EEG数据、赌博决策、人类活动识别和决策相关EEG中测试，并控制惊讶度、强化学习预测误差、声学变化、视觉变化和传感器变化等既有预测因子。
AI.result: 较低的情境契合度预测更长的处理时间、更大的情感或行为转变以及更强的神经状态变化；这些效应在控制既有预测因子后仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: SCF提供了一个计算测量层，可将情境兼容性与行为加工及认知/神经状态转换动态联系起来。

title: Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol
comment: v1.1. 8 pages. Also archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22817289
summary:
This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure.
  The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration.
  This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并操作化“摘要偏差”：大型语言模型倾向于将叙事意义表示为抽象摘要标签，而非生成该意义的可重构推断结构。该偏差假设存在于生成与评价两种机制中，其中评价机制影响更大。
AI.motivation: LLM日益充当评判者与奖励模型，若其偏好“讲述”模式而非“展示”模式，可能对写作施加选择压力，使文本趋向扁平化直白陈述，损害需要读者重构的叙事效果。
AI.method: 在Bulut Doctrine的讲述-展示轴上定义构念；将摘要偏差与LLM-as-judge偏差进行对比；重新解读一项已完成的独立信度研究作为方向性证据；预注册一个双机制检验，并设定放弃该构念的决策规则。
AI.result: 论文不声称该偏差已获验证。重读独立信度研究仅提供与其一致的方向性证据；双机制检验尚待预注册实施。评价机制被认为更关键，因为它可能促使模型奖励直白表达并低估展示型抑制。
AI.conclusion: 摘要偏差目前仍是待检验构念。若预注册检验结果未满足决策规则，则应放弃该构念；若成立，则需关注LLM作为评判者时对叙事风格的系统性影响。

title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
summary: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出按需注意力（ODA），一种局部优先的解码方法，通过轻量级召回头预测全局注意力的收益，从而在生成长文本时选择性调用全局注意力，减少不必要的全局读取并加速推理。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中，全注意力解码在每一步都读取不断增长的历史，即使这对下一步预测未必有益，导致效率低下。作者发现预训练模型在全局读取前的解码状态已包含预测该收益的信息，因此希望让模型自主决定何时需要全局注意力。
AI.method: ODA仅训练一个轻量级召回头，保持预训练权重不变，并保留完整历史KV缓存以供未来召回。召回头根据预测收益动态决定是否调用全局注意力。作者还在vLLM中实现GPU端条件执行，将减少的全局读取转化为实际解码加速。
AI.result: 在Qwen和Gemma模型（包括混合注意力骨干）上的实验表明，选择性召回能够恢复局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时显著减少全局读取，并在长上下文长度下实现相对全注意力的实际解码加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一种长上下文推理范式：预训练模型能够引导自身对已保留信息的访问，在保持性能的同时提升推理效率。

title: Generative Verification: Rethinking the Uncertainty Signal for Active Learning of Object Detection
summary: Nearly every acquisition function for active object detection shares one arrangement, in that the model being improved is also the model being interrogated. We depart from it. In generative verification an independent generative model re-derives the label of a detection from the pixels inside its predicted box, and the disagreement between the two becomes the acquisition signal. Two properties follow from the arrangement itself rather than from any tuning. A displaced box, a box on background and a correct box carrying the wrong label all yield a crop that fails verification, so the failure modes arrive already combined in one scalar and the hand-weighted classification and localization terms of existing criteria are no longer needed. And because the verifier never observes the detector confidence, confidently wrong detections score highest, although a self-derived signal reads them as uninteresting and they are the costliest to leave unlabeled. We build the verifier as a conditional diffusion model whose diffusion target is a label representation rather than an image. Its reverse process is stochastic, so repeated generations return a distribution whose concentration reports how firmly the evidence determines the label, where a classifier returns a single point estimate. On PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO the signal outperforms output-uncertainty, feature-geometry, perturbation and ensemble criteria, gaining about one mAP50 point per round on MS-COCO, with its largest margins in the early rounds where confident detector errors are most common.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式验证的主动目标检测采集函数：用独立生成模型从预测框内像素重新推导标签，以与检测器预测的不一致作为采集信号。
AI.motivation: 现有主动目标检测的采集函数大多让被改进的检测器自我评估，且需手工加权分类与定位项；希望用独立验证器统一捕捉多种失败模式，并优先标注自信的错误检测。
AI.method: 训练条件扩散模型作为验证器，扩散目标是标签表示而非图像；反向过程随机生成标签分布，以分布集中度衡量证据确定性；将生成标签与检测器预测标签的不一致作为采集信号。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO上，该信号优于输出不确定性、特征几何、扰动和集成等准则；MS-COCO上每轮约提升1 mAP50，早期轮次（自信检测错误最常见时）优势最大。
AI.conclusion: 生成式验证通过独立生成模型与检测器解耦，自然融合分类与定位失败模式，且对自信错误更敏感，是有效的主动目标检测采集策略。

title: JointMatch: A Unified Heterogeneous Graph Neural Solver for Large-Scale Ride-Sharing Matching
summary: Ride-sharing platforms must continuously decide which open requests to bundle into shared trips and which idle vehicles should serve them. The dominant academic approach decomposes this into two sequential matching problems -- request pairing first, then vehicle assignment -- and applies a separate solver to each. This decomposition is convenient computationally but loses revenue and scales poorly because the first stage commits to ride bundles before the available vehicles are known. We propose JointMatch, a learning-based framework that handles request pairing and vehicle assignment together on a single graph. The graph is sparsified by spatial proximity so that its size grows linearly rather than quadratically with the number of vehicles and requests, and a graph neural network scores all candidate decisions in one forward pass. On the New York City Yellow Taxi data, the framework already exceeds both the classical Blossom heuristic and a faithfully-trained two-stage GNN baseline -- often by a wide margin -- and at city scale (fleet 10000) it runs more than $20\times$ faster per dispatch epoch than either. A supervised training stage closes most of the remaining revenue gap, and a policy-gradient fine-tune aligns the trained model with realised revenue.

AI.tldr: 提出 JointMatch，一种基于学习的共享出行匹配框架，将请求配对与车辆分配联合建模在单张图上，兼顾收益与大规模调度效率。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将匹配分解为请求配对和车辆分配两个顺序子问题，计算方便但会在未知可用车辆前锁定拼车组合，导致收益损失且扩展性差。
AI.method: 构建联合图，利用空间邻近性稀疏化，使图规模随车辆和请求数线性增长；用图神经网络一次前向传播为所有候选决策打分；再通过监督训练和策略梯度微调对齐实际收益。
AI.result: 在纽约市黄色出租车数据上，JointMatch 超过经典 Blossom 启发式和两阶段 GNN 基线，且常大幅领先；在城市规模（车队10000）下，每个调度轮次比二者快20倍以上；监督训练缩小大部分收益差距，策略梯度微调进一步对齐实际收益。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习式匹配能在单图中同时处理请求配对与车辆分配，在收益和计算效率上均优于传统分解方法与两阶段基线，适合城市级共享出行调度。

title: Safety-Critical Scenanrio Emerges from Initial Scene
summary: Safety-critical driving scenario generation has largely focused on manipulating the behavior of surrounding agents while starting from an initial scene from driving data. This assumption can limit the space of discoverable failures, since driving data can provide little opportunity for meaningful interaction. For example, in the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 20.44% of recorded slices feature a stationary ego vehicle that never moves, and 30.39% of initial frames contain no nearby traffic participants within 10 meters. We instead study safety-critical scenario generation as an initialization problem: given agnostic black-box driving policies, we learn to generate realistic initial scenes that are more likely to evolve into critical interactions. We propose AdvScene, a conditional latent diffusion model that is trained in two stages. Starting from pretraining on naturalistic driving data, we post-train the adversarial-agent generation branch using reinforcement learning with feedback from closed-loop simulator rollouts. Conditioning on ego driving displacement prevents the ego from remaining static, and RL finetuning induces criticality directly with non-differentiable safety-critical metrics. Experiments on the Waymo dataset across 12 combinations of ego and traffic policies show that our AdvScene substantially increases the rate of ego-fault collision events and TTC<3s events.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AdvScene，将安全关键驾驶场景生成视为初始化问题，使用条件潜在扩散模型生成更可能演化为危险交互的真实初始场景。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多从驾驶数据初始场景出发操纵周围智能体行为，但驾驶数据中缺乏有意义交互，限制可发现的失败模式；例如 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 中 20.44% 片段自车静止，30.39% 初始帧 10 米内无交通参与者。
AI.method: AdvScene 是条件潜在扩散模型，分两阶段训练：先在自然驾驶数据上预训练，再用闭环仿真器 rollout 反馈，通过强化学习后训练对抗智能体生成分支；以自车驾驶位移为条件防止自车静止，并用不可微的安全关键指标直接强化危险性。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 数据集上，跨 12 种自车与交通策略组合的实验表明，AdvScene 显著提高了自车责任碰撞事件和 TTC<3s 事件的发生率。
AI.conclusion: 将安全关键场景生成建模为初始场景生成问题可行且有效，AdvScene 能生成更易导致危险交互的真实初始场景。

title: AnyViewDex: View-Invariant Dexterous Manipulation from RGB Observations
summary: Visuomotor policies for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation are highly sensitive to camera viewpoint shifts. To achieve view invariance, recent methods increasingly rely on explicit 3D modalities like RGB-D or point clouds, which can introduce hardware dependencies, calibration requirements, and vulnerability to sensor noise during real-world deployment. In this work, we show that view-invariant control can be achieved without explicit test-time 3D sensing by encoding geometric knowledge into the visual representation during simulation. We present AnyViewDex, an asymmetric training pipeline that combines multi-view contrastive alignment with privileged 3D geometric supervision. By regressing absolute 3D object coordinates during simulated training, this auxiliary objective provides a geometric grounding signal that mitigates the spatial collapse of the globally pooled contrastive embedding. At deployment, the policy operates zero-shot using only uncalibrated monocular RGB and proprioception. We validate this approach across both reinforcement learning and student-teacher distillation. In hardware evaluation on an xArm7 with a 16-DoF LEAP Hand, AnyViewDex reaches 76.7% grasping success across eight unseen objects and six uncalibrated viewpoints (480 trials; 2,400 across all ablation conditions), indicating that geometrically grounded monocular policies transfer zero-shot without test-time depth. Project Page: https://anyviewdex.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出AnyViewDex，一种非对称训练框架，通过在仿真训练中融入多视角对比对齐与特权3D几何监督，使仅用无标定单目RGB和本体感知的灵巧操作策略具备视角不变性，并实现零样本真机迁移。
AI.motivation: 多指灵巧操作的视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感，现有依赖RGB-D或点云等显式3D模态的方法存在硬件依赖、标定要求和传感器噪声脆弱性，因此希望在不使用测试时3D传感的情况下实现视角不变控制。
AI.method: 采用非对称训练管线：在仿真中结合多视角对比对齐与特权3D几何监督，通过回归绝对3D物体坐标提供几何锚定信号，缓解全局池化对比嵌入的空间坍缩；部署时仅用未标定单目RGB与本体感知，兼容强化学习和学生-教师蒸馏。
AI.result: 在xArm7+16自由度LEAP Hand真机评估中，对8个未见物体、6个未标定视角的480次试验达到76.7%抓取成功率（全部消融条件共2400次试验），表明几何锚定的单目策略无需测试时深度即可零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式测试时3D传感，仅通过仿真中编码几何知识即可实现视角不变的灵巧操作控制，为单目视觉运动策略的零样本真机部署提供了可行方案。

title: dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models
summary: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究是否可将包含 Attention 与 RNN 混合架构的预训练自回归模型适配为扩散语言模型，并在 Qwen3.5 上构建了 dQwen3.5 系列。
AI.motivation: 将预训练自回归模型适配为扩散语言模型是一种低成本路径，但现有方法多基于全注意力 Transformer。随着自回归建模转向 Attention 与 RNN 交错的混合架构，RNN 的结构因果性使其难以双向化，这成为适配扩散语言模型的障碍。
AI.method: 作者在 0.8B、2B、4B、9B 规模上对 Qwen3.5 进行适配，构建 dQwen3.5 家族，并与全注意力对照模型比较训练效率、任意顺序解码行为和并行解码性能。
AI.result: 混合骨干可以作为高效的适配起点：相比全注意力对照，混合模型达到相同训练损失约只需一半 token。不同规模下，dQwen3.5 在任意顺序解码行为上接近全注意力扩散语言模型，并在并行解码下表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 混合 Attention-RNN 架构虽存在因果性障碍，但仍可有效适配为扩散语言模型，并成为扩散语言模型的高效起点。

title: AI-Driven Real-Time Relay Optimisation in Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimise Graph Neural Networks
summary: Reliable and low-latency communication is a fundamental requirement for smart city services and Industry 4.0 applications enabled by NR-V2X networks. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) deployment and complex urban propagation conditions often prevent Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable connectivity. This paper proposes an AI-driven Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time multi-hop relay selection in NR-V2X systems. The vehicular network is modelled as a graph, where nodes represent CAVs and RSUs, and edges encode radio-link characteristics. An offline Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulation provides optimal relay decisions used as supervision for training an edge-aware Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge Features (GINE). Extensive experiments on realistic urban datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves near-optimal connectivity performance, recovering up to 11.3% connectivity gain, while reducing execution time by orders of magnitude (up to 100 x speed-up) compared to MILP. The framework enables scalable and real-time network control, making it suitable for smart city and Industry 4.0 deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的AI驱动学习优化（L2O）框架，用于NR-V2X系统中实时多跳中继选择，以提升智慧城市和工业4.0场景下的可靠低时延通信。
AI.motivation: NR-V2X网络中，路侧单元（RSU）部署有限且城市传播条件复杂，导致网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）难以保持稳定连接，因此需要可扩展的实时中继选择方案。
AI.method: 将车联网建模为图：节点表示CAV和RSU，边编码无线链路特征；使用离线混合整数线性规划（MILP）生成最优中继决策作为监督信号，训练带边特征的边感知图同构网络（GINE）。
AI.result: 在真实城市数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到接近最优的连接性能，连接增益最高提升11.3%，相比MILP执行时间减少数个数量级，最高实现100倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持可扩展、实时的网络控制，适用于智慧城市和工业4.0部署。

title: CleanVideo: Adaptive Concept Erasure for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure aims to selectively eliminate undesired visual semantics from pre-trained generative models without compromising their general utility. Extending concept erasure from images to video is nontrivial. Target concepts emerge gradually and vary across frames and denoising steps. As a result, fixed interventions may miss the target or introduce blurring, jitter, and content distortion. We propose CleanVideo, a selective erasure framework that performs low-dimensional subspace intervention controlled by a tri-modal gating mechanism. By jointly processing spatiotemporal visual features, timestep signals, and textual semantics, CleanVideo determines where, when, and whether to intervene, steering erased content toward natural surrogate concepts when such surrogates can be clearly defined while preserving non-target content. Experiments on three video diffusion models show that CleanVideo effectively erases target concepts while maintaining visual fidelity and temporal coherence, outperforming existing baselines under frame-level and video-level evaluations and under concept-recovery attacks when the protected pipeline remains intact.

AI.tldr: CleanVideo是一个用于视频扩散模型的选择性概念擦除框架，通过三模态门控机制进行低维子空间干预，有效擦除目标概念并保持视觉保真度和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 概念擦除旨在从预训练生成模型中消除不良视觉语义而不影响通用性。将概念擦除从图像扩展到视频并非易事，因为目标概念逐渐出现且在不同帧和去噪步骤中变化，固定干预可能遗漏目标或引入模糊、抖动和内容失真。
AI.method: 提出CleanVideo框架，采用低维子空间干预，并由三模态门控机制控制。该机制联合处理时空视觉特征、时间步信号和文本语义，决定在何处、何时以及是否干预，将擦除内容导向自然替代概念（若可明确定义），同时保留非目标内容。
AI.result: 在三个视频扩散模型上的实验表明，CleanVideo能有效擦除目标概念，同时保持视觉保真度和时间一致性，在帧级和视频级评估以及概念恢复攻击下（当受保护流程保持完整时）均优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: CleanVideo是一种有效的视频概念擦除方法，能够选择性擦除目标概念而不损害模型通用性，并具有鲁棒性。

title: AI or Real: Detecting Partially Altered Videos Under Resource-Constrained Environments
summary: The proliferation of generative video models has shifted the practical detection threat from fully fabricated clips to partially manipulated footages. Although modern detectors achieve strong accuracy using foundation backbones of 400M+ parameters, their resource footprint precludes edge deployment. In this paper, we present a lightweight full-frame detector for partially manipulated AI-generated video, designed for deployment on edge hardware without face-detection preprocessing. The system distills a DINOv2-Base teacher into a frozen MobileNetV3-Small student through a pipeline that combines temperature-annealed soft-label transfer, attention-diversity regularization, frame-level supervision, and a residual feature adapter that conditions ImageNet features for artifact detection. We additionally target two failure modes specific to the partial-manipulation regime: false positives on legitimate scene cuts, addressed through within-video temporal hard negatives; and threshold-level miscalibration on the dominant pure-real class, addressed through calibration-aware sampling. Evaluation on a 55,393-sample spliced test set across fake-frame ratios from 6.2% to 31.2% demonstrates the student model closing 58% of the gap to the DINOv2-Base teacher (AUC 0.766) while running at 3.65 ms per 16-frame clip on RTX A4000 with a 150.4 MB checkpoint compatible with edge-device memory and latency budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级全帧检测器，用于检测部分篡改的AI生成视频，可在边缘设备部署。通过将DINOv2-Base教师模型蒸馏到冻结的MobileNetV3-Small学生模型，结合温度退火软标签、注意力多样性正则化、帧级监督和残差特征适配器，并针对场景切换误报和阈值校准问题设计训练策略。在55,393个样本的拼接测试集上，学生模型以150.4 MB检查点和3.65 ms/16帧的速度，达到AUC 0.766，缩小了与教师模型58%的差距。
AI.motivation: 生成视频模型的普及使检测威胁从完全伪造转向部分篡改，而现有高精度检测器依赖400M+参数的基础骨干网络，资源占用大，难以在边缘设备部署，且通常需要人脸检测预处理。
AI.method: 采用知识蒸馏：将DINOv2-Base教师蒸馏到冻结的MobileNetV3-Small学生，使用温度退火软标签迁移、注意力多样性正则化、帧级监督和残差特征适配器（将ImageNet特征适配于伪影检测）。针对部分篡改场景的两个失败模式：合法场景切换的误报通过视频内时间硬负样本解决；纯真实类主导的阈值校准错误通过校准感知采样解决。
AI.result: 在包含55,393个样本、伪造帧比例6.2%至31.2%的拼接测试集上，学生模型AUC为0.766，缩小了与DINOv2-Base教师模型58%的性能差距；在RTX A4000上处理16帧片段耗时3.65 ms，检查点大小150.4 MB，满足边缘设备内存和延迟预算。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量级全帧检测器无需人脸检测预处理，在边缘硬件上实现了对部分篡改AI生成视频的有效检测，在性能和效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: When AI Agents Commit: Cognitive Serializability Across Data, Evidence, Policy, and Authority
summary: Autonomous agents derive concrete mutations from database reads, retrieved evidence, policy, beliefs, and delegated authority. Those inputs may change while reasoning is in progress. Database isolation orders the submitted transaction; agentic transaction processing determines whether a proposal satisfies an executable contract. Neither guarantee establishes a common valid point for the mutation and its derivation inputs unless the contract represents the relevant predicates. Typed dependency tokens distinguish content integrity from applicability, and trusted mediation captures the values exposed to reasoning. Under strict Cognitive Serializability, committed effects admit a serial order and a logical event at which every value exposed to derivation is unchanged. The fences last until the runtime event that realizes the sealed durability domain. The weaker Effect-Compatible Cognitive Admission recertifies an effect against a simultaneously held current dependency vector and current policy without claiming to serialize the original stochastic derivation. TCT combines immutable versioned executable definitions, registry-derived authority plans, sealed envelopes, guard-first commit transactions, post-seal envelope- and witness-bound grants, co-committed receipts, idempotent grant finalization, and receipt-driven epistemic reconciliation. Complete registered footprints and a single growing phase induce an acyclic lock-point order over local guards and incompatible external reservations. The corresponding results give serializability conditions and an observational-equivalence boundary for zero-error soundness and positive progress.
