A falsification suite tests the implementation obligations: the prototype prevented all injected anomalies and added 3.22 ms mean commit overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文研究自主智能体因数据库读取、检索证据、策略等输入在推理中变化而导致的提交一致性问题，提出TCT事务框架，通过认知可串行化与效果兼容认知准入保证突变与其推导输入在有效点一致，并实现低开销原型。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体从可能变化的数据库读取、检索证据、策略、信念和授权中推导出具体突变；现有数据库隔离只排序已提交事务，智能体事务处理只检查提案是否满足可执行合约，二者都不能保证突变与推导输入存在共同有效点，除非合约表示相关谓词。
AI.method: 提出类型化依赖令牌区分内容完整性与适用性，可信中介捕获暴露给推理的值；定义严格认知可串行化与较弱效果兼容认知准入；TCT组合不可变版本化可执行定义、注册表派生授权计划、密封信封、守卫优先提交事务、密封后基于信封和见证的授权、共同提交收据、幂等授权终结和收据驱动认知对账；以完整注册足迹和单一增长阶段诱导无环锁点顺序。
AI.result: 给出可串行化条件与观察等价边界，实现零错误健全性和正进展；原型在证伪测试中阻止所有注入异常，平均提交开销增加3.22 ms。
AI.conclusion: TCT为智能体自主推导的突变提供一致性保证，在输入可能变化时通过认知可串行化或效果兼容准入确保提交效果可被合理解释，且实现开销可接受。

title: Universal Navigation Interface: Robot-Free Data for Wheeled Robot Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://universal-nav.github.io/
summary: Collecting real-world navigation data for mobile robots typically requires platform-specific teleoperation, making large-scale collection expensive and difficult to scale. We introduce Universal Navigation Interface (UNI), a robot-free data collection paradigm that uses a four-wheeled rollator walker (rollator) and smartphone to collect physically constrained human demonstrations. Because the rollator cannot climb stairs, negotiate uncut curbs, or pass through narrow gaps, demonstrations are naturally biased toward wheeled-feasible routes. Using UNI, we collect 37.2 km of real-world navigation data and recover metric trajectories that directly supervise goal-conditioned navigation models. Fine-tuning visual-navigation models on UNI reduces trajectory prediction error by 17.4-24.8% on held-out UNI demonstrations. Evaluation on other navigation datasets shows benefits that vary by dataset and metric. We further demonstrate closed-loop transfer to a powered wheelchair in curb, staircase, and curb-cut scenarios. These results support low-cost physical proxies as a practical source of navigation supervision collected without the target robot.

AI.tldr: 提出UNI无机器人数据采集范式，用四轮助行器和智能手机采集受物理约束的人类导航演示，构建37.2公里真实数据，并用于微调和迁移导航模型。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人真实导航数据通常依赖平台特定遥操作，导致大规模采集成本高且难以扩展。
AI.method: 使用四轮助行器与智能手机采集演示，因助行器无法爬楼梯、越未切路缘或过窄缝，数据自然偏向轮式可行路线；恢复度量轨迹以监督目标条件导航模型，并微调视觉导航模型，再闭环迁移到电动轮椅。
AI.result: 采集37.2公里真实导航数据；在留出UNI演示上轨迹预测误差降低17.4–24.8%；在其他导航数据集上收益随数据集和指标变化；在电动轮椅的路缘、楼梯和路缘坡道场景中完成闭环迁移。
AI.conclusion: 低成本物理代理可作为无需目标机器人即可采集导航监督数据的实用来源。

title: TinyCNN: A 193K-Parameter Network for On-Device Plant Disease Detection, with a Cross-Dataset Robustness Diagnosis
summary: Detecting crop disease early is central to sustainable agriculture and food security under United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 2 (Zero Hunger), and is especially urgent in resource-constrained regions where expert diagnosis is scarce but low-cost mobile devices are widespread. This paper presents TinyCNN, a lightweight convolutional neural network for on-device plant disease classification. TinyCNN uses depthwise separable convolution blocks and contains only 193,190 trainable parameters with 110.05M MACs for a 224x224 input image. On the 38-class PlantVillage benchmark, TinyCNN achieves 98.88% test accuracy and 98.03% macro-F1 while being approximately 58x smaller than ResNet18 and 11.8x smaller than a MobileNetV2 teacher, directly reducing the energy, memory, and cost footprint of inference in line with Green AI principles. The paper further analyzes vanilla knowledge distillation as a sustainable model-compression strategy; an ablation over alpha in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} and T in {2, 4} selects alpha=0.3, T=4, producing a distilled TinyCNN with 98.81% test accuracy. Finally, cross-dataset evaluation from PlantVillage to PlantDoc reveals a substantial robustness gap under real-world conditions, which a Grad-CAM analysis attributes to off-leaf, background-driven attention consistent with shortcut learning. TinyCNN is thus an energy-efficient, deployable building block for sustainable agricultural intelligence, while field robustness remains the key barrier to durable real-world impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轻量级卷积神经网络 TinyCNN，用于移动端植物病害分类，在 PlantVillage 上达到高精度并显著压缩模型规模，但跨数据集到 PlantDoc 时鲁棒性明显下降。
AI.motivation: 作物病害早期检测对可持续农业和粮食安全很重要，尤其在缺乏专家诊断但移动设备普及的资源受限地区，需要低能耗、低成本、可端侧部署的模型。
AI.method: 采用深度可分离卷积块构建 TinyCNN，仅 193,190 个可训练参数，224×224 输入下为 110.05M MACs；在 38 类 PlantVillage 上评估，并分析 vanilla 知识蒸馏，对 alpha∈{0.3,0.5,0.7} 和 T∈{2,4} 做消融；最后进行 PlantVillage 到 PlantDoc 的跨数据集测试和 Grad-CAM 分析。
AI.result: TinyCNN 在 PlantVillage 上达到 98.88% 测试准确率和 98.03% macro-F1，比 ResNet18 小约 58 倍，比 MobileNetV2 教师小 11.8 倍；蒸馏选择 alpha=0.3、T=4，得到 98.81% 准确率；跨数据集到 PlantDoc 显示显著鲁棒性差距，Grad-CAM 归因于背景驱动的离叶注意力，符合捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: TinyCNN 是面向可持续农业智能的节能、可部署基础模型，但真实田间鲁棒性仍是实现持久实际影响的关键障碍。

title: Queries Knew More Than We Thought: Uncovering Latent Knowledge in Segmentation Models
summary: Modern segmenters often fail after the expensive computation has already been done: a useful mask is present among the model's query-conditioned candidates, but the deployed selection rule does not expose it. We study this output-selection bottleneck in frozen DETR-family models. A ground-truth-only oracle first shows substantial hidden headroom in already-computed mask proposals. This raises a simple question: How can we better use the masks a segmenter has already computed but does not expose? We then ask whether that headroom can be recovered without adding queries, generating new masks, rerunning the backbone, or updating weights. HYDRA is a small selector trained only on cached frozen outputs. At inference time, it scores the cached candidates against an explicit keep-baseline option and acts only when a held-out calibrated margin indicates the selected candidate is sufficiently better. Trained on training-split caches and calibrated on held-out data, HYDRA improves Mask2Former, MaskDINO, and OneFormer by up to +7.41 dataset mIoU points on ADE20k and COCO, and improves SAM 3 by +9.4 class-macro prompt-IoU points on average across eight domains while preserving useful predictions through calibration. Paired LoRA controls show that lightweight weight adaptation does not remove the bottleneck: exposed predictions are often flat or worse, while routing over the adapted candidates still recovers accuracy. Finally, we connect the effect to query specialization under bipartite matching and verify it in a controlled TinyDETR study. These results show that frozen segmenters should be evaluated not only by the masks they expose, but also by the useful candidates they suppress.

AI.tldr: 论文研究冻结DETR类分割模型的输出选择瓶颈：有用的掩码已存在于查询候选中，但部署的选择规则未将其暴露。作者提出HYDRA小选择器，仅基于缓存的冻结输出训练，推理时与保留基线比较，并用校准边际决定是否替换，从而在不增加查询、不生成新掩码、不重跑骨干、不更新权重的情况下恢复隐藏性能。
AI.motivation: 现代分割器常在昂贵计算完成后失败：模型查询条件候选中已存在有用掩码，但部署的选择规则没有暴露它。作者希望探究能否在不增加查询、不生成新掩码、不重跑骨干、不更新权重的前提下，恢复这部分已被计算但未被暴露的隐藏性能。
AI.method: 先用仅用真值评估的oracle显示已有掩码提议中存在大量隐藏余量。提出HYDRA：在冻结模型缓存输出上训练的小型选择器，推理时对缓存候选与显式keep-baseline选项打分，仅当留出数据校准的margin表明所选候选足够更好时才采取行动。在Mask2Former、MaskDINO、OneFormer与SAM 3上评估，并进行配对LoRA对照和TinyDETR受控研究。
AI.result: HYDRA在ADE20k和COCO上最多提升Mask2Former、MaskDINO、OneFormer +7.41 dataset mIoU；SAM 3在八个域平均提升+9.4 class-macro prompt-IoU，并通过校准保留有用预测。配对LoRA对照显示轻量权重适应不能消除瓶颈：暴露预测常持平或更差，而对适应后候选进行路由仍能恢复精度。
AI.conclusion: 冻结分割器不仅应按其暴露的掩码评价，也应按其抑制的有用候选评价；该输出选择瓶颈与二分匹配下的查询专业化有关。

title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
summary: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“危害洗白”现象：大型语言模型安全评估中，表面毒性分数下降并不意味着危害减少，而是歧视性内容被转化、重组或转移。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM安全评估依赖表面形式分类器，显示跨模型代际危害分数下降；作者认为该方法系统性不完整，可能遗漏被转化而非被移除的歧视内容。
AI.method: 分析15个模型（GPT-2至GPT-5）共45万条性别导向补全，涵盖三种人口统计条件；结合主题聚类、情感分析、独立分类器及REGARD/Detoxify等表征危害指标，并形式化“危害洗白”三标准测试和三阶段检测协议。
AI.result: GPT-2中针对女性的性暴力主题聚类到GPT-4消失，而针对男性的补全获得照护、情感范围、盟友身份等正面表征，女性补全没有；GPT-5中Topic 5将乳腺癌框定为男性权利辩论，女性导向输出无对应聚类，且三个独立分类器判其为非毒性。情感分数在GPT-4反转：早期贬低女性，后期过度矫正。GPT-4对齐边界处，女性导向主题多样性相对男性下降36%（W/M=0.58，GPT-2为0.91）。REGARD表征危害差异与发布时间相关（ρ=+0.55，p=.034），Detoxify不相关（ρ=-0.23，p=.42）：毒性分数下降时表征危害上升。
AI.conclusion: 在OpenAI GPT谱系内，毒性分数降低不能作为危害减少的充分代理指标；需采用形式化危害洗白测试与三阶段检测协议评估生成模型的真实危害。

title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

AI.tldr: 提出RetireOPD（自适应退出的自策略蒸馏）：先用环境奖励训练解耦的技能条件教师，再以RL+OPD联合训练无技能学生，并让学生在与教师差距不再缩小且达到教师成功率的设定比例后自行退出蒸馏，仅保留RL训练。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体RL每轨迹仅有一个标量奖励，监督稀疏，因此常用自策略蒸馏从具备特权技能的教师提供token级密集监督。但作者发现两个问题：特权信息本身并不总能让教师可靠；教师监督的收益依赖于训练阶段，固定的蒸馏计划并不理想。
AI.method: RetireOPD首先用环境奖励优化一个解耦的、技能条件化的教师模型；然后让学生（无技能）同时接受RL和OPD训练。核心机制是自适应退出（Adaptive Retirement）：不预设蒸馏时间表，当师生差异不再缩小且学生达到教师成功率的某一目标比例时，学生主动丢弃教师，之后仅用RL继续训练。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5系列1.5B至7B模型上，RetireOPD将ALFWorld成功率相比RL基线提升14.1%至18.8%，WebShop准确率提升11.8%至19.0%，并在所有设置下超过其技能条件教师。
AI.conclusion: 自适应退出的自策略蒸馏能有效让无技能学生内化教师技能，并最终超越教师；相比预设蒸馏计划，按师生差距和成功率自动决定退出时机更为有效。

title: JEPA-WAM: Connecting Generated Visual Instructions to World Action Models through JEPA Latent Representations
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated strong robotic manipulation capabilities by augmenting pretrained video generative models with action experts. However, current WAMs still show limited instruction-following ability when conditioned solely on text instructions. We argue that this limitation stems in part from a structural imbalance in robot-learning data: rich visual-action trajectories are often paired with sparse and repetitive language annotations, allowing policies to identify tasks from visual context and motion regularities rather than grounding the instruction itself. To address this limitation, we introduce JEPA-WAM, which augments each text instruction with a bank of stochastically generated visual instructions, providing diverse visual cues for instruction following. Specifically, JEPA-WAM uses an off-the-shelf text-to-image generator to sample multiple task-completion images conditioned on the text instruction, without training the generator. Although these generated images may differ from the current visual scene in appearance and layout, they remain semantically aligned with the instruction and serve as visual goal references. To focus on task-level semantics beyond appearance, we encode these references with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. The resulting dense goal representations are compressed into compact goal tokens that condition both the video and action experts through cross-attention. We further construct a real-robot instruction-following benchmark covering in-distribution, out-of-distribution scene, and out-of-distribution instruction settings. On this benchmark, JEPA-WAM achieves success rates of 87.3%, 74.5%, and 80.9% in these three settings, outperforming π0 and Fast-WAM by at least 10.0, 27.3, and 14.5 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: JEPA-WAM 通过为每条文本指令生成多样化的视觉目标参考（由现成文生图模型生成、冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 编码为紧凑目标 token），以交叉注意力条件化视频与动作专家，从而提升机器人操作中的指令跟随能力，并在真实机器人基准上显著超越 π0 与 Fast-WAM。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models（WAMs）虽具备较强机器人操作能力，但仅依赖文本指令时指令跟随能力有限。作者认为部分原因在于机器人学习数据的结构性失衡：丰富的视觉-动作轨迹常仅搭配稀疏、重复的语言标注，使策略更依赖视觉上下文和运动规律识别任务，而非真正 grounding 文本指令。
AI.method: 提出 JEPA-WAM：1）用现成文本到图像生成器，在不训练生成器的情况下，根据文本指令随机采样多张任务完成图像，作为视觉指令库；2）尽管生成图像在外观和布局上可能与当前场景不同，但其语义与指令对齐，可作为视觉目标参考；3）使用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器提取任务级语义；4）将稠密目标表示压缩为紧凑目标 token，并通过交叉注意力同时条件化视频专家与动作专家；5）构建真实机器人指令跟随基准，涵盖分布内、OOD 场景和 OOD 指令三种设置。
AI.result: 在构建的真实机器人指令跟随基准上，JEPA-WAM 在分布内、OOD 场景、OOD 指令三种设置下的成功率分别为 87.3%、74.5%、80.9%，相比 π0 和 Fast-WAM 至少分别高出 10.0、27.3、14.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: JEPA-WAM 表明，通过引入随机生成且语义对齐的视觉目标参考，并用冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 提取任务级表示，可有效缓解机器人学习数据中语言标注稀疏带来的指令跟随不足问题，显著提升分布内及分布外场景和指令下的指令跟随性能。

title: GPT-6-Astra in a Navigation Workflow: Behavioral Analysis in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
summary: We study GPT-6-Astra in a zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) system, where it interprets instructions, assesses its surroundings, and proposes actions. The system uses a common observation--decision--execution workflow with direct model API calls, without a packaged agent harness or navigation-specific fine-tuning. In this workflow, each request receives selected observations, execution feedback, and retained progress records. Evaluation covers the complete system, including context management and action control. We evaluate the system on 50 of the 100 R2R-CE val-unseen episodes used by Open-Nav. It achieves a success rate of 52.0\%, an SPL of 48.9\%, and an nDTW of 70.8\%. Our analysis highlights three findings. First, recorded responses link landmarks and earlier actions to instructions using observations and supplied history. Second, reviews include requests for additional views and revisions of uncertain judgments. Third, the results suggest a gap between task understanding and autonomous completion: an unfinished crossing is recognized while rotation continues. At termination, 36.0\% of episodes succeed with a workflow-accepted STOP, while another 16.0\% meet the distance criterion at the step limit. These results highlight a central challenge: translating correct local judgments into sustained progress and appropriate stopping.

AI.tldr: 研究GPT-6-Astra在零样本连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）中的表现，采用直接API调用的观察-决策-执行流程，在50个R2R-CE验证集未见过episode上评估，成功率为52.0%。
AI.motivation: 探究无需导航专用微调或封装智能体框架的大模型在连续环境视觉语言导航中的零样本能力，并分析其任务理解与自主完成之间的差距。
AI.method: 使用GPT-6-Astra，在零样本VLN-CE中采用观察-决策-执行工作流，直接调用模型API，每次请求接收选定观察、执行反馈和保留的进度记录；在50个R2R-CE val-unseen episodes上评估，涵盖上下文管理和动作控制。
AI.result: 成功率52.0%，SPL 48.9%，nDTW 70.8%。主要发现：记录响应能利用观察和提供的历史将地标及先前动作与指令关联；审查包括请求额外视图和修正不确定判断；任务理解与自主完成存在差距，例如未完成穿越时仍继续旋转。终止时36.0%的episode通过工作流接受的STOP成功，另有16.0%在步数限制时满足距离标准。
AI.conclusion: 核心挑战在于将正确的局部判断转化为持续进展和适当停止。

title: Not All Layers Are Equal: Dynamic Layer Routing for Reliable CLIP OOD Detection
summary:
Information aggregation across model layers are revealed to improve OOD detection. In contrast to crafting a method for layer-wise information aggregation in recent work, we investigate if layer selection is a learnable problem. In other words, we transpose the question from how to fuse layers to one asking which layers to trust for an input. Using a generalizable, weak, out of distribution context crafting approach for supervision, shown to be more effective than state of the art methods' mechanisms, we formulate learning a lightweight router to select a sparse, final-layer-anchored expert over CLIP's layer depth for OOD detection.
  Across three diverse benchmarks we demonstrate our learnable routing method dubbed Voyager improves OOD detection. On ImageNet-1K, Voyager achieves an average FPR@95 of 18.86, outperforming the strongest, comparable, prompt-learning method by 8.8 points. These gains persist across multiple supervision sources, including those used by existing state-of-the-art prompt-learning methods, demonstrating that, whilst our weak OOD supervision context is highly effective, the key advantage is realized from the learnable router component rather than the supervision source. Significantly, Voyager is highly practical; router learning takes approximately two minutes using less than 1 GB of memory, making it approximately 20x more efficient than current prompt-learning approaches.
  Anonymized Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Voyager/

AI.tldr: 本文研究CLIP中用于OOD检测的层选择问题，提出可学习路由方法Voyager，通过轻量路由器为每个输入选择稀疏的、以最后一层为锚的专家层组合，从而提升OOD检测性能。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明跨模型层进行信息聚合能改进OOD检测，但多数方法关注如何融合层。本文转而研究层选择本身是否可作为可学习问题，即为输入决定应信任哪些层。
AI.method: 提出一种可泛化的弱OOD上下文构造监督信号，并据此学习一个轻量路由器，在CLIP的层深度上选择稀疏且以最终层为锚的专家组合，用于OOD检测。
AI.result: 在三个不同基准上，Voyager均提升OOD检测。ImageNet-1K上平均FPR@95为18.86，比最强同类提示学习方法优8.8个点。增益在多种监督来源下保持，表明关键优势来自可学习路由器而非监督来源。路由器学习约2分钟、内存小于1GB，比当前提示学习方法高效约20倍。
AI.conclusion: 层选择可以作为可学习路由问题，且可学习路由器是性能提升的关键。Voyager兼具有效性与实用性，说明弱OOD监督上下文很有效，但真正优势来自路由机制。

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
summary: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

AI.tldr: 论文提出 JEPA-Anything，一个基于正交预测分解（OPF）的域无关世界建模框架，并在七个领域验证其预测、干预和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有预测模型通常局限于特定领域，作者希望探索是否存在一种通用学习原则，能够支撑跨 radically different systems 的世界建模。
AI.method: 扩展联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），提出正交预测分解（OPF）：将潜在目标分解为互补因子，通过专用路径学习，并在共享预测设计中重组。评估覆盖视觉、生物、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场和天气七个领域，任务包括表征学习、干预预测、分布外泛化和长时程动态。
AI.result: 相比匹配的 JEPA 基线，JEPA-Anything 在全部 10 个 dynamics 任务上提升指标；在 Interventional Pong 上将单干预预测误差降低 34.8%；在四个分子系统中取得最低的一步和 100 步分子误差；生物干预提名在细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤片段和小鼠中获得实验支持；潜在轨道模式恢复 Keplerian 标度指数，拟合斜率为 -1.4991。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种跨异质世界的共同因子化预测原则，将世界建模与干预以及有实验支撑的科学发现联系起来。

title: AgentPProf: Semantic Profiler for Long Horizon AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running activities with users, tools, and system resources for days and weeks. To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to determine where failures happen, what triggers unsafe effects, and which tasks consume the most budget, then optimize those tasks. In systems software, profiling answers similar questions by aggregating resource consumption and attributing it to responsible code paths to identify hotspots. Yet existing agent observability tools focus on per-execution debugging and tracing rather than cross-run, long term profiling, making these questions difficult to answer at scale. Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging, but profiling agents is challenging: the responsible entities are task intent like diagnose authentication, compare branches rather than code paths, and lack stable identifiers for aggregation. We propose a semantic operation stack model that adapts profiling to agent trajectories. Uniform operations represent all activities, and operation stacks replace the runtime call stack, enabling hierarchical attribution at different granularities. We observe that an agent's task occupies a contiguous span and decomposes into subtasks, so we introduce recursive operation segmentation, which recursively splits trajectories at task boundaries. AgentPProf is a profiler that aggregates agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles, enabling flame graph visualization and analysis. AgentPProf reaches 0.764 $B^3$ F1 against human annotations on CodeTraceBench. On three problem-localization benchmarks, the profile raises MAP by up to 56%, demonstrating that it effectively attributes resources, locates problems, and helps optimize token cost at practical profiling cost. AgentPProf is available at https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AgentPProf，将智能体轨迹聚合为 pprof 兼容 профиль，用于跨运行、长期 profiling。它通过语义操作栈和递归操作分割实现任务级层级归因，支持火焰图可视化和分析，帮助定位问题与优化成本。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体越来越多地长期编排用户、工具和系统资源，开发者需要定位失败、不安全效应和高预算任务。现有智能体可观测工具侧重单次执行调试与 tracing，而非跨运行长期 profiling，难以规模化回答归因问题。同时，智能体 profiling 的难点在于责任实体是“诊断认证”“比较分支”等任务意图，而非代码路径，且缺乏稳定标识用于聚合。
AI.method: 提出语义操作栈模型，将智能体轨迹适配为 profiling：用统一操作表示所有活动，用操作栈替代运行时调用栈，实现不同粒度的层级归因。观察到任务占据连续区间并分解为子任务，因此提出递归操作分割，按任务边界递归切分轨迹。实现 AgentPProf，将智能体轨迹聚合成 pprof 兼容 профиль，支持火焰图可视化与分析。
AI.result: AgentPProf 在 CodeTraceBench 上对人工标注达到 0.764 B^3 F1。在三个问题定位基准上，profile 将 MAP 最高提升 56%，表明其能有效归因资源、定位问题，并在实际 profiling 开销下帮助优化 token 成本。
AI.conclusion: 智能体可观测性不仅需要调试，还需要 profiling。AgentPProf 证明语义操作栈与递归操作分割可用于聚合轨迹、可视化和分析，从而辅助优化智能体质量、安全与成本。AgentPProf 已开源。

title: AgriScope: Pixel-Grounded Multimodal Understanding for Agricultural Images
summary: Agricultural image understanding requires fine-grained recognition of plant diseases, pests, crop structures, and botanical species under complex real-world conditions. Despite recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing models remain limited to text-only outputs and lack pixel-level visual grounding capabilities. In this work, we introduce AgriScope, a unified pixel-grounded multimodal framework for agricultural image understanding. AgriScope jointly supports image-level, region-level, and pixel-level understanding within a unified framework, enabling tasks such as grounded caption generation, referring expression segmentation, and multi-turn multimodal interaction for agricultural imagery. AgriScope integrates biologically specialized semantic representations with dense spatial grounding through biological-semantic encoding, dense spatial representations, and pixel decoding. To support large-scale grounded learning, we introduce AgriGround, a large-scale pixel-grounded agricultural multimodal instruction-tuning dataset containing over 500K images and 11M instruction-following samples spanning plant disease analysis, crop and weed identification, insect pest recognition, and fine-grained botanical understanding. AgriGround is constructed through a multi-stage automatic annotation pipeline that integrates multimodal caption generation, phrase-level grounding, segmentation mask generation, and task-oriented instruction synthesis to produce densely grounded supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple agricultural vision-language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of AgriScope in pixel-grounded multimodal understanding, establishing a strong benchmark for agricultural vision-language learning and visual grounding. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at (https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriScope)

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgriScope，一个统一的像素级多模态农业图像理解框架，支持图像级、区域级和像素级理解，并构建了大规模数据集AgriGround（含50万+图像、1100万指令样本），在多个农业视觉-语言任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 农业图像理解需要在复杂真实条件下对植物病害、害虫、作物结构和植物物种进行细粒度识别。现有MLLMs仅能输出文本，缺乏像素级视觉定位能力，无法满足农业场景的精细需求。
AI.method: 提出AgriScope框架，集成生物语义编码、密集空间表示和像素解码，统一支持图像级、区域级和像素级理解。同时构建AgriGround数据集，通过多阶段自动标注流水线（多模态描述生成、短语级定位、分割掩码生成、任务导向指令合成）生成密集定位监督。
AI.result: 在多个农业视觉-语言任务（如定位描述生成、指代分割、多轮多模态交互）上的大量实验表明，AgriScope在像素级多模态理解方面有效，并建立了农业视觉-语言学习和视觉定位的强基准。
AI.conclusion: AgriScope为农业视觉-语言学习与视觉定位提供了统一框架和基准，数据集和代码将公开于https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriScope。

title: LLM-Guided Transformation of Non-Critical Driving Scenes into Safety-Critical Scenarios Using Augmented Reality
summary: Testing Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) requires realistic safety-critical scenarios, but collecting such data from real-world driving is costly and unsafe. This paper presents an automated pipeline that transforms safe driving scenes into safety-critical scenarios by combining computer vision, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Augmented Reality (AR). The system detects and tracks road users, extracts safety features including distance, velocity, motion direction, and Time-to-Collision (TTC), and assesses scene criticality. Safe scenes are modified by an LLM, which generates realistic collision-inducing objects and behaviors that are integrated into the original scene using AR. The proposed pipeline was evaluated on the nuScenes dataset, achieving 97.52% safety classification accuracy and successfully generating realistic scenarios such as pedestrian crossings, rear overtaking vehicles, and sudden-stop events. The results demonstrate an effective and flexible approach for automated generation of safety-critical scenarios to support the testing and validation of autonomous driving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合计算机视觉、大语言模型和增强现实的自动化流水线，将安全驾驶场景转化为安全关键场景，用于自动驾驶系统测试。
AI.motivation: 测试自动驾驶系统需要真实的安全关键场景，但从真实道路中采集此类数据成本高且不安全。
AI.method: 通过计算机视觉检测和跟踪道路使用者，提取距离、速度、运动方向和碰撞时间（TTC）等安全特征并评估场景关键性；再利用大语言模型生成真实的碰撞诱导对象和行为，并通过增强现实集成到原始场景中。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上评估，安全分类准确率达到97.52%，并成功生成行人横穿、后车超车、急停等真实场景。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线能够有效且灵活地自动生成安全关键场景，支持自动驾驶系统的测试与验证。

title: Strategic Transformer for Resource-Constrained Multi-Object Navigation in Ultra-Large-Scale Environments
summary: Resource-constrained multi-object navigation in vast indoor environments ($>2,000\text{ m}^2$) poses significant challenges for efficiency and strategic planning. To tackle this, we reformulate the task as a Set Orienteering Problem (SOP), providing an optimization framework under resource constraints where exploitation is governed by the SOP model and exploration is managed by a separate heuristic switcher. Conventional baselines suffer from either rigid planning or myopic behaviors. To overcome these limitations and resolve the NP-hard computational challenges of SOP for real-time navigation, we develop the Strategic Transformer. This lightweight architecture functions as a priority planner that internalizes expert combinatorial logic into a predictable $41.03\text{ ms}$ forward pass while reducing teacher-student information asymmetry. Incorporating geometric attention biases allows the network to effectively model long-range structural dependencies. By coupling the Transformer's macro-plan with a bounded iterative 2-opt local refinement on a capped candidate graph, our framework achieves a $94\times$ speedup compared to heavy meta-heuristics, ensuring bounded-latency inference suitable for onboard deployment. Experiments on ProcTHOR validate that our method successfully bridges the gap between exploration and exploitation, outperforming carefully re-implemented baselines under Progress weighted by Path Length (PPL) and establishing a new benchmark for scalable, resource-constrained navigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大规模室内环境中资源受限的多目标导航问题，将其建模为集合定向问题（SOP），提出 Strategic Transformer 与局部搜索结合的规划框架，实现实时高效导航。
AI.motivation: 在超过2000平方米的室内环境中进行资源受限多目标导航，对效率和策略规划提出重大挑战；传统基线要么规划僵化，要么行为短视，且SOP的NP-hard特性难以满足实时导航需求。
AI.method: 将任务重构为SOP，用独立启发式切换器管理探索、SOP模型管理利用；提出轻量Strategic Transformer作为优先级规划器，将专家组合逻辑内化为可预测前向推理，并降低师生信息不对称；引入几何注意力偏置建模长程结构依赖；结合有界迭代2-opt在受限候选图上进行局部优化。
AI.result: 前向推理耗时41.03毫秒，相比重型元启发式实现94倍加速；在ProcTHOR实验中，以路径长度加权的进度（PPL）指标超过精心重实现的基线，并建立可扩展、资源受限导航的新基准。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功桥接探索与利用，保证有界延迟推理，适合机载部署，为大规模资源受限多目标导航提供了有效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
summary: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

AI.tldr: 研究整合六种群体敌意理论，利用2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X的286万帖子建模，揭示敌意修辞的结构锚点与时间顺序。
AI.motivation: 敌意言论会正常化排斥、加剧极化和政治暴力；但相关社会科学理论长期平行发展，解释常不一致且少在真实话语中相互检验，导致对敌意修辞机制的理解碎片化。
AI.method: 使用2024年美国总统选举期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X的286万帖子，在统一实证框架中建模六种群体敌意理论机制：边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊、负面评价、非人化和行动导向。
AI.result: 结构上，边界建构和威胁建构是系统锚点；时间上呈现规律顺序：边界建构、贬损和行动导向较早，非人化和威胁建构较晚，替罪羊最晚。
AI.conclusion: 将理论框架映射到真实话语，有助于桥接社会科学传统间的分歧，并为计算社会科学超越单一标签检测、建模群体敌意修辞提供更清晰的实证基础。

title: Diagnose, Recover, Certify: Task Readiness under Hidden Dynamics Changes
summary: A deployed control policy can conceal consequential dynamics changes: an actuator may lose effectiveness without affecting the current task when the policy rarely excites it, despite being critical for a future task that has not yet been specified. We introduce task readiness under dormant dynamics drift, a decision problem that unifies active change diagnosis and post-change control recovery under a limited, task-agnostic interaction budget. An agent must identify whether and where local dynamics have changed, use a small number of informative interactions to characterize the change before downstream task identity is revealed, and subsequently provide each candidate task with either a recovered policy and a calibrated lower bound on its achievable return or an abstention decision to a safe fallback. We propose Evidence-Gated Matched-Pulse Transport, an intervention-based Bayesian procedure that couples fault localization with estimation of actuator effectiveness through a shared matched-response representation, thereby preserving diagnostic reliability while converting localized evidence into recovery-relevant uncertainty. This uncertainty is propagated to task-conditioned policy selection and readiness certification, enabling deployment decisions that explicitly trade off expected performance, confidence, and fallback use. We evaluate the resulting framework on a diverse suite of dormant-actuator benchmarks spanning multiple simulators, under a protocol that separates diagnosis from capability recovery, scores deployment by readiness coverage, selective risk, and interaction cost as well as return, and identifies the fault regimes in which transported evidence is decisive.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“休眠动力学漂移下的任务就绪”决策问题，统一主动变化诊断与变化后控制恢复：在有限且任务无关的交互预算下，智能体需定位局部动力学变化，用少量信息交互表征变化，并在下游任务身份揭示后为候选任务提供恢复策略及可达回报下界，或弃权至安全回退。
AI.motivation: 已部署控制策略可能掩盖关键动力学变化，例如执行器失效未影响当前任务，因为策略很少激励该执行器，但它对未来任务可能至关重要。因此需要在任务未知、交互预算有限条件下统一解决变化诊断与恢复问题。
AI.method: 提出 Evidence-Gated Matched-Pulse Transport，一种基于干预的贝叶斯过程，通过共享匹配响应表示耦合故障定位与执行器有效性估计，在保持诊断可靠性的同时将局部证据转化为恢复相关不确定性，并传播到任务条件策略选择与就绪认证。
AI.result: 在多种模拟器上的休眠执行器基准中评估该框架，采用分离诊断与能力恢复的协议，按就绪覆盖率、选择性风险、交互成本和回报评分，并识别出传输证据具有决定性的故障机制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在预期性能、置信度与回退使用之间进行显式权衡，支持部署决策，并有效连接变化诊断与变化后控制恢复。

title: FreqDINO++: A Frequency-Guided Multi-Task Routing Vision Foundation Model for Universal Ultrasound Analysis
summary: Ultrasound image analysis plays a crucial role in cancer screening and prenatal diagnosis, yet comprehensive assessment requires jointly addressing tasks such as lesion segmentation and benign-malignant classification. While recent vision foundation models have shown remarkable universal representations, unlocking their potential for ultrasound is bottlenecked by the considerable domain gap from natural images. Existing methods typically fine-tune heavy vision encoders for isolated tasks, incurring substantial computational overhead while overlooking the underlying commonalities across heterogeneous tasks. In this work, we propose FreqDINO++, a frequency-guided multi-task routing vision foundation model for universal ultrasound analysis. We first introduce a Multi-task Routing Adapter (MR-Adapter) to support parameter-efficient integration of task-common and task-specific knowledge, a Frequency-aware Feature Enhancer (F$^2$-Enhancer) is then designed to capture the rich multi-scale frequency characteristics of ultrasound images, and a Task-aligned Collaborative Decoder (TC-Decoder) is devised to promote collaboration between dense and global prediction tasks through global-local token interaction. Extensive experiments on large-scale multi-task and external single-task ultrasound benchmarks demonstrate that FreqDINO++ consistently outperforms strong baselines and recent foundation models across 27 diverse clinical task scenarios, while also showing promising generalization to unseen data. The code is at https://github.com/MingLang-FD/FreqDINO-Plus.

AI.tldr: 提出FreqDINO++，一种频率引导的多任务路由视觉基础模型，用于通用超声分析，在27类临床任务中优于强基线及近期基础模型。
AI.motivation: 超声图像分析需联合处理病灶分割与良恶性分类等任务，但视觉基础模型存在与自然图像的域差距；现有方法通常针对单任务微调重型编码器，计算开销大且忽略异构任务间的共性。
AI.method: 设计多任务路由适配器（MR-Adapter）以参数高效整合任务通用与任务特定知识；提出频率感知特征增强器（F²-Enhancer）捕获超声图像多尺度频率特征；构建任务对齐协同解码器（TC-Decoder），通过全局-局部token交互促进稠密与全局预测任务协作。
AI.result: 在大规模多任务及外部单任务超声基准上，FreqDINO++在27种临床任务场景中持续优于强基线和近期基础模型，并对未见数据展现良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FreqDINO++能有效实现通用超声分析，兼顾多任务协作、参数效率与泛化性，代码已开源。

title: Implementation of Tightly-Coupled SLAM Fusion of GPS, IMU, and LiDAR for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Autonomous vehicles depend entirely on Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) to navigate safely in unknown environments. However, relying on a single sensory modality introduces critical failure points: LiDAR systems degrade in featureless corridors, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) accumulate mathematical drift, and GPS drops frequently in urban canyons. This paper presents the implementation of a tightly-coupled SLAM fusion architecture that integrates a Velodyne 3D LiDAR, a high-frequency IMU, and GPS to achieve continuous spatial awareness. Utilizing a phased development methodology, we establish a 2D baseline to validate hardware synchronization and transform geometries before upgrading to a full 3D architecture driven by FAST-LIO2. This advanced approach uses an Iterated Error-State Kalman Filter (IESKF) to process dense 3D laser points alongside continuous inertial data, eliminating motion blur at high speeds. To eradicate long-term drift, a GTSAM pose-graph optimization back-end executes multi-modal loop closures. Evaluated across simulated environments and physical deployments, the results demonstrate that tightly-coupled 3D fusion effectively overcomes individual sensor blind spots to generate highly detailed point clouds, providing the foundational High-Definition (HD) maps required for advanced downstream autonomous planners.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一种紧耦合的激光雷达、IMU与GPS融合SLAM架构，用于自动驾驶在未知环境中的连续定位与建图。
AI.motivation: 单一传感器存在关键失效点：LiDAR在无特征走廊退化，IMU产生漂移，GPS在城市峡谷中频繁丢失，因此需要多模态融合来保证鲁棒空间感知。
AI.method: 采用分阶段开发：先建立2D基线验证硬件同步与坐标变换，再升级到基于FAST-LIO2的3D架构；使用IESKF处理密集3D激光点与连续惯性数据，并利用GTSAM位姿图优化后端执行多模态回环检测。
AI.result: 在仿真环境和实际部署中评估，紧耦合3D融合能克服各传感器盲区，生成高细节点云，并提供下游自动驾驶规划器所需的高精地图基础。
AI.conclusion: 紧耦合3D LiDAR-IMU-GPS融合可实现连续空间感知，有效消除长期漂移，为高级自动驾驶规划提供高精地图支撑。

title: Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation: From Natural-Language Traffic Rules to PROLOG
comment: In Proceedings of the International Workshop on Translating Natural Legal Language into Formal Representations (NLL2FR 2025)
summary: Traffic regulations are written for human interpretation and therefore rely on shared background knowledge and flexible phrasing, which inherently introduce ambiguity, context dependence, and semantic underspecification. These linguistic characteristics conflict with the precision required by computational reasoning engines such as Prolog, which demand explicit logical structure. This study evaluates two baseline translation approaches, Natural Language to Prolog ($NL\rightarrow Prolog$) and Logical English to Prolog ($LE\rightarrow Prolog$), and introduces a new reasoning-guided translation framework called Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation ($S4L\rightarrow Prolog$). The proposed S4L framework performs semantic role extraction, scene completion, logical mapping, and Prolog rule generation within a single guided prompt, enabling direct translation of raw traffic rules into executable logic without human intervention. A benchmark consisting of twenty real-world traffic rules was used to evaluate each approach in terms of syntactic validity, semantic correctness, and logical completeness. $S4L\rightarrow Prolog$ achieves the highest accuracy, correctly formalizing 75 percent of the rules, while $NL\rightarrow Prolog$ reaches 60 percent and $LE\rightarrow Prolog$ reaches 55 percent. Qualitative analysis further shows that S4L captures implicit causal relations, deontic modality, and exception structure more reliably than the baselines. These results demonstrate that structured reasoning prompts can substantially improve the reliability of natural-language-to-logic translation for legal and safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对交通法规自然语言到Prolog逻辑翻译中的歧义与语义不完整问题，提出结构化四阶段法律翻译框架S4L，并在20条真实交通规则上评估其效果。
AI.motivation: 交通法规为人类理解而写，依赖背景知识和灵活措辞，存在歧义、上下文依赖和语义不充分问题，与Prolog等计算推理引擎所需的精确逻辑结构相冲突。
AI.method: 评估两种基线方法：自然语言到Prolog（NL→Prolog）和逻辑英语到Prolog（LE→Prolog）；提出推理引导的S4L→Prolog框架，在单一引导提示中执行语义角色抽取、场景补全、逻辑映射和Prolog规则生成。使用20条真实交通规则作为基准，从语法有效性、语义正确性和逻辑完整性三方面评估。
AI.result: S4L→Prolog准确率最高，正确形式化75%的规则；NL→Prolog为60%，LE→Prolog为55%。定性分析表明，S4L比基线更可靠地捕捉隐含因果关系、道义模态和例外结构。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理提示能显著提高自然语言到逻辑翻译在法律和安全关键应用中的可靠性。

title: NeuSOGA3D: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable 3D Geometric Reconstruction
comment: Preprint. Community feedback and comments are welcome
summary:
Three-dimensional reconstruction from unorganized point clouds remains a challenging problem in computer vision, geometric modeling, and computer-aided design. While neural implicit methods achieve impressive reconstruction accuracy, geometry is typically encoded in latent representations that limit interpretability and reuse within engineering workflows.
  We present NeuSOGA3D (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction in 3D), a hybrid framework that combines learned perceptual priors inherited from NeuSOGA with explicit symbolic geometric reasoning. The method projects point clouds onto principal orthographic planes, constructs symbolic implicit spline representations from the resulting observations, and fuses them through shape-preserving constructive solid geometry operations to generate a coarse visual hull. Additional geometric detail is recovered through cross-sectional decomposition and volumetric reconstruction using Partial Shape-Preserving Splines.
  Unlike conventional neural implicit approaches, NeuSOGA3D progressively transforms observations into explicit symbolic entities, including control polygons, implicit spline fields, cross-sections, and volumetric lofts. Experiments on all forty categories of the ModelNet40 benchmark demonstrate the ability of the framework to recover structurally meaningful and CAD-compatible geometric representations from diverse point-cloud observations. The results highlight the potential of combining learned perception with symbolic geometric reasoning for explainable geometric intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuSOGA3D，一种神经符号混合框架，从无组织点云中重建可解释且CAD兼容的几何表示。
AI.motivation: 三维点云重建仍具挑战；神经隐式方法精度高但潜在表示难以解释和复用，限制了工程工作流中的应用。
AI.method: 结合NeuSOGA学习感知先验与显式符号几何推理：将点云投影到主正交平面，构建符号隐式样条表示，通过保形CSG操作融合成粗视觉外壳；利用截面分解和部分保形样条进行体积重建恢复细节；输出控制多边形、隐式样条场、截面和体积放样等显式符号实体。
AI.result: 在ModelNet40全部40个类别上的实验表明，该框架能从多样点云中恢复结构有意义且CAD兼容的几何表示。
AI.conclusion: 结合学习感知与符号几何推理在可解释几何智能方面具有潜力。

title: Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways
summary: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.

AI.tldr: 研究嵌入空间是否能反映质量、距离、时间和体积等物理测量，发现嵌入对物理测量的建模很弱，且受表层字符串相似性强烈影响，重校准相似度也难以显著改善对齐。
AI.motivation: 嵌入空间定义了语义相似性与距离，但尚不清楚它们是否能反映具有唯一客观语义等价和距离的物理测量概念。
AI.method: 分析嵌入空间对质量、距离、时间和体积等物理测量的表示，考察其与客观语义等价和距离的一致性，并尝试重校准相似度。
AI.result: 物理测量在嵌入空间中仅被弱建模，呈现出较特殊的测量模式；嵌入表示强烈受表层字符串相似性影响，重校准相似度并未显著改善对齐。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入表示不足以可靠反映物理测量的客观语义结构，表层字符串相似性是重要干扰因素，仅靠相似度重校准难以解决该问题。

title: Fast Cross-Strength Multi-Contrast Brain MRI Translation using Latent Bridge Matching
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) acquired at different field strengths exhibits pronounced variation in noise, resolution, homogeneity, and contrast, which limits comparability across acquisition settings and complicates downstream analysis. We address this with a unified conditional model for controllable field-to-field synthesis, built on the framework of conditional latent bridge matching. Our single model achieves highly competitive results across the validation phase for all three tasks of the MRIxFields2026 challenge without task-specific architectures or training. We achieve fast generation with only a single inference step, producing all modality and field-strength combinations for $30$ axial slices in under $90$ seconds, as well as cross-modality-strength translation for a full volume in under $70$ seconds, on a single NVIDIA A5000 GPU. We further provide extensive ablations regarding different components of our solution. Code: https://gitlab.com/siddharthsrivastava/mrixfields-2026

AI.tldr: 提出基于条件潜在桥匹配的统一条件模型，用于可控的MRI场强间合成，在MRIxFields2026挑战赛三个任务中取得有竞争力的结果，并实现快速单步推理。
AI.motivation: 不同场强下获取的MRI在噪声、分辨率、均匀性和对比度上差异显著，限制了采集设置间的可比性，并使下游分析复杂化。
AI.method: 基于条件潜在桥匹配框架，构建统一的条件模型，无需任务特定架构或训练，支持可控的场强到场强合成，并采用单步推理生成。
AI.result: 在MRIxFields2026挑战赛验证阶段，单一模型在全部三个任务上均取得极具竞争力的结果；单张NVIDIA A5000 GPU上，30个轴向切片的全部模态和场强组合生成耗时不到90秒，全卷跨模态-场强转换耗时不到70秒；并进行了广泛的消融实验。
AI.conclusion: 该统一条件模型无需任务特定设计即可有效处理多任务MRI场强合成，生成速度快，为跨场强MRI比较与分析提供了可行方案。

title: RoboFind: Multi-Agent Personalized Object Search for People Who Are Blind or Have Low Vision
summary: Blind and low-vision users often need to locate a specific personal object rather than an arbitrary instance of the same category. The task calls for a robot that can move through the space and reach viewpoints the user cannot, and for an accessible interface where the user says which object is meant and learns whether the right one was found. We present RoboFind, a multi-agent framework in which a smartphone teaches the target and a quadruped robot carries out the search. A Target Teaching Agent converts guided smartphone recordings into a semantic target profile and a reusable multi-view reference bank through an accessible capture flow with AR guidance, speech and haptic feedback, and screen-reader support, so later missions refer to a stored object without repeating the teaching process. At runtime, a Navigation Agent explores the environment and proposes candidate targets, a Verification Agent checks each candidate against the stored references, and a Coordination and Recovery Agent completes the mission or triggers recovery and continued search. Across 32 real-robot missions, RoboFind reaches 85.0% success against 25.0% for a reconstructed sequential first-stop baseline over 20 trials with ten targets, and reduces false success from 75.0% to 5.0%. On six shared targets it succeeds in 10/12 trials, against 5/12 for 12 independently executed GPT-6 Astra-only trials. These results show that the multi-agent design fits the demands of personalized object search, where verifying object identity before declaring completion is what makes the outcome something a user can rely on.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboFind 多智能体框架，帮助盲人和低视力用户寻找特定个人物品：手机端教目标，四足机器人执行搜索。真实机器人任务中成功率达 85.0%，并显著降低误报成功。
AI.motivation: 盲人和低视力用户常需要定位某个特定个人物品，而不是同类物品的任意实例。这要求机器人能到达用户无法到达的视角，并提供可访问界面让用户说明目标并确认是否找对。
AI.method: RoboFind 包含多智能体：Target Teaching Agent 通过 AR 引导、语音/触觉反馈和屏幕阅读器支持，将手机录制转为语义目标档案和多视角参考库；运行时 Navigation Agent 探索环境并提出候选目标，Verification Agent 对照参考验证身份，Coordination and Recovery Agent 完成任务或触发恢复并继续搜索。评估包含 32 次真实机器人任务、20 次十目标基线对比，以及 6 个共享目标与 GPT-6 Astra-only 对比。
AI.result: 32 次真实机器人任务中 RoboFind 成功率为 85.0%，重建的顺序首次停止基线为 25.0%；误报成功从 75.0% 降至 5.0%。在 6 个共享目标上，RoboFind 为 10/12 成功，12 次独立 GPT-6 Astra-only 试验为 5/12。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体设计适合个性化物品搜索需求；在声明完成前验证对象身份，是使结果可靠、用户可依赖的关键。

title: A Qualitative Model for Reasoning about Path and Support
comment: Workshop on Qualitative Reasoning 2026 at IJCAI (35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence)
summary: Spatial reasoning abilities correlate strongly with performance in STEM fields. Games offer a compelling medium for training these critical skills in developing children who have a natural proclivity for play. However, to facilitate human-like tutoring and player guidance, these games require an AI agent capable of making commonsense inferences from spatial events. Qualitative reasoning (QR) models appear to be a suitable framework for these application domains. As these models reason in symbolic representations, they can seamlessly translate game states into interpretable feedback for human-like player guidance. This paper introduces a hybrid qualitative model designed for Camelot Jr., a block-puzzle game that requires constructing multi-level bridges to connect two avatars stationed on separate towers. The game poses a challenge for the player, who must make platforms stable, plan their path, and ensure they use all the provided blocks. To handle the precise physics required by the domain, we integrate a mathematical center-of-mass stability logic to guide our qualitative solver. Our work facilitates spatial skill training in Camelot Jr. and contributes to the development of human-centric, explainable game-playing agents.

AI.tldr: 本文为 Camelot Jr. 积木解谜游戏提出一种融合定性推理与质心稳定性计算的混合模型，以支持可解释的玩家指导和空间技能训练。
AI.motivation: 空间推理能力与 STEM 领域表现密切相关，游戏适合训练儿童空间技能；但游戏中的类人辅导需要 AI 能从空间事件中进行常识推理并给出可解释反馈，而定性推理模型适合将游戏状态转化为符号化、可解释的指导信息。
AI.method: 针对 Camelot Jr. 中搭建多层桥梁、连接两座塔上角色的任务，提出混合定性模型；为处理平台稳定、路径规划和用完所有积木等精确物理要求，引入基于质心的数学稳定性逻辑来引导定性求解器。
AI.result: 构建了面向 Camelot Jr. 的定性求解框架，可将游戏状态转化为可解释反馈，并借助质心稳定性计算处理关卡中的物理稳定性约束。摘要未报告量化实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有助于在 Camelot Jr. 中训练空间技能，并推动以人为中心、可解释的游戏 AI 代理发展。

title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

AI.tldr: 提出Navi-Agent，一种零样本VLN-CE智能体，不依赖深度和全局坐标，而是利用视觉观测与运动历史构建无坐标空间状态，并组织为导航拓扑，以支持自定位、进度验证和恢复，实现闭环导航。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本VLN-CE系统通常依赖几何定位或基于坐标的空间表示；近期几何约束导航虽去除了深度和全局一致坐标，但难以维持持久空间意识，从而影响地点确认、进度验证和失败恢复。
AI.method: 构建无坐标空间状态：将视觉地点作为节点、运动转移作为边，形成导航拓扑；基于观测进行近似自定位、任务进度验证和视觉重访恢复；将指令分解为子目标，执行局部视觉导航，并通过空间状态验证已访问地点，实现闭环导航。
AI.result: 在零样本VLN-CE基准和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent在几何约束方法中达到最先进性能，并与依赖几何定位的方法相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 无需深度和全局坐标，通过视觉地点与运动拓扑构建无坐标空间状态，即可支持持久空间意识和零样本连续环境导航。

title: Generating Heterogeneous 3D Geological Microstructures from 2D Images via a Stable Diffusion-Adversarial Model
summary:
Characterizing the physical properties of clay and cementitious materials matters across many fields, from materials science to geological waste disposal. Property simulation typically calls for 3D imaging, which is expensive, not always accessible, and technically limited for certain materials. Recent progress in deep generative models offers a way around this, reconstructing 3D volumes from the more easily acquired 2D images.
  Among GAN-based methods for 3D microstructure generation, SliceGAN has shown strong results for homogeneous isotropic and anisotropic systems. It struggles, however, to capture the finer detail of more complex heterogeneous microstructures, which motivates alternative generative frameworks.
  We introduce a hybrid approach that draws on the stability and generation quality of denoising diffusion models. Since no 3D ground truth is available, we replace the standard denoising loss with an adversarial loss, which yields a stable training process in our experiments. We show that the resulting model generates microstructures of varying complexity with minimal slice artefacts and close agreement with ground-truth phase fractions and structural descriptors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合去噪扩散模型与对抗损失的混合方法，从2D图像重建3D微观结构，以改善复杂非均质材料的三维生成质量。
AI.motivation: 3D成像昂贵、不易获取且对某些材料有技术限制，因此需要从更易获得的2D图像重建3D体积。现有SliceGAN对复杂异质微观结构的细节捕捉不足，促使寻找替代生成框架。
AI.method: 采用基于去噪扩散模型的混合生成方法。由于没有3D真值，用对抗损失替换标准去噪损失，从而在实验中实现稳定训练。
AI.result: 模型能够生成不同复杂度的微观结构，切片伪影较少，并且相分数和结构描述符与真值接近。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型结合对抗训练可稳定生成高质量3D微观结构，适用于复杂异质材料的三维重建。

title: MM-Future: Multi-Mode Joint World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving involves coupled decision-making and scene evolution under multi-mode uncertainty. To capture this coupling and uncertainty, we introduce MM-Future, a world-action model that generates multiple paired scene-action hypotheses and models bidirectional interaction within each pair. Each hypothesis is initialized from a structured action prior and an independent future scene source, which are then co-evolved through a modality-aware diffusion Transformer. To support efficient multi-mode rollout, MM-Future compresses multi-view video into planning-oriented representations, dubbed MM-Tokens. Finally, a future-conditioned proposal scorer ranks trajectory candidates by shared history context and their paired predicted future. On NAVSIM navtest, MM-Future achieves 94.0 PDMS and 91.5 EPDMS, while attaining a 32.3 HD-Score in zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show consistent improvements over both single-mode and action-only variants, validating the benefit of multi-mode joint world-action modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出MM-Future世界-动作模型，通过多模态配对的场景-动作假设及双向交互，建模自动驾驶中决策与场景演化的耦合不确定性。在NAVSIM和HUGSIM上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶涉及多模态不确定性下决策与场景演化的耦合，需要同时建模两者及其交互。
AI.method: MM-Future生成多个成对的场景-动作假设，每个假设由结构化动作先验和独立未来场景源初始化，通过模态感知扩散Transformer共同演化；压缩多视角视频为规划导向的MM-Tokens；使用未来条件提议评分器对轨迹候选排序。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM navtest上达到94.0 PDMS和91.5 EPDMS，在HUGSIM零样本闭环评估中HD-Score为32.3；消融实验表明优于单模态和仅动作变体。
AI.conclusion: 多模态联合世界-动作建模能有效提升自动驾驶性能，验证了其收益。

title: PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations
summary: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率艾伦代数（PAA），将艾伦区间代数的13种定性时序关系扩展为基于边界概率分布的完整概率化模型，并给出蒙特卡洛验证与开源Python实现。
AI.motivation: 传统艾伦区间代数使用精确边界上的清晰谓词，难以处理语言、感知、数据库或不确定历史中时间、时长和边界不确定以及“刚好之前”“大致在……期间”等渐进表达。
AI.method: 以高斯时间点、具有高斯中点和截断高斯时长的区间为基础，在统一概率空间中将关系定义为边界排序谓词；点-点关系化为误差函数，点-区间和区间-区间关系化为由线性不等式诱导的多元高斯概率积分；引入容差带使接触关系具有正测度，并推导关系分类、层级分解及CIDOC CRM式时序原语。
AI.result: 构建了生成式且完整的概率艾伦代数：13种关系在单一容差下构成真正划分，容差趋零时恢复清晰艾伦代数；粗粒度谓词如先于、重叠、包含是叶节点概率之和；区间退化为点时13种关系依次归约为5种和3种；代数具有尺度不变性，并能区分“ shortly before”等渐进表达与接触关系；结果经蒙特卡洛验证并作为开源Python包发布。
AI.conclusion: 概率艾伦代数从区间边界分布中推导出艾伦关系体系，而非直接设定关系得分，为不确定时序推理提供了原则性概率框架，并兼具理论完备性与可实现的软件工具。

title: EliGSiR: Continual RGB-D Mapping with Gaussian Splatting under Bounded Compute
summary: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting assumes a closed set of observations and long optimization schedules. Continual RGB-D mapping in contrast poses the problem that new observations arrive online, while previously reconstructed regions must be preserved. We present EliGSiR (Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay), a continual Gaussian mapper that controls how the available optimization budget is used as the reconstruction evolves. Map-Guided View Scheduling filters redundant incoming views and reconsiders retained views according to the current state of the map. Load-Adaptive Fidelity adjusts supervision resolution to the current mapping load instead of following a fixed resolution schedule. Targeted Geometry Growth separates depth supervision from Gaussian creation and adds geometric capacity only where repeated RGB-D observations indicate missing or misplaced structure. Together, these mechanisms adapt which views are optimized, how much image detail is used, and where the representation grows while mapping remains active. We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.

AI.tldr: 提出EliGSiR，一种用于连续RGB-D建图的增量高斯泼溅方法，通过自适应视图调度、监督保真度和几何增长来优化建图预算，在多个数据集上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 传统3D高斯泼溅假设封闭观测集和长优化过程；连续RGB-D建图中新观测在线到达，需保留已重建区域，因此必须控制优化预算。
AI.method: EliGSiR包含三个机制：地图引导视图调度（过滤冗余视图，根据地图状态重考虑保留视图）；负载自适应保真度（根据当前建图负载调整监督分辨率）；目标几何增长（分离深度监督与高斯创建，仅在重复观测表明缺失或错位结构处增加几何容量）。这些机制自适应调整优化哪些视图、使用多少图像细节、表示在何处增长。
AI.result: 在Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++和真实RGB-D序列上评估。在TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household上，使用相同GT位姿，EliGSiR达到21.52 dB，SplaTAM为19.42 dB；使用ORB-SLAM3实时位姿，EliGSiR达到23.02 dB，耗时155.5秒，CaRtGS为20.10 dB，耗时230.9秒。还评估了采集过程中的重建，表明自适应机制改善了建图预算使用。
AI.conclusion: EliGSiR通过自适应机制有效利用建图预算，在连续RGB-D建图中实现更高质量和效率的重建。

title: Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task
comment: 37 pages, 4 figures. Preregistration: https://osf.io/5jp7s . Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21318346
summary: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较人类Wason小组与匹配LLM代理小组的全共识率，发现共识率高度依赖评分与参与定义；在减少测量不对称后，LLM组仍更易达成共识，且模拟共识不反映集体准确性。
AI.motivation: 全共识率常被用作集体认知指标，但其估计受参与率和最终状态如何操作化的影响；需要检验LLM模拟小组能否可靠复现人类审议结果。
AI.method: 回放100个保留的人类Wason小组，并用匹配的LLM代理组进行模拟；按每位参与者讨论前答案设置一个信念锚定代理，对人和代理使用同一评分代码；比较不同人类评分定义，并进行submit-based与participation-matched两种盲后敏感性分析，以及去除早停和可记忆答案的重参数化检验。
AI.result: 不同人类评分定义下全共识率为24.0%至57.0%；约五分之一人类参与者从未发帖，而代理几乎都会发帖。代理组更共识：submit-based比较（n=98）在chat和reasoning模式下差距为34.0和43.9个百分点；participation-matched比较（n=45）差距为34.1和44.4个百分点，两种方法差异在0.5个百分点内收敛。无早停和去除可记忆答案后差距仍存在；reasoning模式组几乎一致，但多集中在错误答案。模拟共识未追踪集体准确性，信念锚定代理组对人类组结果分布是有偏估计。
AI.conclusion: 评估模拟群体对人类审议结果的估计必须明确评分规则；在该设定下，LLM代理组会高估共识且与集体准确性脱节，不能直接作为人类群体结果的无偏替代。

title: Imagine-TAMP: Imagination-Guided Task and Motion Planning in Partial Observability
summary: Robots operating in cluttered environments must often manipulate objects whose locations are only partially observable. A central challenge is deciding whether to acquire another observation or to first manipulate objects that may occlude the target. Conventional task and motion planning (TAMP) approaches typically make this decision using symbolic action costs or expensive geometric planning, neither of which adequately captures how likely an observation is to reveal an occluded target. We introduce Imagine-TAMP, an interleaved planning and execution framework that uses semantic and geometric imagination to compare alternative task-level strategies under partial observability before committing to expensive motion planning. A vision-language model shapes a particle belief over target locations using commonsense relationships between the target and visible objects, while a generative scene model estimates plausible geometry in unobserved regions. Given a target hypothesis and imagined scene, Imagine-TAMP generates multiple symbolic plan skeletons and assigns non-unit costs that approximate both manipulation effort and target visibility from sensing actions, distinguishing a short but poorly informative observation strategy from a longer strategy that first manipulates an occluder to better expose the target. The selected skeleton is then refined into a feasible continuous plan and executed, with new observations updating the belief and triggering replanning when necessary. Experiments show that imagination-guided evaluation improves observation-versus-manipulation decisions: in viewpoint-constrained shelf scenes, non-unit geometric evaluation increases success from 46.0% to 84.0%, while semantic belief shaping further reduces manipulation and replanning. On a real robot, the complete system reduces planning time by 32% relative to a geometry-only ablation.

AI.tldr: 提出Imagine-TAMP，一种在部分可观测环境下结合语义与几何想象的交错规划与执行框架，用于决定先观察还是先操作遮挡物。
AI.motivation: 传统TAMP使用符号动作代价或昂贵几何规划，难以评估观察动作揭示被遮挡目标的概率，导致观察与操作之间的决策不佳。
AI.method: 利用视觉语言模型根据目标与可见物体的常识关系塑造目标位置的粒子信念；用生成式场景模型估计未观测区域的合理几何。基于目标假设和想象场景生成多个符号计划骨架，并赋予非单位代价以近似操作努力和感知动作的目标可见性。选出骨架后细化为可行连续计划并执行，新观察更新信念并触发重规划。
AI.result: 在视角受限的货架场景中，非单位几何评估将成功率从46.0%提高到84.0%；语义信念塑造进一步减少操作和重规划。在真实机器人上，完整系统相比仅几何消融将规划时间减少32%。
AI.conclusion: 想象引导的评估能改进观察与操作决策，语义与几何想象结合可提升部分可观测下TAMP的成功率和效率。

title: Compact Vision Models for Iris Presentation Attack Detection under Presentation Attack Instrument Shift and Environmental Degradation
comment: Accepted at BIOSIG 2026. This preprint includes minor nomenclature and editorial corrections clarifying the project-specific Patch-ABMIL and Compact-TransMIL variants
summary: Iris presentation attack detection (PAD) is security-critical when a subsystem that appears reliable during development encounters presentation attack instruments (PAIs) or acquisition conditions absent from validation data. We benchmark three compact scratch-trained computer-vision models, each with at most approximately 0.26 million trainable parameters, on the Notre Dame subset of LivDet-Iris 2017 under PAI-driven domain shift and environmental degradation. All models are trained without external pretraining or data augmentation and evaluated over five seeds. A validation-selected threshold is transferred unchanged to the known-attack, unknown-attack, corrupted, and pooled test partitions. From known to unknown attack presentations, Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate (APCER) increases by 17.11-30.47 percentage points and Detection Equal Error Rate (D-EER) increases by 7.38-12.73 percentage points. At the validation-selected threshold, ZACH-ViT obtains the lowest unknown-attack APCER (47.69 +/- 4.84%) and D-EER (38.87 +/- 0.93%), while Compact-TransMIL obtains the lowest Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate (BPCER). ZACH-ViT also gives the lowest unknown-attack BPCER at an APCER limit of 10% (81.29 +/- 1.95%). The high absolute errors show that the comparative advantage of the best compact model does not constitute deployment readiness under unknown PAIs.

AI.tldr: 该文在LivDet-Iris 2017的Notre Dame子集上，对三个参数量不超过约26万的轻量级从零训练模型进行虹膜活体检测基准测试，评估其在攻击类型未知和图像退化下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 虹膜呈现攻击检测在安全关键场景中，开发阶段表现可靠的子系统一旦遇到验证数据中未出现的攻击工具或采集条件，性能可能大幅下降，因此需要评估轻量模型在未知攻击和退化条件下的真实鲁棒性。
AI.method: 选取三个紧凑的从零训练视觉模型（参数≤0.26M），不使用外部预训练和数据增强，在LivDet-Iris 2017的Notre Dame子集上以五个随机种子训练；将验证集选定的阈值原样迁移到已知攻击、未知攻击、退化图像及混合测试分区进行评测。
AI.result: 从已知攻击到未知攻击，APCER上升17.11–30.47个百分点，D-EER上升7.38–12.73个百分点。在验证阈值下，ZACH-ViT取得最低的未知攻击APCER（47.69±4.84%）和D-EER（38.87±0.93%），Compact-TransMIL取得最低BPCER；在APCER限制为10%时，ZACH-ViT的未知攻击BPCER最低（81.29±1.95%）。
AI.conclusion: 尽管最佳轻量模型在对比中占优，但其绝对错误率仍然很高，说明这种相对优势并不代表在未知呈现攻击下已具备部署就绪能力。

title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
summary: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个执行循环固定、仅变化规划、动作空间与上下文管理三个组件的轻量级编码框架，在4个模型、SWE-Bench Verified与Terminal-Bench 2.1上开展176组匹配实验，系统评估各组件对自主编码智能体长时程性能的独立影响。
AI.motivation: 编码框架决定了模型能力如何转化为长时程软件工程表现，但已有研究通常将框架作为整体评估，导致单个组件的有效性不清晰，缺乏组件级对比。
AI.method: 构建执行循环固定、仅变化规划、动作空间和上下文管理的轻量级编码框架；在4个模型、两个基准上评估176组匹配设置，涵盖5种上下文管理策略、4种上下文窗口预算，并对规划与动作空间进行定向消融。
AI.result: （1）上下文窗口预算越紧，上下文管理价值越大，收益主要来自避免上下文溢出失败；（2）先规则裁剪再LLM摘要的整体效率最优，使被裁剪内容可恢复反而增加几乎不被使用的机制且无准确率提升；（3）规划从弱模型的准确率支架转变为强模型的成本节省手段，准确率变化不大；（4）预定义工具对bash能力弱的模型有帮助，而bash能力强的模型仅用bash接口即可有效工作且成本显著更低，在命令行任务上尤为明显。轨迹级分析表明：上下文管理延长轨迹而不改变行为，规划改变轨迹停止位置，动作空间改变代码编写粒度。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持面向模型与预算的编码框架设计，并提供一个模块化框架用于评估未来更多框架组件。

title: Resilient Motion Planning for Free-Flying Space Robots under Actuator Failures
summary: Free-flying robots rely on multiple thrusters to maneuver in space. If one or more of these thrusters fail, the robot may lose control authority and risk mission failure. At the same time, their free-flying nature implies that, even in the absence of actuation, they continue along (locally) straight-line trajectories. In this work we present a probabilistic, proactive, motion planning framework that explicitly accounts for actuator failures in space. We model actuator failure modes as a Markov chain and propagate the probability of successfully reaching the goal along the planning horizon. Precomputed reachable sets evaluate the robot's capabilities of reaching waypoints under potential failures and an RRT$^*$-based planner concatenates these waypoints. The resulting algorithm maximizes the overall target-reaching probability, providing maximally resilient motion plans utilizing free-flying properties. We validate our approach experimentally on a physical free-flyer platform with injected actuator failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种概率式、主动式运动规划框架，用于在自由飞行机器人执行器发生故障时仍尽量保证任务成功。
AI.motivation: 自由飞行机器人依赖多个推进器进行机动，若一个或多个推进器失效，可能丧失控制能力并导致任务失败；同时其自由飞行特性使无驱动时仍会沿局部直线轨迹运动，因此需要显式考虑执行器故障的规划方法。
AI.method: 将执行器故障模式建模为马尔可夫链，并沿规划时域传播成功到达目标的概率；使用预计算可达集评估潜在故障下到达路点的能力，再用基于RRT*的规划器拼接路点，从而最大化整体目标到达概率。
AI.result: 在物理自由飞行器平台上通过注入执行器故障进行了实验验证，表明该方法能够生成利用自由飞行特性的高韧性运动规划。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可显式处理空间执行器故障，最大化目标到达概率，并提升自由飞行机器人在故障情况下的任务鲁棒性。

title: SkillAA: Attribution-Guided Skill-Graph Updating with Targeted Validation and Rollback
summary: External skills provide domain procedures without parameter updates, but existing methods often edit skills directly from failed rollouts without structured routing from an observed failure to an editable location; existing skill graphs also underuse semantic boundaries, object addresses, and topological dependencies for skill retrieval, targeted updating, and scoped validation. We introduce SkillAA (Skill Abductive Attribution), a structured skill-optimization framework for frozen language models. It represents skill applicability, execution, and composition in a unified graph, allowing the same structure to support skill selection, attribution-guided repair, and update validation. SkillAA contrasts successful and failed executions to route candidate repairs to specific graph objects, updates only the selected local structure, and uses Local and Big Gates to screen candidate changes before commitment. With gpt-5.6-sol, SkillAA reaches 81.5%, 66.7%, and 91.2% on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA, respectively, and attains the highest observed mean in every main setting. These results support the utility of attribution-guided graph editing and graph-scoped validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SkillAA，一种面向冻结语言模型的结构化技能优化框架，用统一图结构表示技能的适用性、执行与组合，通过对比成功与失败轨迹进行溯因归因，定位并局部修复技能，再用双重门控筛选更新，从而在不更新模型参数的情况下提升下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有外部技能方法虽无需参数更新即可提供领域流程，但往往直接依据失败轨迹编辑技能，缺乏从失败到可编辑位置的结构化路由；同时已有技能图未充分利用语义边界、对象地址和拓扑依赖，难以支持技能检索、定向更新与范围化验证。
AI.method: SkillAA 将技能适用性、执行和组合统一建模为图，使同一结构同时服务于技能选择、归因引导修复和更新验证。它对比成功与失败执行，将候选修复路由到具体图对象，仅更新选定的局部结构，并通过 Local Gate 与 Big Gate 在提交前筛选候选变更。
AI.result: 在 gpt-5.6-sol 上，SkillAA 在 SearchQA、LiveMath 和 DocVQA 分别达到 81.5%、66.7% 和 91.2%，在所有主要设置中取得最高观测均值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，归因引导的图编辑与图范围化验证具有实际效用，为冻结语言模型下的技能优化提供了有效路径。

title: TouchSight: Bare-Handed Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Video via Generative Visual Augmentation
summary: Tactile signals provide direct contact and force measurements that are essential for understanding physical interactions and enabling dexterous robotic manipulation. However, tactile sensing requires direct measurement at contact interfaces, making large-scale data collection reliant on intrusive, costly, and restrictive instrumentation. We present TouchSight, a monocular egocentric vision framework for dense full-hand contact force prediction that leverages 500 hours of pressure-glove recordings and extensive hand-object interaction (HOI) data. To address the appearance gap between gloved training data and bare-hand real-world scenarios, we construct TwinTouch-20H: 20 hours of paired visual data in which generative video models re-render gloved recordings as bare-hand observations against new backgrounds while preserving the original measured tactile labels. TouchSight predicts dense force from both gloved and generated bare-hand videos, outperforms prior contact prediction methods on OakInk2, qualitatively generalizes to natural bare-hand egocentric videos from unseen datasets, and improves consistently as glove supervision scales. These results demonstrate that dense tactile signals can be recovered from egocentric vision alone, without tactile instrumentation at capture time.

AI.tldr: TouchSight 是一个仅使用单目第一视角视觉的框架，可从手套训练数据中预测密集全手接触力，并借助生成式视频将手套数据转换为裸手视觉数据，从而在无需接触式触觉仪器的情况下恢复触觉信号。
AI.motivation: 触觉信号对理解物理交互和实现灵巧机器人操作至关重要，但触觉测量需要在接触界面直接采集，导致大规模数据收集依赖侵入式、昂贵且受限的仪器。
AI.method: 提出 TouchSight，利用 500 小时压力手套记录和大量手-物交互数据，以单目第一视角视觉预测密集全手接触力；并构建 TwinTouch-20H，将 20 小时手套视频通过生成式视频模型重渲染为裸手视觉数据，同时保留原始触觉标签以缩小外观差距。
AI.result: TouchSight 能同时从手套视频和生成的裸手视频中预测密集力，在 OakInk2 上优于先前接触预测方法，并能定性泛化到未见数据集中的自然裸手第一视角视频；随着手套监督数据规模增加，性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，密集触觉信号可以仅从第一视角视觉中恢复，而无需在采集时使用触觉仪器。

title: The Organization of Inference: Information, Resource Constraints, and AI Production
summary: The economic value of inference depends on how capacity and task information are distributed across stages of AI production. We study these organizational margins using controlled workflow experiments on externally verified software-engineering tasks. In two matched resource panels, direct execution records the same success rate of 59.6 percent at logical-token ceilings of 12,000 and 24,000, while success under information-constrained planning rises from 36.2 to 51.2 percent. The planning disadvantage narrows by 15.0 percentage points (95 percent task-cluster bootstrap interval: 4.2 to 25.8). A strict read-only planning campaign varies whether the planner sees the task issue. At 12,000 tokens, issue access raises success by about 16 percentage points over issue-hidden planning. Compared with direct execution, task-informed planning is about 10 points lower at 12,000 tokens; at 24,000 tokens, it shows a 29.6-point advantage. In the resource panels, direct execution uses substantially less than either ceiling, while the planning workflow's binding rate falls from 46.2 to 0.8 percent and downstream execution accounts for 89.9 percent of the increase in total use. Scale determines the capacity available to a system; workflow and information structure shape the productive value

AI.tldr: 论文通过受控工作流实验研究AI推理中容量与任务信息的分布如何影响经济价值，发现工作流与信息结构会显著改变成功率与资源使用效率。
AI.motivation: 推理的经济价值取决于容量和任务信息如何在AI生产的各阶段分配，作者试图厘清规模、工作流与信息结构对生产价值的作用。
AI.method: 在外部验证的软件工程任务上进行受控工作流实验，设置两个匹配资源面板（逻辑token上限12,000与24,000），比较直接执行和信息受限规划；并开展严格只读规划实验，操纵规划者是否可见任务issue。
AI.result: 直接执行成功率在两个token上限下均为59.6%；信息受限规划成功率从36.2%升至51.2%，规划劣势缩小15.0个百分点（95%任务簇bootstrap区间4.2–25.8）。12,000 tokens时，可见issue比隐藏issue提高约16个百分点；任务知情规划比直接执行低约10点，但24,000 tokens时反超29.6点。直接执行资源使用远低于上限；规划工作流的绑定率从46.2%降至0.8%，下游执行贡献总使用量增量的89.9%。
AI.conclusion: 规模决定系统可用容量，而工作流与信息结构决定推理的生产性价值；合理分配任务信息与容量能改变AI工作流的成功率和资源利用。

title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
summary: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.

AI.tldr: 论文研究编码智能体在机器人操作中的安全性问题，发现其虽能完成任务但常忽视避障约束；提出SafeHarness，通过障碍感知的路径规划和接触执行两个模块，显著提升任务成功率和避障率。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能在无机器人专门训练下操作机器人，但其安全性尚未被系统评估。现有智能体在任务中往往只关注完成目标，而忽略不能触碰障碍物的安全约束。
AI.method: 将操作分解为路径阶段和接触密集阶段。提出SafeHarness，包含两个障碍感知模块：障碍感知路径规划将物体表示为边界框，生成候选路径点序列，先规划、验证、必要时重规划再执行；障碍感知接触执行则选择接触位置，使接触过程本身避开障碍物。
AI.result: SafeHarness达到71.9%任务成功率和87.5%避障率，分别超过此前最优方法6.5%和27.0%，也是未使用该框架的同一智能体的2.3倍和1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体操作失败的主因在于规划阶段未将安全约束作为优先目标，而非感知或指令问题。通过引入障碍感知的路径规划和接触执行框架，可有效提升机器人操作的安全性与任务完成能力。

title: Time-Efficient Iterative Learning Planning for Safety-Critical Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
summary: Autonomous mobile robots require timeefficient planning and safety-critical dynamic obstacle avoidance under constrained onboard computation. While Iterative Learning Planning (ILP) offers lightweight and efficient traversal planning, it lacks explicit mechanisms for dynamic obstacle perception and avoidance.
