This article extends ILP to safety-critical navigation in dynamic environments by integrating an anticipatory risk-blended control barrier function (ARB-CBF). The extended ILP learns traversal-speed and steering-bias profiles via a fractionalpower update based on local obstacle risk, generating nominal control commands that ARB-CBF modifies at runtime for real-time safety guarantees. Algorithmic analysis demonstrates that the ILP replanning stage scales at O(kN) for k iterations and N waypoints, while ARB-CBF executes with linear complexity. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the framework, demonstrating superior temporal efficiency and safety with lower computational overhead compared to optimizationbased baselines, making it highly suitable for resourceconstrained platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将迭代学习规划（ILP）与预期风险混合控制屏障函数（ARB-CBF）相结合的方法，用于资源受限自主移动机器人在动态环境中的安全关键导航与动态避障。
AI.motivation: 自主移动机器人需要在有限车载计算资源下实现高效规划与安全关键的动态避障。ILP虽轻量高效，但缺乏动态障碍物感知与规避机制。
AI.method: 扩展ILP，集成ARB-CBF；ILP通过基于局部障碍风险的分数幂更新学习行进速度与转向偏置，生成名义控制指令，ARB-CBF在运行时修正指令以提供实时安全保证；并从算法上分析复杂度。
AI.result: ILP重规划阶段复杂度为O(kN)（k次迭代、N个路点），ARB-CBF为线性复杂度；仿真和真实实验表明，相比基于优化的基线，该方法在时间效率和安全性上更优，且计算开销更低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适合计算资源受限平台，可实现高效且安全的动态环境导航。

title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing converts document images into structured content and requires reliable performance across diverse layouts and acquisition conditions. Yet training corpora are biased toward common document types and clean digital pages, while expanding coverage alone does not specify how to address a parser's remaining weaknesses. We present WeVisDoc, a two-stage data-centric framework for robust end-to-end document parsing. Stage I broadens semantic, structural, and appearance coverage through heterogeneous data and structure-preserving degradation synthesis. Stage II uses a held-out probe to measure the Stage I parser's residual errors within fixed visual-structural clusters. These diagnostics guide targeted data construction and reallocation of the target-token budget. WeVisDoc-4B achieves an Overall score of 95.38 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and a mean Overall score of 75.54 across the three PureDocBench tracks, ranking first among the compared end-to-end parsers in all four settings. Compared with Stage I, Stage II improves Overall scores for the 2B and 4B models on both benchmarks, with larger gains on the degraded PureDocBench tracks, including a 4.03-point gain for the 4B model on the Real Degraded track.

AI.tldr: 提出WeVisDoc两阶段数据中心框架，实现鲁棒的端到端文档解析，并在多个基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 文档解析需适应多样版式和采集条件，但训练语料偏向常见文档类型和干净数字页面，且单纯扩大数据覆盖无法指明如何修复解析器的剩余弱点。
AI.method: 两阶段数据中心框架。阶段一通过异构数据和结构保持的退化合成，拓宽语义、结构、外观覆盖；阶段二利用留出探针在固定视觉-结构聚类中测量阶段一解析器的残余误差，指导针对性数据构建与目标token预算重分配。
AI.result: WeVisDoc-4B在OmniDocBench v1.6上Overall达95.38，在三个PureDocBench赛道平均Overall为75.54，四个设置中均排名第一。阶段二相比阶段一提升了2B和4B模型在两个基准上的Overall分数，退化PureDocBench赛道增益更大，其中4B在Real Degraded赛道提升4.03分。
AI.conclusion: 诊断驱动的两阶段数据中心方法能有效提升端到端文档解析的鲁棒性，其针对性数据构建与预算重分配优于单纯扩大数据覆盖。

title: Spatial-Semantic Uncertainty in VLM-Based Target Search: Balancing Exploration and Identification
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026) WorkshopRethinking Uncertainty for Modern Robotics Paradigms
summary: Robots searching for a target from a natural-language description must determine not only where to search, but also which observed candidate is the desired target. These decisions reflect two distinct sources of uncertainty - spatial uncertainty over candidate locations and semantic uncertainty over target identity - that are often conflated in VLM-based search systems. We introduce a spatial-semantic uncertainty formulation that maintains separate beliefs over each component and integrates probabilistic VLM evidence into a global target-identity posterior, including probability mass for undiscovered targets. This decomposition allows an information-theoretic planner to independently value candidate discovery and target disambiguation through spatial and semantic expected information gain (EIG), providing an explicit mechanism for trading broader exploration against earlier identification. We evaluate six VLM uncertainty-elicitation interfaces on 500 synthetic targets and show that similar recognition accuracy can conceal substantial differences in calibration and false confidence. In degraded-observation search-and-identify experiments, EIG-based planners reach confident decisions in 75.0%-92.5% of trials, compared with 20.0% for Random search, while different spatial-semantic weightings achieve comparable identification accuracy once confidence is attained. Increasing semantic emphasis reduces unnecessary exploration and VLM queries, demonstrating that explicitly planning over semantic uncertainty can accelerate target resolution without sacrificing decision quality. These results highlight the distinct roles of uncertainty representation and uncertainty-driven planning in embodied VLM systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种空间-语义不确定性分解方法，用于机器人根据自然语言描述搜索并识别目标，并利用信息论规划器分别评估候选发现与目标消歧的价值。
AI.motivation: 基于VLM的搜索系统常将候选位置的空间不确定性与目标身份的语义不确定性混为一谈，导致搜索与识别决策不清。
AI.method: 将空间与语义不确定性分别建模，维护对候选位置和目标身份的后验信念，并将VLM概率证据整合为全局目标身份后验（含未发现目标概率）；使用空间和语义期望信息增益（EIG）的信息论规划器，在探索与识别之间权衡；评估六种VLM不确定性引出接口，并在500个合成目标及退化观测搜索-识别实验中进行测试。
AI.result: 相似识别准确率可能掩盖校准与虚假置信度的显著差异；EIG规划器在75.0%-92.5%的试验中达到置信决策，而随机搜索仅20.0%；不同空间-语义权重在达到置信后识别准确率相当，但增加语义权重可减少不必要的探索和VLM查询。
AI.conclusion: 显式表示并规划语义不确定性可加速目标确认且不牺牲决策质量，说明不确定性表示与不确定性驱动规划在具身VLM系统中具有不同且重要的作用。

title: How Do Agent Harnesses Create Value? Planning Information and Release Control in Stateful LLM Agents
summary: Agent harnesses supply planning guidance, organize execution, and check completion. We study how these components affect success, erroneous acceptance, and cost in two Retail experiments and an Airline pilot in $τ^2$-bench. The primary comparison pairs prewritten task-specific plans (Fixed) with shuffled policy text matched in word count (Sham), isolating the contribution of guidance content. Across 265 matched cells, Fixed improves oracle-verified success by 7.17 percentage points (90\% task-clustered bootstrap interval, 1.15--13.36 points), with gains concentrated in higher-complexity tasks. A read-only terminal verifier rejects 61\% of Retail oracle-invalid episodes while withholding 17\% of correct ones, at less than one cent of additional cost per episode. Which component matters more depends on the loss assigned to erroneous acceptance: at low liability the planning gain dominates; at high liability the verifier's avoided false passes dominate---and a standalone verifier captures nearly all the false-pass benefit of the full planning-plus-verification stack at a fraction of its cost.

AI.tldr: 该研究在τ²-bench的零售与航空任务中，分析智能体执行框架的规划、执行组织与完成检查组件对成功率、错误接受率和成本的影响。
AI.motivation: 理解执行框架各组件如何影响任务成功、错误接受与成本，并揭示在不同责任/损失设定下，规划指导与验证器哪个更重要。
AI.method: 在τ²-bench中进行两个零售实验和一个航空试点；核心对比为固定任务专属计划与词数匹配的打乱策略文本；使用265个匹配单元、oracle验证成功率、任务聚类bootstrap区间，并评估只读终端验证器。
AI.result: 固定计划使oracle验证成功率提升7.17个百分点（90%任务聚类bootstrap区间1.15–13.36），收益集中在高复杂度任务；只读终端验证器拒绝61%的零售oracle无效回合，同时误拦17%正确回合，每回合额外成本低于1美分。
AI.conclusion: 规划指导能提升成功率，验证器能减少错误接受；哪个组件更重要取决于错误接受的损失：低责任时规划收益占优，高责任时验证器避免的误通过占优。独立验证器能以远低成本获得完整规划加验证栈的几乎所有误通过收益。

title: FreqCondNorm: Towards Cross-domain Predictive Maintenance through a Frequency-Conditioned Transformer Foundation Model
summary: Deep learning predictive maintenance models suffer from poor transferability across machines and operating conditions, especially when labelled data are scarce and signals span five orders of magnitude in sampling frequency (1 Hz to ~100 kHz). We propose FreqCondNorm, a Transformer-based architecture that introduces a FiLM-style frequency-conditioned normalization layer to unify heterogeneous time-series within a single model. The architecture is pretrained on five public predictive maintenance datasets (CWRU, MFPT, UOC18, PRONOSTIA, CMAPSS) using masked auto-encoding and contrastive learning with balanced domain sampling. On fault diagnosis, the model achieves 99.2% accuracy on CWRU (+6.4 pp over CNN) and 82.1% zero-shot accuracy on MFPT, demonstrating strong transfer across sampling frequencies. However, the approach does not improve remaining useful life prediction, suggesting a mismatch between pretraining and RUL objectives that warrants future investigation.

AI.tldr: 提出 FreqCondNorm，一种基于 Transformer 的预测性维护模型，通过 FiLM 风格频率条件归一化层统一不同采样频率的异构时序数据，并在五个公开数据集上预训练。
AI.motivation: 深度学习预测性维护模型跨机器、跨工况迁移能力差，尤其标签稀缺且信号采样频率跨越 1 Hz 到约 100 kHz 五个数量级。
AI.method: 设计带频率条件归一化层的 Transformer 架构；在 CWRU、MFPT、UOC18、PRONOSTIA、CMAPSS 五个公开数据集上，采用掩码自编码、对比学习和平衡域采样进行预训练。
AI.result: 故障诊断上 CWRU 准确率 99.2%，比 CNN 提升 6.4 个百分点；MFPT 零样本准确率 82.1%，显示跨采样频率迁移能力。但剩余使用寿命预测未获改进。
AI.conclusion: FreqCondNorm 能有效统一异构时序并提升故障诊断迁移性能，但预训练目标与 RUL 预测任务不匹配，需未来研究。
AI.conclusion_note: JSON 字段已按要求提供。

title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/NVlabs/SoL-Pi . Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/SoL-Pi/
summary: As coding agents move from supervised code completion to unattended, around-the-clock exploration, their work expands from isolated predictions into long trajectories of reasoning, tool use, and feedback. Token efficiency therefore becomes important for scaling recursive self-improvement. We take an RSI-inspired approach at the harness layer, scaling auto-research loops across increasingly numerous and diverse environments for harness rollouts. At this scale, the process yields reusable improvements that transfer beyond their development setting, moving automated harness discovery toward production-level outcomes. Four mechanisms survive selection and form SoL-Pi, spanning action execution, context compaction, observation handling, and delegated reading. On the 51-task EdgeBench evaluation, SoL-Pi achieves performance comparable to Pi across GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 while reducing recorded token traffic by 44.7-49.0% and API cost by about one third. In other words, estimated hourly savings are \$8.75-\$13.50 relative to native Codex and Claude Code harnesses, and \$4.36-\$5.71 relative to Pi.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向编码智能体长期自主运行的harness层token效率优化方法SoL-Pi，通过大规模自动研究循环筛选出四种可复用机制，在EdgeBench上保持性能的同时显著降低token流量与API成本。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体正从受监督代码补全转向无人值守、全天候探索，其工作从孤立预测变为包含推理、工具使用与反馈的长轨迹，因此token效率对扩展递归自我改进至关重要。
AI.method: 采用RSI启发的harness层方法，在大量且多样化的环境中扩展自动研究循环并进行harness rollout，最终筛选出四种可复用机制，涵盖动作执行、上下文压缩、观察处理和委托阅读，形成SoL-Pi。
AI.result: 在51项任务的EdgeBench评测中，SoL-Pi在GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5上达到与Pi相当的性能，同时将记录的token流量降低44.7%至49.0%，API成本降低约三分之一；相对原生Codex和Claude Code harness，估计每小时节省8.75至13.50美元，相对Pi节省4.36至5.71美元。
AI.conclusion: 大规模自动harness发现能够产生可迁移、可复用的改进，推动自动harness发现走向生产级成果，并显著改善长期编码智能体的token经济性。

title: Visual Sim-to-Real Learning for Robotic Insertion under Geometric Variations: Application to Rebar Installation
summary: Rebar insertion is among the most repetitive and physically demanding tasks on construction sites, and a contact-rich problem at 1.4 mm clearance. The parts, however, vary at two levels: a nominal design per structural member, and fabrication tolerance around each nominal design. Real-world data therefore has to be re-collected as designs and batches change. We present RebarSim, a visual sim-to-real system trained entirely in simulation. A privileged state-based teacher is trained with reinforcement learning over procedurally generated rebar geometries, then distilled into a multi-view student that maps raw RGB and proprioception directly to actions under extensive domain randomization. The student transfers to the real world zero-shot, seating rebars taken from a real factory production run in 91.3% of real-robot rollouts. Underlying that result, geometry diversity and pretraining both bring benefits. Training across a diverse set of nominal designs rather than one lifts the zero-shot success of both the teacher and the student on unseen designs, and the student policy outperforms a single-design specialist on that specialist's own design. A pretrained student then adapts to a new design with 4--6x fewer distillation samples than one trained from scratch. Visual sim-to-real transfer depends on appearance randomization and the DAgger mixture: removing either one sharply lowers success. Videos, code, and task assets are available at https://rebarsim.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 RebarSim，一个完全在仿真中训练的视觉 sim-to-real 系统，用于接触丰富且间隙仅 1.4 mm 的钢筋插入任务，并实现零样本真机迁移，真实机器人 rollout 成功率达 91.3%。
AI.motivation: 钢筋插入是建筑现场重复且高体力消耗的任务，且属于 1.4 mm 间隙的接触丰富问题。构件存在名义设计差异和制造公差，导致真实数据需随设计和批次变化重新采集，因此需要可泛化且无需真实数据的仿真到现实方案。
AI.method: 先在程序化生成的钢筋几何上训练基于特权状态的强化学习教师策略，再蒸馏为多视图学生策略，将原始 RGB 和本体感觉直接映射为动作，并使用广泛域随机化。分析几何多样性与预训练作用，并检验外观随机化和 DAgger 混合对视觉 sim-to-real 的影响。
AI.result: 学生策略零样本迁移到真实世界，在真实工厂生产批次钢筋上成功率为 91.3%。训练多样名义设计比单一设计提升教师和学生未见设计成功率，且学生在其单设计专家自身设计上表现更优；预训练学生适应新设计所需蒸馏样本减少 4--6 倍；移除外观随机化或 DAgger 混合会显著降低成功率。
AI.conclusion: 纯仿真训练可零样本迁移到真实机器人钢筋插入任务。几何多样性、预训练、外观随机化和 DAgger 混合是视觉 sim-to-real 成功迁移的关键因素。

title: SenseFuse: Label-Free Fusion of Image and Shape Encoders for Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary scene understanding is fundamental for robotics, laying the groundwork for spatial reasoning and object manipulation. While closed-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation heavily leverages 3D shape information, state-of-the-art open-vocabulary methods remain predominantly restricted to 2D image features or image-distilled representations during mask labeling. In this paper, we propose SenseFuse, a label-free fusion method that balances 2D image and 3D shape encoders for robust open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, refining only the mask-labeling stage of existing pipelines. We reveal that 2D image and 3D shape encoders exhibit largely disjoint failure patterns and rarely share identical wrong labels, whereas two 2D image encoders frequently repeat the same errors. This distinct behavior makes the 2D and 3D pair inherently complementary. We introduce an adaptive mechanism that selects a scene-level fusion weight to maximize a label-free sensitivity measure, estimated directly from a single scene's unlabeled proposals in milliseconds. SenseFuse improves labeling accuracy in every evaluated setting across ScanNet200, Replica, and ScanNet++, recovering 67-100% (median 93%) of the gain achievable with an oracle weight, and it raises instance AP in 21 of 22 reported settings. Code is available at https://github.com/hanes1207/SenseFuse.

AI.tldr: 提出 SenseFuse，一种无需标签的融合方法，通过平衡 2D 图像与 3D 形状编码器来改进开放词汇 3D 实例分割中的掩码标注阶段。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇 3D 实例分割对机器人空间推理和物体操作至关重要，但现有先进方法在掩码标注时主要依赖 2D 图像特征或图像蒸馏表示，未充分利用 3D 形状信息。
AI.method: SenseFuse 仅精炼现有流程的掩码标注阶段，发现 2D 图像编码器与 3D 形状编码器的失败模式高度不互补且很少犯相同错误，而两个 2D 编码器常重复相同错误。因此设计自适应机制，基于单个场景未标注候选框在毫秒级内估计无标签敏感度度量，并选择场景级融合权重。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet200、Replica 和 ScanNet++ 上，SenseFuse 在所有评估设置中均提升标注准确率，恢复 oracle 权重可获得增益的 67%–100%（中位数 93%），并在 22 个报告设置中的 21 个上提升实例 AP。
AI.conclusion: 2D 图像与 3D 形状编码器具有内在互补性，无需标签即可有效融合二者，从而稳健提升开放词汇 3D 实例分割性能。

title: Towards AI-enhanced control: a numerical technique for trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot for pancreatic surgery
summary: The paper presents a numerical approach for the end-effector trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot designed for minimally invasive pancreatic surgery. The approach is tailored for real-time master-slave control architecture and uses a 3D space mouse for command input for velocity control. The trajectory smoothing is achieved by generating S-curves in the end-effector velocity fields, thus controlling the accelerations, which in turn reduces tissue trauma in the minimally invasive procedures. Real-time control is enabled by segmenting the S-curves based on the command inputs from the 3D space mouse. A special case is considered where the acceleration time is constant for all command inputs. Numeric results demonstrate stable transitions (without abrupt changes) in both the end-effector parameter space and in the active joints parameters, thereby validating the proposed approach. Further work aims to test the approach on an experimental model and integrate it into AI-based training modules.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种用于微创胰腺手术并联机器人末端执行器轨迹平滑的数值方法，适用于实时主从控制架构，通过3D空间鼠标进行速度控制输入，生成S曲线以平滑速度场，从而减少组织创伤。
AI.motivation: 微创手术中机器人末端执行器的 abrupt 运动可能造成组织创伤，需要实时平滑轨迹以提升手术安全性。
AI.method: 采用数值方法，基于3D空间鼠标命令输入的速度控制，在末端执行器速度场中生成S曲线以控制加速度，并根据命令输入对S曲线进行分段以实现实时控制，同时考虑加速度时间恒定的特殊情况。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，末端执行器参数空间和主动关节参数均实现了稳定过渡（无突变），验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效平滑轨迹并减少组织创伤，未来将在实验模型上测试并集成到基于AI的训练模块中。

title: Worst-Case Hidden-Vehicle Trajectory Search in Spatiotemporal Occlusion Regions
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Safe and Defensive Autonomous Driving (SDAD) as an Oral Presentation; Best Paper Award. Workshop website: https://sdad.cc/papers.html
summary: Occlusion creates fundamental uncertainty in autonomous driving. Existing methods often propagate frame-wise hypotheses or optimize ego behavior against prescribed hidden-agent predictions, leaving the worst history-consistent interaction unexplored. We introduce History-Conditioned Minimax Trajectory Search (HC-MTS), which combines temporal occlusion reasoning with response-aware search. First, HC-MTS constructs finite hidden-state modes, each certified by a backward witness satisfying multi-frame visibility, occupancy, semantic-map support, and class-specific kinematic constraints. It then solves a bilevel minimax problem: an inner finite oracle maximizes the ego driving score over destination attainment and ride comfort, while the outer search selects the legal hidden-vehicle trajectory that minimizes this best-response value. Across eight Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios, increasing the visibility-memory horizon from K=1 to K=20 reduces the mean per-scenario vehicle, pedestrian, and total retained hidden-seed counts by 18.12%, 21.67%, and 18.45%, respectively. HC-MTS identifies six avoidable counterexamples, while no legal collision-producing attacker is found in the remaining two scenes within the finite search budget.

AI.tldr: 提出HC-MTS，结合时序遮挡推理与响应感知搜索，通过双层极小极大优化寻找最坏历史一致隐藏交互，在Waymo数据集上减少隐藏状态数量并识别可避免碰撞反例。
AI.motivation: 遮挡给自动驾驶带来根本不确定性，现有方法未探索最坏历史一致交互，仅传播逐帧假设或针对给定隐藏智能体预测优化自车行为。
AI.method: HC-MTS构建有限隐藏状态模式，每个模式由满足多帧可见性、占据、语义地图支持和类别运动学约束的后向见证认证；求解双层极小极大问题：内层有限预言机最大化自车驾驶得分（目的地达成与舒适性），外层搜索选择合法隐藏车辆轨迹以最小化该最佳响应值。
AI.result: 在8个Waymo Open Motion Dataset场景中，可见性记忆视野从K=1增至K=20，平均每场景车辆、行人、总保留隐藏种子数分别减少18.12%、21.67%、18.45%；HC-MTS识别出6个可避免反例，剩余2个场景在有限搜索预算内未发现合法碰撞攻击者。
AI.conclusion: HC-MTS能有效进行历史条件极小极大轨迹搜索，减少隐藏状态并发现可避免的碰撞反例，但部分场景未找到攻击者，可能受搜索预算限制。

title: Refuse, Decompose, Refresh: A Claim-Safe Protocol for Closed-Loop AI Evaluation
comment: 8 pages, 0 figures, 3 tables. The reproducibility artifact is linked in the paper
summary: An AI evaluation can be perfectly reproducible and still support the wrong claim. This risk is acute in closed-loop systems: policy determines visited states, observable components, and which failures leave a measurable trace. We propose a claim-safe protocol with three actions. Refuse: abstain when a clean reference stream or matched runtime comparison lacks support. Decompose: report protocol execution, operational false admission, and structural hypotheses separately rather than as one PASS/FAIL label. Refresh: treat distribution-shift alarms as requests to invalidate and recompute a reference map, not as fault evidence. We instantiate the protocol in an aggregate-only simulator with 24 policy components, three demand regimes, two fault-mask families, and independent development and heldout seeds. The preregistered heldout contains 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows. Only 55/72 regime-component units were reference-admitted and 54/55 remained runtime-admitted, making abstention part of the result. Stable false admission was 0/20 represented components, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391 under a frozen 0.20 rule. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic outpredicted nominal fault-cell fraction: across 540 unit-arm rows nested in 20 component clusters, the cell-minus-traffic negative-log-likelihood difference was 0.1264 nats per row, with a 95% component-cluster interval of [0.0593, 0.1918]. A drift log shows why "null" must be reference-relative: clean fault-null streams triggered 15/15, 0/15, and 14/15 alarms across three regimes, while only the middle regime matched the frozen detector reference. Rather than a universal threshold, we contribute an executable contract linking observable support, statistical calibration, and justified claims.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种 claim-safe 协议，针对闭环 AI 评估中“可完全复现但仍支持错误结论”的风险，通过 Refuse、Decompose、Refresh 三个操作，并在仅聚合模拟器中进行预注册验证。
AI.motivation: 闭环系统中，策略决定访问状态、可观测组件以及哪些失败会留下可测量痕迹，因此评估可能统计上可复现，却仍支持错误声明；需要把协议执行、操作错误准入和结构性假设分开处理。
AI.method: 提出 claim-safe 协议：Refuse 在缺乏干净参考流或匹配运行时比较时弃权；Decompose 分开报告协议执行、操作错误准入和结构假设，而非单一 PASS/FAIL；Refresh 将分布偏移警报视为使参考图失效并重算的请求，而非故障证据。在仅聚合模拟器中实例化，含 24 个策略组件、3 种需求机制、2 个故障掩蔽族以及独立开发和留出种子；预注册留出集含 1440 个案例和 21600 个分区行。
AI.result: 仅 55/72 个机制-组件单元被参考准入，其中 54/55 保持运行时准入，使弃权成为结果的一部分。稳定错误准入为 0/20 个代表组件，在冻结 0.20 规则下单侧精确 95% 上界为 0.1391。在准入单元内，受影响清洁流量比名义故障单元比例更具预测性：540 个单元-臂行嵌套于 20 个组件簇，cell-minus-traffic 负对数似然差为每行 0.1264 nats，95% 组件簇区间为 [0.0593, 0.1918]。漂移日志显示“null”必须相对于参考：干净故障空流在三种机制下分别触发 15/15、0/15、14/15 次警报，仅中间机制匹配冻结检测器参考。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献不是通用阈值，而是一个可执行契约，将可观测支持、统计校准和合理声明联系起来；弃权和参考相对性应被纳入评估协议本身。

title: When Do Language-Grounded Explanations Help? A Graph-Bottleneck for Farm Monitoring Interpretable Sheep Facial Pain
summary: Automated pain recognition from facial expression could make continuous welfare assessment practical in sheep, but adoption depends on trust: a stockperson cannot act on a score that arrives without justification. We ground a model in the Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES) by letting each detected facial region attend over text embeddings of the clinical descriptors and then test whether the resulting explanations mean anything. They do not. Ablating an entire descriptor changes the predicted logit by about $10^{-4}$, and the most-attended cue agrees with the predicted pain level in only $32.6\%$ of regions, although the attention maps, the learned gate, and the generated text all proposed otherwise. We therefore remove the appearance bypass with a concept bottleneck whose classifier reads only SPFES concept scores, supervised by per-region state annotations that image-level pipelines discard. This costs $0.05$--$0.10$ in Cohen's $κ$ but yields concepts that are demonstrably learned: minority pain-indicating states are recovered at $3.5$--$8.3\times$ their base rates, and the ear and eye severity orderings emerge without severity supervision. Removing the supervision alone leaves $κ$ unchanged while concept accuracy falls to $0.109$, showing that architectural necessity does not imply semantic validity. We also show that pooled concept accuracy is misleading under clinical imbalance and provide a cross-validated, protocol-matched benchmark of seven methods on this dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究绵羊面部疼痛自动识别中的可解释性可信问题：发现基于SPFES文本注意的解释并不可靠，转而提出仅读取SPFES概念分数的概念瓶颈模型，以少量性能损失换取可验证的概念学习，并提供七种方法的协议匹配基准。
AI.motivation: 自动面部疼痛识别有助于绵羊福利连续评估，但从业者需要可信解释才能依据分数采取行动；因此必须检验模型解释是否真正对应SPFES临床描述符，而非仅表面合理。
AI.method: 先让每个检测到的面部区域对SPFES临床描述符的文本嵌入进行注意力学习，并通过消融描述符和注意力一致性测试解释有效性；随后移除外观旁路，构建概念瓶颈分类器，使其只读取SPFES概念分数，并用图像级流程通常丢弃的逐区域状态标注进行监督；最后在临床不平衡条件下进行交叉验证和七种方法的协议匹配基准比较。
AI.result: 原解释无效：消融整个描述符仅使预测logit变化约1e-4，最受关注线索与预测疼痛等级仅32.6%区域一致，尽管注意力图、学习门控和生成文本均显示相反。概念瓶颈模型使Cohen's κ下降0.05--0.10，但概念确实被学到：少数疼痛指示状态以3.5--8.3倍基率被恢复，耳和眼严重度排序无需严重度监督即可出现。仅移除监督时κ不变，但概念准确率降至0.109。还表明汇总概念准确率在临床不平衡下具有误导性。
AI.conclusion: 架构必要性不等于语义有效性；可解释性必须通过概念监督和验证来保证。概念瓶颈可在可接受的性能损失下提供更可信的疼痛概念，并为该数据集提供协议匹配的基准。

title: Cross-Architecture Foundation-Model Distillation for Edge Flood Segmentation
comment: Main paper (17 pages) with supplementary material (11 pages). Submitted to IEEE JSTARS, Special Section on Generalist-Specialist Model Synergy for Remote Sensing: Theories, Methods, and Applications
summary: Geospatial foundation models can provide strong flood-segmentation performance, but their size limits deployment on memory-constrained edge hardware. We distill a 300-million-parameter Prithvi-EO-2.0 teacher, fine-tuned on the 252 manually labeled Sen1Floods11 training scenes, into a 0.7-million-parameter EfficientViT-B0 student. The teacher supervises additional unlabeled Sentinel-2 imagery, allowing the student training set to grow without new manual annotations. At the matched budget of 252 scenes, teacher-supervised training is competitive with direct training and improves STURM-Flood performance across tested configurations; a geometry-matched control shows that label source alone does not explain the difference. Scaling the teacher-supervised pool to 2,500 scenes narrows the remaining student--teacher gap: the float student reaches 0.787 water intersection over union on the Sen1Floods11 test split against 0.822 for the teacher, matches the teacher on STURM-Flood under our evaluation protocol, and remains below it on WorldFloods-v2. After activation replacement and quantization-aware training, the student runs as a 1.5-megabyte 8-bit integer (INT8) TensorRT engine on a Jetson Xavier NX at 5.57 milliseconds of graphics processing unit (GPU) compute per 512-by-512 image, with approximately 14 megabytes of runtime device memory. A fixed modified normalized difference water index (MNDWI) threshold is competitive with both models on the two clean external benchmarks, so we interpret those benchmarks as generalization tests rather than as evidence of learned-model superiority over a spectral rule. The results support the conclusion: foundation-model supervision can amplify a fixed manual annotation budget into a substantially larger training set and yield a compact, deployable edge model.

AI.tldr: 该研究将3亿参数的Prithvi-EO-2.0洪水分割基础模型蒸馏为70万参数的EfficientViT-B0学生模型，利用教师模型监督无标签Sentinel-2影像扩充训练集，并量化为INT8 TensorRT引擎，实现在Jetson Xavier NX上的边缘部署。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型洪水分割性能强，但参数量大，难以部署在内存受限的边缘硬件上。
AI.method: 以在252个手工标注Sen1Floods11训练场景上微调的Prithvi-EO-2.0（300M）为教师，蒸馏到EfficientViT-B0（0.7M）学生；教师监督额外无标签Sentinel-2影像以扩大训练集；在252场景匹配预算下与直接训练对比，并设几何匹配对照；将监督池扩至2500场景；经激活替换和量化感知训练转为INT8 TensorRT引擎；与固定MNDWI阈值比较。
AI.result: 252场景下教师监督训练与直接训练竞争，在STURM-Flood上提升，几何匹配对照表明标签来源本身不能解释差异；2500场景下浮点学生在Sen1Floods11测试集水IoU达0.787（教师0.822），在STURM-Flood上匹配教师，在WorldFloods-v2上低于教师；量化后模型为1.5MB INT8 TensorRT引擎，Jetson Xavier NX上512x512图像GPU计算5.57ms，运行时设备内存约14MB；固定MNDWI阈值在两个干净外部基准上与两模型相当，故这些基准应视为泛化测试而非学习模型优越性证据。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型监督可将固定手工标注预算放大为更大训练集，并产生紧凑、可部署的边缘模型。

title: Grounded Product Understanding in Livestream Videos
summary: E-commerce livestreams have emerged as an important channel for presenting products to online consumers, containing multiple products whose information is scattered in different moments. This poses significant challenges for downstream product understanding applications, such as product-centric livestream clipping, where models need to identify the product and its relevant segments for information gathering. However, existing benchmarks for general product understanding typically evaluate product retrieval and temporal localization in isolation, leaving the critical correspondence between product identity and temporal evidence largely unassessed. To address this limitation, we introduce GPUB, a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,000 livestream instances with quality-controlled multi-moment temporal annotations and a catalog of over 31K fashion products. GPUB supports three evaluation tasks: the main task Grounded Product Understanding (GPrU) requires jointly identifying the target product and localizing its supporting moments from a livestream video and a candidate product set; Product Retrieval and Product Moment Localization serve as two complementary subtasks. Evaluation of existing multimodal models shows that GPrU remains highly challenging, with the best-performing baseline achieving only 10.13% Pair mAP@.3. To narrow the performance gap, we further develop UniPro, a unified product understanding model that derives product-aligned and temporally structured representations from shared multimodal encoding, improving Pair mAP@.3 to 21.53% while achieving 37.23% Joint R@1@.3 on GPrU.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了GPUB基准和UniPro模型，用于电商直播中产品理解与相关时刻定位的联合任务。
AI.motivation: 现有产品理解基准孤立评估产品检索和时间定位，未评估产品身份与时间证据之间的关键对应关系，而电商直播中产品信息分散带来挑战。
AI.method: 构建GPUB基准，包含3000个直播实例、多时刻时序标注和超3.1万时尚产品；定义主任务GPrU及两个子任务；提出UniPro统一模型，从共享多模态编码中学习产品对齐和时序结构化表示。
AI.result: 现有模型在GPrU上表现差，最佳基线仅10.13% Pair mAP@.3；UniPro将Pair mAP@.3提升至21.53%，并达到37.23% Joint R@1@.3。
AI.conclusion: GPrU任务仍具挑战性，UniPro有效缩小性能差距，表明统一建模产品身份与时间定位的重要性。

title: Ownership in AI-Assisted Everyday Tasks
summary: When does work done with AI still feel like ours? As AI becomes woven into everyday tasks, we must examine what happens to our sense of ownership and contribution when a machine shares in producing what we make. We report an exploratory qualitative survey in which participants were asked to describe two recent, self-selected tasks completed with AI: one that felt like their own and one that did not. We find that felt ownership depends on the process of collaboration: people disown work when they merely approve AI's suggestions, but retain ownership when they lead, iterate, or rewrite. Ownership can also extend to settings where people own the vision for a project but not the execution; respondents reported high ownership on tasks they could not have completed without AI. Loss of personal voice and a lack of comprehension of the output both erode ownership. Finally, willingness to disclose AI use is often decoupled from actual pride or ownership, and instead shaped by community norms and fear of credit erasure. We propose several research directions as a result of these findings to promote AI development that supports people's sense of authorship over their own lives.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过探索性定性调查探讨了人们在使用AI完成任务时何时仍觉得成果属于自己。发现所有权感受取决于协作过程：主导、迭代或重写时保留所有权，仅批准AI建议时则放弃所有权；同时，个人声音缺失和理解不足会削弱所有权，披露意愿则常与自豪感脱钩。
AI.motivation: 随着AI融入日常任务，需要研究当机器参与创作时，人们的归属感与贡献感会发生什么变化。
AI.method: 开展探索性定性调查，要求参与者描述两个近期自选的AI辅助任务：一个感觉属于自己的，一个感觉不属于自己的。
AI.result: 归属感取决于协作过程：仅批准AI建议会让人放弃所有权，而主导、迭代或重写则保留所有权；当人们拥有项目愿景而非执行时，所有权也可延伸，甚至对没有AI无法完成的任务报告高所有权；失去个人声音和不理解输出都会侵蚀所有权；披露AI使用的意愿常与自豪感或所有权脱钩，而受社群规范和害怕贡献被抹除影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出若干研究方向，以促进支持人们对自己生活拥有作者感的AI发展。

title: Integrated Guidance and Control of a Mother-Child UAV-UGV System for Cooperative Missions
summary: Autonomous recovery of a small multirotor onto a hovering multirotor carrier differs from recovery onto ground or shipborne platforms because the recovery surface is itself an actively controlled, thrust-limited aerial vehicle. This paper presents a field-validated autonomy framework for a heterogeneous rover-mothership-child system executing rover supervision, mothership transit, child deployment and sortie, autonomous return, aerial recovery, and synchronized descent. The recovery stack combines jerk-bounded reference generation, disturbance-observer-augmented planar tracking, feasibility-aware vertical control, a discrete-time barrier-based safety filter for relative vertical geometry, and communication-aware carrier-state prediction. The contribution is the coordinated system-level integration of these methods for recovery onto a hovering multirotor and its full-scale outdoor validation. The framework is implemented on a PX4-ROS 2 architecture using RTK-enabled GNSS, IMU, and barometric fusion, with mothership-side 1D lidar used only as an auxiliary near-contact cue. RTK-fixed positioning was maintained throughout testing. Across 20 outdoor cooperative missions, 17 successfully completed deployment, sortie, and recovery, giving an observed mission success rate of 85%. For successful recoveries, mean terminal-alignment time was 6.3 s, mean planar alignment error at acceptance was 0.18 m, maximum terminal planar deviation was 0.32 m within a 0.40 m capture radius, and minimum logged relative vertical separation during coupled descent was 0.41 m. Mothership planar station-keeping RMS error was 0.25 m. The three unsuccessful trials occurred at different mission stages and are analyzed separately. Results demonstrate practical autonomous aerial recovery within the tested outdoor operating envelope.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并户外验证了一套面向异构“漫游车-母机-子机”系统的自主空中回收框架，实现母机悬停状态下对小型多旋翼的部署、出击、返航与回收，20次任务中17次成功，成功率85%。
AI.motivation: 将小型多旋翼自主降落到悬停的多旋翼母机上，区别于地面或舰船平台，因为回收表面本身是主动控制且推力受限的飞行器，带来更强的相对运动、扰动和安全约束。
AI.method: 构建异构 rover-mothership-child 自主框架，覆盖漫游车监督、母机转场、子机部署与出击、自主返航、空中回收和同步下降。回收控制栈包括：加加速度有界参考生成、扰动观测器增强的平面跟踪、可行性感知垂直控制、基于离散时间障碍函数的相对垂直几何安全滤波器、通信感知的母机状态预测。系统部署于PX4-ROS 2，融合RTK GNSS、IMU和气压计，母机侧1D激光雷达仅作近距接触辅助线索。
AI.result: 20次户外协同任务中17次完成部署、出击与回收，观测任务成功率85%。成功回收中：平均终端对准时间6.3 s，验收时平均平面对准误差0.18 m，0.40 m捕获半径内最大终端平面偏差0.32 m，耦合下降期间记录的最小相对垂直间距0.41 m；母机平面站位保持RMS误差0.25 m。3次失败发生在不同任务阶段并单独分析。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在测试的户外操作包线内，所提出的系统级集成方法能够实现实用的自主空中回收，并完成了全尺寸户外验证。

title: Automated Goldsmith's Mark Retrieval in Silverware
comment: Accepted at the VISART workshop, ECCV 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures, 1 table
summary: For art historians, goldsmith marks play a critical role in the identification and dating of artifacts. In practice, experts must manually compare a query mark against hundreds of documented examples, a process that is both tedious and highly dependent on specialist knowledge. To address this, we present an AI-assisted retrieval pipeline that combines mark localization with metric-learning fine-tuning across three backbone architectures: an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, a supervised ViT-S/16, and a self-supervised DINOv2 ViT-S/14. We conduct a systematic evaluation of cropping strategies, where we measure the impact of no cropping, manual ground-truth cropping, and learned detection-based cropping, and assess their interaction with each backbone. Our strongest configuration, DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with manual crop and metric-learning fine-tuning, achieves an mAP of 62.63% and a Top-1 accuracy of 73.74%. Our experiments show that self-supervised pretraining and mark localization are the two most impactful factors, with learned cropping recovering the majority of the gain from manual cropping without requiring ground-truth annotations at inference time. To enable reproducibility and adoption in the digital humanities, we release our manually annotated dataset and codebase, and deploy the system via a public web interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种AI辅助的金匠标记检索流程，结合标记定位与度量学习微调，比较ResNet-50、ViT-S/16和DINOv2 ViT-S/14三种骨干网络及不同裁剪策略，最佳配置达到mAP 62.63%和Top-1 73.74%，并公开数据集、代码和网页系统。
AI.motivation: 艺术史研究中，金匠标记对文物识别和断代至关重要，但专家需人工将查询标记与数百个已记录样本逐一比对，过程繁琐且高度依赖专业知识。
AI.method: 构建AI辅助检索流程，将标记定位与度量学习微调结合，在ImageNet预训练ResNet-50、监督ViT-S/16和自监督DINOv2 ViT-S/14三种骨干上系统评估无裁剪、人工真值裁剪和基于学习检测的裁剪策略及其交互影响。
AI.result: 最强配置为DINOv2 ViT-S/14结合人工裁剪与度量学习微调，取得mAP 62.63%和Top-1准确率73.74%。实验表明自监督预训练和标记定位影响最大，学习式裁剪无需推理时真值标注即可恢复人工裁剪的大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练与标记定位是提升检索性能的关键因素，学习式裁剪具有实用替代价值。为促进数字人文领域的可复现与应用，作者公开人工标注数据集和代码库，并通过公共网页界面部署系统。

title: Learning Slope-Adaptive Whole-Body Locomotion for Humanoid Robots in Roofing Construction
summary: Roofing requires workers to coordinate locomotion, balance, and work-related body motions on pitched surfaces, creating a challenging application for humanoid robots. Directly retargeted human demonstrations, however, may preserve motion appearance while placing the robot's feet or hands incorrectly relative to the roof. This study presents a task-semantic scene-grounded framework for learning roofer-style whole-body motions on a Unitree G1. Human demonstrations are captured using a tracking system and retargeted to the robot, while a metric roof model supplies the spatial reference unavailable from the tracking system. A trajectory-level optimization grounds inferred support contacts and annotated work relations to the roof, and execution-aware reinforcement learning encourages the resulting policy to preserve these relations under dynamic tracking errors. The framework is evaluated through a multi-motion tracking study, a roof-pitch coverage matrix, a five-way nailgun ablation, cross-task experiments on hammering and lateral pushing, and comparisons with pure reinforcement learning and zero-shot teleoperation. Our method enables the robot to satisfy support, work-clearance, and nonpenetration criteria across all evaluated seeds. Across nailgun, hammering, and pushing, it achieves work-clearance errors between 0.256 and 0.531 cm and 3/3 successful evaluations per task. Physical experiments reproduce uphill walking, nailgun, hammering, and bending motions with mean base-frame motion errors below 80 mm. These findings establish scene-grounded human motion learning as a promising basis for construction-oriented humanoid motion primitives.

AI.tldr: 提出一种任务语义场景锚定框架，使Unitree G1学习屋面工式全身动作，通过轨迹优化与执行感知强化学习保证支撑、作业间隙和非穿透关系。
AI.motivation: 屋顶倾斜面要求工人协调移动、平衡和作业动作，但直接重定向人体演示可能只保留动作外观，却使机器人脚或手相对屋顶位置错误，且跟踪系统缺少屋顶空间参考。
AI.method: 用跟踪系统采集人体演示并重定向到机器人；用度量屋顶模型提供空间参考；通过轨迹级优化将推断的支撑接触和标注的作业关系锚定到屋顶；用执行感知强化学习让策略在动态跟踪误差下保持这些关系。评估包括多动作跟踪、屋顶坡度覆盖矩阵、五路钉枪消融、锤击与侧推跨任务实验，以及与纯强化学习和零样本遥操作的对比。
AI.result: 方法在所有评估种子中满足支撑、作业间隙和非穿透标准；在钉枪、锤击和推挤中，作业间隙误差为0.256–0.531 cm，每任务3/3成功；物理实验复现上坡行走、钉枪、锤击和弯腰动作，基座系平均运动误差低于80 mm。
AI.conclusion: 场景锚定的人体运动学习是构建面向建筑的人形机器人运动基元的有前景基础。

title: Limits of Confidence in Diffusion
summary: Discrete diffusion, including remasking and uniform-state samplers, generate a sequence by writing multiple token positions per step, drawing each from a per-position distribution and choosing which positions to write from those same distributions. For domains of general interest (pixels, phonemes, or words) there are inherent dependencies between tokens. We show that a step matches the training distribution only when the positions it writes are conditionally independent given the tokens already fixed, that no product of per-position distributions can match a dependent group, and that per-position distributions do not determine whether a group is dependent: two joint distributions can have identical per-position marginals while differing in which combinations of values occur. On ScanAndAdd, a synthetic task whose joint distribution is available in closed form, we verify that every group of two or more undetermined positions a confidence ranking writes is dependent, and measure the generated distribution to be $29\times$ the sampling-noise floor total variation while per-sample metrics are $1.0$.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，离散扩散采样器若每步并行写入多个位置，只有当这些位置在已固定 token 条件下条件独立时，该步才能匹配训练分布；否则各位置边缘分布的乘积无法表示存在依赖的联合分布。作者在 ScanAndAdd 合成任务上验证了这种偏差：置信度排序写入的多位置组均存在依赖，生成分布总变差远高于噪声下限，但单样本指标看似完美。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散、重掩码和均匀状态采样器常通过每步并行写入多个 token 位置来加速生成，但像素、音素、词等真实数据中 token 之间存在依赖。作者因此质疑：仅基于各位置边缘分布选择并写入多个位置，是否还能正确匹配训练数据的联合分布。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析离散扩散并行写入步骤与训练分布匹配的条件，证明 per-position 分布乘积无法匹配依赖组，且边缘分布不能决定联合依赖结构。随后构造联合分布有闭式解的 ScanAndAdd 合成任务，检验 confidence ranking 每步写入的未确定位置组是否依赖，并测量生成分布的总变差与采样噪声下限。
AI.result: 理论上，一个步骤只有在所写位置于已固定 token 条件下条件独立时才能匹配训练分布；任何依赖组都不能由各位置分布的乘积表示；相同边缘分布可对应不同的联合依赖结构。实验上，ScanAndAdd 中 confidence ranking 写入的任意两个及以上未确定位置组都是依赖的；生成分布总变差达到采样噪声下限的 29 倍，而逐样本指标仍为 1.0。
AI.conclusion: 常用离散扩散并行采样策略在存在多位置依赖时会产生原理性分布偏差，而单样本指标可能掩盖这种分布级错误。需要显式考虑 token 依赖，或改进采样、排序与分组策略以匹配真实联合分布。

title: Deep Noir: Autonomous Steering Discovery via Architectural Chronometry in Transformer Models
summary: Activation steering modifies LLM behavior at inference time, but identifying where and how strongly to steer remains manual. We introduce Deep Noir, a framework that uses Logit Lens convergence and causal head-level attribution to autonomously discover optimal steering parameters. Across three scales (1B x 3, 2-3B x 2, and 7-9B x 4), our engine achieves 16.7 percentage-point improvement on spam at 1B (standard deviation 4.7; 39 runs), with gains increasing to 21 to 42 percentage points at 7-9B across four architectures. On SST-2 sentiment, it achieves a 13.1 percentage-point improvement with zero code changes. Mechanistic grounding enables automated discovery of intervention points that generalize across tasks and architectures. On sentiment, RepE without head masking fails to improve over baseline, while Deep Noir improves all models (p less than 0.01). We further show that steering creates a predictable prompt-injection attack surface whose vulnerability increases monotonically with steering magnitude. This finding is relevant to agent systems deploying steered classifiers.

AI.tldr: Deep Noir 是一个通过 Logit Lens 收敛和因果头级归因自动发现激活干预参数的框架，能在多模型规模和多任务上提升分类性能，并揭示激活引导带来的提示注入攻击面。
AI.motivation: 激活引导可在推理时改变大语言模型行为，但现有方法中“在哪里引导、引导强度多大”仍依赖人工设定，缺乏自动化且机制可解释的发现手段。
AI.method: 提出 Deep Noir 框架，结合 Logit Lens 收敛分析与因果头级归因，自动发现最优激活引导参数和干预点；在 1B、2-3B、7-9B 等多个模型规模与架构上，针对垃圾信息分类和 SST-2 情感分类进行评估，并与 RepE 等方法比较。
AI.result: 在垃圾信息任务上，1B 模型提升 16.7 个百分点（标准差 4.7；39 次运行），7-9B 四个架构提升 21 至 42 个百分点；SST-2 情感任务上零代码修改提升 13.1 个百分点。情感任务中，未使用头掩码的 RepE 未能超过基线，而 Deep Noir 在所有模型上均有提升（p<0.01）。此外，激活引导会形成可预测的提示注入攻击面，且脆弱性随引导强度单调增加。
AI.conclusion: 机制归因使自动发现干预点成为可能，并可跨任务和架构泛化，显著提升激活引导效果；但部署带激活引导的分类器时需关注其引入的提示注入安全风险，尤其是智能体系统。

title: DocAttriBench: Benchmarking Answer Grounding in Document Visual Question Answering
summary: Answer grounding in document visual question answering remains an open challenge: most benchmarks lack grounding annotations or provide limited-quality labels, while constructing grounded datasets still requires costly manual effort. We introduce DocAttriBench (DAB), a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained, element-level source attribution in Document VQA, grounding answers to specific layout elements such as text blocks, tables, and images. To build DAB, we propose a Mask-based Perplexity-Derived Attribution method (MAPPET) that combines document layout and language modeling to identify the most informative element for each answer. MAPPET measures the increase in perplexity after masking candidate elements and attributes the answer to the element contributing most to model confidence. Applying MAPPET to multiple existing Document VQA datasets yields DAB, with 237k documents and 296k question-answer pairs with element-level grounding. We benchmark grounding-capable multimodal LLMs on DAB, evaluating answer accuracy, attribution accuracy, and overall answer quality. Results show that while larger models generally achieve higher answer accuracy, even the strongest models often fail to localize the supporting elements. DAB provides a scalable benchmark for developing grounded, verifiable, and trustworthy Document VQA models. Dataset and code are available at https://aimagelab.github.io/DocAttriBench/.

AI.tldr: 提出 DocAttriBench (DAB) 大规模文档 VQA 元素级溯源基准，并利用 MAPPET 自动构建标注，评估多模态大模型的答案准确性与归因定位能力。
AI.motivation: 文档视觉问答中的答案 grounding 仍是开放挑战：现有基准缺少 grounding 标注或标注质量有限，而人工构建带 grounding 的数据集成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出 MAPPET（基于掩码的困惑度归因方法），结合文档布局与语言建模，通过掩码候选布局元素并测量困惑度增量，将答案归因于对模型置信度贡献最大的元素；将其应用于多个现有 Document VQA 数据集以构建 DAB。
AI.result: DAB 包含 237k 文档和 296k 问答对，并提供元素级 grounding；对具备 grounding 能力的多模态 LLM 进行基准测试，评估答案准确率、归因准确率和整体答案质量，发现更大模型通常答案准确率更高，但即使最强模型也常无法定位支持元素。
AI.conclusion: DAB 为开发 grounded、可验证且可信的 Document VQA 模型提供了可扩展的基准。

title: Walking on the Slope: Stable Bipedal Gaits with Genetic-Algorithm-Optimized Trajectories
summary: This paper presents the kinematic and dynamic modeling, trajectory generation, and stability analysis of an 8-degree-of-freedom (DOF) biped robot walking on flat and inclined terrain. Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) parameters and homogeneous transformations are used to derive the forward kinematics, while closed-form inverse kinematics maps the desired hip and swing-foot Cartesian trajectories, generated with cubic splines, to joint angles. Joint torques are computed using the Newton-Euler iterative algorithm, and dynamic stability is evaluated using the zero moment point (ZMP) criterion. A genetic algorithm (GA) optimizes the hip height, maximum swing-foot lift, and frontal-plane tilt angle by minimizing the work done by the joints subject to a ZMP feasibility penalty. Simulation results in MATLAB show that the nominal 8-DOF model remains ZMP-stable for step completion times down to 0.5 s and for slope inclinations up to 22.5 degrees with the given foot geometry. Beyond these limits, the ZMP leaves the support polygon, and either the foot dimensions or the trajectory parameters must be modified. The results also show that ZMP stability is governed by the mass distribution among the links rather than the total mass of the robot.

AI.tldr: 本文对8自由度双足机器人在平地与斜面行走进行运动学、动力学建模、轨迹生成和稳定性分析。
AI.motivation: 研究8自由度双足机器人在不同步时和坡度下的稳定行走边界，并通过优化步态参数提升动态稳定性。
AI.method: 采用DH参数和齐次变换推导正运动学，闭式逆运动学将三次样条生成的髋部与摆动足笛卡尔轨迹映射为关节角；用Newton-Euler迭代算法计算关节力矩；用ZMP判据评估动态稳定性；用遗传算法以关节做功最小为目标，并加入ZMP可行性惩罚，优化髋高、最大摆动足抬升高度和额状面倾斜角；在MATLAB中仿真。
AI.result: 标称8自由度模型在步完成时间低至0.5 s、坡度达22.5°时仍满足ZMP稳定；超过这些极限后ZMP会离开支撑多边形，需修改足部尺寸或轨迹参数；ZMP稳定性主要受各连杆质量分布影响，而非机器人总质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提建模、轨迹生成、动力学计算和优化框架可用于双足机器人平地与斜面稳定行走分析，并给出了稳定性的步时与坡度边界及后续设计调整方向。

title: A Dual-Stream Regulated Reconstruction and Segmentation Network with Hierarchical Artifact-Prior Modeling for Ultra-Low-Field Pediatric Neuroimaging
summary: Automated quality assessment, enhancement, and segmentation of multiple structures in $0.064\,\mathrm{T}$ ultra-low-field pediatric MRI are limited by a low signal-to-noise ratio, weak anatomical boundaries, and frequent artifacts. We present a unified framework for the LISA 2026 Challenge that performs all three tasks together within one inference pipeline. A network with two coupled streams, built on a 3D U-Net, first reconstructs an enhanced uLF volume and then combines the original and enhanced images for subcortical segmentation. To improve boundary stability, we add an auxiliary class covering brain tissue outside the target structures, derived from whole brain masks. A head conditioned on an artifact graph predicts the seven artifact ratings from reconstruction residuals and frozen segmentation features. We address the scarcity of dense annotations using diffeomorphic registration from atlas to target for label propagation and to regularize anatomical reconstruction. We report validation results across all three tasks.

AI.tldr: 面向0.064 T超低场儿童MRI，提出一个统一框架，在同一推理流程中同时完成质量评估、图像增强和多结构分割。
AI.motivation: 超低场儿童MRI存在低信噪比、解剖边界弱和伪影频繁等问题，限制了自动化质量评估、增强与多结构分割；同时密集标注数据稀缺。
AI.method: 基于双耦合流3D U-Net：先重建增强后的uLF体积，再融合原始与增强图像进行皮层下分割。引入由全脑掩膜得到的目标结构外脑组织辅助类以提升边界稳定性。使用以伪影图为条件的网络，从重建残差和冻结分割特征预测7种伪影评分。通过图谱到目标的微分同胚配准进行标签传播，并正则化解剖重建。
AI.result: 在LISA 2026 Challenge中报告了全部三项任务的验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架可联合处理超低场儿童MRI的质量评估、增强和分割；辅助类与图谱配准策略有助于应对边界不稳定和密集标注稀缺问题。

title: Q&A on Any Spreadsheet Requires Interpreting Its Grid Structure
summary: Semantic cell annotation improves chunking interpretability for spreadsheets in LLM-driven RAG systems, aiding answer generation through enriched context rather than improved retrieval accuracy. We propose a novel framework of splitting any spreadsheet into interpretable chunks using cell role annotation. Our framework beats the state of the art, yet it faces a hard ceiling. Spreadsheets are fundamentally two-dimensional unstructured data with continuous relationships and infinite potential cell roles. Because classification models are restricted to finite, pre-defined classes, they cannot perfectly capture this structural nuance, even with human-level annotation. We show that addressing the spreadsheet-to-LLM bottleneck requires moving beyond discrete cell classification. Instead, the field must develop dimensionality-reduction techniques to directly flatten 2D unstructured spreadsheets into 1D unstructured text. Text chunks would be easier for downstream RAG to interpret and generate from.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用单元格角色标注将电子表格切分为可解释块，以增强LLM驱动RAG的上下文与答案生成；方法虽超越SOTA，但受限于离散分类的固有天花板，主张转向降维技术把2D表格扁平化为1D文本。
AI.motivation: 电子表格在RAG中难以处理：它是2D非结构化数据，关系连续且潜在单元格角色无限，而分类模型只能使用有限预定义类别，无法完美捕获其结构语义，即使人工标注也存在上限。
AI.method: 提出基于单元格角色标注的框架，将任意电子表格分割成可解释的chunk，并与当前最先进方法比较；同时分析离散单元格分类的局限，提出发展维度降低/扁平化技术的方向。
AI.result: 该框架优于当前SOTA，但面临硬性上限；语义单元格标注主要通过丰富上下文帮助答案生成，而非提升检索准确率；离散分类无法完整表达表格的结构细微差异。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠离散单元格分类无法解决电子表格到LLM的瓶颈；领域应发展降维技术，直接将2D非结构化电子表格压平成1D非结构化文本，使下游RAG更易解释和生成。

title: RawSLAM: Online HDR Gaussian SLAM from Linear Radiance
summary: Current dense visual SLAM systems rely almost exclusively on 8-bit tonemapped Low Dynamic Range (LDR) inputs, limiting their robustness in extreme lighting where shadows and highlights trigger tracking drift and mapping collapse. Conversely, existing raw and High Dynamic Range (HDR) reconstruction pipelines operate strictly offline. They depend on Structure-from-Motion preprocessing and are not suited for large inter-frame motion. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first online Gaussian SLAM framework that tracks and maps directly on single-exposure 16-bit linear HDR imagery. Our method rests on three core components: an architecture-agnostic HDR Gaussian Splatting module featuring an MLP-free logarithmic parameterization of Gaussian color features; a Reinhard range-compressed photometric objective; and structure-guided spatial gradient weighting. Combined, these components allow our approach to outperform a direct HDR adaptation of MonoGS in both trajectory and reconstruction accuracy, while rendering natively in linear scene radiance for post-rendering processing. The same formulation runs unchanged on standard 8-bit inputs, roughly halving the MonoGS baseline error. Furthermore, our HDR Gaussian module transfers seamlessly to SplaTAM, Gaussian SLAM, and DROID-W, eliminating all tracking failures these systems suffer on challenging illumination sequences. To enable this research, we introduce RawSLAM: a dataset of 10 real-world indoor sequences featuring 16-bit RAW imagery, aligned depth, IMU measurements, and external OptiTrack poses. Code and dataset will be made publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个在线高斯SLAM框架，可直接在单次曝光的16位线性HDR图像上进行跟踪与建图，并能原生渲染线性场景辐射。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密视觉SLAM几乎只依赖8位色调映射的LDR输入，在极端光照下易出现跟踪漂移与建图崩溃；而现有RAW/HDR重建流水线均为离线，依赖SfM预处理，无法应对大帧间运动。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：与架构无关的HDR高斯泼溅模块，采用无MLP的对数参数化高斯颜色特征；Reinhard范围压缩的光度目标函数；结构引导的空间梯度加权。同时发布了RawSLAM数据集，包含10个真实室内序列的16位RAW图像、对齐深度、IMU和外部的OptiTrack位姿。
AI.result: 在轨迹与重建精度上优于直接HDR适配的MonoGS；在标准8位输入下误差约减半；HDR高斯模块可无缝迁移至SplaTAM、Gaussian SLAM和DROID-W，消除了这些系统在困难光照序列上的全部跟踪失败。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了首个在线HDR高斯SLAM，能够原生输出线性场景辐射以支持后渲染处理，且公式在8位输入下同样适用，具有良好通用性；代码与数据集将公开。

title: RAFT: A Stateful Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Effective troubleshooting agents in enterprise customer support depend on retrieving actionable guidance from similar historical cases, yet existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems treat support cases as static documents and overlook their multi-stage, stateful nature. We introduce RAFT (Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents), a stateful RAG framework that abstracts each closed historical case into a directed chain of timeline entries and retrieves at the entry level, surfacing cases whose intermediate states match the active case and returning the parent-case trajectory anchored at the matched state; an optional case-level graph links cases through a configurable similarity representation. We evaluate this retrieval layer directly, which, unlike evaluating a full agent system, requires no production deployment. Because public multi-stage troubleshooting data is extremely rare, we pair a synthetic benchmark built from Microsoft Learn Windows Server documentation with real Apache Jira issues carrying human-created duplicate labels. RAFT improves Case Hit over vanilla RAG and GraphRAG baselines at every stage of case progress, with statistically significant gains over the strongest baseline; the Jira results provide directional evidence that the advantage transfers to real case histories. We release our benchmark, implementation, and the Apache Jira evaluation set.

AI.tldr: 提出RAFT，一种有状态RAG框架，将历史支持案例抽象为时间线条目链，并在条目级检索，从而匹配当前案例的中间状态并返回锚定该状态的父案例轨迹；在合成基准与真实Apache Jira数据上验证了检索效果。
AI.motivation: 企业客服排障依赖从相似历史案例中检索可操作指导，但现有RAG系统将支持案例视为静态文档，忽视其多阶段、有状态的特点，难以在案例进展的中间状态上实现有效匹配。
AI.method: RAFT将每个已结历史案例抽象为有向时间线条目链，支持条目级检索：先找到与当前案例中间状态匹配的条目，再返回以该匹配状态为锚点的父案例轨迹；可选案例级图通过可配置相似度表示连接案例。评估上，直接评测检索层而无需生产部署，并使用两个数据集：基于Microsoft Learn Windows Server文档构建的合成基准，以及带有人工重复标签的真实Apache Jira问题。
AI.result: RAFT在案例进展的每个阶段上，Case Hit均优于vanilla RAG和GraphRAG基线，且相对最强基线取得统计显著提升；Jira结果表明该优势可方向性迁移到真实案例历史。
AI.conclusion: 条目级、有状态的历史案例检索能有效提升排障代理的案例匹配能力，且无需完整代理系统部署即可评估；作者发布了基准、实现和Apache Jira评估集。

title: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
summary: Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics. For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher. On a single GPU, SGPS learns policies for locomotion, obstacle traversal, crate pushing, and bimanual carrying on simulated Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. Our experiments further show that refinement improves policy learning beyond initialization and tracking alone. For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS)，将基于采样的模型预测控制与一阶策略优化结合，用于视觉运动策略学习，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 学习视觉运动与操作策略需协调环境接触，计算和GPU内存成本高。一阶策略梯度(FoPG)通过可微分仿真降低训练成本，但局部优化可能收敛到非预期的接触模式。
AI.method: SGPS通过采样-based MPC反复细化动作目标，并与一阶策略优化耦合。行为克隆从采样动作初始化策略；训练交替进行采样细化和短视界FoPG更新，并在扰动初始状态和随机动力学下进行。视觉策略训练采用解耦FoPG，将渲染排除在计算图外，无需状态策略教师即可直接从深度观测学习。
AI.result: 在单GPU上，SGPS在仿真Unitree Go2和G1机器人上学习运动、越障、推箱子和双臂搬运策略。实验表明细化能提升策略学习，超越仅初始化和跟踪。硬件部署时，蒸馏策略零样本迁移到真实Go2，利用板载深度自主小跑、爬行、跨越障碍并在行为间切换。
AI.conclusion: SGPS通过结合采样细化和FoPG，解决了FoPG局部优化问题，实现了高效视觉策略学习，并成功零样本迁移到真实机器人。

title: Semantic SLAM in Precision Agriculture using Bayesian Inference
summary: This paper presents a real-time semantic world modeling framework specialized for precision agriculture using autonomous robots. The framework combines probabilistic mapping of objects and their semantic attributes, updated through Bayesian inference, with a graph-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) approach implemented using $g^2o$, a general framework for graph optimization. This integration enables accurate mapping and localization without relying solely on GPS. By leveraging semantic information such as plant type, size, and health, the robot can perform tasks while mapping and localizing itself within a field of crops. The proposed framework was validated through Gazebo simulations and physical experiments on an indoor field with artificial plants using Boston Dynamics' robot dog Spot. A YOLOv8n object detection model was trained to extract object and semantic data from depth camera observations. These simulations and experiments demonstrate that the system can successfully perform real-time mapping of up to at least 400 plants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向精准农业自主机器人的实时语义世界建模框架，将贝叶斯概率对象/语义属性映射与基于g²o的图优化SLAM结合，并用YOLOv8n从深度相机提取语义信息。
AI.motivation: 精准农业中的自主机器人需要在不完全依赖GPS的情况下实现准确建图与定位，同时利用植物类型、大小和健康状态等语义信息执行任务。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯推断对对象及其语义属性进行概率建图；使用g²o实现图优化SLAM；训练YOLOv8n目标检测模型处理深度相机观测；通过Gazebo仿真和Boston Dynamics Spot机器人在室内人工植物田中进行物理实验验证。
AI.result: 仿真与实验表明，系统能够实时完成至少400株植物的建图，并同时进行定位与语义信息提取。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将语义世界建模与图优化SLAM有效集成，可在精准农业场景下支持机器人边建图、边定位、边执行任务，且无需仅依赖GPS。

title: PhGS: Post-Hoc Pruning and Refinement of Single-View Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
summary: Recent single-view feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) generation predicts a fixed number of Gaussians per camera ray, introducing severe spatial redundancy. Most existing compaction strategies target multi-view setups to exploit cross-view consistency and are incompatible with single-image models. Instead of retraining the base feed-forward network to directly output compact representations, our insight is to keep the base models frozen and apply post-hoc pruning and recurrent refinement to the generated Gaussians. Consequently, we propose a backbone-agnostic compaction pipeline for single-view feed-forward 3DGS that couples an importance-score-based pruning mechanism with a trainable, lightweight recurrent refinement module, which iteratively updates the surviving primitives to restore image quality. Our results demonstrate seamless integration with existing baselines while preserving novel-view rendering fidelity and achieving high memory reduction. Furthermore, our method supports flexible inference-time keep ratios for application needs.

AI.tldr: 针对单视图前馈3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）生成中每条相机射线固定数量高斯导致的空间冗余问题，提出一种与骨干网络无关的后处理压缩流程，结合重要性评分剪枝与轻量循环精炼模块，在冻结基础模型的前提下实现高内存压缩并保持新视角渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有单视图前馈3DGS生成方法为每条相机射线预测固定数量的高斯，造成严重空间冗余；而现有多数压缩策略面向多视图场景，依赖跨视图一致性，无法兼容单图像模型。重新训练基础前馈网络直接输出紧凑表示成本高，因此需要一种后处理式的压缩方案。
AI.method: 保持基础前馈模型冻结，采用后处理剪枝与循环精炼。具体提出一种骨干无关的压缩流水线：首先基于重要性评分对生成的高斯进行剪枝，然后使用可训练的轻量级循环精炼模块，迭代更新存活的高斯基元以恢复图像质量。
AI.result: 该方法能与现有基线无缝集成，在保持新视角渲染保真度的同时实现高内存压缩，并支持推理时灵活调整保留比例以满足不同应用需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结基础模型并施加后处理剪枝与循环精炼，可有效压缩单视图前馈3DGS生成的高斯表示，兼顾渲染质量与内存效率，且具备良好的通用性和灵活性。

title: V2-STRep: VLM-Grounded Structured Task Representations for Reusable Robot Skills Acquired from Generated Videos
summary: Human manipulation videos provide rich motion and interaction cues for acquiring robot skills without robot demonstrations. Video generation models synthesize such demonstrations from an initial scene image and task instruction, avoiding the need to record demonstrations for each task. However, the recovered motion captures only one scene-specific realization, leaving task structure, geometric relations, and constraints implicit. We present V2-STRep, a zero-shot framework that converts generated video motion into reusable robot skills through VLM-grounded structured task representations. The representation specifies motion phases, references, and task-relevant constraints, with targets described by minimal geometric structures: points, point-normals, axes, planes, and full 6D poses. VLM-provided 2D image-space cues are lifted into 3D using RGB-D observations to reconstruct task geometry and candidate grasp poses. Geometry-specific rules transfer motion to new scenes, while task-constrained trajectory optimization couples grasp selection with complete robot motion planning. It preserves task requirements while using remaining rotational freedom to accommodate joint limits. Updating deployment grounding and constraints enables reuse under new compatible instructions without generating another video. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved execution success over baselines, reliable cross-scene transfer of successfully acquired skills, and adaptation to changed deployment instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出V2-STRep零样本框架，将生成视频中的运动转换为可重用机器人技能，通过VLM结构化任务表示实现跨场景迁移和指令适应。
AI.motivation: 人类操作视频可提供机器人技能学习线索，但生成视频恢复的运动仅针对单一场景，任务结构、几何关系和约束隐含其中，难以重用。
AI.method: V2-STRep使用VLM生成结构化任务表示（运动阶段、参考、约束），用点、法线、轴、平面、6D位姿描述目标；通过RGB-D将2D线索提升到3D重建几何和抓取位姿；几何规则迁移运动，任务约束轨迹优化耦合抓取选择与运动规划，并利用旋转自由度满足关节限制；更新部署接地和约束即可复用。
AI.result: 在六个真实操作任务上，执行成功率优于基线，成功习得技能可跨场景迁移，并能适应变化的部署指令。
AI.conclusion: V2-STRep有效将生成视频运动转化为可重用机器人技能，实现跨场景和指令适应，提升执行成功率。

title: INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use
summary: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.

AI.tldr: 提出INSPECT方法，让机器人从智能眼镜助手的记录中学习视角偏好，用于装配检查中判断零件是否存在及安装是否正确，无需目标域视角标签即可选择最佳观察视角。
AI.motivation: 机器人在装配检查中需要确定零件是否出现、安装是否正确。第一人称装配辅助场景下，头部运动、工件操作和语音确认提供了检查证据，但机器人难以直接获得目标域的视角标签来训练视角选择策略。
AI.method: INSPECT框架包含：PI-TwinSwap（通过成对身份干预校准物体证据）、claim-indexed监督（分离证据需求与相机可复现的观察变化）、物体中心校准（将相对视角偏好适配到机器人位姿）、子句级筛选（检查预测证据）。机器人仅利用当前观察和已知位姿选择视角，无需候选图像。
AI.result: 在物理齿轮箱装配图像上，INSPECT在非预言机策略中取得最高视角效用，将人工评估的完全可验证率从34.8%提升至41.7%。在IMPACT商用角磨机记录上，迁移的相对视角选择器使冻结感知头的正确决策率从50.6%提升至54.3%。
AI.conclusion: INSPECT能有效从辅助记录中学习机器人视角偏好，提升装配检查的视角效用和决策正确率，且无需目标域视角标签。代码已开源。

title: Bayesian Continuum Robot Dynamics and State Estimation
summary: Recent factor graph approaches to continuum robot state estimation have been successful for quasi-static applications and spatiotemporal estimation using white-noise kinematic motion priors. However, when inertial effects are significant, these approximations may fail to capture the underlying physics, limiting accuracy during dynamic motions. In contrast, our approach approximates the Cosserat rod dynamics of continuum robots. We write inertia and damping as equivalent applied loads, so that the dynamic balance retains the algebraic form of the static one from prior work with quasi-static robots. Without backbone observations, the framework reduces to a stochastic forward simulation of the robot's motion. Given observations, it jointly refines kinematic and dynamic states and infers external loads, among other states. We validate the approach through simulation and experiments, demonstrating stochastic forward simulation as well as state estimation on tendon-driven continuum robots.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向连续体机器人动态状态估计的因子图方法，通过近似Cosserat杆动力学，在惯性效应显著时提升估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有因子图方法多基于准静态假设或白噪声运动先验，在惯性效应显著时难以准确描述物理过程，限制动态运动下的估计精度。
AI.method: 将惯性和阻尼等效为外加载荷，使动态平衡保持与准静态工作相似的静态代数形式；无骨干观测时退化为随机前向仿真，有观测时联合优化运动学与动态状态并推断外部载荷等状态。
AI.result: 通过仿真和实验在腱驱动连续体机器人上验证，展示了随机前向仿真和状态估计能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够处理连续体机器人的动态运动，实现动态状态估计与外部载荷推断，弥补传统准静态或白噪声先验的不足。

title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
summary: To operate effectively in human environments, robots must identify articulated objects, segment their movable and interactive parts, and estimate their kinematic models. Existing articulated scene representations typically recover kinematics from observed interactions, while methods operating on static scans often decouple articulation from functional interactive elements. We present FunArt, a framework that constructs articulation-aware functional 3D scene graphs from posed RGB-D observations captured in a single static configuration. FunArt reconstructs object instances, converts their fused geometry directly into the O-Voxel representation of TRELLIS.2, and exploits its frozen, sparse-compression VAE as a structural prior. A lightweight query-based decoder combines compact object-level latents with dense, surface-aligned features to jointly segment movable parts and functional interactive elements while estimating motion type, axis, origin, and range. On the Articulate3D dataset, FunArt achieves state-of-the-art performance across movable-part segmentation, articulation estimation, and functional-element segmentation, both with and without ground-truth object input. In the end-to-end setting, it outperforms the strongest baselines by 1.5 AP_{50} points for movable parts, 2.8 AP_{50} points under joint origin-and-axis constraints, and 6.7 AP_{50} points for functional elements. These results demonstrate that generative 3D latents encode actionable structural cues that can initialize robotic perception and planning before physical interaction.

AI.tldr: FunArt 提出一种从单次静态位姿RGB-D观测中构建关节感知功能3D场景图的框架，可联合分割可动部件与功能交互元素并估计运动学参数。
AI.motivation: 现有铰接场景表示多依赖观测到的交互，或在静态扫描中割裂关节结构与功能交互元素；机器人需要在交互前就能识别可动部件与功能区域。
AI.method: 重建物体实例，将融合几何转为TRELLIS.2的O-Voxel表示，利用其冻结稀疏压缩VAE作为结构先验；轻量查询解码器结合物体级隐变量与表面密集特征，联合分割可动部件和功能元素，并估计运动类型、轴、原点与范围。
AI.result: 在Articulate3D上，无论是否输入真值物体，均可动部件分割、关节估计和功能元素分割均达SOTA；端到端设置下较最强基线分别提升1.5 AP50（可动部件）、2.8 AP50（关节原点与轴约束）、6.7 AP50（功能元素）。
AI.conclusion: 生成式3D隐变量编码了可操作的结构线索，可在物理交互前初始化机器人感知与规划。

title: Earth Surface Immune System for Rapid Monitoring of Unknown Anomalies
summary: Earth surface anomalies, driven by escalating climate change, and expanding human activities, are increasing in both frequency and diversity, yet their limited historical data and unpredictability make them fundamentally different from conventional remote sensing targets. Existing methods address specific anomaly categories or stop at localization, leaving a gap between detection and actionable information. Here we present ESIA, an Earth Surface Immune System whose architecture is constrained by three principles from the biological immune system, refined over millions of years against equally diverse and uncertain threats. A non-specific innate immune stage treats anomalies as unobserved changes in time-series satellite imagery, generating binary localization maps at 14.51 km2/s without assuming any anomaly category, surpassing the strongest general baseline by 37% in F1. A specific adaptive immune stage applies negative selection to filter text prompts and matches surviving prompts with localized image patches through a multi-modal foundation model, enabling open-vocabulary recognition of unknown anomaly attributes including category, affected area, and damage severity, with recognition F1 exceeding 80%. A mutation mechanism tunes minimal embeddings at test time, adapting to each scene in 3.26s using a single reference image pair. We validate ESIA on a global-scale dataset covering 19,801.60 km2 across six anomaly categories, comparing against 22 models, and further apply it to quantify degraded farmland in the Dnipro Delta following the Kakhovka Dam collapse and assess burn severity from 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles. This unprecedented flexibility in handling unknown anomalies opens new avenues for real-time disaster response and environmental surveillance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ESIA地球表面免疫系统，用于检测和识别地球表面异常，通过模拟生物免疫系统的非特异性、特异性和变异机制，实现未知异常的定位、开放词汇识别与快速场景适应。
AI.motivation: 气候变化和人类活动导致地球表面异常在频率和多样性上不断增加，但异常数据有限且难以预测，与传统遥感目标不同。现有方法多针对特定异常类别或仅做定位，难以从检测走向可操作信息。
AI.method: ESIA受生物免疫系统三原则约束：非特异性先天免疫阶段将异常视为时序卫星影像中的未观测变化，生成二值定位图；特异性适应性免疫阶段用负选择过滤文本提示，并用多模态基础模型匹配定位图像块，实现开放词汇识别；变异机制在测试时微调少量嵌入，利用单对参考图像快速适应新场景。
AI.result: ESIA在覆盖19,801.60平方公里、六类异常的全球数据集上验证，并与22个模型比较。先天免疫阶段定位速度达14.51平方公里每秒，F1比最强通用基线高37%；适应性免疫阶段识别F1超过80%；变异机制仅用单对参考图像即可在3.26秒内适应每个场景。还应用于量化Kakhovka大坝倒塌后Dnipro三角洲退化农田，以及评估2025年洛杉矶Palisades火灾烧毁严重度。
AI.conclusion: ESIA能灵活处理未知异常，为实时灾害响应和环境监测开辟了新途径。

title: Refinement Is Inherently Editable: Training-Free Prompt-to-Prompt Image Editing with Generative Refinement Network
summary: Text-guided image editing must introduce the requested changes while preserving unrelated source content. Diffusion-based editors rely on spatial controls whose inaccuracies can leave edits incomplete or alter unrelated regions. Causal autoregressive editors face a further constraint: their fixed decoding order limits revision of earlier decisions. We introduce RefineEdit, a training-free prompt-to-prompt image editing framework built on a Generative Refinement Network. Our key idea is to couple edit localization with content generation through the global refinement of binary image codes, allowing editing evidence to be reassessed as the image evolves. RefineEdit initializes an editing branch from an intermediate source state, reusing the emerging layout. We compare the probabilities assigned by the two branches to the same source-sampled bits, using their signed differences to select editable positions and bits. Selected bits follow editing refinement, while the remaining bits copy the evolving source state. To stabilize editing across refinement steps, adaptive spatial freezing limits unnecessary mask expansion, while finite bit locking keeps recently selected bits editable. The framework requires no additional training, external masks, or attention control. Across nine editing categories of PIE-Bench, RefineEdit achieves the best background-preservation scores in PSNR, LPIPS, MSE and SSIM, together with the highest whole-image and edited-region CLIP scores among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 提出RefineEdit，一种无需训练的prompt-to-prompt图像编辑框架，基于生成细化网络，通过耦合编辑定位与内容生成，在PIE-Bench九个类别上取得最佳背景保持和CLIP分数。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑需引入请求的修改同时保留无关源内容。基于扩散的编辑器依赖空间控制，其不准确会导致编辑不完整或改变无关区域；因果自回归编辑器则受固定解码顺序限制，难以修正早期决策。
AI.method: RefineEdit无需训练，基于生成细化网络。从源图像中间状态初始化编辑分支，复用涌现布局；比较两个分支对同一源采样比特的概率，用带符号差异选择可编辑位置和比特；选中比特进行编辑细化，其余复制演化中的源状态；采用自适应空间冻结限制掩码扩张，有限比特锁定保持近期选中比特可编辑。无需额外训练、外部掩码或注意力控制。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench九个编辑类别上，RefineEdit在PSNR、LPIPS、MSE、SSIM上取得最佳背景保持分数，并在所有评估方法中获得最高的整图和编辑区域CLIP分数。
AI.conclusion: RefineEdit通过全局细化二进制图像码，无需训练、掩码或注意力控制，能有效实现文本引导图像编辑，在保持背景的同时完成编辑，性能优于现有方法。

title: PROVIA: Procedure State Tracking for Online Mistake Detection in Egocentric Videos
summary: An assistant watching egocentric video should notice a mistake from past frames alone, before the next step begins, and keep working once the person recovers. A mistake changes the state of the work, so every later step has to be read against what was done rather than against the plan. The first-mistake protocol that current online methods report on cuts each recording at its first mistake, so a fixed-time rule that never looks at the video is right on every case. We evaluate on complete trials, where mistakes and recoveries arise naturally, under a validation false-alarm budget and against controls that use timing alone. PROVIA keeps two records apart: a factual state, a learned summary of the steps each actor performed, mistakes included, and the accepted progress, an exact posterior over the state of an automaton induced from correct demonstrations by Bayesian state merging and over the execution status of each actor. Procedure-state transitions occur only in the correct-status branch; the mistake and correction branches retain the source state. A sequential test turns the per-frame mistake probability into alarms. With one filter and one optimization rule, PROVIA ranks mistakes best among the evaluated controlled baselines on CaptainCook4D, IndustReal, HoloAssist and IMPACT-ego. At a validation budget of 0.1 false alarms per minute it recalls .154 against .128 on CaptainCook4D and .034 against .015 on HoloAssist, where it leads at every budget. The pipeline runs at 58-70 frames per second. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/PROVIA.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PROVIA，一个用于第一视角视频的在线错误检测方法：它分离维护「事实状态」（已执行步骤的学习式摘要，含错误）与「已接受进度」（由正确演示经贝叶斯状态合并得到的自动机状态后验及执行状态），并在完整试验（错误与恢复自然发生）上以固定误报预算进行评估，在四个数据集上优于仅依赖时序的基线，运行速度 58-70 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有在线方法采用的「首次错误协议」会在每个视频的第一个错误处截断，导致一个从不看视频、仅按固定时间触发的规则在所有样本上都正确，从而使评估失去意义。错误会改变工作实际状态，因此后续步骤必须对照已发生的操作而非原始计划来解读，这要求用包含错误与恢复的完整试验来评估在线检测器。
AI.method: PROVIA 将两类记录分开维护：一是事实状态，即对每位执行者所完成步骤（含错误）的学习式摘要；二是已接受进度，即从正确演示中通过贝叶斯状态合并诱导出的自动机的状态后验，以及每位执行者的执行状态。过程状态转移只发生在正确状态分支中，而错误分支与纠正分支保留源状态。随后用一个序贯检验把逐帧错误概率转换为报警。
AI.result: 在 CaptainCook4D、IndustReal、HoloAssist 和 IMPACT-ego 上，PROVIA 在受控基线中错误检测排序最优。在每分钟 0.1 次误报的验证预算下，CaptainCook4D 召回率 .154 对 .128，HoloAssist 为 .034 对 .015，且在 HoloAssist 的每个预算下均领先。流水线运行速度为 58-70 帧/秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过将事实状态与已接受进度分离，并用单一滤波器与统一优化规则进行序贯检测，PROVIA 能在完整试验中有效、实时地检测并跟踪错误与恢复，优于仅依赖时序的控制方法；源代码已公开于 https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/PROVIA。

title: GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoAAC，一种基于几何的自适应动作分块方法，用于流式VLA策略，根据动作预测可靠性动态调整动作视野。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略通常使用固定动作视野，但任务不同阶段对动作连续性、控制精度和闭环反馈的需求不同，固定视野无法适应变化的控制要求。
AI.method: 利用Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何信息表征预测可靠性，发现动作前缀的几何变化与预测不确定性正相关；基于前缀几何构建视野级几何轮廓，在单次生成中自适应确定动作视野，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在GR00T N1.5和π0.5上，于LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365及真实世界操作任务中，相比固定视野基线和现有自适应方法，模拟环境成功率提升最多8.7个百分点，真实世界平均成功率从53.3%提升至74.4%。
AI.conclusion: GeoAAC通过几何驱动的自适应动作分块有效提升了流式VLA策略在不同任务和场景下的性能。

title: HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface
summary: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

AI.tldr: HIL-UMI 是一种无需机器人的、策略引导的人类在环 VLA 后训练框架，通过手持 UMI 演示实现高效数据收集与优势估计优化，从而提升机器人操作策略。
AI.motivation: 大规模 VLA 模型虽提供强大先验，但适配特定部署仍困难。监督微调（SFT）面临两个持久局限：静态数据对分布外状态覆盖有限，且标准模仿目标无法区分有进展的行为与低价值数据。交互式后训练可缓解这些问题，但通常需要在物理机器人上反复执行策略并依赖人工干预。
AI.method: 提出 HIL-UMI 框架。在手持 UMI 演示过程中，查询当前策略但不执行其预测。使用 Energy Score 比较人类动作轨迹与策略推理，当差异表明分布外区域时触发数据收集。另一反馈循环利用低在线优势预测识别关键片段，精炼基于进展的优势估计器。更新后的估计器引导优势条件行为克隆，使用基础演示与新策略数据的平衡混合。该设计将数据收集与机器人部署解耦。
AI.result: 在四个真实任务（涵盖长时程和精细操作）上，HIL-UMI 相比 SFT 取得持续改进，并受益于针对性收集和优势精炼。在 Clean Up Table 任务上，HIL-UMI 优于 HG-DAgger，且每帧收集时间更低。
AI.conclusion: HIL-UMI 为跨操作员和地点的 VLA 后训练提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE/OES Autonomous Underwater Vehicles Symposium (AUV 2026), Southampton, UK. This is the author-accepted manuscript
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. The framework, which we call SPAR (Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery), supports evaluation across fault realizations, prompt structures, reasoning models, and mission conditions. We vary these for a mass-shift fault over 480 SPAR trials, evaluating a frontier model and three off-the-shelf locally deployable LLMs. Model choice dominates diagnosis: the frontier model places the CG-shift mechanism in its top three hypotheses in 85-90% of trials, versus 60-78% for the best local model. Reasoning analysis indicates that local-model success is associated with following the complete diagnostic procedure, whereas weaker models often commit prematurely to elevator failure even though the actuator tracks its command. Diagnosis and operational decision performance do not appear to be coupled in this dataset. The contributions are an architecture extending unanticipated-fault recovery from detection to mitigation and an ensemble methodology for evaluating LLM-assisted mission management on low-power AUVs.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种AUV故障恢复架构，结合确定性分层控制与可调用的LLM作为诊断和恢复规划器，并开发SPAR仿真平台，通过480次试验评估不同LLM在质量偏移故障下的诊断与决策表现。
AI.motivation: 自主水下航行器在通信不可靠时需自主从故障中恢复，但传统确定性控制难以应对未预期故障；LLM可提供诊断与恢复规划，但其随机性要求严格的集成评估而非单次演示。
AI.method: 提出SPAR仿真架构，将实时C车辆软件与高层编排层结合，支持物理故障注入、结构化提示、LLM交互、任务文件生成、验证、执行和LLM评判评分。在480次质量偏移故障试验中，变化故障实现、提示结构、推理模型和任务条件，评估一个前沿模型和三个本地部署LLM。
AI.result: 模型选择主导诊断：前沿模型在85-90%的试验中将CG偏移机制列入前三假设，最佳本地模型为60-78%。本地模型成功与遵循完整诊断程序相关，弱模型常过早归因于升降舵故障。诊断与操作决策性能不耦合。
