AI.conclusion: 贡献在于扩展了未预期故障恢复从检测到缓解的架构，以及用于评估低功耗AUV上LLM辅助任务管理的集成方法。

title: SmellDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Quadruped Navigation with Olfactory Scene Graphs
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables, submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: A robot sent to a named gas leak must preserve gas identity, estimate the source, and navigate to the resulting goal. We present SmellDiffusion, a simulation pipeline that represents species-specific gas zones in an open-vocabulary olfactory scene graph and shares the selected goal between classical and diffusion planners. Its key components are a peak-local geometric gate for selective source correction and diffusion-based, gas-guided trajectory generation. Among 424 unique source-wind configurations in solved flow, 28 have a concentration peak displaced more than 0.5m from the source. A source-independent geometric gate, calibrated only on the training split and evaluated at the observed peak, detects 9 of 10 held-out displacements at 0.64 precision. Gating a precomputed forward-matching correction reduces mean error on the displaced cases from 1.468m to 0.592m (60%), using matching for only 14/204 cases. All-case mean error falls from 0.205m to 0.180m. All planners receive the same scene-graph source estimate as their goal. In a controlled comparison, best-of-ten diffusion achieves mean gas exposure comparable to gas-guided A* (0.0476 versus 0.0455). A single diffusion proposal takes 41.7ms, compared with 72.3ms for gas-guided A*, although best-of-ten sequential sampling increases total runtime. Plain A* also reaches the same goal and remains the fastest and shortest-path method. Six matched Gazebo runs give mean robot-to-source errors of 0.39m for A* and 0.31m for diffusion.

AI.tldr: SmellDiffusion 是一个面向指定气体泄漏源的机器人仿真流程，利用开放词汇嗅觉场景图表示特定气体区域，并在经典规划器与扩散规划器之间共享目标，结合峰值局部几何门控进行选择性源校正和气体引导扩散轨迹生成。
AI.motivation: 机器人被派往指定气体泄漏源时，需要保持气体身份、估计源位置并导航至目标。然而浓度峰值可能偏离真实源，导致源估计误差，因此需要选择性校正机制与更优的气体引导规划方法。
AI.method: 提出 SmellDiffusion 仿真流程：在开放词汇嗅觉场景图中表示不同气体区域，并将场景图源估计作为经典规划和扩散规划的共享目标。关键组件包括峰值局部几何门控和基于扩散的气体引导轨迹生成。评估涵盖424种源-风配置、留出的峰值位移案例，以及六次匹配的Gazebo运行。
AI.result: 在424种已求解源-风配置中，28例浓度峰值偏离源超过0.5m。源无关几何门控在留出位移上检测到9/10例，精度0.64；门控前向匹配校正将位移案例平均误差从1.468m降至0.592m（60%），仅对14/204案例使用匹配。全体案例平均误差从0.205m降至0.180m。最佳十次扩散的平均气体暴露与气体引导A*相当（0.0476对0.0455）。单次扩散提议耗时41.7ms，气体引导A*为72.3ms，但最佳十次顺序采样增加总运行时间。普通A*也能到达同一目标，且最快、路径最短。六次匹配Gazebo运行中，机器人到源平均误差A*为0.39m，扩散为0.31m。
AI.conclusion: SmellDiffusion 表明，选择性几何门控可有效校正峰值位移带来的源估计误差，扩散规划能在气体暴露上与气体引导A*相当，并在Gazebo中获得更低的最终源定位误差，但顺序采样带来运行时间权衡；经典A*仍是最快且路径最短的方法。

title: FlowSGS: Improving Flow Matching Priors for Inverse Imaging with Stochastic Interpolants
summary: Flow matching has emerged as the state-of-the-art generative model and has been used for plug-and-play (PnP) priors to solve inverse problems in computational imaging. However, existing flow-based inverse solvers assume linear forward models and/or make simplifying approximations in posterior sampling. To circumvent these problems, we introduce FlowSGS, a flow-based posterior sampling method using Split Gibbs Sampling (SGS) to decompose the posterior into a likelihood step and a prior step. Specifically, we sample from the likelihood step using Langevin dynamics and leverage the Stochastic Interpolants (SI) framework to integrate a pretrained flow model into the prior step. We provide a form for the prior step that uses SI's reverse-time SDE, and show connections to previous PnP methods. Moreover, with the aid of the flow prior's straight probability paths and a novel timestep correction technique for the reverse-time SDE, FlowSGS requires fewer network evaluations in its prior step than plug-and-play diffusion samplers. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on a range of inverse problems. For the first time, we provide an experiment on a nonlinear inverse problem (Fourier phase retrieval) for flow-based inverse solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlowSGS，一种基于流匹配和 Split Gibbs Sampling 的后验采样方法，用于求解计算成像逆问题。它将后验分解为似然步与先验步，并在多种逆问题上取得 SOTA 性能，且首次用于非线性傅里叶相位恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流的逆问题求解器通常假设线性前向模型，或在后验采样中引入简化近似，限制了其适用性和准确性。
AI.method: 使用 Split Gibbs Sampling 将后验分解为似然步和先验步；似然步采用 Langevin dynamics 采样；先验步基于 Stochastic Interpolants 框架整合预训练流模型，并利用其反向时间 SDE，提出时间步校正技术以减少网络评估次数。
AI.result: 在一系列逆问题上达到当前最优性能；相比 plug-and-play 扩散采样器，先验步所需网络评估更少；首次在非线性逆问题（傅里叶相位恢复）上验证基于流的逆求解器。
AI.conclusion: FlowSGS 有效克服了现有基于流的逆求解器对线性前向模型和简化后验采样的依赖，减少了计算开销，并将流匹配后验采样成功扩展到非线性逆问题。

title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
summary: Professional design requires any-color control: the ability to specify an object's target color with any 24-bit hex value for image generation and editing. Prior work has explored color generation, editing, and colorization, but often relies on dedicated color representations or specialized inference procedures. Advances in large language models offer a simpler starting point: even compact models can associate hex values with color semantics. We present Paint-Anything, which learns a shared hex-prompt interface for generation and editing through object-level color supervision. We develop a data pipeline that constructs Paint-500K from real images through object grounding, perceptual color labeling, and editing-pair synthesis. Since shadows make real-image labels only approximate colors, we complement this supervision with pure-color anchors whose pixels exactly match their paired hex values. These anchors are used only at high-noise timesteps, leaving low-noise training to natural images. We further introduce Any Color Benchmark (ACBench), comprising ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit, to measure object-level hex color fidelity across both tasks. On FLUX.2-4B, Paint-Anything improves ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit scores by 85.3% and 28.3%, respectively, relative to the base model, with ablations supporting the training recipe. It also achieves the highest average CompColor score among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Paint-Anything，通过共享的十六进制颜色提示接口，实现图像生成与编辑中对象级的任意颜色控制。
AI.motivation: 专业设计需要以任意24位十六进制值精确指定目标颜色；现有颜色生成、编辑与上色方法常依赖专用颜色表示或复杂推理流程，而大语言模型可自然关联十六进制值与颜色语义，提供了更简单的起点。
AI.method: 构建Paint-500K数据管道：基于真实图像进行对象定位、感知颜色标注与编辑对合成；针对阴影导致标签近似的问题，引入像素与十六进制值精确匹配的纯色锚点，仅在高噪声时间步使用；提出Any Color Benchmark（ACBench），含ACBench-T2I和ACBench-Edit，衡量对象级十六进制颜色保真度。
AI.result: 在FLUX.2-4B上，Paint-Anything使ACBench-T2I和ACBench-Edit分数分别较基模型提升85.3%和28.3%；消融实验支持该训练配方；在对比方法中取得最高平均CompColor分数。
AI.conclusion: Paint-Anything以共享十六进制提示接口有效实现对象级任意颜色的生成与编辑，所提出的数据与训练策略对颜色保真度提升显著。

title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
summary: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence. Most feed-forward methods infer articulation from a single observation and therefore rely heavily on learned category-level shape priors. We present FAMOS, a feed-forward model that predicts movable-part segmentation and joint parameters from a sparse, unordered set of partial point clouds. Our model jointly reasons over multiple observations and naturally supports a variable number of inputs, including a single view. To aggregate articulation cues across observations, we introduce a Multi-state Articulation Transformer with alternating state-wise and global attention. We further propose an observed articulation span objective that supervises the motion range each part exhibits across the input observations, encouraging the model to leverage the full observation set. To overcome the limited scale and diversity of existing datasets, we introduce a procedural data generator that synthesizes self-annotated assets during training. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility, ACD, and ArtiCraft-10K demonstrate consistent improvements over both feed-forward and optimization-based baselines. Project page: https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos

AI.tldr: 提出FAMOS，一种从稀疏、无序的部分点云集合中前馈预测可动部件分割和关节参数的模型，支持单视图或多视图输入。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏单目视图建模铰接物体很困难，因为每个观测只提供部分几何和运动信息；现有前馈方法多基于单观测并依赖类别级形状先验，限制其泛化与精度。
AI.method: 设计多状态铰接Transformer，通过交替的状态级注意力和全局注意力聚合多观测中的铰接线索；提出观测铰接跨度目标，监督各部件在输入观测中的运动范围；引入程序化数据生成器，在训练中合成自标注资产。
AI.result: 在PartNet-Mobility、ACD和ArtiCraft-10K数据集上，FAMOS持续优于前馈方法和基于优化的基线。
AI.conclusion: 联合推理多个观测并利用观测铰接跨度监督与程序化数据生成，能有效提升稀疏视图下铰接物体的可动部件分割和关节参数估计，且自然支持可变数量输入。

title: Should This Case Be Adapted? Prediction Fragmentation Controls Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Episodic test-time adaptation resets a frozen segmenter to source weights $M_0$ on each case and adapts for a fixed step count. A fixed horizon conflates a cohort-level question, how far to adapt, with an irreducibly per-case one, whether this case should be adapted at all. Cohort means hide that decision: on cross-vendor cardiac MRI the mean $Δ$Dice from adaptation is statistically indistinguishable from zero while 58.7% of cases are individually made worse. We quantify this harm as harmful accepted area (HA), the harmful fraction of the edited area a controller deploys. Held-out tuning gives a stronger baseline than a fixed horizon, but the budget it selects transfers on neither of the two main medical benchmarks, and no global budget can condition on the case. We show that prediction fragmentation---the disagreement geometry between $M_0$ and the adapted mask $M_k$---predicts HA with no labels or extra backward passes at decision time, comparably on three benchmarks (Spearman $ρ$ 0.50--0.60), at a quarter of gradient-norm's latency. A case-level router built on it cuts HA from 0.228 to 0.139 on a benchmark that took no part in its design, with the design frozen and only cut-points recalibrated there. On the cardiac benchmark the design was selected on, the router cuts HA from 0.129 to 0.013 at matched Dice and 1.10 deployed updates, against the retrospective-best budget found post hoc on evaluation labels, and reduces that 58.7% to 20.0%, an upper bound we quantify. Where the retained cases are not net-helped (as on prostate), the router still cuts HA but concedes accuracy, a boundary we report. Thresholds are fit once on a labeled split disjoint from evaluation; decisions use no labels or gradients. The template ports across architecture and domain (nnU-Net$\to$SegFormer, Cityscapes$\to$ACDC) with coordinate, thresholds and per-bucket actions instantiated per domain.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 episodic test-time adaptation 中固定适应步数会掩盖个体病例是否应被适应的问题，提出用预测碎片化（prediction fragmentation）作为无标签、无额外反向传播的病例级信号，构建路由器决定是否部署适应，从而显著减少有害编辑面积 HA。
AI.motivation: 固定适应 horizon 把“适应多远”的群体级问题与“该病例是否应适应”的个体级问题混在一起；群体平均 ΔDice 可能接近零，但跨厂商心脏 MRI 中 58.7% 病例被个体性地恶化，因此需要病例级决策来控制适应伤害。
AI.method: 定义 harmful accepted area (HA) 为控制器部署编辑区域中有害部分的比例；分析源权重 M0 与适应后掩码 Mk 之间的分歧几何，即 prediction fragmentation；基于该信号构建病例级 router，在决策时无需标签或梯度，阈值仅在独立标注划分上拟合一次，并验证跨架构与跨域迁移。
AI.result: prediction fragmentation 在三个 benchmark 上预测 HA 的 Spearman ρ 为 0.50–0.60，延迟约为 gradient-norm 的四分之一；在未参与设计的 benchmark 上 HA 从 0.228 降至 0.139；在心脏 benchmark 上 HA 从 0.129 降至 0.013，匹配 Dice 与 1.10 次部署更新，并优于事后最佳预算，58.7% 恶化病例降至 20.0%；在前列腺数据上 HA 仍下降但准确率让步。
AI.conclusion: 固定 horizon 不足以处理 episodic test-time adaptation 的个体差异；病例级 router 能有效减少适应伤害，且无需标签或梯度、可跨架构和域迁移；但其边界是当保留病例并非净受益时，路由会以牺牲准确率为代价来降低 HA。

title: RTK-Vision PPO for Autonomous Micro UAV Recovery on an Airborne Carrier
summary: Autonomous recovery of a micro unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) onto a moving airborne carrier enables reusable deploy-mission-recover operation, but couples long-range rendezvous, close-range perception, carrier motion, aerodynamic interaction, and a discontinuous contact event. This paper presents an RTK-vision-guided reinforcement-learning framework in which a child UAV is physically transported by a larger carrier, takes off from the carrier while airborne, executes an independent sortie, returns to the carrier's current position, redocks, and subsequently descends with the carrier. Both vehicles carry RTK-GNSS, and the carrier continuously shares its navigation state with the child. Near the recovery deck, RTK remains active while a downward-facing camera with a fiducial marker detector provides marker-relative alignment cues. A proximal policy optimization (PPO) policy governing the terminal recovery phase is trained in a physics-based MuJoCo simulation environment with explicit sensor noise models, an aerodynamic disturbance surrogate, and marker-latency randomization, then transferred to hardware. PX4 retains low-level stabilization, and a deterministic safety gate authorizes descent independently of the learned policy. The PPO checkpoint achieves 99.55% success over 2,000 held-out randomized terminal episodes, compared with 78.4% for a tuned PD baseline under identical conditions, with a median planar terminal error of 6.62 cm. Across 14 outdoor trials, the full mission succeeds in 13 trials (92.9%), spanning both near-region recovery and recovery after the carrier translates away from the release point. The results demonstrate a complete autonomous aerial deployment-and-recovery cycle rather than an isolated landing maneuver, establishing a practical basis for reusable carrier-child operation in inspection, surveillance, and mobile-logistics applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于RTK视觉引导的强化学习框架，实现微型无人机从移动空中载机上的自主回收，包括起飞、独立任务、返回、重新对接和随载机下降的完整循环。
AI.motivation: 实现可重复使用的部署-任务-回收操作，但面临远距离交会、近距离感知、载机运动、气动干扰和接触事件不连续等挑战。
AI.method: 采用RTK-GNSS与下视相机标记检测器提供相对定位，载机共享导航状态；终端回收阶段使用PPO策略，在MuJoCo物理仿真中训练，包含传感器噪声、气动干扰代理和标记延迟随机化，并迁移到硬件；PX4负责底层稳定，确定性安全门独立授权下降。
AI.result: PPO检查点在2000个保留随机终端回合中成功率达99.55%，优于调优PD基线的78.4%，中位平面终端误差6.62 cm；14次户外试验中完整任务成功13次（92.9%），涵盖近区域回收和载机偏离释放点后的回收。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了完整的自主空中部署-回收循环而非孤立着陆，为检查、监视和移动物流中的可重复使用载机-子机操作奠定了实用基础。

title: SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出SkipVLA混合策略，将预训练VLA与经典运动规划器结合：自由空间移动交给规划器，仅在抓取、放置等接触丰富技能时查询VLA，从而降低推理延迟与能耗。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽能直接由图像和语言指令生成机器人动作，但测试时速度慢，尤其长时程任务需频繁查询策略。现有加速方法（蒸馏、异步动作块、快慢策略）仍需对整段任务运行学习策略；而经典运动规划器虽快且能避障，却缺乏语义理解且需显式目标。
AI.method: SkipVLA用经典运动规划器负责自由空间运动，仅对接触丰富技能调用VLA。它复用VLA中冻结的视觉-语言主干来预测每次规划运动的目标位姿，并利用大VLA已有知识学习该预测器，无需引入额外演示数据。
AI.result: 在仿真中基于三种VLA评估13个LIBERO任务，并在真实6-DoF YAM机械臂上测试三个抓放任务。相比基线，任务完成速度最高提升2.5倍，能耗显著降低，同时保持相同任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将VLA的语义能力与经典运动规划的快速避障能力结合，可有效加速长时程机器人任务并降低能耗，且不牺牲成功率，为VLA实际部署提供高效方案。

title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
summary: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 workspace token：在训练时利用 VLM 提取任务相关的当前与历史信息，并通过集合重建解码器损失蒸馏为轻量潜在记忆；部署时无需在环 VLM 推理，可作为观测的替代品用于机器人操作策略。
AI.motivation: 复杂机器人操作任务需要长期记忆，但直接使用完整历史会使策略容易学到伪相关并降低性能；现有方法常依赖昂贵的 VLM 在环查询来压缩历史信息，计算开销大。
AI.method: 训练阶段使用 VLM 识别完成当前和历史任务所需的信息，再通过 set-reconstruction decoder loss 将这些信息蒸馏到轻量的 workspace token 中；部署阶段直接查询该 token，作为观测的 drop-in replacement，无需 VLM 在环推理。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实硬件上，workspace token 使策略能够在没有 VLM 在环推理的情况下解决记忆密集型任务；并且它不仅更轻量，还带来了更好的策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 将重计算 VLM 查询移到训练时、学习可高效查询的轻量潜在记忆，是替代部署时 VLM 推理的有效方案；workspace token 能提升记忆密集型机器人操作策略的效率与表现。

title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
summary: Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了ERCPMP-Gx数据集，这是一个包含内镜、组织病理学和基因组学数据的结直肠息肉病数据集，旨在支持人工智能在识别、表征和分类中的应用。数据集包含160张图像和视频片段，约80%为遗传性息肉病综合征，20%为非遗传性息肉。每个记录关联了内镜注释、组织病理学和种系发现。数据集公开可用。
AI.motivation: 遗传性息肉病综合征是结直肠癌的前驱病变，并与多种结肠外肿瘤相关。早期识别和准确分类对于及时诊断、个性化管理和针对性监测至关重要。然而，公共内镜数据集主要围绕散发性息肉组织，没有在患者层面将息肉病表型与组织病理学和种系发现联系起来。
AI.method: 研究人员开发了ERCPMP-Gx数据集，使用Olympus EVIS X1系统进行WLE、NBI、放大NBI和近聚焦NBI检查，获得160张图像和视频。数据集包括约80%经临床和/或遗传确认的遗传性息肉病综合征（FAP、PJS、JPS、GNS）和20%非遗传性息肉及类似病变。每个记录关联标准化内镜注释、代表性组织病理学和临床报告的种系发现。
AI.result: 该数据集形成了一个AI就绪的、患者级别的注释框架，并公开可用（Mendeley和DataBioX网站）。
AI.conclusion: ERCPMP-Gx数据集支持人工智能在结直肠息肉病的识别、表征和分类中的应用。

title: TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces
summary: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a flow-matching action expert generates each action chunk (a short command sequence) by integrating a learned velocity field; once its weights are fixed, the success or failure of an earlier rollout cannot change the chunk generated now. Concurrent test-time methods give a frozen policy such an input from retrieved successes, a learned critic, a verifier, or a dynamics model, but none uses the robot's own failed rollouts as negative evidence with nothing but a terminal outcome bit. We introduce TraceFlow, a progress-aligned guidance field that turns the action densities of retrieved successful and failed rollouts into a bounded correction to a frozen flow-matching action expert, using one terminal outcome bit per rollout and no other label. Its TraceBank stores traces, time-ordered state-action records with a terminal label, starts from the target-task training traces, and later admits the deployed robot's own rollouts. On an ordered real-robot packing task the base completes 21 of 50 trials in order, TraceFlow 39, and one stacking round without any weight update 47, with wrong-sequence episodes falling from 20 to 0. In simulation the gain is selective: with per-suite selected settings, TraceFlow raises RoboMemArena Sequence from 78.92\% to 91.50\% task success and Transferring from 54.41\% to 62.00\% at stacking round 2, leaves the 26-task aggregate unchanged, lowers Counting and Occlusion by 1.12 and 1.42 points, and changes LIBERO-Plus (Long) by +1.27 points (p = 0.0733). Stacking gains are finite, every branch peaking before round ten, and the bank's success-to-failure ratio predicts no retrieval allocation.

AI.tldr: 提出 TraceFlow：一种进度对齐的引导场，将检索到的成功与失败轨迹的动作密度转化为对冻结 flow-matching 动作专家的有界修正，仅使用每条 rollout 的终端成败位，无需更新权重。配合 TraceBank 存储时序状态-动作轨迹，在真实机器人和仿真任务中提升部分序列任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 冻结的 VLA 策略与 flow-matching 动作专家在权重固定后，早期 rollout 的成败无法影响当前动作块生成。现有测试时方法虽引入检索成功、critic、verifier 或动力学模型，但未把机器人自身失败 rollout 作为负证据，也未做到仅依赖终端结果位。
AI.method: TraceFlow 使用 TraceBank 存储带终端标签的时序状态-动作记录，初始来自目标任务训练轨迹，后续加入部署机器人自身 rollout。它把检索到的成功与失败 rollout 的动作密度转为有界修正，引导冻结的 flow-matching 动作专家；每条 rollout 只需一个终端成败位，无需其他标签或权重更新。
AI.result: 真实机器人有序打包任务中，基础方法 50 次按序完成 21 次，TraceFlow 完成 39 次，一次堆叠轮且无权重更新完成 47 次，错误序列从 20 降至 0。仿真中增益有选择性：RoboMemArena Sequence 从 78.92% 升至 91.50%，Transferring 从 54.41% 升至 62.00%（stacking round 2）；26 任务总体不变，Counting 与 Occlusion 分别下降 1.12 和 1.42 点，LIBERO-Plus（Long）变化 +1.27 点（p=0.0733）。堆叠增益有限，各分支在第十轮前达峰；成功失败比不能预测检索分配。
AI.conclusion: TraceFlow 能仅凭终端结果位利用成功与失败轨迹，对冻结 flow-matching 动作专家进行测试时引导，无需权重更新。它在部分序列与长时任务上有效，但收益具有选择性且有限，检索分配并非由成功失败比决定。

title: SplashSplat: Reconstructing Splashing Liquids from Real-World Multi-View Videos
comment: 18 pages (11 main + 7 supplementary), 14 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://niko-creater.github.io/splashsplat-web/
summary: A splash lives for a fraction of a second: sheets tear into ligaments and droplets, appearance is view-dependent and nearly textureless, and little persists long enough to track. Reconstruction research has consequently focused on smoke, synthetic liquids, or gently deforming surfaces. To our knowledge, no synchronized multi-view dataset of splashing liquids exists. We therefore introduce a benchmark of 20 real scenes, from coherent streams to violent splashes, captured by seven synchronized, calibrated 4K cameras at 60 fps, with manually refined per-view liquid and container masks and fixed evaluation splits. We further present SplashSplat, built on a single principle: impose physical structure only where the observations can constrain it. Per-frame liquid SDFs fused from the masks provide the geometry, level-set transport between consecutive SDFs yields a coarse velocity field, and Lagrangian carriers advected along this flow, corrected against each new observation and reseeded where coverage is lost, decode local Gaussians for differentiable rendering. SplashSplat outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic Gaussian splatting methods on our real captures and on a synthetic benchmark, with physically more plausible motion and a lower training cost. The same representation supports temporal interpolation and style transfer without re-optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个同步多视角飞溅液体数据集，并提出了SplashSplat方法，用于从多视角视频中重建动态飞溅液体，在真实和合成数据上优于现有动态高斯泼溅方法。
AI.motivation: 飞溅液体持续时间极短、易破碎成液丝和液滴、外观依赖视角且近乎无纹理，现有重建研究多集中于烟雾、合成液体或缓慢变形表面，缺乏同步多视角真实飞溅液体数据集。
AI.method: 构建20个真实场景的基准数据集，使用7台同步标定4K相机以60fps采集，并提供逐视角液体与容器掩码及固定评估划分。提出SplashSplat：仅在观测可约束处施加物理结构；每帧液体SDF由掩码融合得到，相邻SDF间的水平集传输产生粗略速度场，拉格朗日载体沿流场推进，并通过新观测校正、在覆盖丢失处重新播种，解码局部高斯进行可微渲染。
AI.result: SplashSplat在真实采集和合成基准上均优于最先进的动态高斯泼溅方法，运动更符合物理且训练成本更低；同一表示还支持无需重新优化的时间插值与风格迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了真实飞溅液体多视角数据集的空白，并表明仅在观测可约束处引入物理结构，可有效重建复杂飞溅液体动态，同时具备更低训练成本和额外编辑能力。

title: Can 4D Foundation Models Remember?
summary: Perceiving and remembering the visual world is fundamental to navigating and interacting with our environment. Current 4D foundation models, such as camera-controllable video models or 4D reconstruction models, can perceive and reconstruct dynamic environments, but how well they remember what they have perceived remains an open question. Existing benchmarks largely rely on pixel-level metrics and lack ground truth for objects once they leave the field of view, making them unable to evaluate visual memory in an object-centric manner against references. To fill this gap, we introduce PersistBench, a dataset and metric suite that leverages 360° videos as omniscient ground truth and proposes three evaluation aspects: object permanence, motion continuity, and appearance preservation. Evaluating various models across diverse categories reveals that current models can only maintain short-term consistency that degrades significantly once objects leave the field of view. Our findings highlight the gap between current model capabilities and robust visual memory ("seeing is not remembering"), providing guidance for future development of 4D foundation models. Dataset and code are available on the project page: https://guangzhaohe.com/persistbench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PersistBench，一个利用 360° 视频作为全知真值的基准数据集与指标套件，从物体恒存性、运动连续性和外观保持性三个维度评估 4D 基础模型的视觉记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 4D 基础模型（如可控摄像机视频模型、4D 重建模型）能感知和重建动态环境，但其记忆能力尚不明确；现有基准多依赖像素级指标，且缺乏物体离开视野后的真值，无法以物体为中心、对照参考来评估视觉记忆。
AI.method: 构建 PersistBench 数据集与指标套件，以 360° 视频作为全知真值，提出三个评估方面：物体恒存性、运动连续性、外观保持性，并对多种类别的模型进行评测。
AI.result: 评估发现当前模型仅能维持短期一致性，一旦物体离开视野，一致性显著下降；揭示了模型能力与稳健视觉记忆之间的差距，即“看见不等于记住”。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来 4D 基础模型的发展提供了指导方向，数据集与代码已在项目主页公开。

title: DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
comment: Accept to IROS 2026 Workshop RoBoWoMo (Lightning Talk)
summary: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

AI.tldr: 提出 DexTouch-WM，一种动作条件世界模型，可利用可扩展的人类触觉数据，联合预测未来 RGB 观测与双手触觉动态，并迁移到机器人灵巧操作中。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的灵巧操作预测模型依赖密集触觉交互，但真实机器人数据采集成本高且受限于特定传感器与本体，难以规模化。
AI.method: 在人类和灵巧机器人手上部署共享传感布局的柔性压阻阵列，将人类运动重定向到机器人动作空间，使人类交互可监督同一动态模型；模型耦合预训练视频专家与轻量触觉专家，并使用解剖感知触觉 token 和对齐的动作条件。
AI.result: 在人类到机器人的扩展实验中，固定 5 小时真实机器人监督，将人类交互从 0 增加到 100 小时，在未见机器人域上的视觉、几何和接触预测均显著提升，且人类与机器人任务集不重叠。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的人类交互可作为学习灵巧机器人世界模型的补充数据维度；该世界模型还能作为策略评估的替代环境，并生成合成轨迹用于真实机器人策略学习。

title: Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions
comment: Accepted to I-RIM 3D 2026 and it will be published in SPAR series
summary: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文为混合空中-水上无人机扩展了PX4固件，新增手动与自主水面导航模式，并集成到标准PX4任务流程与QGroundControl中，实现空中与水上任务的统一规划与执行。
AI.motivation: 测绘与监测水域环境需要能够结合飞行和水面航行的混合空中-水上无人机，但现有PX4固件缺乏对这类平台的水面导航及混合任务支持。
AI.method: 在PX4固件中扩展实现手动和自主水面导航模式，将其接入标准PX4任务管线与QGroundControl界面，同时保留原有飞行功能和安全机制，并支持区分空中与水面航点的混合任务规划。
AI.result: 仿真案例验证了实现方案，表明在平静和有浪条件下均能实现稳定的水面导航。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在不破坏原有飞行功能与安全机制的前提下，支持混合空中-水上任务的统一规划与执行，为水域测绘与监测应用提供了可行方案。

title: Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies
summary: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

AI.tldr: 提出 Movement Trend Guidance，从短观测历史中学习交互演化潜表示，为3D扩散策略提供未来导向条件，在多个仿真与真实任务上显著优于DP3。
AI.motivation: 现有3D扩散策略主要根据当前观测生成几何上可行的动作，缺乏对交互未来走向的预见；而成功操作不仅需要知道当前可行运动，还需要预判交互将如何发展。已有方法大多让这种预见从动作学习中隐式涌现。
AI.method: 从短观测历史学习紧凑的交互演化潜表示；训练时用稀疏的未来夹爪状态监督该表示；推理时仅保留该潜表示作为未来导向条件，与当前观测一起用于动作生成。潜表示提供全局条件，并在UNet瓶颈处加入门控FiLM分支。方法仅增加3.52%参数，保留DP3原有的密集动作与滚动时域形式。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin2.0、LIBERO-40和DexArt上持续优于DP3：RoboTwin2.0 50任务混合训练达到62.8% vs 56.1%；LIBERO-40达到71.93% vs 37.08%；五个真实机器人任务达到72.0% vs 49.0%。
AI.conclusion: 扩散策略可以从“知道交互将走向何处”中获得显著收益，而无需显式规划或被告知具体移动目标。

title: Towards Scaling Marine Perception with Synthetic Data
summary: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了基于IsaacSim的水下感知模拟器OceanSim，加入合成数据生成管线，用于生成大规模、自动标注、可配置的水下数据集，并在真实海胆检测任务上评估合成场景变化对仿真到现实迁移性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 水下环境中的可扩展机器学习受限于缺乏标注的真实世界训练数据，且真实数据采集与整理成本高、难度大，因此需要利用模拟数据来缩小差距。
AI.method: 在OceanSim基础上提出合成数据生成管线，支持生成照片级真实感、自动标注、可配置场景外观、结构和传感器设置的大规模数据集；在真实海胆检测任务上进行评估，并研究不同合成场景变化对sim-to-real性能的影响。
AI.result: 通过实验讨论了合成场景变化对仿真到现实迁移性能的影响，总结了当前管线的主要局限，并识别出提升水下渲染保真度、场景多样性和sim-to-real泛化评估的未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 该合成数据生成管线有助于水下感知模型的训练与仿真到现实迁移研究，代码已开源，但当前仍存在渲染保真度、场景多样性及泛化评估方面的限制。

title: HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning
summary: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOPHY，一种基于超图的可复用分层越野地形表示，将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通的语义区域、保持连通性的关键区域以及带类型的超边，从而支持高效路径与任务规划。
AI.motivation: 灾害响应、搜救和战术UGV等任务需要在地形、智能体类型和目标变化时反复进行路径与任务规划；像素网格搜索在公里级重复查询中代价高，而语义抽象需在条件变化时维持有效代价与连通性。
AI.method: HOPHY构建分层地形表示：GSNodes表示几何连通的语义区域，Coarse Regions表示保持连通性的关键区域，并用类型化超边编码地形、智能体和天气上下文；通过超边交集选择受影响区域和关联边进行状态更新，而无需重建整个层次结构。
AI.result: 在公里级真实越野地图上，HOPHY实现100%规划成功，与oracle（像素A*）相比中位代价偏差低于0.01%，查询和重规划延迟显著低于像素与抽象基线；在多机器人任务分配中，总计算量较像素A*减少79倍、较最快抽象基线减少7.2倍，任务总完成时间与像素A*相当；并在Clearpath Jackal实体机器人上成功执行1.5公里、八任务混合地表户外任务及阻塞触发的重规划路线。
AI.conclusion: HOPHY能够以可复用的分层超图表示，在保持接近像素级最优代价和连通性的同时显著降低重复规划与任务分配计算开销，并具备实体机器人长距离多任务越野部署能力。

title: MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band
summary: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGNETAR，从单次异步射频多径快照（包含到达角和信噪比估计）推断发射器平面位置与朝向的联合后验分布。
AI.motivation: 机器人定位无线电发射器时，仅用点估计不够：在杂乱房间中，一次测量可能对应多个发射器位置，且由于中高频段天线具有方向性，还可能对应多个朝向。因此需要推断位置与朝向的联合后验。
AI.method: 采用五种神经评分器，最终选用共享2D U-Net，以每个候选朝向为条件，在离散化的位置-朝向网格上联合归一化评分。训练使用真实到仿真校准的10 GHz仿真数据以及少量实测数据。
AI.result: 在留出仿真中，基于网格的联合后验优于参数化方法；朝向条件评分器在机器人实测中迁移效果最好；融合联合后验优于融合仅位置边际。
AI.conclusion: MAGNETAR能有效推断发射器位置与朝向的联合后验，网格化联合建模和朝向条件设计有助于提升实际机器人测量中的性能。

title: MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出MoWAM，一种高效的世界动作模型，用显式未来运动预测替代推理时的未来视频生成，从而提升机器人策略学习效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型通过融入未来动态来改进机器人策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频计算开销巨大；若移除未来生成，未来动态只能隐式编码在观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: MoWAM将结构化机器人运动建模为未来紧凑抽象，而非重建完整未来场景；采用Mixture-of-Transformer架构，在训练中学习未来视觉动态并联合预测运动与动作，推理时完全去除视频生成；同时利用紧凑运动表示进行推理时缩放，采样多组运动-动作候选，并用运动感知任务进度验证器进行选择。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM取得强分布内性能、更好的分布外鲁棒性，以及高于代表性WAM基线的真实世界平均成功率；且随着候选数量增加，性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式未来运动为推理时缩放提供了有效且高效的基础，使模型在无需视频生成的情况下仍能保留对未来的显式表示。

title: MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving
summary: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

AI.tldr: 提出MILER端到端策略框架，通过自定义语义中层表示模拟器和轨迹对齐策略，实现非结构化环境下感知与控制的零样本sim-to-real迁移，并在真实车辆上完成无人干预测试。
AI.motivation: 强化学习具有超越人类表现和自主学习策略的潜力，但在真实世界自动驾驶中应用仍少，尤其在非结构化环境中，主要受限于sim-to-real迁移困难。
AI.method: 离线训练阶段，使用自定义语义中层表示（MLR）模拟器，以强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型。实车部署时，用BEVFusion处理相机和LiDAR数据，生成与MLR模拟器一致的语义鸟瞰图表示。策略网络生成的动作不直接用于实车，而是采用轨迹对齐策略，实现感知和控制的零样本sim-to-real迁移。整套软件栈运行在Jetson AGX Orin上。
AI.result: 在包含多种障碍物、发夹弯、最高33.6 km/h速度及越野路段的多样化测试赛道上评估。两辆不同车辆在3.0 km测试赛道上无人工干预行驶17.3 km，验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: MILER能够有效实现非结构化环境下端到端自动驾驶策略的零样本sim-to-real迁移，并在真实车辆上表现出良好性能。

title: OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher
summary: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

AI.tldr: 提出OPTED，将强化学习从端到端驾驶策略的后训练中解耦：先用向量化输入训练特权教师，再用教师监督预训练学生在闭环中微调；在AlpaSim中使TransFuser和VaVAM驾驶分数分别提升1.6倍和9.5倍。
AI.motivation: 单纯扩大预训练数据收益递减，后训练在自动驾驶等物理AI领域愈发重要。端到端驾驶策略通常通过人类演示进行开环行为克隆预训练，但闭环部署时误差累积会使车辆偏离训练分布，增加安全风险。闭环后训练可缓解该问题，但基于传感器的策略需要昂贵仿真。
AI.method: OPTED将强化学习与端到端策略后训练解耦：在HD地图和边界框等向量化输入上，用RL训练特权教师；教师再在闭环后训练中为预训练学生提供监督。作者将OPTED应用于TransFuser和VaVAM两个相机模型，并在AlpaSim中使用真实驾驶日志的3DGS神经重建进行微调，同时与直接RL后训练进行对照实验。
AI.result: 两个相机模型的驾驶分数分别提升1.6倍和9.5倍。对照实验中，OPTED以约少三个数量级的仿真器交互达到与直接RL后训练相当的闭环性能，同时更接近人类先验。
AI.conclusion: OPTED能够高效提升端到端驾驶策略的闭环性能，显著减少仿真交互需求，并更好保持与人类驾驶先验的一致性，为物理AI中的闭环后训练提供可行方案。

title: Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control
summary: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于自主水下航行器的立体视觉伺服框架，通过稳定深度感知与解耦控制实现水下目标跟踪。
AI.motivation: 水下视觉目标跟踪面临深度测量不可靠和目标运动未知的问题，传统方法难以稳定获取三维相对状态并实时控制。
AI.method: 感知上，利用颜色、视差和时间线索构建目标深度掩膜，选择可靠目标像素，并分别对深度测量和图像中心进行卡尔曼滤波，得到稳定三维相对状态；控制上，解耦偏航调节与平移控制，采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合恒速与零速目标模型，并基于历史预测误差更新模型权重，在驱动、跟随距离和视场约束下计算平移指令。
AI.result: 通过仿真和真实实验验证了框架的有效性，并表明其性能优于现有框架。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的立体视觉伺服框架能够提升水下目标跟踪的可靠性与实时性，适用于AUV自主目标跟踪任务。

title: Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TARO，一种用于接触丰富机器人控制的敏捷触觉世界行动模型（World Action Model）。它通过多时间尺度多模态预测，联合生成动作块和未来视觉/触觉潜变量，在仿真和真实任务中实现了高成功率和低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 近期触觉世界行动模型依赖大规模预训练生成骨干网络来捕捉接触丰富的物理动力学，这限制了推理效率和灵活部署。
AI.method: TARO将视觉和触觉观测编码到共享潜空间，直接进行视觉-触觉到动作的流匹配过程，联合生成动作块和未来视觉/触觉潜变量。针对视觉和触觉信号时间尺度不同（视觉帧间相似，触觉在接触时突变），引入多时间尺度多模态预测：对视觉潜变量使用较大时间偏移的监督，对触觉潜变量预测下一帧以捕捉细粒度接触动力学。
AI.result: 在九个仿真和五个真实世界接触丰富操作任务中，TARO成功率高且推理延迟低。在五个真实实验中，总体成功率相对提升29.4%，推理延迟为11.9毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 多模态世界行动模型可以通过敏捷架构实现，适用于精确且高频率的机器人控制。

title: StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation
summary: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出StageGuard，一种智能体蒸馏框架，用于分层机器人规划中准确高效地判断子任务完成与技能切换，通过教师模型推理与演示轨迹生成结构化解释，蒸馏到轻量学生VLM实现实时监控。
AI.motivation: 现有分层规划框架依赖难以获取的预设计完成信号检查器；大规模视觉语言模型虽有强推理能力，但其决策边界与任务完成标准不天然对齐，且云端部署与长推理带来高延迟，限制实时监控。
AI.method: StageGuard结合教师模型推理与演示轨迹生成子任务完成和策略切换的结构化解释；轻量学生VLM基于这些解释生成紧凑自解释，并用于监督微调，从而支持在线阶段转换预测。
AI.result: 在两个基准轨迹上评估阶段转换预测，并通过集成到BEHAVIOR-1K分层机器人控制中评估闭环任务成功率，同时在真实机器人上验证；结果显示阶段转换预测显著提升，并支持高效在线监控。
AI.conclusion: StageGuard能实现准确且高效的阶段转换决策，提升分层机器人长时程任务执行能力，并具备实际部署潜力。
